Volledige aanvragen en beschikkingen worden niet actief openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht ‘Qatar Airways CEO says aviation industry will miss 2050 net zero target’

MP Van Raan asked the minister to respond to Qatar Airways CEO claims that the aviation industry will miss its 2050 net zero target and that its targets are a PR exercise, unrealistic and not achievable. The minister rejected these analyses, pointed to binding Dutch, EU and ICAO targets and instruments such as the CO2 ceiling, ReFuelEU and the EU ETS, and said the sector can decarbonise without shrinking.
The Netherlands, the EU and ICAO have set various climate targets for aviation that have been made concrete, for example through the national CO2 ceiling, the EU ETS or ReFuelEU.
Nederland, de EU en ICAO hebben verschillende klimaatdoelen voor de luchtvaart gesteld, welke geconcretiseerd zijn, zoals bijvoorbeeld met het nationale CO 2 -plafond, het EU ETS of ReFuelEU.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over directe en indirecte lozingen en/of afvalinjecties onder de Waddenzee

MPs Van Esch and Van Raan asked about direct and indirect discharges and waste injection of oil and gas production water under the Wadden Sea, including legal storage duties, alternatives, and whether NAM could be denied new permits if prosecuted. The state secretary answered that no waste is injected under the Wadden Sea, that reporting on production water exists, and that he cannot anticipate prosecution consequences for future permit decisions.
I cannot anticipate a possible prosecution of NAM and its possible consequences for future permit granting.
Ik kan niet vooruitlopen op een mogelijke vervolging van NAM en de eventuele gevolgen daarvan voor toekomstige vergunningverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het aan banden leggen van ChatGPT in Italië vanwege privacyzorgen en de consequenties hiervan voor Nederland

An MP asked the government about Italy's temporary ban on ChatGPT over privacy concerns, possible GDPR breaches, a reported data leak, and what this means for the Netherlands and the Dutch privacy regulator. The minister answered that the Dutch regulator (AP) is part of the EDPB taskforce, no breach involving Dutch users was reported to the AP, and enforcement and prioritisation are for the independent supervisor, while the government is preparing an AI vision.
It is up to the AP to supervise the processing of personal data by companies and to pick up signals when the rules are violated.
Het is aan de AP om toezicht te houden op de verwerking van persoonsgegevens door bedrijven en signalen op te pikken wanneer de regels worden overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Vestering over het artikel van SchipholWatch van 27 maart jl., getiteld ‘Onderhoud Schiphol loopt wéér uit, bewoners nog langer in de herrie’

MPs Van Raan and Vestering asked why Schiphol's runway maintenance was delayed again, whether the minister had intervened despite warnings, whether nitrogen emissions from maintenance traffic and equipment were assessed, and what action will be taken. The minister replied that Schiphol is responsible for planning and execution, that weather buffers were built in, that the 'bestaand recht' from 1994 covers the maintenance, and that Schiphol's processes will be evaluated without committing to sanctions.
Schiphol is responsible for the planning and execution of the maintenance work at Schiphol.
Schiphol is verantwoordelijk voor de planning en uitvoering van de onderhoudswerkzaamheden op Schiphol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Akerboom en Van Raan over Nederlandse investeringen in een oliepijplijn in Oeganda met grote risico’s voor mens, dier en natuur

MPs Akerboom and Van Raan asked the government about Dutch investment in the EACOP oil pipeline in Uganda, covering land displacement, arrests of protesters, CO2 emissions, and Dutch financial institutions' investments in TotalEnergies. The minister answered that the government does not assess the project itself, relies on companies and financial institutions to apply due diligence, and defers to Uganda's sovereignty, while promising to raise human rights concerns and pursue EU and national IMVO legislation.
The cabinet does not make its own assessment of the consequences of this project.
Het kabinet maakt geen eigen appreciatie van de gevolgen van dit project
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg, Vestering, Van Esch en Van Raan over het adequaat beschermen van kwetsbare en unieke natuur en koraal op en rondom de BES-eilanden

MPs from the Party for the Animals asked how a motion to halt irreversible building steps at Plantage Bolivia on Bonaire, port expansion near Hato, coral damage, and enforcement against coastal construction on Sint Eustatius were being implemented. The government answered that no irreversible steps are legally possible before the environmental impact assessment is complete, that the port and coral issues will be examined in the MER, and that the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport report on local enforcement capacity and related follow-ups will be sent by end May 2023.

Since the revision of the Bonaire spatial development plan will not be started in procedure until the MER has been established and assessed, I note that it is currently not legally possible to take irreversible steps.

Aangezien de herziening van het Ruimtelijke Ordeningsplan Bonaire (ROB) niet in procedure worden gebracht, zolang de MER niet is vastgesteld en beoordeeld, constateer ik dat het op dit moment juridisch niet mogelijk is om onomkeerbare stappen te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Van Raan over dassenburchten onder en rondom het spoor

MPs Vestering and Van Raan ask the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen about badger setts under and near railway tracks, including whether ProRail knew of them, whether badgers are protected, the risks of excavation, and external threats to badger populations. The minister answers that badgers are protected under the Wet natuurbescherming, that ProRail monitors about 40 sites with a three-scenario protocol and an exemption-based approach, that an evaluation with other parties will follow, and that the Brabant sett was excavated with safeguards and no badgers were found or killed.
IenW and ProRail will evaluate, following the problems in Molkwerum and Esch, with the other involved parties how it came to the point where no trains could run.
IenW en ProRail gaan naar aanleiding van de problemen in Molkwerum en Esch evalueren met de andere betrokken partijen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de kosten tot nu toe van de arbitragezaak die Uniper tegen Nederland heeft aangespannen

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy for a full breakdown of costs in the Uniper and RWE ICSID arbitrations against the Netherlands, how costs are split after withdrawal, and why international arbitration costs are so much higher than domestic litigation. The minister gave itemised cost figures, said costs are paid from the energy market budget, reported that the tribunal rejected the state's request for costs against Uniper so each party bears its own, and explained that arbitration procedures are more extensive than domestic civil cases.
The tribunal rejected the State's request to order Uniper to pay the costs, as it found no grounds for this.
Het tribunaal heeft het verzoek van de Staat om Uniper in de kosten te veroordelen afgewezen, omdat zij oordeelde dat hiervoor geen gronden aanwezig waren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over de explosieve uitkomsten van het onderzoek van het Amerikaanse House Committee on Oversight and Reform naar de klimaatontwrichtende investeringsplannen van de li

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan asked the ministers whether they know of, and how they will respond to, US House Oversight Committee findings that major fossil fuel firms plan to keep investing in oil and gas and engage in greenwashing, and whether the government will hold these companies to account, demand Paris-aligned investment plans, or investigate similar conduct in the Netherlands. The ministers answered that the government expects firms to meet Paris goals through binding bilateral agreements and carbon pricing, cannot dictate strategies to international companies, will not summon them or investigate Dutch conduct, and will not make Paris alignment a condition for subsidies.
I will not summon these companies following the American investigation.
Ik zal deze bedrijven naar aanleiding van het Amerikaanse onderzoek niet op het matje roepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het gelijkwaardigheidscriteria in de Wet Luchtvaart

An MP asked the minister whether the Aviation Act's equivalence criteria for Schiphol airport (noise, external safety, local air pollution) bar any later decision from worsening protection relative to the first 2003 decisions, and sought emissions data and related details. The minister confirmed the equivalence rule applies on an annual, net ('per saldo') basis, reported emissions and enforcement figures showing no breach in 2019, and committed to later sharing the permit application with the Chamber.
As indicated in the answer to question 3, the statutory framework of RBML has applied to these airports since 2009.
Zoals in het antwoord op vraag 3 aangegeven geldt voor deze luchthavens sinds 2009 het wettelijk kader van RBML.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Van Raan over de door Schiphol en Rijkswaterstaat opgekochte ‘stikstofruimte’ ten goede laten komen aan de natuur en daarmee de Europese natuurbeschermingswet naleven

Two MPs (Vestering and Van Raan, PvdD) asked whether nitrogen capacity bought up by Schiphol and Rijkswaterstaat should instead be used for nature restoration under the Habitats Directive, and whether external netting (extern salderen) should be banned. The minister answered that external netting is an accepted mitigation measure, that provinces cannot simply force the nitrogen capacity to nature, and that the government will tighten rules but will not ban external netting.
No, I do not intend to ban external netting.
Nee, ik ben niet voornemens om extern salderen te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht ‘Megaclaim gloort in slepend arbeidsgeschil bij de KLM’

An MP asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers about a reported 478 million euro legal claim against KLM by Martinair pilots, and whether the state knew of it when approving a loan and state aid. The government answered that KLM, not the state, assesses and provides for the claim (22 million euro provision), that the state is not a party, and that it will monitor cost reductions under the aid conditions without taking a direct role.
The Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management are not parties to this legal dispute and its aftermath; it is a matter between KLM and the Martinair pilots group.

Het Ministerie van Financiën en het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat zijn geen partij in dit juridische conflict en de nasleep daarvan, dat is iets tussen KLM en de groep Martinair-piloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch, Vestering en Van Raan over het bericht 'Havermelk duurder door 'limonadebelasting''

Three PvdD MPs asked whether the planned increase in the beverage consumption tax, which exempts dairy drinks but taxes most plant-based milk drinks, is consistent with health and protein policy, and whether the exemption for sugary dairy drinks will be removed. The government confirmed the budget-driven increase, defended the dairy exemption on nutritional grounds, and said a study on sugar taxation is ongoing with results due in 2023, without committing to specific changes.
It is correct that the consumption tax on non-alcoholic drinks (hereinafter: consumption tax) is being increased.
Het klopt dat de verbruiksbelasting van alcoholvrije dranken (hierna: verbruiksbelasting) wordt verhoogd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht 'Campaigners urge EU to rethink green investment label’

An MP asked the minister whether the European Commission plans to label investment in new aircraft as climate-friendly, and whether this is credible given fossil-fuel aviation. The minister answered that the Commission has not formally decided, that the EU platform recommended treating new efficient aircraft as a transition activity, and that the government will keep pressing the Commission for realistic criteria and will assess a concrete proposal when it is tabled.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Raan over de Uitvoeringsagenda Internationale Sociale Voorwaarden (ISV)

An MP asked why the government's International Social Conditions (ISV) implementation agenda lacks measurable targets, timelines and responsible departments for procurement, and whether it will impose stronger obligations. The minister answered that research on targets, sector scope and award criteria is underway with completion targeted for Q4 2023, and that the approach mixes support measures with an examination of mandatory use.
The aim is to complete this research in Q4 2023.
Het streven is dit onderzoek in Q4 2023 af te ronden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de SLAPP (Strategic Lawsuit Against Public Participation) tactiek van reisorganisatie TUI tegen natuurorganisatie STINAPA (Stichting Nationale Parken Bonaire)

MPs Van Raan and Vestering asked whether TUI's threat of legal action against STINAPA, which had flagged that the Chogogo resort on Bonaire lacked proper permits and a compliant seawall, amounts to a SLAPP tactic, and asked how the government would enforce and remedy the sand runoff damaging coral. The government answered that a compliance order (last onder dwangsom) was imposed on the permit holder, that whether the threat is an abuse of procedure is for the courts, that the EU anti-SLAPP directive is still under negotiation, and that enforcement and coral-restoration measures are being pursued with the Bonaire public body.
The Bonaire executive board informed the permit holder that the construction height does not meet the requirements in the permit.
Het bestuurscollege van Bonaire heeft de vergunninghouder medegedeeld dat de bouwhoogte niet voldoet aan de eisen in de vergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de uitwerking van de COP26-verklaring over het beëindigen van overheidssteun voor fossiele projecten in het buitenland

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development how the COP26 pledge to end export credit support for overseas fossil projects is being implemented, including the transition period, the pipeline of fossil deals, exemptions and transparency. The government answers that new applications for fossil-related export credit insurance were stopped from 1 January 2023, with a transition for applications filed earlier, lists ten pipeline cases and six pledges with limited detail, explains the exemptions, and commits to reporting in an annual monitor.
Information on company names and the country has been omitted from the overview so that it cannot be traced to specific projects and companies, given commercial sensitivity.
Informatie over bedrijfsnamen en het land zijn in het overzicht achterwege gelaten zodat de informatie niet herleidbaar is tot specifieke projecten en bedrijven, gelet op de bedrijfsgevoeligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht ‘Russische olietankers verdwenen van de radar vlak voor sancties’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how Russian oil tankers evading sanctions are monitored, including whether monitoring should extend beyond Russian ships and Dutch waters, and whether AIS data and oil samples are checked. The government answered that the Coast Guard and Customs jointly monitor tankers from Russian ports bound for the Netherlands regardless of flag, but that Customs makes the final origin assessment and that sampling is less effective, with enforcement details withheld for confidentiality.
Regarding the precise enforcement, no statement can be made for reasons of confidentiality.
Over de precieze handhaving kan omwille van vertrouwelijkheid geen uitspraak worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over ‘De gebrekkige antwoorden aangaande stikstof’

MP Van Raan asked why Schiphol's nature permit application could allow more nitrogen emissions and why the aviation sector is exempted from proportional reductions, and questioned whether voluntary buyouts make compulsory buyouts more likely. The minister answered that the Wnb permit will be assessed objectively against the statutory framework without political judgement, that aviation must contribute proportionally, and that a compulsory buyout decision will be evaluated in autumn 2023.
Once the application is complete, I will assess it, with the Nature Conservation Act forming the assessment framework.
Als de aanvraag volledig is, zal ik die beoordelen, waarbij het toetsingskader wordt gevormd door de Wet natuurbescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht 'Geheime covid-cijfers Schiphol lagen ver boven het gemiddelde'

An MP asked the minister whether covid sewage concentrations at Schiphol were above average, why they were not published on the dashboard, and whether an independent study into incoming flights was warranted. The minister answered that Schiphol sewage data cannot be compared with residential catchments, so it is not dashboard material, that variant sequencing has been intensified, and that no conclusion on flight-driven spread can be drawn, though the government will keep monitoring incoming variants and report on wastewater testing of arriving aircraft.
For that reason we are actively keeping track of incoming variants.
Daarom houden we hier actief zicht op de binnenkomende varianten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het rapporteren van luchtvaartemissies boven 3000 voet

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the Netherlands reports NOx emissions from aviation above 3,000 feet to the European Commission, whether the Commission challenged this, and whether it will start reporting them. The Minister answered that only LTO-cycle emissions are required under the NEC Directive, denied being challenged by the Commission, and said RIVM will begin registering these emissions from 2023 with a first report expected in 2024.
At the Ministry of I&W's request, RIVM will from 2023 map and register NOx emissions from air traffic above 3,000 feet in the Emission Registry.
Het RIVM zal, op verzoek van het Ministerie van IenW, vanaf 2023 de emissies NO X van vliegverkeer boven 3.000 in beeld brengen en registreren in de Emissieregistratie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Van Raan over de slinkse vertragingspogingen van de Raad van de Europese Unie inzake de Verordening Duurzaam gebruik pesticiden

MPs Vestering and Van Raan ask why an EU Council request for an additional impact assessment of the Sustainable Use of Pesticides Regulation was placed as an A-item on the Energy Council agenda, and why the Netherlands' earlier opposition appeared to shift. Minister Adema explains the Czech presidency placed it as an A-item after a majority of member states supported it, that the Netherlands opposed it, and that the Netherlands will run its own impact study with results expected in Q1 2023.
I will inform the Chamber about this.
Ik zal de Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen, Van Raan en Sylvana Simons over het bericht ‘Nederland doet te weinig om Bonaire te beschermen tegen bedreiging klimaatverandering’

MPs Teunissen, Van Raan and Simons asked whether the government will do enough to protect Bonaire, Saba and Sint Eustatius from climate change, citing a VU report, and questioned the lack of adaptation strategies, water safety standards and Rijk funding for the islands. The State Secretary replied that climate scenarios for the Caribbean Netherlands are being developed by KNMI with results expected end 2023, that the public bodies bear primary responsibility for adaptation with Rijk support in knowledge and tools, and that no specific Rijk adaptation programme or new funding is planned.
On the basis of the outcomes of these studies it will be determined in which area further research is needed.
Op basis van de uitkomsten van deze onderzoeken zal bepaald worden op welk vlak vervolgonderzoek nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de grootschalige vervuiling door het gebruik van scrubbers in de scheepvaart

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the minister, through about twenty-two questions, why open-loop scrubber wash water discharges into the North Sea are allowed, citing RIVM and other studies on pollution and acidification, and asks for an EU/IMO ban. The minister answers that the risks are known, that IMO discussions and a RIVM follow-up study due in 2023 will inform possible next steps, and that current discharge rules are enforced by the ILT.
National figures for the amount of sludge from exhaust gas cleaners (scrubber sludge) delivered each year to Dutch seaports are not known to me.
Landelijke cijfers voor de hoeveelheid slib afkomstig van rookgasreinigers (scrubber sludge) die jaarlijks in de Nederlandse zeehavens wordt afgegeven, zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Raan en Vestering over de Tijdelijke regeling groot onderhoud banenstelsel Schiphol 2023 en de natuurvergunning voor dit groot onderhoud

MPs Van Raan and Vestering asked whether Schiphol needed a nature permit for stikstof emissions from the 2023 runway maintenance, and questioned truck movements, weather risks, PFAS-contaminated soil, asphalt pollution and why traffic rules were relaxed instead of capacity cut. The minister answered nearly all questions by pointing to the pending nature-permit and enforcement request handled by the minister for Natuur en Stikstof, with substantive answers only on truck numbers, scheduling, PFAS handling and why capacity was not reduced.
Once a decision on the enforcement request has been taken, the Minister for Natuur en Stikstof will inform the House and answer questions 2 through 9.
Zodra een beslissing op het handhavingsverzoek is genomen, zal de Minister voor Natuur en Stikstof de Kamer daarover informeren en de vragen 2 tot en met 9 beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over bericht ‘Beschermd bos als biomassa opgefikt: ‘Plundering’’

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks whether wood pellets from protected Natura 2000 forests in Eastern Europe reach the Dutch market, whether woody biomass is sustainable, and whether the government should reduce its use. The minister says the leakage cannot be excluded, that the certification system worked according to an NEa investigation but can be improved, that woody biomass is needed for a climate-neutral economy, and that energy saving is a priority.
The cabinet will examine in the coming period how the NEa's advice can be incorporated into tightening the sustainability criteria.
Het kabinet zal de komende tijd bekijken hoe de adviezen van de NEa verwerkt kunnen worden in de aanscherping van de duurzaamheidseisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over mogelijke fossiele exportsteun Santos Basin Pre-Salt Pole

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about a pending export credit insurance application for the Santos Basin Pre-Salt Pole fossil project in Brazil, questioning its compatibility with the COP26 commitment to end fossil export support by end-2022 and its emissions impact. The government answered that the application is in due diligence, that it falls under a transition period allowing policies for applications submitted before 1 January 2023 to lead to a policy until end-2023, and that emissions data is not yet available.
At the ex-ante publication stage no information is given about the exporters, financial institutions or insured value involved, because this is commercially sensitive at this stage.
Bij de ex-ante publicatie wordt geen informatie gegeven over de betrokken exporteurs, financiële instellingen of te de verzekeren waarde, omdat dit in deze fase concurrentiegevoelig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het Energy Charter Verdrag

An MP asked the minister about the modernised Energy Charter Treaty, the secrecy of the negotiated text, and calls to withdraw, including the Teunissen motion. The minister answered that the modernisation is insufficiently ambitious, that the government intends to withdraw from the treaty and will push for coordinated EU withdrawal, but declined to publish the negotiated text, which will be viewable only confidentially by MPs.
As promised during the two-minute debate on 19 October, the text of the modernised treaty will be available for confidential inspection by members of the House of Representatives.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het tweeminutendebat op 19 oktober jl., zal de tekst van het gemoderniseerde verdrag vertrouwelijk in te zien zijn voor leden van de Tweede Kamer.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat het Chinese TikTok bij het gebruik van de in-app browser alle toetsaanslagen vastlegt en daarmee wachtwoorden en creditcardgegevens kan verzamelen

An MP asked the government about reports that TikTok's in-app browser may record keystrokes, including passwords and credit card data, and what should be done about it. The minister answered that data protection supervision is the task of the independent regulator, that the government will raise the principles with TikTok in a meeting, and that the government will strengthen oversight, without itself investigating or ordering deletion.
Overseeing and enforcing the lawfulness of data processing in the private sector is not a task of the cabinet but of the supervisory authority.
Antwoord 4 Het houden van toezicht op en het handhaven van de rechtmatigheid van gegevensverwerkingen in de private sector is geen taak van het kabinet, maar van de toezichthouder.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Wassenberg en Sylvana Simons over het volbouwen van de kust, zonder vergunningen op Bonaire, met bedreiging van het koraal tot gevolg, met actieve medewerking van de hoogste geza

MPs from PvdD and BIJ1 asked whether the appointed governor of Bonaire facilitated coastal construction without permits, threatening coral, and how enforcement and permitting are being strengthened. The government answered that the island council and executive are responsible for investigating, that it is reviewing staffing and rules (including a new environmental regulation), that the Inspectorate will audit permitting and enforcement, and that it has made arrangements to monitor implementation.
I have now asked the Inspectorate for Environment and Transport (ILT) to carry out an audit of permitting, supervision and enforcement.
Ik heb de Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT) inmiddels gevraagd om een onderzoek (visitatie) te laten uitvoeren op het gebied van vergunningsverlening, toezicht en handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over het milieuzorgsysteem van Tata Steel

MPs Van Esch and Van Raan asked the State Secretary about Tata Steel's environmental management system (ISO 14001), including whether its documents, coke oven plant 2 emissions and benchmarks can be disclosed and verified. The State Secretary answered that the system is not a single shareable document, that the matter is partly under court review and that the regional environmental service and certifier hold the relevant oversight, declining to provide documents or confirm several points.
Given my own role and position, as stated in the introduction, I also have no legal powers to demand – insofar as that is even possible – the relevant parts of the environmental management system.

Gelet op mijn eigen rol en positie, zoals aangegeven in de inleiding, heb ook geen wettelijke bevoegdheden om – voor zover dat überhaupt kan – de relevante delen uit het milieuzorgsysteem te vorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over investeringsplannen van de fossiele industrie

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan asked the government about fossil fuel companies' investment plans (the 'carbon bombs' reported by The Guardian) and whether the government would act internationally to stop them, given the Paris Agreement. The minister acknowledges the climate risks, says the plans are incompatible with Paris if the figures hold, and lists existing policy and coalitions, but declines to provide an overview of Dutch-linked investment plans and does not join the Beyond Oil and Gas Alliance.
That data is not public and the cabinet therefore does not keep track of it.
Die data zijn niet openbaar en houdt het kabinet dus ook niet bij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Vestering en Teunissen over investeringen in de intensieve veehouderij door ABP

MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers whether ABP's investments in intensive livestock farming conflict with animal welfare, climate and Paris goals, and what the government can do to steer the pension fund. The government replied that the ABP board is independently responsible for investment policy, that the government has no formal control over it, and pointed to existing voluntary IMVB and climate commitments with review later.
The cabinet, as one of the sector employers involved with ABP, has no formal means to steer the implementation of the pension scheme.
Het kabinet heeft, als één van de sectorwerkgevers betrokken bij het ABP, geen formele mogelijkheden ter sturing op de uitvoering van de pensioenregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Van Esch en Vestering over de mogelijke bouw van huizen ten kosten van waardevolle natuur op Bonaire

MPs from the Party for the Animals asked whether housing construction on Plantage Bolivia on Bonaire, a valuable nature area, can be prevented and how the zoning plan and intent agreement are handled. The minister answered that the island authority is responsible for the zoning plan, that the current zoning protects the area, and that the national government will review any draft plan and can issue a reactive direction if needed.
Once the (draft) plan has been released, it will be assessed by the national government and a response will be given.
Nadat het (voor)ontwerp is vrijgegeven, zal dit door het Rijk worden beoordeeld en zal daarop worden gereageerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over het rapport 'What is a fair emissions budget for The Netherlands'

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan asked the government to respond to an NCI report arguing that the Netherlands' fair share of the carbon budget requires near-zero emissions by 2030, and whether current climate targets are consistent with the Paris Agreement. The minister rejected the report's conclusions and methodology, maintained that the national targets are in line with the 1.5°C goal and the Paris Agreement, and committed to aligning public export credit support with the COP26 declaration without giving a firm new date.

No. According to the cabinet, the tightened Dutch climate targets for 2030 (at least 55% and aiming for 60% reduction) and 2050 (climate neutral, i.e. net-zero greenhouse gas emissions) are, based on the IPCC, in line with the 1.5-degree goal of the Paris Agreement.

Nee. Volgens het kabinet zijn de aangescherpte Nederlandse klimaatdoelen voor 2030 (ten minste 55% en streven naar 60%-reductie) en 2050 (klimaatneutraal oftewel netto-nul-broeikasemissies) op basis van het IPCC in lijn met het 1,5 gradendoel van het Akkoord van Parijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over privéjachten en privévliegtuigen naar aanleiding van de artikelen ‘The huge impact of private jets’ en ‘Superyachs symbolize climate breakdown’

An MP asked the minister about the large climate impact of private jets and superyachts, the low taxation of private aviation, and possible tax avoidance through charter structures. The government answered that it pursues international rules and EU measures such as the Fit for 55 package, that Dutch influence is limited because superyachts are foreign-owned and registered abroad, and that it will push for stricter international regulation rather than bilateral action with Malta.
That is why I focus my efforts on making ambitious international agreements.
Daarom richt ik mijn inzet op het maken van ambitieuze internationale afspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht 'ING te druk met witwasonderzoek, weert stichtingen en verenigingen'

MP Van Raan asked the Finance Minister about reports that ING was temporarily refusing new accounts for foundations and associations due to anti-money-laundering workload, and about PEP-related scrutiny, costs and proportionality. The minister answered that banks must do client due diligence, called for risk-based approaches and dialogue with client groups, said the government will examine exclusion of client groups and review PEP rules (including an EY study), but did not deem the ING measure discriminatory.

I have also asked, together with the Minister of Justice and Security, the researchers revising the National Risk Assessments whether it is possible to identify factors or circumstances that make risks for a particular legal form, such as foundations and associations, higher or lower.

Ik heb verder, samen met de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid, aan de onderzoekers die werken aan de herziening van de National Risk Assessments (NRA's) gevraagd of het mogelijk is om factoren aan te wijzen of omstandigheden te benoemen die maken dat risico's voor een bepaalde rechtsvorm of binnen en bepaalde rechtsvorm, zoals stichtingen en verenigingen, hoger of lager zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat heel Schiphol sinds 2008 onrechtmatig in bedrijf is

An MP asked whether the 2008 Schiphol airport traffic decree (LVB) was lawfully adopted, given reports that no complete appropriate assessment of nitrogen effects on Natura 2000 areas was carried out, and what this means for the airport's current operation. The minister answers that the decree was lawfully adopted and remains in force, that Schiphol must now apply for a nature permit which is under way, and rejects claims of deliberate illegal operation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het bericht dat autofabrikanten alleen nog grote auto’s willen bouwen

Two Party for the Animals MPs asked whether car manufacturers are only building large, heavy cars and whether this conflicts with space, energy, circularity and emissions goals. The State Secretary disagreed with the framing, argued electric cars are more efficient despite their weight, pointed to innovation in batteries and to policies promoting cycling, public transport and shared mobility.
I recognise the picture. Cars have become heavier for several reasons.
Ik herken het beeld. Auto's zijn om verschillende redenen zwaarder geworden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over ecocide door Russische militaire agressie in Oekraïne

MPs Van Raan and Teunissen asked the Foreign Minister about ecocide and environmental damage from Russia's aggression in Ukraine, including whether the ICC investigation covers the Rome Statute's environmental clause and whether Nederland will support evidence gathering. The minister answered that the government respects ICC independence, offers forensic support on request, and maintains its earlier position against a standalone ecocide crime, while saying it has no information on the reported number of environmental complaints.
The Dutch government respects the independence of the International Criminal Court and therefore does not interfere substantively with criminal investigations by the ICC Prosecutor.

De Nederlandse regering respecteert de onafhankelijkheid van het Internationaal Strafhof en bemoeit zich derhalve niet inhoudelijk met strafrechtelijke onderzoeken van de Aanklager van het Internationaal Strafhof.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het bericht ‘Nieuwe milieunormen voor Tata laten op zich wachten door Europese stroperigheid’

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch asked whether the EU process for setting best available techniques (BBT/BREF) for steel plants like Tata Steel is objective, whether environmental norms are outdated, and what the government will do about pollution around Tata Steel IJmond. The state secretary replied that the process is sufficiently objective, that the government will push in the Industrial Emissions Directive revision for faster BREF updates and an end date for outdated-installation exemptions, and that a National Environmental Programme on the right to a clean environment is being developed.
I agree that the process for drafting the BREF reference document and the associated BAT conclusions should proceed as objectively as possible.

Ik ben het met u eens dat het proces voor het opstellen van het Referentiedocument voor de Beste Beschikbare Technieken (BREF) en de daarbij behorende conclusies over de Beste Beschikbare Technieken (BBT-conclusies) zo objectief als mogelijk moet verlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over het Bescherm- en Herstelplan Gas

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan asked the minister why no companies are named under the gas protection plan, how much gas the 60 largest consumers and the flower sector use, whether a gas-saving tender was discussed, and why the plan's shutdown step is not applied and CO2 emissions rise. The minister answered that no specific companies are named, consumption data is confidential or outdated, a gas-saving tender is being studied, shutdown is only possible in an emergency, and a productie restriction was withdrawn to protect gas supply, with supplementary measures promised by Prinsjesdag.
Due to the commercially confidential nature of information on gas consumption, I cannot make any statement about individual connections to the gas network.
Vanwege het bedrijfsvertrouwelijke karakter van informatie omtrent gasverbruik kan ik geen uitspraak doen over individuele aansluitingen op het gasnet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het aantal toegenomen vluchten op Rotterdam The Hague Airport

An MP asked the minister about a sudden increase in flights and noise at Rotterdam The Hague Airport, including whether the airport took over Schiphol flights and whether noise limits and compensation were respected. The minister answered that unused winter slot capacity was shifted to summer without changing total annual capacity, that a prompted reversal was made to avoid exceeding a noise enforcement point, and that the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport supervises compliance, with a new airport decision targeted for 2024.
It is the responsibility of the airport to remain within the norms set in the Omzettingsregeling.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de luchthaven om binnen de normen te blijven die in de Omzettingsregeling zijn gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over “de door Nederland uitgesproken steun aan diepzeemijnbouw”

MPs Van Raan and Teunissen asked about Dutch support for deep-sea mining, scientific uncertainty about deep-sea ecosystems, how the Dutch position was formed and who was involved, and the timeline for ISA decisions. The government answered that Dutch aims are environmentally strict conditions and a precautionary approach before exploitation, that the final position will be sent to parliament in Q3 2022, and gave partial detail on the process.
The cabinet will inform the House further about the Dutch position in the third quarter of 2022.
Het kabinet zal Uw Kamer in het derde kwartaal van 2022 nader informeren over het Nederlands standpunt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de openbaarmaking van documenten in ICSID zaak nr. ARB/21/4 (RWE v. Koninkrijk der Nederlanden)

MP Van Raan asked when the RWE arbitration request, claim and damages report would be made public, whether RWE and the Dutch government were acting as openly as promised, and why publication was delayed. The minister answered that the government seeks maximum transparency, that publication of the key documents was delayed for months because RWE and the Netherlands could not agree on redactions, and that RWE had now indicated agreement so documents could be published soon.
On 28 December 2021 the Netherlands asked RWE to make public the request for arbitration, the memorial and all exhibits, including the damages report and conversion analysis.
Op 28 december 2021 heeft Nederland RWE verzocht tot openbaarmaking van het verzoek tot arbitrage, de memorial en alle producties, waaronder het schaderapport en ombouwanalyse.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over dienstauto’s, in aanvulling op eerdere vragen over hetzelfde onderwerp van het lid Van Raan

MP Van Raan asked the Minister of the Interior about delayed answers to earlier questions on ministerial service cars, why ministers do not switch to zero-emission vehicles, and the broken charging points at the temporary Tweede Kamer building. The minister answered that the delay was due to staff shortages, that security requirements can override zero-emission driving, that charging points at government buildings are about half built, and that the broken chargers will be replaced before the summer recess.
My starting point is that I always answer your questions on time or send a postponement letter if more time is needed to answer.
Mijn uitgangspunt is dat ik uw vragen altijd tijdig beantwoord of een uitstelbrief stuur indien meer tijd nodig is voor beantwoording.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het zelfsturend vermogen van banken in de klimaatcrisis

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether banks like ING, which still finance fossil fuel activity, are moving fast enough under the self-regulatory climate commitment, and whether stronger government steering or a climate duty is planned. The minister says the sector's voluntary commitment will be assessed through progress reports at year end and early next year, after which she and the climate minister will decide whether more binding action is appropriate, while declining to judge individual banks' policies.

Depending on the results of the progress reports and whether the targets are met, I will decide together with the Minister for Climate and Energy whether more normative intervention is appropriate and possible.

Afhankelijk van de resultaten van de voortgangsrapportages en het behalen van de doelstellingen, besluit ik samen met de Minister voor Klimaat en Energie of meer normerend optreden gepast en mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over vervuiling door de scheepvaart

Van Raan (PvdD) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about large-scale ocean and air pollution from shipping, including open-loop scrubbers, bilge water, washing discharges and varend ontgassen, and whether the Netherlands would ban these practices. The Minister answered that the RIVM found scrubber discharges unlikely to breach current water quality norms, that the IMO guidelines are being evaluated, that the Netherlands will push for stricter rules if evidence shows unacceptable effects, and that a national ban on open-loop scrubbers or bilge discharge is not planned for now.
No. At the request of the Ministry of I&W, the RIVM carried out an initial study into the effects of scrubber discharges on water quality.
Nee. Het RIVM heeft in opdracht van het Ministerie van I&W een eerste onderzoek laten uitvoeren naar de effecten van scrubber-lozingen op de waterkwaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de gevolgen van het Energy Charter Treaty (ECT)

MP Van Raan asks the Minister for Climate and Energy about the Energy Charter Treaty, including whether the Netherlands favours withdrawal, whether ISDS claims could hamper climate policy and oil and gas phase-out, and the risks from Dutch and bilateral investment treaties. The Minister says the Netherlands wants modernisation aligned with the EU mandate with withdrawal as a fallback, and argues that investment treaties do not restrict climate policy, while declining to inventory potential claims.
The Netherlands is currently examining the legal aspects of the various scenarios, including withdrawal.
Nederland is momenteel de juridische aspecten van de verschillende scenario's, waaronder uittreding, aan het onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Sylvana Simons over het meest recente IPCC-rapport in relatie tot Bonaire, Statia en Saba

MPs Van Raan and Simons asked the government about the latest IPCC report and its implications for Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, including climate adaptation, water safety, the 1.5-degree target, and energy transition. The government answered that the report lacks a Caribbean-specific assessment, that these islands are largely excluded from national climate laws and plans, and that a sustainable energy route map is promised before the summer recess.
Antwoord op op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over exportsteun uit Nederlands Belastinggeld voor een omstreden project op de Filipijnen (deel 2)

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the Finance and Foreign Trade ministers about Dutch export credit insurance (ekv) for the contested New Manila International Airport project, covering biodiversity, flood and subsidence risks, the Boskalis dredging role, the absence of independent review and the lack of an environmental impact assessment. The state secretary answered most questions by defending the ekv due diligence, stating that the project's ESIA was adequate and that mangrove loss and forced resettlement are considered acceptable if mitigated, while committing to no new action.
I am of the view that the CSR assessment and testing against the CSR standards for the ekv was carried out carefully.
Ik ben van mening dat de IMVO-beoordeling en toetsing aan de IMVO-standaarden voor de ekv zorgvuldig heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over de dag van het Natuurlijk Kapitaal

Two Party for the Animals MPs asked the government about the Dutch Natural Capital Day, Dutch ecological footprint overshoot and how to reduce it. The minister answered that the footprint is too high, that the Netherlands cannot be self-sufficient but is working on transitions, and promised further information in later letters.
It goes too far to list all the cabinet's measures here.
Het voert te ver om hier alle maatregelen van het kabinet op te sommen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht 'Zelfs milieuminister hoeft in Nederland niet elektrisch te rijden'

MPs Van Raan asked why ministers still drive mostly non-electric cars despite government climate pledges, and why only 2 of 31 service cars are fully electric. The minister confirmed the figures, said the civil fleet aims for zero-emission by 2028 with a 'zero-emission unless' policy, and cited contracts, security needs, and vehicle availability as reasons for slow progress.
The cabinet is fully committed to sustainability and is aware of its exemplary role.
Het kabinet zet vol in op verduurzaming en is zich bewust van zijn voorbeeldrol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke, Wuite, Van Raan en Wassenberg over de uitzending van Zembla 'Bedreigd Nederlands Koraal' van 17 februari 222

MPs Boucke, Wuite, Van Raan and Wassenberg asked about a Zembla broadcast on threats to Bonaire's coral reef, including a planned oil pier, BBT's sustainability mandate and the 40 million euro WEB green-energy request. The minister answers that no new pier is currently planned, that 10 million euro was invested in BBT for the energy transition, and that a transition roadmap for the Caribbean Netherlands will follow before summer.
To avoid influencing the tender for the construction, some data remain confidential.
Om de aanbesteding van de bouw niet te beïnvloeden, blijven sommige gegevens vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het bericht ‘Na jaar vertraging levert Schiphol onvolledige data over gifstoffen’

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch asked about reports that Schiphol delivered late and incomplete data on emissions of carcinogenic substances, and whether the Omgevingsdienst NZKG should enforce before assessing the report and how citizens are protected. The minister replies that the reported emissions concern only 0.1% of Schiphol's total ZZS emissions under the environmental permit, that the regulator granted two extensions and gave Schiphol two months for supplementary data, that enforcement is not ruled out but no sanctions yet, and that the government will examine in the first half of 2022 whether aviation ZZS emissions require reduction.
Therefore I will examine in the first half of this year whether emissions of ZZS from aviation affect the surroundings of airports to such an extent that these emissions must be reduced.
Daarom zal ik nog in de eerste helft van dit jaar bezien of de uitstoot van ZZS door de luchtvaart, de omgeving van luchthavens dusdanig negatief beïnvloedt, dat die uitstoot moet verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het bericht ‘Luchtvaartonderzoek houdt vliegherrie buiten beeld, waarschuwt GGD’

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch asked why the aviation cost-benefit guidance (MKBA werkwijzer) treats aircraft noise in ways that allegedly favour the aviation sector and diverge from WHO noise guidelines, and whether this undermines trust of residents. The minister replied that the guidance is an adequate first version, that noise valuation will be improved through a research agenda, that the ministry did not influence the noise norms, and that no 'rekentrucs' (calculation tricks) occurred.
It is indeed important that noise nuisance is taken into account properly in cost-benefit analyses.
Het is inderdaad van belang dat geluidhinder op goede wijze wordt meegenomen in MKBA's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de uitstoot van zeer zorgwekkende stoffen (ZZS) die mogelijk niet door Schiphol gerapporteerd worden

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management which activities at Schiphol must report emissions of very high-concern substances (ZZS), and whether platform activities such as taxiing, take-off and landing are covered. The minister listed the permitted activities under the environmental permit, explained that taxiing, take-off and landing fall under the Aviation Act and the Schiphol airport traffic decree rather than the environmental permit, and pointed to the national emissions register for reporting.
Taxiing, take-off and landing therefore do not form part of the environmental permit.
Taxiën, starten en landen maken dus geen deel uit van de omgevingsvergunning milieu.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Raan over zandsuppletie bij gaswinning onder het UNESCO Werelderfgoed

MPs Wassenberg and Van Raan asked whether UNESCO has been informed that sand nourishment may compensate gas- and salt-extraction subsidence in the Wadden Sea World Heritage site, and what UNESCO's view is. The minister answers that UNESCO was informed via the 2008 nomination file, that sand nourishment is coastal maintenance rather than a mitigation measure, that IUCN will assess the Ternaard gas extraction impact, and that no delisting is currently in question.
I do not consider that necessary.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Thijssen en Van Raan over het bericht 'Shell moet reclame over 'miljoenen schone kilometers' direct aanpassen'

Three MPs asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about a Reclame Code Commissie ruling that Shell must amend misleading 'clean kilometres' advertising, and about whether fossil fuel advertising slows the energy transition, whether the Commission is effective, and whether a ban on fossil advertising is warranted. The Minister welcomed the Commission's scrutiny of advertising accuracy, said advertising is permitted if not misleading, and declined to assess the Commission's functioning or to commit to a fossil advertising ban, citing existing climate instruments.
In this capacity I have no view on the conduct or functioning of the Reclame Code Commissie.
Ik heb in deze hoedanigheid geen oordeel over het optreden of het functioneren van de Reclame Code Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over het Energy Charter Treaty

MPs Van Raan and Teunissen asked the government about the modernisation of the Energy Charter Treaty, arbitration claims by RWE, Uniper and Riverstone over Dutch coal-phase-out policy, and whether investor claims threaten climate policy. The government answered that the EU seeks to align the treaty with the Paris Agreement, that it is still negotiating and will reconsider options such as withdrawal after the next negotiation rounds, and that it has made the arbitration procedures and subsidy documents partly transparent while withholding confidential commercial information.
Due to commercially confidential information, I cannot make the subsidy decision and the underlying advice public.
Vanwege bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie kan ik het subsidiebesluit en de onderliggende adviezen niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over het bericht dat de CCS-installatie bij een waterstofproject van Shell meer broeikasgassen uitstoot dan het afvangt

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan asked whether the Scotford hydrogen CCS plant emits more CO2 than it captures, whether CCS is a sound use of public subsidy, and related questions on risks, leakage and subsidy recovery. The minister disputes the report's conclusion, says the plant captures more than it emits after correcting for energy use, defends subsidies for hard-to-abate industry under the ETS and a cost-correction mechanism, and rejects stopping or reclaiming CCS funding.
No, that is not correct. The article refers to a specific project in which the CO2 released in hydrogen production is captured.
Nee, dat klopt niet. Het artikel refereert aan een specifiek project, waarbij de CO 2 die vrijkomt bij de productie van waterstof wordt afgevangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over de plannen voor het hyperscale datacenter van Facebookmoederbedrijf Meta in Zeewolde en andere datacenters

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch (PvdD) asked about Meta's hyperscale data centre plans in Zeewolde, the sale of state land, energy and water use, and grid tariffs. The minister answered that the state conditions the land sale on energy and water standards, and that the government will tighten national steering and licensing criteria for hyperscale data centres.
The cabinet will tighten the choices in the NOVI regarding data centres.
Het kabinet zal de keuzes in de NOVI over datacenters aanscherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over de Zembla uitzending over de uitstoot van giftige stoffen op Schiphol

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch asked the government about the Zembla broadcast on toxic emissions at Schiphol and the health risks for platform workers, including accountability, Arbowet compliance, and liability. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to sector-wide steps and ongoing Labour Inspectorate investigation, but largely placed responsibility on employers and stated that data on life expectancy and some emission assessments are unavailable or pending.

It is up to the employer and the client to ensure this. The Netherlands Labour Inspectorate started an investigation at the end of 2021 into compliance with working conditions legislation at Schiphol.

Het is aan de werkgever en de opdrachtgever om daar zorg voor te dragen. De Nederlandse Arbeidsinspectie is eind 2021 onderzoek gestart naar de naleving van de arbeidsomstandighedenwet- en regelgeving op Schiphol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord.

Eleven MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, and the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen, 17 questions on the 2021 coalition agreement covering nitrogen targets, the transition fund, carbon credits, sustainable food, buyouts, legalisation of PAS cases and a possible consumer levy. The ministers largely answered by pointing to forthcoming analyses, planned provincial area plans and later decisions, with several answers promising to inform the House soon.
To determine the precise target achievement, an additional calculation is necessary, after further elaboration of the plans.
Om het precieze doelbereik te bepalen is een aanvullende doorrekening noodzakelijk, na verdere uitwerking van de plannen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

Eleven MPs from across the opposition and coalition asked the Minister of Justice and Security 25 factual questions about the coalition agreement, covering asylum and migration, police staffing, financing, cybersecurity, organized crime and the bar. The government answered many questions only partially, deferring details to later elaboration or a decision by the cabinet, and gave specific answers on police numbers, withdrawn bills, asylum spending and the reasons for expected higher asylum inflow.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a decision by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Waterstaat factual questions about the coalition agreement, covering short-haul flight discouragement, flight numbers, investment splits, air quality, aviation tax revenue, road safety budgets and infrastructure maintenance. The minister answered most questions in general terms, deferring several figures and allocations to later cabinet decisions or reports.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from eleven parties asked the government dozens of factual questions about the 2021 coalition agreement's climate, energy, and biomass plans, including Ternaard gas drilling, CCS, nuclear, and the Westerschelde tunnel toll. The minister answered only a handful on substance and deferred most questions to later cabinet decisions.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from eleven parties asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the 2021 coalition agreement, covering minimum wage, childcare subsidy, rent allowance, the AOW gap, child poverty targets, institutional racism and the Rainbow Accord. The government answered most questions substantively but deferred many details (funding, targets, the Rainbow Accord) to later elaboration by the cabinet.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a cabinet decision. You will be informed about this during the further elaboration.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover bij de nadere uitwerking geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the foreign minister, in written questions, about the coalition agreement, covering EU budget and enlargement, ODA targets, asylum spending, migration partnerships, Middle East resolutions, and transparency. The ministers answered most questions in substance, pointing to existing reports and promising further studies and letters, with few concrete commitments.
The cabinet will inform your House about this in more detail with a BNC fiche.
Het kabinet zal uw Kamer hierover met een BNC-fiche nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

Eleven MPs asked the Finance Minister about the coalition agreement, covering the budget, tax burden, fiscal rules, the RRF recovery plan, and wealth inequality. The minister answered most questions in detail, citing indicative figures, and deferred several items (inflation effects, purchasing-power tables, the sugar tax, asset-tax reform) to the Spring Memorandum and later analyses.
The cabinet is examining the options for eventually lowering VAT on fruit and vegetables to 0% and introducing a sugar tax.
Het kabinet beziet de mogelijkheden voor het op termijn verlagen van de btw op groente en fruit naar 0% en het invoeren van een suikerbelasting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parliamentary groups asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the coalition agreement, covering student grants, research funding, teacher pay, press funding, special education, childcare and digitalisation. The government answered most questions with references to further elaboration and future decisions, providing concrete figures only in a few places.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a decision by the cabinet. You will be informed about this further.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Health Minister about the 2021 coalition agreement, covering youth care savings, health inequality, healthcare wages, the chief medical officer, ICU capacity, the health deductible and premium effects. The minister answered most questions in substance, deferred several to later decision-making, and pointed to other documents for details.
For a number of questions, further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet is still required.
Voor een aantal vragen geldt dat deze nog nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming vragen door het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Defence Minister, in a set of factual questions before the government declaration debate, about the defence budget increases in the coalition agreement, how the funds are allocated, European defence cooperation, specialisation and strategic autonomy, and the NATO spending norm. The minister answered that the money is additional, broken down into intensification and maintenance items, will be detailed in a forthcoming Defence Note, and brings spending to the European NATO average of 1.85% of GDP.
How the coalition agreement funds will exactly be spent requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet.
Hoe de middelen uit het coalitieakkoord precies worden uitgegeven, vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het schrappen van de groeidoelstelling voor de internationale luchtvaart uit Artikel 44a van het Verdrag van Chicago

An MP asked the minister why she called amending the Chicago Convention's growth objective for international aviation nearly impossible, and whether ICAO's rules and objectives block such a change. The minister answered that amendments need a two-thirds vote and ratification, that ICAO objectives are balanced rather than fixed, and that she will focus on concrete climate policy at the 2022 Assembly instead of proposing a treaty change.
It is better to deploy the available manpower and resources to make concrete policy at international level that contributes to combating climate change from aviation
Het is beter om de beschikbare menskracht en middelen in te zetten om in internationaal verband concreet beleid te maken dat bijdraagt aan het tegengaan van klimaatverandering door luchtvaart
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over een door FMO gefinancierd bedrijf dat is veroordeeld voor een moordcomplot in Honduras

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan asked the ministers about FMO's financing of the company behind the Agua Zarca project in Honduras, whose CEO was convicted of involvement in the murder of activist Berta Cáceres, and whether FMO and the ministry ignored repeated civil-society warnings and how to improve FMO's due diligence and transparency. The minister answered that a civil lawsuit against FMO is pending so no judgement is given on FMO's role, that the ministry has pressed for improvements, and that FMO's transparency and IMVO policies have been and are being tightened.
Pending this procedure, I make no statements about FMO's role.
Hangende deze procedure doe ik over de rol van FMO geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over de afgegeven opsporingsvergunningen voor aardwarmte in (huidige en toekomstige) drinkwatergebieden

MPs Van Esch and Van Raan asked why geothermal exploration licences were granted in current and future drinking water areas despite warnings from the Court of Audit and the State Supervision of Mines, and what safeguards exist. The Minister replied that a bill amending the Mining Act is pending, that licences are market-ordering concessions with no drilling rights until an environmental permit is granted, that provinces normally exclude mining in protected drinking water zones, and that no specific restrictions were attached to the licences.
The Court of Audit investigation took place in mid-2019.
Het onderzoek van de Algemene Rekenkamer (AR) heeft medio 2019 plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de COP26-verklaring voor het in lijn brengen van internationale overheidssteun met de groene energie

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development how the COP26 pledge to align public international support with clean energy would affect SMEs, renewable exporters, workers, fossil export credit, and the scope of exceptions. The government answered that it will implement the pledge by end-2022, will inform parliament by Q2 2022, and gave partial answers on definitions, CCS, and transparency, while several questions were deferred.

The cabinet will use the coming months to reach a careful implementation with the sectors involved and will endeavour to inform the House about this by the second quarter of 2022 at the latest, in line with the adopted Klink motion.

Het kabinet zal de komende maanden benutten om met de betrokken sectoren tot een zorgvuldige implementatie te komen en zich inspannen de Kamer hierover uiterlijk in het tweede kwartaal van 2022 over te informeren, conform de aangenomen motie Klink c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Vestering over interne analyses en afwegingen aangaande de gaswinning Ternaard en de aanleg van een elektrische stroomkabel onder de Wadden

MPs Van Raan and Vestering asked about internal legal assessments, public consultation, and the Ternaard gas extraction and Wadden cable routing. The minister answered that the internal legal review underlying the draft decisions was shared, that the Landsadvocaat was not consulted beforehand to avoid exposing litigation strategy, and that the cable landing decision is being pursued jointly with other projects.

The government, like any other litigating party, must be able to speak freely with the lawyer representing it in (future) court proceedings, without the risk that advice given in that context becomes public.

De overheid moet, net als elke andere procespartij, vrijelijk kunnen spreken met de advocaat die haar vertegenwoordigt in (toekomstige) rechterlijke procedures, zonder het risico dat adviezen die in dat verband worden gegeven openbaar worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de bescherming van de privacy en het gebruik van een front-facing camera op de zelfscanner van de Albert Heijn

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked whether Albert Heijn's handheld self-scanners with a front-facing camera enable facial recognition of customers, and what the government will do to prevent supermarkets from using it. The minister replied that the camera is switched off, that the manufacturer lists facial recognition as a possible use, that GDPR allows biometric processing only with explicit consent or for overriding public interest, that a bill clarifying this in the UAVG is planned, and that the AP's guidance is considered sufficient.
The statutory text will explicitly state that the exception in Article 29 may only be applied where necessary for an overriding public interest.
In de wettekst wordt expliciet opgenomen dat de uitzonderingsgrond van artikel 29 alleen kan worden toegepast wanneer dat nodig is voor een zwaarwegend algemeen belang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het geven van ‘topprioriteit’ aan de legalisatie van de stik stofvergunning van Lelystad Airport

MP Van Raan (PvdD) asks whether giving 'top priority' to legalising Lelystad Airport's nitrogen permit crowds out nitrogen space for housing and agriculture, and presses on the 43 MW heat-content assumption in the emissions modelling, the handling of an Arcadis memo and the timing of disclosures to parliament. The minister answers that the aviation share of nitrogen deposition is small, that the 'top priority' label was an internal civil-servant term, that the heat-content choice reflects the OPS model's limits, and that the Chamber was informed of relevant developments.
It is the task of civil servants to advise the minister concerned on possible courses of action in a specific file.
Het is de taak van ambtenaren om de betrokken bewindspersoon te adviseren over mogelijke handelingsopties in een specifiek dossier.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de vervuilende afscheidsvlucht van de KDC-10

An MP asked the Defence Minister why a 550 km farewell flight with an old KDC-10 tanker, emitting about 50,540 kg CO2, was justified given climate ambitions and its cost. The minister replied that the flight was a fitting farewell to a plane that transported veterans and supported missions, that it cost about 7,042 euro within the regular budget, and that the non-CO2 effects were insignificant due to low altitude.
The flight was a fitting farewell to the transport aircraft that since 1995 have carried tens of thousands of veterans to various mission and deployment areas and flown them home again.

De vlucht was een passend afscheid van de transporttoestellen die sinds 1995 tienduizenden veteranen naar verschillende missie- en inzetgebieden hebben gebracht en vervolgens weer naar huis hebben gevlogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de vraag waarom de gastarieven voor huishoudens stijgen terwijl de gasvoorraden toch voldoende waren

An MP asked why household gas tariffs are rising when Dutch gas storage was reportedly sufficient, and whether government energy policy leaves households exposed to price volatility. The state secretary answered that gas prices are set on a global market, that the L-gas storage is over 80% full and sufficient for households, and that the government is offering temporary energy-tax relief while monitoring affordability.
With a fill level of over 80%, the L-gas storage facilities on which households depend are more than sufficiently filled for a normal or cold winter.
Met een vulgraad van ruim 80% zijn de L-gasopslagen, waar de huishoudens van afhankelijk zijn ruim voldoende gevuld voor een normale of koude winter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over de geluidsoverlast van motoren

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the government about noise nuisance from motorcycles, including health effects, EU-level and national noise norms, roadside acoustic cameras, municipal road closures and the regulation of non-certified exhausts. The minister replied that noise policy is being developed in an integrated response expected after a new cabinet, that municipalities may close roads case by case, and that EU and national rules on exhausts and inspections are being reviewed or enforced.
For this reason an integrated policy response is expected to be drafted and sent to the House after a new cabinet takes office.
Om die reden zal een integrale beleidsreactie naar verwachting na aantreden van een nieuw kabinet kunnen worden opgesteld en naar de Kamer worden gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Van Raan en Thijssen over de herkomst van biomassa

MPs Van Raan and Thijssen asked about the origin, sustainability and certification of biomass used for energy in the Netherlands, citing an EU JRC report, a CE Delft report, and reports on forest loss in the Baltic states. The Secretary of State answered that the origin is traceable to country level, that a 'carbon debt' study has been requested from PBL, that the emissions authority will examine the Greenpeace/SOMO report, but that plot-level certificates and detailed sourcing data are commercially confidential and cannot be disclosed.
The information needed to break down the source of wood for category 5 biofuel raw materials by country and region is competitively sensitive and not publicly available.
De informatie die nodig is om de bron van het hout voor biogrondstoffen categorie 5 uit te splitsen naar land en regio is concurrentiegevoelig en niet publiekelijk beschikbaar.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over “het delen van de eigen juridische analyse van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat waaruit blijkt dat er geen ruimte is om de vergunningsaanvraag van de Nederlands

MP Van Raan asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the ministry's internal legal analysis, which reportedly found no room under existing law to refuse the NAM gas permit under the Wadden Sea, would be shared with parliament. The minister confirmed the analysis was sent to parliament on 27 September 2021 and said the final decision would not come before March 2022 and that courts ultimately decide on the interpretation of the Mining Act.
Yes, I have shared this legal analysis with your House in my letter on the permit granting for gas extraction at Ternaard of 27 September 2021.
Ja, deze juridische analyse heb ik met uw Kamer gedeeld in mijn brief met betrekking tot de vergunningverlening gaswinning Ternaard van 27 september 2021
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het rapport van de Eerlijke Bankwijzer waaruit blijkt dat banken onvoldoende verantwoordelijkheid nemen in de eiwittransitie

An MP asked ministers whether banks are doing enough to finance the protein transition, citing an Eerlijke Bankwijzer report on barriers such as farmer access to capital and vested interests. The minister agrees banks can play a crucial role, points to existing and planned measures, acknowledges voluntary IMVO covenants are insufficient, and says the government will pursue due-diligence rules at EU level or national measures if needed, but declines to set measurable targets for banks yet.
Supplementing and tightening the IMVO measures is therefore necessary.
Aanvulling en aanscherping van de IMVO-maatregelen is daarom nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Van Raan over de dood van een lammergier na botsing met een Nederlandse windmolen

MPs Vestering and Van Raan asked ministers about the death of a lammergier after a collision with a Dutch wind turbine, detection systems, protected-area permits, cumulative effects and subsidies for biodiversity. The ministers answered largely in general terms, saying permits are the responsibility of provinces, that a black-blade pilot is under way, and that a cumulative study and subsidy review are being considered.
Provinces are the competent authority for granting exemptions or waivers for species and permits for Natura 2000.
Provincies zijn bevoegd gezag voor het verlenen van ontheffingen of vrijstellingen voor soorten en vergunningen voor Natura 2000.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over de publicatie van de juridische definitie van ecocide door een internationaal panel van experts

Two MPs (Van Raan and Teunissen, PvdD) asked the government for its view on an expert panel's proposed legal definition of ecocide and whether the Netherlands would engage with it. Minister Knapen replied that the proposal is a useful starting point for discussion but that ecocide is not recognised in international law, there is no current negotiation or consensus, and the government will follow developments and participate in relevant fora while focusing on other interventions for nature and biodiversity.
The government closely follows further developments and discussions on this.
Het kabinet volgt de verdere ontwikkelingen en discussies hierover nauwgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de meldingen die gedaan zijn bij het Bewoners Aanspreekpunt Schiphol (BAS) maar zijn ‘kwijtgeraakt’

Van Raan asks the minister about aircraft noise complaints lost from the Schiphol residents' contact point BAS and whether this undermines trust. The minister confirms a small share of 2020 complaints was mis-registered during a system migration, says an independent review is underway and the annual report will be corrected, and points to other trust-building efforts.
Depending on the outcome of the independent investigation, BAS must correct its annual report.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomsten van het onafhankelijk onderzoek dient BAS haar jaarrapportage te corrigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Simons over nieuwe problemen die dreigen te ontstaan omdat de Commissie Werkelijke Schade nog steeds onderbemenst is

MPs Van Raan and Simons asked whether the Commission Werkelijke Schade (CWS) is still understaffed, creating new emergencies such as forced evictions, and why capacity was not scaled up sooner.
