The State Secretary answered that the waiting list is undesirable but emergencies are addressed via the pause button, the Brede Hulp Team and priority treatment, that scale-up began in June 2021 with results lagging, and that capacity is expected to suffice within three to six months.
The CWS and UHT will handle her claim for actual damage with urgency.
De CWS en UHT zullen haar aanvraag voor werkelijke schade met spoed behandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over het gebrek aan duurzaam herstel uit de coronacrisis

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan asked why COVID-19 recovery support flowed to fossil firms without green conditions, why investment in sustainable energy is insufficient, and what the government will do about rising emissions. The Secretary of State answered that support aims to preserve jobs and income, that green conditions are costly and better handled through regular climate policy, that the amount invested in renewable energy cannot be determined, and that the government will present additional climate measures in the autumn Klimaatnota.
The primary aim of the support is to preserve business activity, employment and income, not to drive sustainability.
Het primaire doel van de steun is behoud van bedrijvigheid, werkgelegenheid en inkomen, niet het aanjagen van duurzaamheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over exportsteun uit Nederlands belastinggeld voor een omstreden project op de Filipijnen

MPs Van Raan and Teunissen asked whether the government will grant an export credit insurance (ekv) to Boskalis for a contested airport project in Manila Bay, citing forced relocations and mangrove destruction. The state secretary confirmed a conditional coverage commitment ('mvo-mits') pending an unfinished environmental and social risk assessment, declined to disclose the amount, and said no policy is yet determined on the allegations.
I cannot yet make statements about the amount that may be insured. This concerns business, competition and price-sensitive information.
Over het eventueel te verzekeren bedrag kan ik op dit moment (nog) geen uitspraken doen. Dit betreft namelijk bedrijfs-, concurrentie- en koersgevoelige informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over het rapport 'AR6 Climate Change 2021: The Physical Science Basis' van het Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC)

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan asked the government about the IPCC AR6 Working Group I report on climate change, including its attribution of warming to humans, sea-level rise, extreme weather, tipping points, and Dutch fossil-fuel and climate policy. The Secretary of State mostly answered 'yes' or deferred, promising an appreciation letter in October and leaving further national climate targets to a future cabinet.
The demissionary cabinet considers the discussion on possibly adjusting Dutch climate targets a matter for a next cabinet.
De discussie over eventuele aanpassing van Nederlandse klimaatdoelen acht het demissionaire kabinet een zaak voor een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht ‘Aviation Is as Sustainable Now as It Will Be in Your Lifetime’

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a Bloomberg opinion piece claiming aviation biofuels are not truly sustainable, including whether the term Sustainable Aviation Fuel is misleading, whether 10% lower-emission fuels count, and whether biofuels with higher volumetric fuel use raise emissions. The Minister rejects the article's claims, defends the SAF terminology and the RED-based definition, argues that energy density of SAF is nearly equal to kerosene, and states a commitment to push for a European blending obligation.
For this reason, I will actively work to introduce a European blending obligation.
Om deze reden zal ik mij actief inzetten voor de invoering van een Europese bijmengverplichting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over het bericht ‘mogelijk meer vluchten met besmette passagiers dan gedacht’

MPs Van Esch and Van Raan asked the ministers whether a Canadian-data analysis (36% of July flights from Amsterdam to Canada carried an infected passenger, versus 9% in an NLR/RIVM study) reveals underestimated in-flight infection risk, and whether testing, mask and distancing rules are adequate. The minister answered that the NLR/RIVM study only covered aerosol inhalation in flight, used early-June prevalence and the original variant, that the government sees insufficient reason for stricter measures now, and that it will monitor the situation and reconsider if needed.

The cabinet currently sees insufficient reason, compared with the current policy on testing, the passenger health declaration, triage, masks on board and the quarantine declaration, to take additional measures.

Het kabinet ziet op dit moment onvoldoende aanleiding ten opzichte van het huidige beleid ten aanzien van testen, de gezondheidsverklaring van de passagier, triage, mondkapjes aan boord en de verklaring van de quarantaineplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over de exportkredietverzekering voor het omstreden gasproject in Mozambique

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan ask whether export credit insurance granted for the Total Mozambique LNG project was justified given escalating violence, human rights abuses and climate concerns, and why the policy was not withdrawn. The government answers that the risk assessment was careful and based on the information then available, that the force majeure situation was not foreseen, that the policy is not currently withdrawn, and that a new security, human rights and environmental review plus remedial action plan will be required before the project resumes.
The cabinet asks the multilateral development banks to systematically test for Paris alignment from 2023 onwards.
Het kabinet vraagt de multilaterale ontwikkelingsbanken om uiterlijk vanaf 2023 systematisch te toetsen op Paris alignment.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Vestering over de aanleg van een elektriciteitskabel door een kwetsbaar stuk van het Werelderfgoed Waddenzee

MPs Van Raan and Vestering (PvdD) asked the government about routing an offshore electricity cable through the vulnerable Wadden Sea World Heritage area, including Schiermonnikoog, and why the Eemshaven West route was chosen over Eemshaven East. The State Secretary answered that no route decision is final, that a second-phase environmental assessment and further studies will be completed before any irreversible steps, and that the government considers the wider energy transition and future connections in its choice.
In the meantime, I am not taking any irreversible steps.
In de tussentijd neem ik geen onomkeerbare stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over een exportkredietverzekering voor een baggerschip van IHC in Myanmar

Two MPs (Van Raan and Teunissen, PvdD) asked why the Dutch state gave export credit insurance for an IHC dredger to a Myanmar ministry after the 2021 coup and given the Rohingya genocide allegations, and whether due diligence and the parliamentary motion against such cover were respected. The state secretary answered that the deal was insured before the coup, that the risks were judged acceptable under OECD and IFC standards, that Myanmar's country policy was tightened to exceptional cover in May 2021, and that the insurance was not retroactively withdrawn.
Legally it is not possible to retroactively withdraw a cover commitment as a result of a change in country policy.
Juridisch gezien is het niet mogelijk om met terugwerkende kracht een dekkingstoezegging in te trekken als gevolg van een wijziging van het landenbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Vestering over mogelijke overheidssteun voor Formule 1 races

Two PvdD MPs asked whether the government would rule out financial support for the Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort, citing earlier promises, the organiser's request for compensation, and fly-past plans. The state secretary answered that the organiser does not qualify for the event guarantee scheme, that no state financial support was given, and that the fly-past was cancelled.
However, the DGP does not meet the requirements of the event guarantee scheme, because the event was not prohibited by the central government.
De DGP voldoet echter niet aan de eisen van de garantieregeling evenementen, omdat het evenement niet door de rijksoverheid is verboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over ernstige misstanden bij 'duurzame' palmoliebedrijven in Liberia

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan ask the government about serious abuses on palm oil plantations in Liberia (Golden Veroleum, MOPP) that are linked to RSPO membership and FMO financing, including land grabs, labour and environmental violations, and FMO's due diligence. The minister answers that FMO applies due diligence standards, RSPO is a private initiative outside government, FMO's action plan for SIFCA/MOPP is being monitored with an independent review planned, and the government is pursuing broader mandatory due diligence rules at EU level.
The cabinet expects Dutch companies, including those in the palm oil sector, to apply due diligence in line with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises.

Het kabinet verwacht van Nederlandse bedrijven, waaronder bedrijven in de palmoliesector, dat zij gepaste zorgvuldigheid (due diligence) toepassen in lijn met de OESO-Richtlijnen voor Multinationale Ondernemingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht ‘Economie groeit niet door uitbreiding Schiphol, het kost alleen maar geld: nieuw onderzoek legt bom onder plannen’ van EenVandaag

An MP asked the minister whether a CE Delft cost-benefit analysis showing possible welfare losses from further Schiphol growth should prompt a reconsideration of aviation policy, and whether the government would write a shrinkage-oriented aviation note. The minister replied that CE Delft's assumptions deviate in places from the newly published guidelines, declined to write an alternative aviation note, and said the Luchtvaartnota 2020–2050 already provides clarity on growth limits.
The advice to those preparing welfare analyses and cost-benefit analyses on aviation development is to follow the recommendations in this guideline.
Het advies aan opstellers van welvaartsanalyses en MKBA’s die gaan over de ontwikkeling van de luchtvaart is om de aanbevelingen uit deze werkwijzer te volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over ’de uitruil van geluidsruimte tussen kleine en grote luchtvaart op Groningen Airport Eelde’

An MP asked whether the Groningen Airport Eelde noise-allowance conversion regulation, which exchanged noise room between small and large aviation, could be challenged in court and whether it could increase noise and nitrogen emissions. The minister answered that the conversion was a one-to-one transposition with no new legal effects, so no appeal is open, that the total noise room is unchanged, and that a new airport decision will be appealable.

Given that the conversion regulation was a one-to-one transposition of the use provisions of the designation decision, producing no new legal effects, the RBML law provides that no objection procedure or appeal to the administrative court is open against it.

Gezien het feit dat de omzettingsregeling daarmee een één op één omzetting van de gebruiksbepalingen van het aanwijzingsbesluit betrof waaruit geen nieuwe rechtsgevolgen voortvloeiden is in de wet RBML bepaald dat tegen de omzettingsregeling geen mogelijkheid van een bezwaarschriftprocedure of een beroep op de bestuursrechter openstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Vestering over het lage btw-tarief op sierteeltproducten

MPs Van Raan and Vestering asked the government about the reduced 9% VAT rate on ornamental horticulture products, questioning its original justifications, its environmental impact, reliance on migrant labour, and whether it should continue. Minister Schouten answered that the reduced rate remains justified for affordability and sector support, that the sector's pesticide use per hectare has declined, and that a broad evaluation of the reduced rate will take place in 2022.
A broad evaluation of the reduced VAT rate, including ornamental horticulture, will take place in 2022.
Er zal in 2022 een brede evaluatie van het lage btw-tarief, inclusief sierteelt, plaatsvinden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Peters, Lodders, Edgar Mulder, Van Weyenberg, Snels, Nijboer, Bruins, Van Raan, Azarkan, Van Haga, Van Otterloo, Leijten, Stoffer en Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht dat de Bel

MPs from many parties asked whether the Tax Authority fails to apply the protected minimum (beslagvrije voet) when offsetting benefit overpayments against current allowances, and whether this breaches the law. The State Secretary admits that offsets under the standard payment arrangement were made without applying the protected minimum, that this is a mistaken assumption, and promises a repayment operation and a solution, but declines to meet the requested three-week deadline.
I conclude that this approach, given the purpose and intent of the Wet vBVV, offers citizens insufficient protection.
Ik concludeer dat deze werkwijze, gezien het doel en de strekking van de Wet vBVV, onvoldoende bescherming aan burgers biedt.
Antwoord  op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat de Duitse Klimaatwet deels ongrondwettelijk is

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers how the German Constitutional Court ruling on the Climate Act relates to the Dutch Climate Act and whether Dutch climate policy protects the right to a future for present and future generations. The state secretary answered that the German ruling cannot be translated directly to Dutch law, that Dutch policy aims at emission reductions in line with the Paris Agreement, and that the Climate Act will be adjusted to EU targets.
This link between human rights and climate applies in particular to those who will most come to face the consequences of climate change, such as children and future generations.
Dit verband tussen mensenrechten en klimaat geldt in het bijzonder voor degenen die het meest met de gevolgen van klimaatverandering te maken gaan krijgen, zoals kinderen en toekomstige generaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over zandwinning uit de Waddenzee

An MP asked the government about sand extraction from the Wadden Sea, including whether it harms the sandbar structure, how much sand is dredged, and whether sand from the North Sea is needed to offset subsidence from gas and salt mining. The minister answered that extraction at maintenance dredging ends in 2022, that dredged sand will instead be dumped in designated spots, and that mining subsidence is compensated by North Sea sand supplements under licence conditions.
From 2022 no more sand may be extracted from the Wadden Sea system during fairway maintenance.
Per 2022 mag er geen zand meer aan het waddensysteem worden onttrokken bij vaargeulonderhoud.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht 'Lawaai vliegbasis nadert de (pijn)grens'

An MP asks the government about reports that F-35 jet noise, especially low-frequency noise, exceeds that of the F-16 and is not blocked by existing home insulation, and about environmental, consultation and transparency concerns around the airspace redesign and enlarged military training area in northern Netherlands. The government disputes the comparison as methodologically flawed, says noise monitoring and a study are underway, notes the F-35 noise table is classified by the US, and limits its commitments to further study within the existing consultation process.
The noise table of the F-35 is still classified as such by the US government.
De geluidstabel van de F-35 is nog als geclassificeerd bestempeld door de Amerikaanse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over mensenrechtenschending, milieuvervuiling en belastingontwijking door oliebedrijf Pluspetrol

Two MPs asked the Dutch government about alleged human rights violations, pollution and tax avoidance by Pluspetrol, including its refusal to cooperate with the Dutch OECD National Contact Point and whether business misconduct should be sanctioned or made legally enforceable. The ministers answered that OECD guidelines are voluntary, that CSR policy is being strengthened toward a due diligence obligation (preferably at EU level), and that enforcement options are still being worked out.
The cabinet is currently developing building blocks for CSR legislation.
Het kabinet werkt op dit moment bouwstenen uit voor IMVO-wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht ‘Nederlands pensioengeld betrokken bij illegale veehandel en ontbossing Amazone’

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Finance Minister whether ABP, a public-sector pension fund that signed the IMVB covenant, should stop financing deforestation linked to meat supplier JBS, and how this fits government biodiversity policy. The government answered that investment decisions and engagement are the responsibility of individual pension funds, that it expects them to follow OECD and UNGP standards, and that it is pursuing a due diligence obligation at EU level.

How individual pension funds give effect to compliance with these international guidelines, and which companies they invest in or not, is the responsibility and choice of the individual pension funds.

Hoe individuele pensioenfondsen invulling geven aan de naleving van deze internationale richtlijnen en in welke bedrijven zij wel of niet investeren is de verantwoordelijkheid en keuze van de individuele pensioenfondsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over het bericht dat Duitsland haar broeikasgasreductiedoelen gaat aanscherpen

Two MPs (Teunissen and Van Raan, PvdD) asked the government about Germany's tightened 2030, 2040 and 2045 greenhouse gas targets, which follow a Constitutional Court ruling on Germany's climate law. The State Secretary answered that the targets are binding and cover all greenhouse gases, that Germany responded to the court ruling, and that the Netherlands will leave its own ambition for 2030 and 2050 to a next cabinet while welcoming the EU's higher target.
The Netherlands has in recent years repeatedly worked for ambitious European climate policy, including through the European Climate Ambition group.
Nederland heeft zich de afgelopen jaren veelvuldig ingezet voor ambitieus Europees klimaatbeleid, onder meer via de Europese klimaatkopgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen, Bouchallikh, Grinwis, Van Raan en De Hoop over de minicargovluchten die worden uitgevoerd tussen Luik en Maastricht

MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about mini cargo flights between Liège and Maastricht, including how many occurred, whether the minister still opposes them for environmental reasons, and whether a ban like France's is legally possible. The minister confirmed seven repositioning flights since January (six by Astral Aviation), said the EU framework lacks room for national bans, and promised to monitor France's case and raise the issue in revising EU Regulation 1008/2008.

A concrete legal basis for temporarily banning such flights due to serious environmental problems is absent from Dutch legislation and, given their cross-border nature, could not be unilaterally established by the Netherlands.

Een concrete wettelijke grondslag voor het tijdelijk verbieden van dergelijke vluchten wegens ernstige milieuproblemen ontbreekt in de Nederlandse wetgeving en zou gelet op het grensoverschrijdend karakter niet eenzijdig door Nederland vastgesteld kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over exportkredietverzekeringen voor omstreden gasprojecten in Mozambique

MPs Van Raan and Teunissen asked the Dutch government about export credit insurance for the contested Mozambique LNG gas project in Cabo Delgado, including security, human rights, status of policies and climate compatibility. The government answered that policies were issued in March 2021 after financial close, that the state would not recover losses from Mozambique, that a new security analysis would be needed for any restart, and that the project was assessed against OECD/IFC standards.
We therefore cannot provide you with information on this, insofar as it is not already public.
Wij kunnen u hierover dus geen informatie verstrekken voor zover niet reeds openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over biomassacentrales bij kastuinbouwgebieden

An MP asks the minister why biomass plants for greenhouse horticulture keep receiving subsidies and whether cleaner heat alternatives should be prioritised, and whether building such plants should be discouraged or banned. The minister answers that biomass is considered a sustainable heat source, that low-temperature subsidies will be phased out as soon as feasible, that the final phase-out date is left to the next cabinet, and that a ban is not planned.
I cannot provide a list of built biomass plants at greenhouse horticulture areas because the type of heat customer is not registered.
Ik kan geen lijst met gebouwde biomassacentrales bij glastuinbouwgebieden overleggen omdat de aard van de afnemer van de warmte niet wordt geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over het bericht dat volgens de secretaris-generaal van de Verenigde Naties de wereld op de rand van de afgrond staat door de klimaatcrisis

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan asked the minister about UN and IEA warnings on climate change and CO2 emissions, and whether the Dutch COVID recovery packages sufficiently support a green recovery. The minister acknowledges the urgency, says the packages aimed to preserve employment rather than break with fossil business as usual, and points to the Klimaatakkoord, the EU Recovery and Resilience Facility, and a decision left to the next cabinet.
Implementing reforms was an important condition for the cabinet to agree to establish the RRF.
Het doorvoeren van hervormingen was een belangrijke voorwaarde voor het kabinet om in te kunnen stemmen met de oprichting van de RRF.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Laçin en Kröger over Lelystad Airport

MPs Van Raan, Laçin and Kröger asked the ministers whether the government would honour the House's controversial declaration on Lelystad Airport and refrain from irreversible steps, including continuing the permit procedure, given the statutory decision deadline. Minister Schouten answered that the permit is a legally required individual procedure separate from political decision-making, that the deadline is an order term but binding and cannot be suspended, and that she will not pause the procedure.
A controversial declaration by the House of Representatives does not constitute grounds for me to invoke force majeure in the case of this permit application.
Een controversieel-verklaring door de Tweede Kamer vormt geen grond om mij te mogen beroepen op overmacht in het geval van deze vergunningaanvraag.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het aanwenden van zijn invloed, als gevolg van de staatsdeelneming Schiphol, om de behandeling van de aangevraagde natuurvergunning voor Lelystad Airport op te schorten

MP Van Raan asked whether the state, as shareholder of Schiphol, could pressure the Lelystad Airport permit applicant to accept a delay in the nature permit so that the House's controversial-declaration request not to take irreversible steps is respected. The government answered that operational permit matters are the responsibility of Schiphol's management, that shareholders have no direct role, and that the permit concerns legal ecological criteria rather than political decisions requiring parliamentary involvement.
There would only have been a disregard of a controversial declaration if the decision-making involved political considerations and parliament had involvement.

Er zou echter pas sprake zijn geweest van het negeren van een controversieel-verklaring als het besluitvorming zou betreffen waarbij politieke afwegingen een rol spelen en het parlement betrokkenheid heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over onnodig hoge subsidies voor Carbon Capture and Storage (CCS) en de lobby van de fossiele industrie

MP Van Raan asks whether the fossil industry lobbied the government for CCS subsidies, state liability and guarantees, and whether SDE++ subsidies for CCS are excessive given the CO2 levy and the PBL advice. The minister denies industry drafted the CCS plans or demanded guarantees, explains the SDE++ and CO2 levy mechanics, and defends the 2020 subsidy round, promising only to revisit SDE++ details in future rounds.
No, that is incorrect. In regular contacts with the companies involved, including state holdings, numerous topics are discussed.
Nee, dat is onjuist. In de reguliere contacten met de betrokken ondernemingen, waaronder staatsdeelnemingen, komen tal van onderwerpen aan bod.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Raan over de Rabobank die erkent dat het landbouwsysteem failliet is, maar verandering tegenwerkt,

MPs Wassenberg and Van Raan asked the ministers about Rabobank acknowledging co-responsibility for agricultural problems while allegedly resisting change, and about financing barriers for farmers seeking sustainable transition and the use of subsidies that may flow to banks. The minister acknowledged shared responsibility of financiers, pointed to voluntary initiatives, the Omschakelprogramma and Investeringsfonds, the SER exploration, and declined to pursue additional legislation or new reporting, leaving banks' lending decisions to them.
I do not intend to work towards an additional reporting cycle at company level, but I consider it very important to have good insight into developments in this area.
Ik ben niet voornemens naar een additionele rapportagecyclus op bedrijfsniveau toe te werken, maar ik vind het wel heel belangrijk om goed inzicht te hebben in de ontwikkelingen op dit terrein.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over het bericht ‘Hoekstra: NS zal ‘op termijn’ minder moeten gaan rijden’

Two Party for the Animals MPs asked why the Finance Minister says NS (Dutch Railways) must run fewer trains when more sustainable public transport is needed, and why Air France-KLM is not held to the same standard, including whether a motion on capacity growth is being implemented. The minister answers that NS faces financial pressure from COVID-19, that a public-transport availability fee has been extended to end-2021, that talks on further support and a post-2021 scheme are ongoing, and that Air France-KLM is not bound by concession obligations, but gives largely general answers without committing to specific new steps beyond continued consultation.
In doing so we look at what NS can do itself, and at what the shareholder and concession authority can do.
Daarbij kijken we naar wat NS zelf kan doen, en naar wat de aandeelhouder en concessieverlener kunnen doen.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Raan over de activiteiten van de KLM Flight Academy (KFA)

MP Van Raan asked about the rise in training flights at Groningen Airport Eelde in 2020 by the KLM Flight Academy, its turnover, NOW wage subsidy receipt of EUR 1.56 million, noise and environmental effects. The minister confirmed the 23% rise in movements, largely from training flights merged with Martinair, said turnover is booked per student progress and cannot be shown separately as it is confidential, and stated operations stay within noise limits and opening hours enforced by the ILT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over een extra subsidie voor de extra bijstook van houtige biomassa

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether RWE's Eemshaven coal plant received extra subsidy to raise woody biomass co-firing from 15% to 30%, and how this fits with the Energy Agreement cap and the ban on new biomass subsidies. The minister answered that no new or increased subsidy decision was issued, that the existing 2016 subsidy ceiling is about 930 million euros over 8 years, and that the co-firing category was closed in the SDE+ after 2017.
I cannot provide competition-sensitive data on the amount of biomass used.
Ik kan geen concurrentiegevoelige gegevens over de gebruikte hoeveelheid biomassa verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over watergebruik in datacenters

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the government about water use by data centres, including whether dikes must be raised, permitting, discharge rules and drinking water use for cooling. The minister answered that the Wieringermeer dike meets the legal norm, that the permitting authority and discharge rules are set out, and that she does not find national legislation on data centre water use necessary, while committing to a national drinking water policy exploration.
There is no information available on cooling water use for specific data centres in North Holland.
Er is geen informatie beschikbaar over gebruik van koelwater voor specifieke datacenters in Noord-Holland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de noodzaak van een progressieve vliegbelasting voor veelvliegers

An MP asked the government about introducing a progressive flight tax for frequent flyers, citing a report on elite flying and public support. The State Secretary answered that the current per-passenger tax already charges frequent flyers more, and that a frequent-flyer levy raises implementation and privacy problems, so the government did not commit to such a tax.
The cabinet is aware that not everyone in the Netherlands flies equally.
Het kabinet is zich ervan bewust dat niet iedereen in Nederland evenveel vliegt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het uitfaseren van subsidies voor houtige biomassa

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about phasing out subsidies for woody biomass, citing a PBL advice, the CO2 accounting of biomass, and the ecological and emissions concerns raised by experts and NGOs. The minister answered in detail on volumes, subsidy amounts (about 4.95 billion euro for 2020-2032 in the table, 9.5 billion in total commitments), the carbon-neutrality assumption, and the phase-out timeline, but committed to a later response on the Van Esch motion and left the phase-out date to a future cabinet.
I will return shortly on the implementation of the Van Esch motion (Kamerstuk 30 175, no. 360).
Ik kom op korte termijn terug op de uitvoering van Motie Van Esch (Kamerstuk 30 175, nr. 360).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de bouwprojecten op Bonaire

An MP asked ministers about planned port and fuel-pier construction on Bonaire that could destroy coral and whether permits, enforcement, financing, cruise tourism and waste management were adequately handled. The government answered that no construction has begun, that existing environmental and maritime procedures apply and can be appealed, and that a feasibility and cost-benefit study and the Bonaire Brandstof Terminals company will follow.
These procedures are public, have objection and appeal possibilities and can go to the administrative court.
Deze procedures zijn openbaar, kennen bezwaar en beroepsmogelijkheden en een gang naar de bestuursrechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over het transparantiebeleid van ontwikkelingsbank FMO en door FMO gefinancierde misstanden in de Democratische Republiek Congo

MPs Van Raan and Van den Nieuwenhuijzen asked about FMO's transparency policy and alleged abuses (land rights, wages, complaints handling) linked to the Feronia-PHC palm oil plantations in DR Congo. The minister's answers largely describe FMO's ESAP, debt write-down conditions, the complaints mechanism process and monitoring, while declining to share the confidential due diligence report and stating there is no list of companies guilty of land grabbing.
This study contains confidential business information and for legal reasons FMO cannot share or publish this document.
Dit onderzoek bevat bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie en om juridische redenen kan FMO dit document niet delen of openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de duurzaamheid van houtige biomassa

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about Estonian forest cutting, whether the Dutch sustainability certification schemes for wood biomass (SBP, FSC, PEFC) guarantee sustainability, and how they are controlled. The minister disputed the reported forest-area decline, said the schemes meet Dutch criteria and that checks by accredited bodies apply, but declined to disclose company certificate use and specific shipment details as confidential.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de onzin van subsidieslurpende mestfabrieken

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked whether manure processing plants receiving SDE++ subsidy really produce renewable energy, given gas use, digestate marketing, fraud risk and emissions. The minister answered that subsidies go to renewable energy production, that fraud risks are addressed through enforcement, and declined to remove manure installations from the scheme.
No figures are kept on gas use by manure processors.
Er worden geen cijfers bijgehouden van het aardgasgebruik bij mestverwerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de natuurvergunning van Groningen Airport Eelde

Two MPs (Van Raan and Wassenberg, PvdD) asked the minister whether the 2009 nature permit for Groningen Airport Eelde, its monitoring plans and reports, and possible additional conditions to protect nearby Natura 2000 areas were in order. The minister confirmed she is the competent authority, said monitoring was required, but explained that no further conditions were needed because flight movements fell after the permit, so the planned post-permit monitoring was never carried out.
The subsequent monitoring, which concerned the expansion, ultimately did not take place because the number of flight movements actually decreased after the permit was issued.
De opvolgende monitoring, die zag op de uitbreiding, heeft echter uiteindelijk niet plaatsgevonden omdat de hoeveelheid vliegbewegingen na afgifte van de vergunning juist is afgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over ING als huisbankier van de overheid

MP Van Raan asks the Finance Minister how the tender that awarded ING the government's current-account banking contract applied sustainability criteria, and whether ING's climate, human-rights and sustainability record was weighed given its financing of controversial sectors and clients. The minister replies that MVO criteria carried 24% of quality points, that ING met the sustainability threshold on external ratings, and that the government will keep engaging the financial sector on climate commitments without committing to specific sanctions on ING.
In a tender, the information bidders provide and its assessment are confidential.
In een aanbesteding heeft de informatie die de inschrijvers bieden en de beoordeling hiervan een vertrouwelijk karakter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het bericht dat journalisten stiekem konden meekijken bij online tentamens

MPs asked the education minister about reports that journalists could covertly watch online exams at Hanzehogeschool, exposing student names and ID numbers, and what safeguards exist. The minister confirmed the breach, described remedial steps and a notification to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, said no new regulation is needed, and declined to keep a register of online exam incidents, citing institutions' own responsibility.
Higher education institutions bear responsibility under their statutory duties for ensuring the quality of (online) examinations and their components.
Hoger onderwijsinstellingen dragen vanuit hun wettelijke taak de verantwoordelijkheid om de kwaliteit van de (online) examens en de onderdelen daarvan te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over de boete voor een kapitein na een grote olielekkage in de Rotterdamse haven

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked why a captain was fined only 1,000 euros after a major oil spill in the Rotterdam port, and about liability, sentencing and environmental criminal law. The minister answered that the courts decide sentencing, that the shipowner's liability-limitation request was rejected and is pending before the Supreme Court, and that work on speeding up environmental enforcement is underway, without committing to new criminal-law measures.
I do not intervene in the decision of the criminal judge.
Ik treed niet in de beslissing van de strafrechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het bericht dat studenten van de Erasmus Universiteit een tweede camera moeten gebruiken bij tentamens

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch asked whether the Erasmus University's requirement for a second camera during proctored exams is proportionate and privacy-compliant, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister answered that institutions decide their own measures after a risk analysis with the data protection officer, that she calls on institutions to use second cameras only when strictly necessary, and that alternatives to proctoring should be offered where possible.
I call on educational institutions to be restrained in using a second camera for online examinations and to adopt this measure only where it is deemed strictly necessary.
Ik roep onderwijsinstellingen op om terughoudend te zijn met de inzet van een tweede camera bij online tentaminering en alleen over te gaan op deze maatregel als het strikt noodzakelijk wordt geacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de commodificatie van water en waterroof door Nederlandse financiële instellingen

An MP asks the government about financial institutions and water commodification and water grabbing, and whether the financial sector can regulate itself, citing Follow the Money reporting. The government recognises the right to water, says a binding corporate due diligence obligation (ideally at EU level) is preferred over single-theme criminalisation or a ban, and points to voluntary initiatives such as the Valuing Water Initiative and existing sector covenants.
In the policy note of 16 October 2020 the cabinet states that evaluations show the existing CSR policy is insufficiently effective.
In de beleidsnota van 16 oktober 2020 geeft het kabinet aan dat uit evaluaties blijkt dat het bestaande IMVO-beleid onvoldoende effectief is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin, Van Raan, Van Brenk, Stoffer en Gijs van Dijk over reisbeperkingen

MPs from several parties asked the Infrastructure and Water Management and Justice ministers about travel restrictions on non-essential trips, including how Finland and Belgium's border measures fit EU law, whether Dutch legal frameworks allow similar restrictions, and whether the OMT should be asked for advice. The government answered that it considers a ban on non-essential travel disproportionate, legally vulnerable and hard to enforce, has already adopted other measures, and that the OMT judged additional flight bans unnecessary, providing a country overview in an annex.
The cabinet therefore considers it currently not proportionate, legally vulnerable and difficult to enforce to prohibit non-essential travel.
Het kabinet acht het derhalve op dit moment niet proportioneel, juridisch kwetsbaar en moeilijk uitvoerbaar om niet-noodzakelijke reizen te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over de MQ-9 Reaper drones en over vergunningen voor vliegbasis Leeuwarden

MPs Van Esch and Van Raan asked about the armed potential of MQ-9 Reaper drones, civilian harm, and environmental permits (nitrogen and noise) for Leeuwarden air base, and whether residents can access full study information. The state secretary said arming the MQ-9 is not yet in defence plans but is being considered, stated that classified noise data are withheld while the permit authorities decide what is published, and said there are no significant effects on Natura 2000 areas.

If Defence states in the permit application that parts of the information supplied are classified, the competent authority includes a justification in the decision and those parts are not made available for public inspection.

Als Defensie bij de vergunningsaanvraag stelt dat delen van de geleverde informatie geclassificeerd zijn, dan wordt door het bevoegd gezag in de beschikking een motivering opgenomen en worden die delen niet ter inzage gelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over oliehandelaren, corruptie en de financiële sector

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Finance Minister about oil trader Vitol's alleged bribery and tax avoidance, bank financing of such firms, and whether the government would enforce OECD guidelines and mandatory due diligence. The government acknowledged the allegations, said it expects Dutch firms and banks to follow the OECD guidelines, and pointed to a planned broad due diligence obligation, mostly without committing to specific enforcement of the named companies.
On questions about how the above or other companies handle these matters and what their tax position is, I cannot go into detail.
Op vragen over hoe bovengenoemde of andere bedrijven hiermee omgaan en wat hun belastingpositie is, kan ik niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de weeffout in de subsidiëring voor CO2-afvang en -opslag (Carbon Capture Storage)

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the SDE++ subsidy for carbon capture and storage (CCS) is distorted by the national CO2 levy and ETS prices, and whether this delays the energy transition, across 20 questions. The Minister rejects the alleged flaws, defends the design of the levy and the subsidy, notes that bank guarantees and the 7.2 Mt cap limit the risk, and states that the requested tender figures will follow after assessment.
At this moment the Netherlands Enterprise Agency (RVO.nl) is assessing and checking the applications.
Op dit moment is de Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO.nl) bezig met het beoordelen en controleren van de aanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Kröger over luchtvaart en corona

MPs Van Raan and Kröger asked the minister about RIVM sewage monitoring at Schiphol for coronavirus, why the data is not public, flight passenger numbers from the UK and South Africa, and refusals of non-Schengen arrivals. The minister answered that the Schiphol sampling continues but is not published because it cannot be compared with municipal sites, that passenger data and refusal statistics are provided, and that some data (variant testing, nationality of all travellers) is unavailable.
Schiphol cannot provide country-specific passenger figures because the information is highly competitively sensitive.
Schiphol kan, in verband met de zeer concurrentiegevoelige aard van de informatie, geen landenspecifieke cijfers over passagiersaantallen verschaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over Maastricht Aachen Airport

An MP asks the government about Maastricht Aachen Airport growth, noise in Limburg quiet areas, and conflicting studies on tourism impacts, and asks whether the growth doctrine influenced commissioned research. The minister answers that the province of Limburg is responsible for quiet areas and for MAA's future, that the independent advice is pending, and that he does not take positions on the Breda and Ecorys studies, while also replying on the air-freight levy report and rejecting a growth doctrine.

Since I am not the commissioning party for either study and there is no formal application for an airport decision yet that I must consider, I do not think it is appropriate to make statements about either study.

Aangezien ik geen opdrachtgever ben van beide onderzoeken en er nog geen formele aanvraag voor een luchthavenbesluit ligt waarover ik mij moet buigen acht ik het niet opportuun om uitspraken te doen over beide onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Gijs van Dijk, Laçin, Van Raan en Stoffer over de stikstofberekeningen Lelystad Airport

MPs asked whether the 2014 nitrogen calculations for Lelystad Airport were wrong, why a high heat content was used, and whether the 2015 airport decision and 2019 PAS notification should be voided. The minister acknowledges calculation errors, says the PAS notification was made in good faith and will be legalised under a verification procedure, and promises to share the project-specific assessment later.
As reported in the letter to parliament of 3 December, I will share the project-specific assessment with the House once it is completed.
Antwoord 3 Zoals gemeld in de Kamerbrief van 3 december 5 zal ik de project specifieke beoordeling met de Kamer delen zodra deze is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het nieuwe investeringsbeleid van de Nederlandse ontwikkelingsbank (FMO)

An MP asks the Dutch government about FMO's proposed phase-out of fossil fuel investments, including gas, and whether the state as shareholder should require alignment with the Climate Agreement. The minister answers that FMO has not yet decided, that the state is a distant shareholder leaving individual investment choices to FMO, and that the government is pursuing gradual phase-out in multilateral finance.
However, the state is a distant shareholder. It is up to the holdings themselves to determine how individual investments relate to climate-related and other (impact) objectives.

De staat is echter aandeelhouder op afstand. Het is aan deelnemingen zelf om te bepalen hoe individuele investeringen zich verhouden tot klimaat gerelateerde doelstellingen en andere (impact) doelstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over belemmeringen voor verduurzaming van de financiële sector

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Finance about deforestation linked to soy and cattle supply chains, biodiversity risks in the financial sector, and whether regulation beyond self-regulation is needed. The Minister answered that the government supports EU taxonomy, due diligence and non-financial reporting initiatives and sees no need for further research at this stage, while declining to commit to new binding measures.
I therefore see no need for additional research at this moment.
Ik zie daarom op dit moment geen noodzaak tot aanvullend onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, Dik-Faber en Van Raan over het artikel 'Stukken bos kaalgekapt in Estland voor Nederlandse biomassacentrales'

MPs Sienot, Dik-Faber and Van Raan asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about press reports that whole forests in Estonia were clear-cut to supply Dutch biomass plants, and about controls and sustainability. The minister disputed that this reflects the picture, pointed to strict Dutch sustainability criteria, certification and verification by conformity bodies, and promised to investigate the signal further and discuss it with Estonia.
I want to investigate this signal further and enter into discussion with the authors of the report 'The dark side of the wood pellet'.
Ik wil dit signaal verder onderzoeken en in gesprek gaan met de opstellers van het rapport «De duistere kant van de houtpellet».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Karabulut, Ploumen, Van Raan, Van Ojik, Van Helvert en Van der Staaij over de mensenrechtensituatie in West-Papua

MPs from seven parties asked the Foreign Minister about arms exports to Indonesia, the Community Policing Programme, human rights in West Papua, journalist access, the murder of Yeremia Zanambani, and environmental damage by companies. The minister answered that arms licences are assessed case by case including the Papua situation, the Dutch programme ended in 2019 with local continuation, and human rights concerns are raised bilaterally, though no full overview of documented violations or environmental damage is held.
However, I do not have a complete overview of all documented damage to the environment, living environment and climate in Papua.
Ik beschik echter niet over een totaaloverzicht van alle gedocumenteerde schade aan milieu, leefomgeving en klimaat in Papua.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Gijs van Dijk, Stoffer en Van Raan over stikstofberekeningen

MPs asked the minister about a 2014 review by Arcadis and NLR of nitrogen deposition calculations for Lelystad Airport, including the review's findings, its commissioning, and the NLR role, with documents to be shared within a week. The minister answered that the concept memo was attached, that flagged points were corrected in a June 2014 addendum, that the commissioning contract is withheld as commercially confidential, and that new project-specific assessments will be done with updated models.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Kröger, Bruins, Remco Dijkstra, Amhaouch, Gijs van Dijk, Van Brenk, Laçin, Stoffer, Krol, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Raan over een overvol Schiphol

Opposition MPs asked the government about overcrowding and queues at Schiphol, adherence to COVID-19 distancing rules, travel advice, the Brexit and testing effects on arrivals, and whether flight bans or test facilities would be used. The ministers answered that Schiphol is required to prevent queues and enforce rules, that a flight ban is currently undesirable, and that testing and an air corridor pilot are being developed, with several questions combined.
We asked Schiphol for clarification and said they must take action to ensure the measures are complied with.
Wij hebben Schiphol om opheldering gevraagd en gezegd dat zij actie moeten ondernemen om te zorgen dat de maatregelen worden nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de poging van Twente Airport om zonder vergunning zeer zware vliegtuigen te laten vertrekken

MP Van Raan asked the government about Twente Airport's attempt to operate very heavy aircraft without a permit, including whether the ILT granted an exemption under pressure and whether the airport repeatedly pushes regulatory limits. The minister answered that the ILT granted a one-off exemption for six Lufthansa aircraft under additional safety conditions, denied any influence from litigation threats or the airport's business plan, and said the ILT will tighten oversight of the airport.
The ILT is intensifying its attention on the airport because, based on the facts described, it has found that the airport repeatedly seeks the limits of the rules.

De ILT verscherpt haar aandacht voor de luchthaven, omdat zij op basis van de hiervoor beschreven feiten en omstandigheden heeft geconstateerd dat de luchthaven telkens de grenzen van de regels opzoekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over zandwinning

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about sand extraction in the North Sea, including whether sand used to compensate subsidence from gas and salt mining is a justified use of a scarce resource and whether a priority rule applies. The minister answered that North Sea sand is not scarce for the Netherlands, that sand extraction for coastal protection has national priority under the Nationaal Waterplan, and that the questions could not be answered in time before the committee meeting.
For the Netherlands, sand from the North Sea cannot be called scarce.
Voor Nederland geldt dat het zand afkomstig uit de Noordzee niet schaars te noemen is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het bericht ‘studenten die spionagesoftware moeten installeren om tentamens te kunnen doen’.

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch asked whether students being forced to install surveillance software (proctoring) for exams is acceptable, given privacy concerns and expert warnings. The Minister says proctoring is sometimes necessary when alternatives are infeasible, that GDPR-compliant safeguards apply, that students may object and request alternatives, but gives no figures on use and no commitment to compensate or to stop its use.
Institutions do not register how many students do or do not install proctoring software.
Instellingen registreren niet hoeveel studenten wel of niet proctoring-software installeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de klimaatplannen van olie- en gasbedrijven

An MP asks the ministers of Economic Affairs and Climate and of Finance whether oil and gas companies' climate plans are adequate for 1.5°C, about Shell's greenwashing, fossil fuel licensing, tax incentives, export credit and FMO financing, advertising, and the Climate Day platform for Shell and BP. The minister largely defends continued gas extraction from small Dutch fields, says a review of fossil fuel fiscal incentives will be completed in Q1 2021, and declines to ban fossil fuel advertising or remove Shell and BP from the Climate Day.
Unfortunately, this overview cannot yet be provided with sufficient care at this time.
Dit overzicht kan op dit moment helaas nog niet met voldoende zorgvuldigheid worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Laçin over de toekomst van Groningen Airport Eelde

MPs Van Raan and Laçin asked whether the Minister knows of Groningen Airport Eelde's weak traffic and financial position and whether the state will provide six to eight million euro per year, and about closure procedures. The Minister said the government sees airports as independent enterprises, structural state contributions do not fit aviation policy, no formal request was received, and shareholders must first decide on the airport's future; closure would require changes to regulations and the Aviation Act.
The cabinet sees airports as independent enterprises that are themselves responsible for financing their activities.
Het kabinet ziet luchthavens als zelfstandige ondernemingen die zelf verantwoordelijk zijn voor de bekostiging van hun activiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over het bericht ‘misleidende kindermarketing door de vee-industrie’

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked whether the government will act against pig-industry marketing aimed at children, including the 'The Pig Story' lesson pack and the Agractie 'Boer in de klas' programme that receives a start-up subsidy. Minister Schouten answers that schools freely choose their materials, the government does not vet or warn against them, no oversight tightening is planned, and the subsidy conditions are described.
Beyond that, I do not foresee any additional steps.
Verder voorzie ik geen extra stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over biogrondstoffen

The MP asks about biomass energy: whether the government will talk with environmental groups and Vattenfall, phase out subsidies for wood-fired heat and power, tighten emission limits near homes, and revise RED II. The minister answers that stakeholder consultation is ongoing, existing subsidies will not be revoked, phasing out subsidies and tightening emission norms are planned, and disputes about the Diemen plant are for the courts.
Furthermore, it is not for me to interfere in the legal proceedings that are ongoing on this matter.
Het is verder niet aan mij om mij te mengen in gerechtelijke procedures die hierover lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over investeringen in de plasticindustrie

MP Van Raan asked the government about investments in the plastics industry, including Shell and financial institutions, recyclate requirements, a tax on virgin plastic and OECD guidelines. The government answered that it expects firms to follow OECD and UN guidance, will raise the plastics pact and recyclate use at EU level, sees no national import levy as current, and will not yet decide on additional measures.

The cabinet expects all Dutch companies operating internationally, including banks, insurers and pension funds, to comply with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.

Het kabinet verwacht van alle Nederlandse bedrijven die internationaal ondernemen, waaronder banken, verzekeraars en pensioenfondsen, dat zij de OESO-richtlijnen voor Multinationale Ondernemingen (OESO-richtlijnen) en de UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights (UNGP's) naleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik, Karabulut, Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Van Raan over de beveiliging van Nobelprijswinnaar dr. Denis Mukwege

MPs asked whether MONUSCO protection of Nobel laureate Denis Mukwege and the Panzi hospital is sufficient, whether Nederland will play a role in his security, and whether he should be protected. The minister answered that Nederland pressed the UN for adequate protection, MONUSCO assigned Nepalese troops to the compound and committed to continued protection, and Nederland is exploring a new contribution to security without a formal request from Mukwege.
For this reason, the Netherlands has in recent weeks pressed the UN for adequate protection for Dr. Mukwege.
Nederland heeft daarom de afgelopen weken bij de VN aangedrongen op adequate bescherming voor dr. Mukwege.

Antwoord op vragen van de van de leden Kröger, Laçin, van Raan, Gijs van Dijk van Brenk over reizigers die vanuit Nederland met het vliegtuig naar gebieden vertrekken waarvoor een oranje reisadvies geldt

MPs asked how many travellers fly from the Netherlands to orange-advice destinations, how many are non-essential, and whether low fares undermine the advice. The minister reported about 39,928 non-transfer passengers from Schiphol in one week, said travel purpose is not recorded, and wrote to airlines and travel associations urging them not to promote such trips.
Under privacy regulations, transport companies do not record the intention or purpose of the traveller's journey.
Op grond van de privacyregelgeving registreren vervoersbedrijven niet de intentie dan wel het doel van de reis van de reiziger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de vergunningverlening aan Vattenfall voor de bouw van een biomassacentrale in Diemen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about permitting and subsidy for Vattenfall's biomass plant in Diemen, and whether a moratorium on new biomass subsidies should be introduced. The minister said a subsidy decision was already taken, refused a moratorium while citing a forthcoming biomass sustainability framework and phase-out measures.
The national government plays no further role in this.
Het Rijk speelt hierbij verder geen rol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over investeringen van ontwikkelingsbanken in de vee-industrie

MP Van Raan asks the Finance and Foreign Trade and Development ministers why development banks such as IFC and EBRD finance industrial livestock, which he considers harmful to climate goals and to developing countries. The minister replies that such investments are limited, are screened against strict environmental and climate criteria, serve food security, and that Nederland pushes banks to align portfolios with Paris goals; he gives a detailed overview of Dutch shareholdings and sector financing by other banks, without committing to halting livestock investments.
The Netherlands exerts influence through its representation on the institutions' executive boards, participation in replenishment negotiations for the banks' funds, and contributions to Trust Funds.

Nederland oefent onder meer invloed uit via de vertegenwoordiging in de uitvoerende raden van de instellingen en door deelname aan overlegrondes over middelenaanvullingen van de fondsen van de banken en door bijdragen aan Trust Funds.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over het actief ontmoedigen van onnodige reizen naar risicogebieden

Green MPs Van Esch and Van Raan asked the government how it will discourage unnecessary travel to COVID-19 risk areas, including ticket advertising and the Schiphol test lane's capacity. The ministers answered that travellers bear responsibility for their choices, orange advice is in place, a Schiphol testing study is under way with results expected mid-September, and airlines were urged to stop promoting travel to orange areas.
It is the responsibility of the traveller themselves to weigh whether a trip is necessary or not.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de reiziger zelf om de afweging te maken of een reis noodzakelijk is of niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Raan en Wassenberg over het NOW-register en controversiële steun

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked whether NOW wage-support should go to firms linked to controversial sectors and to firms with animal-welfare, COVID-compliance or dividend controversies, and asked for sector data and new ethical criteria. The minister said the scheme is deliberately generic to be fast and broad, that the register cannot show sector activities, and that no new criteria will be added.
To provide income protection and preserve employment, the measure must be generic.
Om inkomensbescherming en behoud van werkgelegenheid te bieden, moet er sprake zijn van een generieke maatregel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over biomassa uit Estland

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals ask the ministers about clear-cutting and biodiversity loss in Estonian forests supplying wood pellets to Dutch subsidised biomass plants, including Natura 2000 logging, overexploitation, corruption risks and whether subsidies should stop. Minister Wiebes answers that Dutch sustainability criteria under the SDE+ scheme apply, that the government sees no reason for independent research, and that Estonian forest regulation is primarily Estonia's responsibility.
I am not aware of how much biomass is imported annually from Estonia.
Het is mij niet bekend hoeveel biomassa er jaarlijks geïmporteerd wordt uit Estland.
Antwoord op ragen van de leden Kröger, Paternotte, Gijs van Dijk, Van Raan, Öztürk, Bruins, Amhaouch, Laçin, Van Kooten-Arissen, Van Brenk en Stoffer over de teststraat op Schiphol

Eleven MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the Schiphol COVID-19 test facility should be scaled up and extended to match arrivals from orange-code countries such as Spain and France, and whether all travellers from those areas could be tested on arrival at Dutch airports. The answer, sent via a letter from Minister De Jonge, refers to the broader testing and tracing letter and does not address the specific questions.

The written questions from the eleven MPs to the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management, submitted 27 August 2020, have been answered by a letter titled 'Testing and tracing: together strategically combating the Corona pandemic'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Kröger (GroenLinks), Paternotte (D66), Gijs van Dijk (PvdA), Van Raan (PvdD), Öztürk (Denk), Bruins (ChristenUnie), Amhaouch (CDA), Laçin (SP), Van Kooten-Arissen (Van Kooten-Arissen), Van Brenk (50PLUS) en Stoffer (SGP) aan de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat ingezonden 27 augustus 2020, zijn beantwoord middels brief «Testen en traceren: samen strategisch de Corona-pandemie bestrijden».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de mogelijke contradictie tussen uitspraken van de Minister van I&W en een stelling van Corendon over het reisadvies 'code oranje'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether Corendon's claim that Dutch health insurance covers medical costs abroad regardless of an orange travel advice contradicts the minister's earlier statement, and about the government's stance on flights to orange-advice destinations and on a discouragement campaign. The minister answered that orange advice means non-essential travel is discouraged, that insurers usually cover care abroad up to Dutch tariffs but travel insurance and orange or red advice may affect coverage, and that a discouragement campaign for flying in general is not considered necessary since orange advice already discourages risk destinations.
Generally the health insurer reimburses care costs abroad up to the Dutch tariff.
Doorgaans vergoedt de zorgverzekeraar zorgkosten in het buitenland tot aan het Nederlandse tarief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de toename van de stikstofuitstoot door de biomassacentrales in Diemen en Geertruidenberg

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked whether biomass plants in Diemen and Geertruidenberg, licensed on maximum historic emissions and without netting out unused headroom, would raise nitrogen emissions, and questioned the NOx standards. The minister answers that the provinces are competent authority, that permits were granted via internal netting within the rules, that actual emissions may rise under full operation, and that stricter emission standards are planned for 2022.
It should be noted first that the provinces are the competent authority for these permits. I therefore cannot intervene in their assessment of the permit.
Vooropgesteld moet worden dat de provincies bevoegd gezag zijn voor deze vergunningen. Ik kan dan ook niet treden in hun beoordeling van de vergunning.

Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Raan over de benoeming van de oud-staatssecretaris van Financiën, de heer Menno Snel, tot commissaris bij IHC en de directeur van Atradius DSB als bestuurder in de Stichting Continuïteit IH

An MP asked whether the appointment of former state secretary Menno Snel to IHC's supervisory board and of the Atradius DSB director to the Stichting Continuïteit IHC board created conflicts of interest and why parliament was not informed earlier. The government answered that the timing of communication depended on IHC's final agreement, and that the foundation's board has no involvement in IHC's transactions, so no conflict of interest arises.
Changes to the Supervisory Board could only be communicated once there was final agreement on the takeover and refinancing of IHC.
Over wijzigingen in de Raad van Commissarissen kon pas worden gecommuniceerd op het moment dat er definitieve overeenstemming was over de overname en herfinanciering van IHC.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het rapport ‘Aandelenverwerving Air France-KLM’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the Court of Audit report finding the purchase of Air France-KLM shares comptably unlawful, and about budget and information rights of parliament. The minister confirmed the unlawfulness under the Comptabiliteitswet, disputed the application of article 2.27, acknowledged the Eerste Kamer was not informed in advance, and said he would seek further advice from the Raad van State, but gave no clear commitment on future conduct.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Paternotte, Bruins en Van Raan over het basisjaar van CORSIA

Four MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether moving CORSIA's baseline year to 2019, possibly delaying offsetting obligations until 2023, is desirable given climate goals, and what the Dutch position is. The Minister answered that Netherlands prefers keeping the current baseline, treats baseline change as a fallback, that the Council decision is only a negotiating mandate, and that the 2019 baseline would be evaluated in 2022.
The starting point for the Netherlands is preserving the current ambition.
Het uitgangspunt voor Nederland is behoud van de huidige ambitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Paternotte, Bruins, Van Raan en Stoffer over het basisjaar voor CORSIA

MPs from GroenLinks, D66, ChristenUnie, PvdD and SGP asked whether the Netherlands agreed to move the CORSIA baseline to 2019, how that fits earlier ambitious commitments, and why the government did not follow a motion requiring coordination with the House. The minister denied agreeing to a baseline change, saying the EU instruction only allows adjustment if needed to preserve global support, and promised to inform the House of further developments.
Of course I will keep the House continuously informed about new developments.
Uiteraard zal ik de Kamer blijvend informeren over nieuwe ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over strenge voorwaarden aan staatssteun voor de luchtvaartsector in het perspectief van een sector die stevig moet krimpen

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked ministers why state aid to KLM is not conditioned on shrinking aviation to within climate limits, and about stranded assets, Lelystad Airport, job losses and the closed briefing on state holdings. The government answered that conditions for KLM aid are still under negotiation, that climate targets and noise measures will be pursued regardless of aid, that the state's Air France-KLM shares lost value, and that the closed briefing was justified by the company's listed status.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat voetbalclubs met succes een beroep deden op de regeling waarbij de overheid maximaal 9.538 euro van een maandsalaris betaalt

Van Raan (PvdD) asked whether the NOW wage subsidy, capped at twice the maximum daily wage, gave pro football clubs excessive compensation compared with support for self-employed workers, and about pay levels in football. The minister answered that NOW is a wage subsidy to employers to preserve jobs, not individual compensation, that the cap applies equally to all sectors, and that the government lacks detailed salary data for football, giving medians instead.
The UWV, which implements this scheme, does not have information at this level of detail.
Het UWV, dat deze regeling uitvoert, beschikt niet over informatie op dit detailniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over een nieuw onderzoek naar de risico’s op botsingen met vogels als gevolg van de opening van Lelystad Airport

An MP asks the government whether a new bird-radar study showing higher-altitude and night-time bird movements undermines the bird-strike risk assessment in the updated environmental impact report for Lelystad Airport, and whether the report should be re-tested or redone. The minister answers that the new method does not change the conclusions, that the same radar data was used, that the risk assessment remains valid, and that no guarantee against bird strikes can be given, but declines to commit to a new or independent review.
No. The relevant scientific article by Kranstauber and others does not concern Lelystad Airport.
Nee. Het betreffende wetenschappelijke artikel van Kranstauber en anderen gaat niet over Lelystad Airport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat het kabinet met miljarden komt voor KLM

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers about a planned state rescue package of up to 4 billion euros for KLM, including its share price, asset and debt values, state aid compliance, bank comparisons, conditions on climate and safety, and timing of answers before a debate. The minister answered most questions substantively, explaining the support as liquidity via guarantees and a loan, citing EU temporary aid rules, and saying conditions were still being finalised before any payment.
The support will only be provided once everything is settled, including the conditions.
De steun wordt pas verstrekt wanneer alles rond is, waaronder de voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Kröger en Laçin over de stikstofberekeningen inzake Lelystad Airport

Three MPs (Van Raan, Kröger, Laçin) asked 28 questions about stikstof (nitrogen) calculations for Lelystad Airport, including why new calculations were commissioned after the Council of State ruling against the PAS, why the Chamber was not informed earlier, and whether the MER 2018 was complete. The minister answered that the new work follows the PAS annulment, that the Chamber was informed in September 2019 and February 2020, that results are not yet final, and that the Commission for the MER and RIVM advice was obtained, while declining to share the commissioning assignments citing commercial confidentiality.
It is not customary to share commissioning assignments with the House of Representatives because of their commercially confidential nature.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om opdrachtverstrekkingen te delen met de Tweede Kamer vanwege het bedrijfsvertrouwelijk karakter hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het uitstellen van klimaatmaatregelen en het bericht dat de CO2-heffing mogelijk wordt uitgesteld

An MP asked whether the CO2 levy for industry and the aviation tax were being postponed due to the COVID-19 crisis, and how climate and biodiversity goals fit with the economic recovery. The minister denied that the CO2 levy is postponed, said the aviation tax may be delayed under its entry-into-force clause, and gave only general answers on the broader questions.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat er in Zaandam een biomassacentrale zonder vergunning in gebruik is genomen

An MP asked the ministers about a biomass plant in Zaandam that began operating without a permit, asking why this was allowed, who is liable, and whether such plants should be built near schools and homes. The government answered that the plant was permitted under nature and municipal rules, that the permitting authorities (province and municipality) are responsible, that the environmental permit requirement for smaller plants is being reviewed, and that it will work with the other ministry on tighter criteria.
As part of the Clean Air Agreement I am examining whether laws, regulations and permit requirements should be tightened.
Als onderdeel van het Schone Lucht Akkoord ben ik aan het kijken of wet- en regelgeving en vergunningseisen aangescherpt moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de inzet van biomassa

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about biomass burned in four coal plants, permit headroom, emission norms (NOx) and compliance with EU best-available-techniques rules. The minister answered that most plant-level data is unavailable or confidential, that the government is studying tighter emission limits for small and medium biomass installations with a report due in 2020, and that continued biomass subsidies are needed for the climate transition.
Individual plants are not reported on, because this may contain competitively sensitive information.
Over individuele centrales wordt niet gerapporteerd, omdat dit concurrentiegevoelige informatie kan bevatten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het gevolgde en te volgen protocol bij coronarepatriëringsvluchten uit niet-brandhaarden

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch asked whether a COVID-19 repatriation flight from Kuala Lumpur was overcrowded and whether quarantine or protocol changes were planned for such flights. The minister could not independently confirm the footage, said the flight carried 285 passengers and 13 crew under EASA and RIVM guidance, and stated no new measures were being considered for now.
At this moment the cabinet is not considering new measures, but we are monitoring the situation closely.
Op dit moment overweegt het kabinet geen nieuwe maatregelen, maar we monitoren de situatie nauwlettend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma, Ploumen, Van Ojik, Krol en Van Raan over de zaak van dhr. Singh

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign and Justice Ministers about the case of Mr Singh (J.S.), a Dutch prisoner in the United States, including whether a transfer request was received, whether Nederland can start a transfer procedure, whether a clemency request was made without his knowledge, and what efforts are made on humanitarian grounds. The government answered that no formal transfer request has been received, that the US was told he does not meet the binding criteria, that it expressed humanitarian support diplomatically, and that the initiative lies primarily with Mr J.S.
As far as the question concerns the specific circumstances of detainee J.S., I must inform you that no statements can be made about this for privacy reasons.
Voor zover de vraag ziet op de specifieke omstandigheden van gedetineerde J.S. moet ik u mededelen dat er in het kader van de privacy hierover geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat de Luchtverkeersleiding met juridische stappen dreigt tegen NH Nieuws

MP Van Raan asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that air traffic control (LVNL) threatened legal action against NH Nieuws and NOS over broadcasting radio transmissions of a runway incident at Schiphol, and about the incident itself, including sixteen landings on a closed runway and a go-around. The minister answers that LVNL asked the media to stop rebroadcasting, that LVNL dropped legal steps, that the incident is under LVNL and OVV investigation with published reports, and that the procedural failure has been addressed by a system update.
LVNL has indicated that indeed it has not objected to all online fragments with R/T.
LVNL heeft aangegeven dat inderdaad niet tegen alle fragmenten met R/T die online staan bezwaar is gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over het bericht dat de provincie Drenthe toestemming heeft gegeven voor het afschieten van tientallen diersoorten op Groningen Airport Eelde

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers about reports that the province of Drenthe permitted culling dozens of animal species at Groningen Airport Eelde, and whether the permit was justified, lawful, effective and transparent. The minister replied that the province is the competent authority under the Wet natuurbescherming, that the permit was granted for aviation safety, that the government cannot intervene in provincial decisions, and that the matter can be taken to court.
It is not for me to intervene in the considerations and decisions of the provinces, nor to intervene in the course of justice.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in de afwegingen en besluiten van de provincies, noch om te interveniëren in de rechtsgang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het vervroegde luchtvaartadvies van de commissie Remkes en de gebrekkige rapportage van stikstofuitstoot op grote hoogte

An MP asked the ministers about the early aviation advice of the Remkes committee and whether nitrogen emissions above 3,000 feet from aviation are fully reported, including whether they are placed under 'abroad'. The government answered that the Adviescollege recommends bringing emissions above 3,000 feet into view, that Dutch airport emissions above that height are not counted as 'abroad', and that reporting to the EU will be adjusted following the advice.
With the follow-up to the Remkes committee's advice, the reporting to the European Commission will be adjusted on this point.
Met de opvolging van het advies van de commissie Remkes zal op dit punt de rapportage naar de Europese Commissie worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de extra maatregelen om handelsstromen op gang te houden
