An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary of Finance about the expanded COVID-19 export credit insurance measures, including consultation with businesses, environmental and human rights screening by Atradius DSB, pricing, and state risk exposure. The government answered that consultation went through the Rijkscommissie voor Export, that documents are not disclosed because they are internal and contain commercial information, that sustainability screening continues under existing policy, and that the measures run until 31 December 2020 with the state taking on risks the private market will not cover.
To the extent minutes of these consultations were made, they were intended for internal use and contain personal policy views of officials and possibly commercially sensitive information.

Voor zover er verslaglegging van deze overleggen is gemaakt, is deze voor intern gebruik bedoeld geweest en bevatten deze persoonlijke beleidsopvattingen van ambtenaren en mogelijk bedrijfsgevoelige informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Leijten over de berichten dat grootschalige kapitaalverschaffing aan banken een risico vormen voor de stabiliteit van de (Europese) bankensector

MPs Van Raan and Leijten asked the Finance Minister whether ECB liquidity support to banks and shadow banks, repo funding and the ban on monetary financing create risks to financial stability and fairness during the COVID-19 crisis. The minister answered that the ECB's measures are within its independent monetary mandate, that the ECB monitors risks, that monetary financing of governments is prohibited and that the EU's 500 billion euro package and Commission funds are the chosen route for support.
In addition, the ECB continuously monitors the financial system to detect potential risks and vulnerabilities early.
Daarnaast monitort de ECB voortdurend het financiële systeem om potentiele risico's en kwetsbaarheden vroegtijdig te detecteren.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden van Van Raan, Alkaya, Van den Hul, Nijboer, Diks en Snels over schending van de OESO-richtlijnen door Pluspetrol

MPs asked the government about an OECD guidelines complaint against Pluspetrol over pollution and indigenous rights in the Peruvian Amazon, the Dutch oil and gas sector's responsible business conduct plan, Tax Authority transparency requirements on financial flows to low-tax jurisdictions, and binding due diligence legislation. The government acknowledged the concerns, said the sector had not published the promised plan and it would reach out again, and described existing tax transparency measures and a study on enforceable due diligence instruments.
The oil and gas sector has not published an action plan. The cabinet cannot establish whether any improvement has taken place.
De olie- en gassector heeft geen plan van aanpak gepubliceerd. Het kabinet kan niet vaststellen of er verbetering heeft plaatsgevonden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, De Roon, Van Ojik, Karabulut, Ploumen, Voordewind, Van Raan, Krol, Van der Staaij, Kuzu, Baudet, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Haga over de repatriëring van Nederlander

MPs asked how many Dutch nationals remain stranded abroad, why repatriation costs are charged, and whether a 300-euro rate should extend to more countries and hardship cases. The minister replied that about 8,000 registered Dutch nationals still wished assistance, that the registration closed on 8 April, that costs are charged after the fact, that Jordan, Israel, Lebanon and the Palestinian territories will be considered favourably, and that a coulance regime is not appropriate given personal responsibility and budget impact.
I am willing to look favourably at the request to add Jordan, Israel, Lebanon and the Palestinian territories to the list for which the 300-euro rate applies.
Ik ben bereid welwillend te kijken naar het verzoek om Jordanië, Israël, Libanon en de Palestijnse Gebieden toe te voegen aan de lijst waarvoor het tarief van 300 euro geldt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat het Britse Hof van Beroep heeft geoordeeld dat uitbreidingsplannen voor London Heathrow Airport strijdig zijn met de klimaatdoelstellingen uit het Parijsakkoor

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the government whether aviation can still ignore the Paris Agreement after a UK Court of Appeal ruled Heathrow expansion plans unlawful, and how Dutch airport plans such as Schiphol growth and Lelystad Airport fit with climate goals. The government answers that aviation emissions are addressed through ICAO and national sector agreements, that the UK ruling concerns UK planning law, and that Dutch airport decisions require environmental impact assessments which are still pending, without committing to halt the projects.
The government's aim is to achieve CO2 reductions based on the measures described in my letter on aviation climate policy of 27 March 2019.
Het streven van het kabinet is om CO 2 -reducties te realiseren op basis van de maatregelen die zijn beschreven in mijn brief over het klimaatbeleid voor de luchtvaart van 27 maart 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over het bericht dat Shell de Nationale Boomfeestdag van Staatsbosbeheer sponsort

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked whether Shell's sponsorship of the Nationale Boomfeestdag, its climate record, and related tree-planting and flight-compensation claims amount to greenwashing and misleading children's education material. The government confirmed the sponsorship, said climate responsibility lies with companies and the Klimaatakkoord, declined to assess school learning materials citing school autonomy, and promised a separate letter on the voluntary CO2 compensation market.
The cabinet regularly receives questions about the content of learning materials.
Met enige regelmaat krijgt het kabinet vragen over de inhoud van leermiddelen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat een klimaatscepticus meer dan een miljoen gulden ontving van o.a. Nederlandse bedrijven met als expliciet doel om twijfel te zaaien over klimaatverandering en

An MP asks ministers whether they will act on reports that Dutch companies funded a climate sceptic to sow doubt about climate change, and whether those companies should be excluded from climate policy and education. The government answers that it is up to the companies to provide clarity, that it cannot assess the influence of sceptics, that it will not ask schools, media or the cultural sector to change their ties, and that companies funding sceptics may keep their seats at the Climate Agreement table.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over Nederlandse investeringen in dierenleed

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether Dutch banks, including ABN AMRO and ING, finance animal welfare-harming meat producers such as WH Group and MHP, and how the government will respond. The minister says he lacks insight into the companies financed, expects banks to apply OECD and UN due diligence standards, notes ABN AMRO is bound by law and its board is responsible, and states that bank financing choices are their own responsibility while pointing to the IMVO convenants and a forthcoming animal welfare framework.
I have no insight into the companies that banks finance and the extent to which animal welfare standards are complied with within those companies.
Ik heb geen inzage in de bedrijven die banken financieren en de mate waarin dierenwelzijnsstandaarden binnen die bedrijven worden nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de cofinanciering door ING van een Indonesische kolencentrale

MP Van Raan asks the ministers whether ING's financing of a new Indonesian coal plant in Cirebon breaches international responsible business standards, whether ING should have refused the contract and handle complaints from local NGOs, and how this fits with climate goals. The government answers that banks are expected to follow the OECD guidelines and UN guiding principles, that ING monitors projects and handles complaints under the banking covenant, that binding measures are being considered, and that ING intends to phase out coal financing, while declining to judge ING's specific case.
I expect ING (and other banks) to take investigations such as the FFGI study into account in their considerations.
Ik verwacht van ING (en andere banken) dat zij onderzoeken zoals het onderzoek van FFGI meenemen in hun afwegingen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de vergunningen Wet natuurbescherming (Wnb) die niet noodzakelijk zijn voor het aanvragen van SDE+-subsidies waardoor miljoenen euro’s subsidie op de plank blijven liggen

An MP asked why Wnb nature permits are not required for SDE+ subsidy applications, even though some biomass and other renewable projects are delayed for lack of them and subsidy budget stays reserved. The minister answered that the Wnb permit is not a mandatory attachment for most categories, that a stricter requirement will be introduced for certain categories in the SDE++ round, and that the province decides whether small biomass plants need a Wnb permit.
I currently have no insight into all projects for which the Wnb permit is a constraint on realisation, and therefore also not into how much commitment budget is involved.
Ik heb op dit moment geen inzicht in alle projecten waarvoor de Wnb-vergunning knellend is voor realisatie en dus ook niet hoeveel verplichtingenbudget hiermee gemoeid gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de uitgifte van dode dieren vanuit vrachtwagens tijdens het Offerfeest

An MP asked the ministers whether the sale of slaughtered animal carcasses from trucks during the Eid al-Adha festival was legal, under what exemption, and how the NVWA supervises it. The government answered that a temporary, generic NVWA permission allowed transport of unchilled carcasses from approved slaughterhouses, with NVWA inspection of slaughter, and that the police tweet's wording was unfortunate.
On the basis of that authority, the NVWA granted a permanent generic permission for transport of not yet chilled carcasses during the Eid festival.
Op grond van die bevoegdheid heeft de NVWA een permanente generieke toestemming verleend voor vervoer van nog niet afgekoelde karkassen tijdens het offerfeest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Sienot, Agnes Mulder, Van der Lee en Van Raan over de Gedragscode Zon op Land

Five MPs from different parties asked ministers about the industry-drafted Gedragscode Zon op Land (code of conduct for ground-mounted solar), its alignment with the solar-ladder motions, protection of Natura 2000 and national park areas, guidance to local authorities and RES regions, use in rijksgronden tenders, and PBL's landscape report. The government welcomed the code as consistent with the voorkeursvolgorde zon, said it will be promoted via the Nationaal Programma RES and monitored, and deferred the landscape-policy questions to a forthcoming NOVI letter.
Through the National Programme RES we will bring this code of conduct to the attention of the RES regions.
Via het Nationaal Programma RES (NP RES) brengen we deze gedragscode onder de aandacht van de RES’en.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het toevoegen van klimaatlessen aan het onderwijscurriculum in Nieuw-Zeeland

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked whether the government will adopt New Zealand's climate-education curriculum and related lessons on climate crisis, activism and eco-anxiety, and asked about the psychological effects of climate change. The ministers answered that sustainability is already part of the Dutch curriculum, that New Zealand's materials are freely available to schools, that Dutch education policy is a national responsibility, and that they do not see a need to copy the Italian or New Zealand models.
The Netherlands therefore does not need to follow the example of Italy and New Zealand, since themes such as sustainability, climate and liveability are already embedded in Dutch education.
Nederland behoeft het voorbeeld van Italië en Nieuw-Zeeland dan ook niet te volgen, aangezien thema's als duurzaamheid, klimaat en leefbaarheid ook nu al ingebed zijn in het Nederlandse onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het integraal verwerken van klimaatlessen in het Italiaanse onderwijs

An MP asked the ministers about Italy's plan to integrate climate and sustainability lessons across the curriculum and how this relates to Dutch education, including a parliamentary motion on inspectorate oversight of company-provided education. The ministers replied that the Italian plans are not yet concrete, that climate and sustainability already feature in Dutch curricula, that curriculum.nu addresses sustainability, and that schools have autonomy, so they see no need for intervention.
Moreover, we have no signals that this is the case.
Wij hebben trouwens geen signalen dat hiervan sprake zou zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de berichten “VOLE wil dat vliegveld Eelde wordt gestraft voor overtredingen” en “Rechter buigt zich over klachten sluitingstijden Groningen Airport Eelde”

An MP asked the minister about enforcement of night-time opening hours at Groningen Airport Eelde, the ILT's interpretation of the extension rules, and the airport's future. The minister answered that the ILT issued warnings, applies a strict interpretation endorsed by the court, and requested a plan of action, but did not yet provide its content or timing.
In addition, the ILT has requested a plan of action from GAE to secure long-term compliance.
Daarnaast heeft de ILT verzocht om een plan van aanpak van GAE om naleving op de lange termijn te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Raan over overlast van vliegveld Luik-Bierset en het uitblijven van concrete actie ondanks een aangenomen motie

An MP asked the minister why a passed motion on noise nuisance from Liège-Bierset airport has produced no concrete improvement, and about the timing and scope of a Belgian-Dutch expert group. The minister answered that efforts continue, the expert group has met once and is analysing options, but gave no firm timeline and only vague benchmarks.
I am doing my utmost to reach a solution to the situation as quickly as possible and to remove the additional nuisance caused by the 2013 airspace change.
Ik doe mijn uiterste best om zo spoedig mogelijk tot een oplossing van de situatie te komen en de extra overlast als gevolg van de luchtruimwijziging in 2013 weg te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Raan over de wijze waarop een vreedzame demonstratie op Schiphol werd beëindigd en het verschil met de boerendemonstraties

MPs Wassenberg and Van Raan asked why a peaceful Greenpeace demonstration at Schiphol on 14 December 2019 was ended forcefully, with arrests and a 48-hour area ban, and why it was treated differently from farmers' protests and a KLM concert. The government answered that the mayor of Haarlemmermeer is responsible for demonstration management and emergency orders, that the matter is subject to council accountability and possible court review, and that it cannot judge the mayor's conduct.
It is not for me to intervene in that.
Het is niet aan mij om daarin te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat de overheid de glastuinbouw heeft geholpen om het betalen van de CO2-prijs te ontwijken

An MP asked whether the government helped greenhouse horticulture firms escape the EU ETS carbon price, and whether this undermines climate goals and public trust. The ministers deny any improper help, say firms left the ETS for legitimate reasons under NEa supervision, and reject changing the arrangement or pursuing unpaid sums.
Given the NEa's supervision of the legal rules, I have confidence that possible misuse of the rules is very small.
Door het toezicht van de NEa op de wettelijke regels heb ik er vertrouwen in dat mogelijk misbruik van de regels erg klein is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over het bericht dat vogels kleiner worden door klimaatverandering

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked the government about reports that birds are shrinking due to climate change, including the red knot study and its implications for biodiversity and the Wadden Sea. The minister acknowledges the research, says climate change is one cause of biodiversity loss, notes the Wadden Sea's importance for migratory birds, and points to existing climate and Wadden policy without committing to new action.
This is a scientific question that I cannot assess.
Dit is een wetenschappelijk vraagstuk dat ik niet kan beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin, Van Raan, Van Brenk en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Minister houdt poot stijf: Zonder nieuwe vluchten geen Lelystad'

MPs asked the minister whether she was right that Lelystad Airport could never take over all flights from Schiphol, and why she only acknowledged unavoidable autonomous growth in December 2019 after earlier stating growth would be prevented. The minister replied that the European Commission's objections to the original scheme were known, that she withdrew the notification in December 2018 and resubmitted a more selective scheme, and that she informed parliament of the independent analysis on growth in December 2019.
From the very beginning it was clear that approval from the European Commission was necessary before a VVR could be deployed.
Vanaf het begin af aan is duidelijk geweest dat goedkeuring van de Europese Commissie (EC) noodzakelijk was alvorens een VVR in te kunnen zetten.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Van Raan, Laçin  en Kröger over de correctiebrief op de brief Luchtvaart van 15 oktober

MPs Van Raan, Laçin and Kröger asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a correction letter on the validation of noise-calculation appendices for regional airports, including when the error was found, why the correction came late, and whether the appendices were externally validated. The minister answered that the error was discovered on 17 October 2019, that there was no legal basis or regulation requiring external validation before 2010, and that external validation was introduced from 2010 and formalised in 2018, while declining to commit to re-validating the appendices for shielding and atmospheric attenuation.
After receiving the email, I unfortunately had to establish that the word 'geen' had been dropped from the relevant sentence in the Verzamelbrief.
Na ontvangst van de mail heb ik helaas moeten constateren dat in de Verzamelbrief in de betreffende zin het woord «geen» is weggevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat de vertegenwoordigers van SATL en BTV zijn opgestapt uit het overleg van de klankbordgroep Luchtvaartnota 2020–2050

An MP asked the minister about reports that two resident groups (SATL and BTV) walked out of the Luchtvaartnota climate group, alleging a pre-cooked process, incomplete minutes and blocked statements. The minister rejected most criticisms, said the groups could speak and had their input considered, and offered to attach their statement to the minutes.
SATL and BTV were allowed to explain their statement but not to read it out in full at the climate group meeting of 26 November 2019.
SATL en BTV mochten hun verklaring wel toelichten maar niet integraal voorlezen tijdens de klankbordgroep van 26 november 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de uitrol van 5G

Van Raan (PvdD) asked the government about approval steps, rollout timelines, antenna numbers, tree removal, health and environmental research, cumulative exposure and EMF norms for 5G. The government answered that spectrum auctions run from 2020, that private operators decide rollout locations, that research has found no proven harm below exposure limits, and that Agentschap Telecom will monitor compliance.
The choices they make in this regard depend on business strategy, which is commercially confidential.
De keuzes die zij hierbij maken zijn afhankelijk van de bedrijfsstrategie, die bedrijfsvertrouwelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over het bericht ‘Bomen stoken in centrales? Waanzin!’

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a critical newspaper article on burning trees in power plants, questioning the minister's claim that whole trees do not end up in Dutch wood pellets, the carbon debt of biomass, and biodiversity in production forests. The minister defended the sustainability criteria for subsidised pellets, acknowledged limited US pellet imports, and announced that small pellet stoves and biomass boilers will no longer be subsidised from 2020 while air emission norms for mid-sized plants are examined.
I do not have the specific cost breakdowns that companies use, and I could not share them because this is commercially confidential information.
Over de specifieke kostenverdelingen zoals bedrijven deze hanteren beschik ik niet en deze zou ik ook niet kunnen delen omdat dit bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin en Van Raan over emissieregistratie

MPs Kröger, Laçin and Van Raan asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the Dutch emissions register, including whether aviation emissions above 3,000 feet are omitted from reporting and what this means for air quality and deposition figures. The minister answered that reporting follows the NEC Directive, which excludes aviation emissions outside the landing and take-off cycle, that the guidebook does not determine reporting scope, and deferred the exact emission amounts pending follow-up on a motion, while the answer to one question was delayed by third-party input.
On how I will implement this motion, I will inform you further.
Over de wijze waarop ik deze motie uitvoer, zal ik u nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over “het uitgelekte marktonderzoek naar Lelystad Airport en de stelling van Wizz Air dat prijsvechters niet kunnen worden geweerd vanaf Lelystad Airport”

MP Van Raan (PvdD) asked the minister about a leaked market study on Lelystad Airport and Wizz Air's claim that low-cost carriers cannot be excluded from it, and why the report was kept from parliament and leaked to the press. The minister answered that the study does not conclude that low-cost carriers will dominate, that EU rules prevent excluding non-Schiphol traffic, that the report was only finalised late and was sent to parliament at the same time as the letter, and that the government will push for revision of the EU slot regulation.
This report is now final and has been sent to the House of Representatives together with this letter.
Dit rapport is thans definitief en is tegelijkertijd met onderhavige brief aan de Tweede Kamer toegezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Diks, Bouali en Van de Hul over de moord op de Braziliaanse activist Paulo Paulino Guajajara

Four MPs asked the government about the murder of Brazilian indigenous activist Paulo Paulino Guajajara, whether Brazil's environment and indigenous rights are deteriorating under Bolsonaro, and what concrete action the Netherlands will take. The government said illegal loggers likely were involved but could not confirm it, said violence against indigenous people appears to have grown, and outlined diplomatic dialogue, EU-Mercosur review and support for rights defenders without committing to a new concrete measure.
It seems very likely that illegally operating loggers were involved in his death, although we cannot confirm that.
Het lijkt zeer waarschijnlijk dat illegaal opererende houthakkers betrokken waren bij zijn dood, hoewel wij dat niet kunnen bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over het «Special Report on the Ocean and Cryosphere in a Changing Climate  (SROCC)» van het IPCC

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked ministers about the IPCC special report on oceans and the cryosphere, covering glacier loss, marine heatwaves, ocean acidification, marine protected areas and fisheries. The government answered at length, mostly restating the IPCC findings and pointing to the forthcoming cabinet appraisal and international negotiations, with few concrete commitments.
A comprehensive cabinet appraisal of the IPCC report on oceans and the cryosphere has been sent to the House.
Een uitgebreide kabinetsappreciatie van het IPCC-rapport over oceanen en de cryosfeer is aan de kamer toegezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat vogels doof en agressief worden van vliegvelden

An MP asked the ministers whether a study showing that aircraft noise may make wild birds near airports deaf and aggressive would be incorporated into noise limits, environmental impact assessments, Schiphol growth decisions and the decision to open Lelystad Airport, and whether a new assessment was needed. The minister replied that the study is limited and does not show large-scale harm, so its results will not be used in policy or environmental impact reports, and that the Lelystad Airport environmental assessment is sufficient and will not be redone.
As indicated in the answer to questions 4 to 7, this study gives no reason to include its results in new policy or in the environmental impact reports to be drawn up.
Zoals aangegeven in het antwoord op de vragen 4 t/m 7 geeft dit onderzoek geen aanleiding om resultaten te betrekken bij nieuw beleid of op te stellen milieueffectrapportages.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over door de Nederlandse Ontwikkelingsbank FMO gefinancierde misstanden

An MP asks the ministers whether they know of reports that the Dutch development bank FMO finances land grabbing, tax avoidance and non-transparent arbitration, and what they will do about it, including independent investigation and transparency on land-rights risks. The minister answers that the cases are known and discussed with FMO, that independent evaluations and a complaints mechanism exist, but declines to share a list of land-grabbing companies citing client confidentiality and commits only to ongoing dialogue and policy tightening.
It is generally not in the interest of the ongoing investigation to share information about this with external parties.
Het is doorgaans niet in het belang van het lopende onderzoek om informatie hierover te delen met externe partijen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan vragen over het advies van de commissie-Remkes en de implicaties voor de subsidie voor het (bij)stoken van biomassa in energiecentrales en de aanleg van nieuwe biomassacentrales

An MP asks whether the government will reconsider subsidies for biomass co-firing and new biomass plants in light of the Remkes commission advice and scientific criticism of biomass sustainability. The minister refuses to reconsider, defends biomass as sustainable and necessary for climate targets, but commits to not granting new subsidies for biomass once shortages are expected before 2030, pending a sustainability framework.
The cabinet is not responsible for the construction of biomass power plants.
Het kabinet gaat niet over de bouw van biomassacentrales.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Laçin en Kröger naar aanleiding van de uitspraak van de Raad van State vragen ingediend over de uitspraak van de Raad van State inzake het PAS

MPs Kröger, Van Raan and Laçin asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether she meant a legal 'trick' (list) to get around the Council of State's ruling on the PAS, and how this squares with respect for the judiciary. The minister says the government is researching how to implement the ruling within legal requirements, without intending to evade it, and refuses to retract the remark, calling it a popular expression not to be taken literally.
Within the framework of the Council of State's ruling, executive choices must be made that do justice to both the letter and the spirit of the ruling.
Binnen het kader van de uitspraak van de Raad van State zijn uitvoerende keuzes te maken die recht moeten doen aan zowel de letter als de geest van de uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Van Raan en Laçin over het handhavingsverzoek van Mobilisation for the Environment met betrekking tot Schiphol en de Wet natuurbescherming

MPs Kröger, Van Raan and Laçin asked the minister about an enforcement request by Mobilisation for the Environment claiming Schiphol lacks a Wet natuurbescherming permit and that about 100,000 flights are illegal. The minister answered that Schiphol holds no Wnb permit, that the ministry of LNV, as competent authority, will assess the request, and that details on emissions and nitrogen deposition will follow via a new calculation and the MER for the revised airport decree.
In the context of the enforcement request, the Ministry of LNV will gather the necessary information and request views.
Het Ministerie van LNV zal in het kader van het handhavingsverzoek de benodigde informatie verzamelen en zienswijzen opvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin, Kröger en Van Raan over het bericht dat provinciale staten van Overijssel zich niet serieus genomen voelen door de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MPs from SP, GroenLinks and PvdD asked whether air traffic from 7 November 2019 must use the B+ routes to and from Lelystad Airport, why these routes are opened before expansion is certain, and whether the minister will heed Overijssel's call to drop low-flying routes. The minister confirmed that an inregelperiode starts on 7 November for existing small aviation only, stressed the B+ routes are the least noisy option, and declined to postpone, pointing to consultations and planned route improvements.
The routes are not open to commercial traffic because the political decision-making on that has not yet been completed.
De routes zijn niet open voor handelsverkeer want de politieke besluitvorming daarover is nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bezoek van de minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat aan de gemeente Eijsden-Margraten vanwege de aanhoudende overlast van vliegveld Luik-Bierset

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the minister's visit to Eijsden-Margraten over noise from Liège-Bierset airport has not produced concrete relief, and presses on the 2013 airspace change, the Belgian air traffic control agreements and the Luchtvaartnota. The minister replies that an expert group with Belgian authorities will explore measures to return night-time noise near Eijsden toward pre-2013 levels, that a detailed analysis and monitoring show improvement but not yet stable results, and that reversing the airspace change is not feasible for safety reasons.
An agreement has been reached with the Belgian authorities to set up a joint expert group to explore and develop concrete options for improvement.
Met de Belgische autoriteiten is afgesproken om een gezamenlijke expertgroep te starten om concrete mogelijkheden voor verbetering te verkennen en uit te werken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over “de alternatieve luchtvaartnota van Natuur & Milieu, Greenpeace en Natuur en Milieufederatie Noord-Holland, waaruit blijkt dat krimp van de luchtvaart onvermijdelijk is.”

MP Van Raan asks the government whether it endorses the claims in an alternative aviation policy paper by environmental NGOs, including that aviation must shrink, that technical measures are insufficient, and that health and noise harms and nitrogen deposition require action. The minister answers that the government pursues a broad mix of climate instruments, will assess volumes via the PlanMER, does not endorse all claims (e.g., on economic importance), and will consider the paper's ideas in the forthcoming Luchtvaartnota without committing to a shrinkage scenario.
The government's approach is primarily aimed at achieving the necessary emission reductions through this route.
De inzet van het kabinet is er primair op gericht om via deze weg de benodigde emissiereducties te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen va het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat INEOS via kindermarketing het draagvlak voor schaliegas probeert te vergroten

An MP asked whether INEOS's sponsorship of The Daily Mile, used to build support for shale gas, should be countered, and whether schools should be warned and the programme publicly funded. The minister replied that INEOS is not a sponsor in the Netherlands, that JOGG runs the programme independently, that schools can use the sponsorship convenant, and that the government sees no reason for further action.
INEOS is not a sponsor of The Daily Mile in the Netherlands.
INEOS is in Nederland geen sponsor van The Daily Mile.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Kröger en Laçin over de buitensporige subsidie van de luchtvaartsector

MPs Van Raan, Kröger and Laçin asked the government about claimed excessive subsidies to the aviation sector, including tax treatment of kerosene, Schiphol's accessibility costs, WTO rulings on Airbus and Boeing, and airport charges. The minister disputed the subsidy calculation, provided partial figures and data on Schiphol-related spending, and promised a forthcoming overview of external costs of aviation.
Question 2: Do you endorse the subsidy of 86.29 euros per person calculated in this article?
Vraag 2 Onderschrijft u de in dit artikel berekende subsidie van 86,29 euro per persoon
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bezoek van de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat aan Maastricht Aachen Airport

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the minister's visit to Maastricht Aachen Airport, the handling of complaints, extended opening hours, runway length, and public funding. The minister answered that the visit was informal, that noise and night-flight effects are being assessed in the PlanMER, that there is no decision to extend opening hours, and that many matters are the responsibility of the province, the municipality or others.
This is a matter for the owner of the airport, i.e. the province of Limburg, and the operator.
Dit is een aangelegenheid van de eigenaar van de luchthaven i.c. de provincie Limburg en de exploitant.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over Shell’s kindermarketingfestival Generation Discover 2019

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers whether Shell's children's festival Generation Discover, which promotes fossil-fuel-friendly energy views and allegedly misleading teaching materials, is compatible with climate goals, and what government will do to prevent such incidents and avoid officials attending. The ministers answered that the government is not involved in or responsible for the festival, that schools decide for themselves, that no public funds go to it, and that the Shell climate commitment is noted.
The central government is not involved in or responsible for Generation Discover.
De rijksoverheid is niet betrokken of verantwoordelijk voor het Generation Discover.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over gastlessen van (voormalig) Shell-personeel

An MP asked the Minister of Education about Shell's guest lessons and lesson materials for schoolchildren, including child marketing, greenwashing concerns and possible climate-denialist influence from a former Shell director. The Minister acknowledged the concerns but said schools are responsible for choosing teaching materials and guest speakers, and refused to request or share Shell's lesson package with Parliament.
I do not see it as my role to request this lesson package and share it with you.
Ik zie het dan ook niet als mijn rol om dit betreffende leerpakket op te vragen en met u te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het "Special Report on Climate Change and Land" van het IPCC

An MP asks the government about the IPCC Special Report on Climate Change and Land, including the links to diet, livestock, forest and the Schijf van Vijf. The government answers that the report shows effective strategies exist, that a full appraisal will follow in November, and that it does not draw the conclusions the MP attributes to the IPCC.
A comprehensive appraisal of the IPCC report will be sent to you in November (together with that of the forthcoming special report on Oceans and Ice).
Een uitgebreide appreciatie van het IPCC-rapport ontvangt u in november (tezamen met die van het nog te verschijnen speciale rapport over Oceanen en IJs).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Van Ojik, Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, en Van Raan over een aanval op de democratie in Turkije

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about Turkey's removal of elected HDP and CHP mayors and appointment of state supervisors, and whether the Netherlands and EU would condemn it and what consequences would follow. The minister answered that the government shares EU and Council of Europe concerns, supports the EU's public statements, raises the issue bilaterally, and backed halting accession talks, though that proposal lacked support and talks have stalled.
The government does not have precise figures.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over precieze aantallen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Van Raan, Laçin, Gijs van Dijk, Paternotte, Bruins, Stoffer en Van Brenk over  het  bericht 'L’UE refuse d’abandonner sa souveraineté sur  les émissions de CO2 de l’aviation'.

Eight MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a report that the EU refuses to give up sovereignty over aviation CO2 emissions, and about the Dutch position and a draft ICAO resolution making CORSIA the only permitted global aviation emissions system. The minister confirmed Dutch support for the EU line, said the Netherlands will enter a reservation if the text could limit EU climate measures (including via the EU ETS), and said a kerosene excise is a fiscal measure outside the resolution's scope.

At the same time, the Netherlands will make a reservation against texts in the final resolution if they could politically limit the freedom in Europe to take the measures needed to achieve the climate goals.

Tegelijkertijd zal Nederland een voorbehoud maken tegen teksten in de uiteindelijke resolutie, wanneer die politiek gezien een beperking zouden kunnen betekenen van de vrijheid om in Europa de maatregelen te nemen die nodig zijn om de klimaatdoelstellingen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de stalbrand in Niawier, waarbij 42.000 kippen zijn omgekomen

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked the minister about a barn fire in Niawier that killed 42,000 chickens, including whether birds escaped, the farm's permit and capacity, fire prevention, and whether the government will act on barn fire prevention. The minister said no birds escaped, that permits are a municipal matter, and that a broader action plan with added measures is being discussed, but gave no concrete legislative commitment.
How many animals the farm was permitted for is not known to me. The issuing of environmental permits falls under the responsibility of the municipality concerned.
Voor hoeveel dieren het bedrijf een vergunning had, is mij niet bekend. De afgifte van omgevingsvergunningen valt onder de bevoegdheid van de desbetreffende gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Kooten-Arissen en Van Raan over het bericht ‘Inlichtingendiensten: stop je intimiderende bezoekjes’

MPs Kooten-Arissen and Van Raan asked whether intelligence and police informant recruitment targeting climate activists was intimidating, disproportionate and lawful, and how citizens can hold the state to account on climate and rights. Minister Grapperhaus replied that individual cases cannot be discussed for confidentiality reasons, that police must act within legal frameworks and handle complaints, and that the government shares concern about climate policy pace.
As I stated in my letter of 18 June (Kamerstuk 29 628, no. 885), given the confidentiality, individual cases cannot be addressed.
Zoals ik gemeld heb in mijn brief van 18 juni jl. (Kamerstuk 29 628, nr. 885 ), kan er gelet op de vertrouwelijkheid niet worden ingegaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het doordrukken van groei op Schiphol terwijl krimp nodig is om binnen de grenzen van klimaat, leefomgeving en veiligheid van mens en dier te blijven

Van Raan (PvdD) asks the minister why Schiphol growth is being pushed through despite the need for shrinkage within environmental, climate and safety limits, and whether the government respects participation, trust and motions requiring broader environmental standards. The minister rejects the claims of improper governance, says growth is conditional on verifiable noise reduction and safety, and promises a hinder-reduction plan, an Omgevingsfonds and a Luchtvaartnota with a PlanMER examining normative options.
Only after verifiable noise reduction has been achieved can Schiphol earn growth.
Pas nadat er sprake is van aantoonbare hinderbeperking kan Schiphol groei verdienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de flinke groei CO2 Luchtvaart terwijl reductie van de uitstoot van CO2 nodig is

An MP asks the minister why aviation CO2 emissions in the Netherlands grew sharply despite the need for reductions, and whether aviation's non-CO2 climate effects, international aviation's place in national targets, and ETS impacts are adequately addressed. The minister acknowledges that aviation emissions have grown, says a 2030 reduction below 1990 levels is unrealistic, commits to a 2030 target equal to 2005 levels for international aviation, and states that non-CO2 effects cannot yet be reliably quantified, with further research and a forthcoming aviation policy note pending.
International aviation has grown so strongly over the past 30 years that a reduction in 2030 compared with 1990 CO2 emissions is hardly realistic.
De internationale luchtvaart is de afgelopen 30 jaar dermate sterk gegroeid dat een reductie in 2030 ten opzichte van de CO 2 emissies in 1990 weinig realistisch is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Laçin en Kröger over de impact van de vernietiging van de PAS door de Raad van State op de besluitvorming omtrent Lelystad Airport

MPs Van Raan, Laçin and Kröger asked the minister how the Council of State's annulment of the PAS nitrogen programme affects the status of Lelystad Airport as a priority project, the required permitting and studies, and whether new research is needed before any decision. The minister answered that the reserved development space for Lelystad has lapsed, that the Wet Natuurbescherming now applies and consequences are still being examined, and that careful study is needed, so opening in April 2020 is no longer feasible.
As soon as more is known about this, I will inform the House.
Zodra hierover meer bekend is, zal ik uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat Rotterdam The Hague Airport straffeloos het afgesproken aantal nachtvluchten kan overschrijden

An MP asked the minister whether the Rotterdam The Hague Airport exceeds its agreed night-flight limit of 849 without enforcement, and what remedies residents have. The minister acknowledges the overrun (around 1,300 night flights, mainly driven by trauma helicopter use), says enforcement applies to the total permitted capacity via the ILT, and commits to examining a binding night-flight maximum in the new airport decree.
I will therefore seriously consider this option.
Ik zal deze optie dan ook serieus bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat nachtvluchten op Maastricht Aachen Airport niet worden uitgesloten

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that night flights at Maastricht Aachen Airport are not excluded under a possible growth scenario in the draft Aviation Policy Note, and about refusing to disclose Belgian-related documents on overflights above Eijsden. The minister answered that scenarios are being assessed in a PlanMER process without final decisions, but withheld content of documents at Belgium's request and committed to publishing the independent detailed analysis.
I therefore cannot go into the content of these documents.
Ik kan daarom niet ingaan op de inhoud van deze documenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over kerosineprojecten in Rotterdam en Delfzijl

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked the minister about public funding and sustainability of synthetic and bio-kerosene projects in Rotterdam and Delfzijl, including fraud risks, deforestation and aviation volume reduction. The minister answered that public funds support feasibility studies and an innovation programme, that the Delfzijl plant receives no public money, and that sustainability is assured through private auditors and advisory boards, while acknowledging limited public enforcement powers and deferring on volume reduction.
At present the ministry is in discussion with the Netherlands Emissions Authority (NEa) about various scenarios for public-law supervision and enforcement to limit fraud risks in the chain.

Op dit moment is het ministerie met de Nederlandse Emissieautoriteit (NEa) in gesprek om verschillende scenario's te bekijken voor publiekrechtelijk toezicht en handhaving om de frauderisico's in de keten te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Kröger en Laçin over ongerustheid over een grote militaire oefenzone

MPs Van Raan, Kröger and Laçin asked about concerns over a large military exercise zone in the north of the Netherlands, its consultation, decision-making roles, environmental and Wadden Sea effects, and links to Lelystad Airport. The ministers answered that the zone is still being designed within the Luchtruimherziening programme, that participation and Plan-MER procedures will follow, and that the decision is due in 2020.
It is too early in the design process to give clarity on the positioning of the exercise area and the consequences for airspace use.
Het is te vroeg in het nog te doorlopen ontwerpproces om al duidelijkheid te geven over de positionering van het oefengebied en de gevolgen hiervan voor het luchtruimgebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de gevolgen van de arresten van het Europese Hof over doorstroom-bv’s van februari 2019

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the consequences of February 2019 European Court rulings on conduit companies (doorstroom-bv's), including whether the tax service will tackle abuse, re-examine rulings, and how large the affected dividend, interest and royalty flows are. The State Secretary answered that existing anti-abuse rules are largely compatible with the rulings, that a bill with a conditional withholding tax and changes to the dividend and corporate tax anti-abuse rules will follow on Budget Day, that existing rulings remain binding until the tax service notifies their lapse, and that risk-based reviews and a report on flows will follow.
I intend to inform your House further on this before the parliamentary treatment of the Tax Plan 2020.
Ik ben van plan uw Kamer hierover vóór de parlementaire behandeling van het Belastingplan 2020 nader te informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Kooten-Arissen over de ontheffing voor het doodschieten van onder andere de das, eekhoorn, haas, konijn, ree, wild zwijn, steenmarter, vos en 22 vogelsoorten op het terrein

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers about a provincial exemption allowing the killing of protected animals (badger, hare, deer, fox and 22 bird species) at Twente Airport, and questioned oversight, the procedure, and whether the exemption should be withdrawn. The minister answered all 17 questions, largely stating that the province is the competent authority and declining to intervene, while confirming the province will withdraw the exemption at the applicant's request.
It is not for me to intervene in the considerations the provinces make when taking those decisions.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in de afwegingen die de provincies bij het nemen van die beslissingen maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Raan over de (bij)stook van biomassa in centrales

MPs Wassenberg and Van Raan asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether biomass co-firing in coal plants is truly CO2-neutral, given transport and processing emissions, forest regrowth times, and the growing role of biomass by 2020 and 2023. The minister replied that biomass is treated as CO2-neutral under international agreements, that Dutch sustainability criteria require at least 70% CO2 savings across the chain, and that the government sees biomass as necessary for the energy transition, though it did not provide a precise breakdown of chain emissions.
I cannot provide an exact breakdown of the CO2 emissions associated with the production, transport and processing of biomass.
Ik kan geen exacte uitsplitsing geven van de CO 2 -uitstoot die samenhangt met de productie, het transport en de verwerking van biomassa.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over een nieuw onderzoek naar de impact van de ongekende veranderingen rond de Noordpool

MP Van Raan (PvdD) asked ministers about media reports on a new study of rapid Arctic change, including claims of a tipping point, sea-ice and ice-sheet loss, and whether Dutch climate policy has enough margin for setbacks toward the 1.5°C goal. The minister acknowledged the study's concerning picture and the need for ambitious climate policy, while stating the 49% 2030 target stands and that policy can be adjusted as new insights emerge.
Dutch climate policy aims for a 49% reduction in 2030 compared with 1990.
Het Nederlandse klimaatbeleid is gericht op een reductie van 49% in 2030 ten opzichte van 1990.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Raan over de grootste, maar ongewenste, houtoven in Diemen

MPs Wassenberg and Van Raan asked whether Diemen and the province of Noord-Holland must approve the permit for the Netherlands' largest wood-burning biomass plant despite air and CO2 concerns, what legal tools exist to refuse it, whether biomass is doubly subsidised, and what SDE+ subsidy applies per kWh. The minister answered that permits can only be refused for non-compliance with law, that biomass is treated as renewable and CO2-neutral under international rules, and gave the subsidy amounts (about 0.051 euro/kWh for a pellet boiler for district heating, 0.027 euro/kWh for smaller boilers).
Yes, if all laws and regulations are complied with, in particular the requirements on air emissions and air quality, the Environmental Permitting Act (Wabo) contains no ground to refuse an activity.

Ja, als voldaan wordt aan alle wet- en regelgeving – in het bijzonder ook de vereisten op het gebied van luchtemissies en luchtkwaliteit – dan kent de Wet algemene bepalingen omgevingsrecht (Wabo) geen weigeringsgrond om een activiteit te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Van Raan over het openbreken van de associatieovereenkomst met Oekraïne en het vervolgens fors verhogen van de importquota voor Oekraïens kippenvlees

MPs Ouwehand and Van Raan asked whether the EU-Ukraine association agreement quota for Ukrainian chicken meat was tripled through a loophole, which Dutch and other EU processors may have facilitated, and whether the government would act to stop it. The minister confirmed the loophole and a proposed quota increase, said the government will decide its position after reviewing the Commission proposal, and gave limited answers on the named companies and the EBRD loan, pointing to other bodies.
The cabinet will study the European Commission's proposal after publication and on that basis take a definitive position.
Het kabinet zal het voorstel van de Europese Commissie, na publicatie, bestuderen en op basis hiervan een definitief standpunt innemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de kosten van stimulering van fossiele brandstoffen

An MP asked the state secretaries of Finance and Infrastructure about the cost of fossil fuel subsidies, aviation fuel and car tax exemptions, carbon pricing and related environmental damage (34 questions). The government answered that it favours pricing polluting activities, acknowledged existing exemptions bound by international treaties, and promised a study into definitions of environmentally harmful subsidies, but did not provide several requested figures.
To nevertheless implement the motion as well as possible, the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate will commission a study into the various definitions of environmentally harmful subsidies.

Om toch zo goed mogelijk uitvoering te geven aan de motie zal de Minister van Economische zaken en klimaat een onderzoek laten uitvoeren naar de uiteenlopende definities van milieuschadelijke subsidies
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin en Van Raan over de 40dB-contour

MPs Kröger, Laçin and Van Raan asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether a changed departure route near Wezep affects the 40dB contour used as the MER study area, and whether the sensitivity analysis can legitimately substitute for assessing alternatives. The Minister replied that the 40 dB(A) contour is shown for information only without spatial restrictions, that the route variants differ in location not height, and that the effects on inhabitants were compiled and published, though the government did not commit to a new MER assessment of the altered route.
The aim of a possible route change is that less built-up area is overflown.
Het doel van een mogelijke routewijziging is dat er minder over bebouwd gebied wordt gevlogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Raan over de aanklacht tegen de EU vanwege de negatieve klimaatimpact van houtstook

MPs Wassenberg and Van Raan asked the minister about a lawsuit claiming EU energy policy wrongly treats wood burning as CO2-neutral, and whether subsidies for wood burning should stop. The minister rejects the claim that wood burning is wrongly classed as CO2-neutral, says sustainability criteria and the Klimaatakkoord address carbon debt and air quality, and declines to stop subsidies.
I do not share the view that wood burning is wrongly classified as CO2-neutral.
Ik deel het standpunt niet dat houtstook onterecht wordt aangemerkt als CO 2 -neutraal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de behandeling van informeel-kapitaal-structuren in het vernieuwde rulingbeleid

An MP asks how the Tax Authority will decide whether tax avoidance is the decisive motive for a structure before issuing an advance ruling, including effects in third countries, double non-taxation, low-tax jurisdictions, and what happens if abuse emerges after a ruling. The State Secretary answers that rulings will be refused where tax saving is the sole or decisive motive, assessed case by case, with examples published in a policy decision effective 1 July 2019, and commits to publishing the policy document and a general meeting answer.
In the renewed ruling practice, no advance certainty will be given if saving Dutch or foreign tax is the sole or decisive motive for the legal act(s) or transactions.
In de vernieuwde rulingpraktijk zal geen zekerheid vooraf worden gegeven indien het besparen van Nederlandse of buitenlandse belasting de enige dan wel doorslaggevende beweegreden is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat er een vliegshow is georganiseerd boven Amsterdam

An MP asked the ministers whether the aerial display over Amsterdam followed safety procedures, stayed above the minimum altitude, and why residents were not informed in advance, along with emissions, noise, and climate questions. The minister replied that the permit and safety rules were followed, the minimum altitude was respected, the event was not secret but deliberately not widely advertised to avoid crowds, and emissions will be offset while the government is pursuing aviation sustainability.
There is no question of secrecy regarding the aerial display.
Er is geen sprake van geheimhouding van de luchtvaartvertoning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Laçin en Kröger over de wijze waarop zal worden omgegaan met de constateringen van de Omgevingsraad Schiphol in het toekomstige luchtvaartbeleid

Three MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how she will take into account the Schiphol Environmental Council's finding that there is no support for further growth before improvements are made, how she reconciles public statements about growth and Lelystad with that advice, and how safety, climate and the 50-50 noise/growth rule will be handled in the upcoming Luchtvaartnota. The minister answered that she is pursuing two amendments to the Schiphol airport traffic decree (one to legally anchor the 500,000 movement cap, one for post-2020 development), will send the Chamber a response before summer, and that safety and climate will be addressed through the planMER process with a draft Luchtvaartnota after summer.
In preparation, I will send the Chamber a response to the chair's report of the ORS before summer, including a proposal for how this LVB will be shaped and how the environment will be involved.

Ter voorbereiding daarop zal ik uw Kamer voor de zomer een reactie op het verslag van de voorzitter van de ORS sturen, inclusief een voorstel voor de manier waarop dit LVB wordt vormgegeven en de omgeving wordt betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de brief van Schiphol aan omwonenden

An MP asked the minister about Schiphol's letter to 1.5 million residents over runway maintenance, including how the area was defined, the permits required, and why flights were not reduced. The minister answered that the letter reflects Schiphol's wider information ambition, that the exemption followed the normal legal and expert review process, and that the schedule must stay continuous within environmental limits.
Sending the letter has no effect on this procedure, and questions or reports arising from the letter are handled in the same way.
Het versturen van de brief heeft geen effect op deze werkwijze en vragen of meldingen naar aanleidingen van de brief worden op overeenkomstige wijze in behandeling genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat de klimaatplannen van grote luchtvaartmaatschappijen falen, o.a. in relatie tot de recente aankoop van aandelen Air France-KLM

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers whether a Transition Pathway Initiative study showing airlines' climate plans fall short, and the Dutch state's purchase of Air France-KLM shares, are compatible with climate policy, and how the state as shareholder will act. The minister answered that the study's conclusions apply broadly but the government will pursue international aviation climate measures, rejects compensation-free assumptions, and states the shareholding serves public economic interests such as Schiphol's network rather than climate goals, with climate weighed in the forthcoming Luchtvaartnota.
Climate challenges have played no direct role.
Klimaatopgaven hebben geen directe rol gespeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over het bericht dat Rotterdam The Hague Airport alle vogels op de luchthaven wil en mag doden

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked whether the province's permit allowing Rotterdam The Hague Airport to kill all wild bird species, including eggs and nests, goes beyond what is necessary, conflicts with Natura 2000 objectives, and whether the government will press the province to withdraw it and inform travellers about bird deaths. The minister replied that the province is primarily responsible for such permits, that the permit is open to objection and appeal to the administrative court, that it is not appropriate for the cabinet to judge this case, and that bird-strike control is a continuous process where killing is used only when other measures fail.
Primary responsibility for granting exemptions under the Nature Conservation Act lies with the provinces.
De primaire verantwoordelijkheid voor het verlenen van ontheffingen in het kader van de Wet natuurbescherming is bij de provincies belegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de gevolgen van Lelystad Airport voor vogels

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked whether the government had adequately studied bird strike risks around Lelystad Airport and why environmental NGOs' concerns had not been addressed. The minister rejected the critique, stated the bird research was thorough, and offered a further meeting with Vogelbescherming Nederland.
The Lelystad project within my ministry is willing to receive Vogelbescherming for an additional meeting.
Het project Lelystad binnen mijn ministerie is bereid om de Vogelbescherming te ontvangen voor een aanvullend gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de gevolgen van Lelystad Airport voor vogels

Two PvdD MPs asked whether the bird-impact research for Lelystad Airport was adequate, whether bird-scaring or killing measures are acceptable, and whether the airport decision should be suspended. The minister replied that the research (including a 2017-2018 baseline survey) shows no need for extra bird-scaring beyond the faunabeheerplan, that killing birds is a last resort, and that no defects justify suspending the decision.
No, I do not share that view. The bird research provides sufficient justification for a positive decision
Nee, die mening deel ik niet. Het vogelonderzoek geeft voldoende onderbouwing voor een positief besluit
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de impact van de luchtvaartplannen van de minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat op het natuurbeleid

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the agriculture and nature minister whether the aviation expansion plans of the infrastructure minister, including Lelystad Airport, affect nature policy through nitrogen deposition and bird strikes, and whether the effects on Veluwe nature have been adequately studied. The minister replied that the impacts were assessed in the MER and follow-up studies, that flight routes avoid Natura 2000 areas, and that the infrastructure minister's aviation policy falls outside her remit, so she sees no reason for further consultation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kooten-Arissen, Van Raan en Van Gerven over het bericht dat EU-voorzitter Roemenië zich laat sponsoren door Coca-Cola

MPs from PvdD and SP asked whether Coca-Cola's sponsorship of the Romanian EU presidency, and similar Dutch presidency sponsorships, create conflicts of interest and undermine the EU's health and sugar policy. The minister answered that sponsorship is a logistical matter for each presidency, that Coca-Cola's sponsorship is separate from EU negotiations on food rules, that no intervention was planned, and that the Dutch sponsorship policy will be considered for the 2029 presidency.
Sponsorships are a way to facilitate an EU presidency logistically.
Sponsorschappen zijn een manier om een EU-voorzitterschap logistiek te faciliteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Ouwehand over de inmenging van Shell in inhoudelijke exposities van Rijksmuseum Boerhaave

MPs Van Raan and Ouwehand asked whether Shell's partnership with Rijksmuseum Boerhaave, including a Shell board member's role in an exhibition and Shell's links to the museum's supervisory board, compromises the museum's independence and whether the government will end it. The minister rejected the criticism, stating the partnership targets talent development, that the museum keeps editorial control under the Ethical Code, and that governance rules are followed; she refused to end the partnership.
Article 1.10 of that code requires museums, regardless of their source of income, to at all times retain control over the content and integrity of their programmes, exhibitions and activities.

Artikel 1.10. van die code schrijft voor dat musea, ongeacht de bron van inkomsten, te allen tijde controle houden over de inhoud en integriteit van hun programma's, tentoonstellingen en activiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Kooten-Arissen over de berichten dat verschillende buitenlandse steden een klimaatnoodtoestand hebben uitgeroepen

MPs Van Raan and Van Kooten-Arissen asked whether the government would explain the effects of cities such as Basel, Vancouver and London declaring a climate emergency on local and national powers, and whether Dutch municipalities and provinces could declare one too. The minister answered that such declarations are symbolic with no transfer or widening of powers, that Dutch law has no rules for them, and that a climate emergency declaration would not affect the forthcoming package of CO2 measures.
In none of the cities does declaring the climate emergency widen or transfer powers of local or national governments.
In geen van de steden worden door het uitroepen van de klimaatnoodtoestand bevoegdheden van de lokale of nationale overheden verruimd of overgeheveld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Kröger en Laçin over het bericht dat ‘de vliegroutes voor Lelystad Airport gewijzigd zijn tijdens de lopende zienswijzenprocedure’

Three MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why flight route changes for Lelystad Airport were made during an ongoing public comment procedure without involving municipalities such as Kampen, and whether residents' objections would be affected. The minister replied that the Wezep route is still only a proposal under consultation with neighbouring municipalities, that the amended MER already covers a possible route change without altering legal noise contours, and that no extension of the comment period is planned.
Partly on the basis of this advice, I will take a decision on a possible adjustment of the route.
Mede op basis van dit advies zal ik een besluit nemen over een mogelijke aanpassing van de route.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat ruim 3.200 Belgische wetenschappers en academici de klimaatstakers groot gelijk geven

Van Raan (PvdD) asked whether Dutch climate policy has caused public concern, whether the government endorses the Scientists4Climate call for stronger climate ambition, and whether it will strengthen its own targets. Minister Wiebes answered that the government shares the concern, meets Youth for Climate, supports the call for structural measures, and sees no need to raise Dutch targets since its own goals already exceed those proposed.
No, that is not necessary, because the Scientists4Climate movement sets lower targets for 2030 and 2050 than the cabinet.
Nee, dat is niet nodig, want de beweging Scientists4Climate hanteert lagere doelen voor 2030 en 2050 dan het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Raan over de online omgevingsanalyse die is opgesteld in opdracht van de Omgevingsraad Schiphol (ORS)

MPs Laçin and Van Raan asked about an online environmental analysis commissioned by the Schiphol Environmental Council, its purpose, cost, and GDPR safeguards. The minister explains it was part of a broad public consultation on Schiphol's future, costing €45,375, and states that the ORS as a foundation must comply with the GDPR under supervision of the Dutch Data Protection Authority.
The Schiphol Environmental Council is a foundation and as such, like any other natural or legal person, must comply with the rules and obligations of the GDPR.
De Omgevingsraad Schiphol is een stichting en moet als zodanig net als iedere andere natuurlijke of rechtspersoon voldoen aan de regels en verplichtingen van de AVG.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bezoek van de topman van Air France-KLM

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked whether ministers discussed declining public support for aviation, climate targets and possible aviation shrinkage with the Air France-KLM CEO during his January 2019 visit. The government confirmed the meeting covered the network, public interests and agreements, and said climate and safety were not discussed at group level but are raised regularly with KLM and Transavia.
These topics were not discussed at Air France-KLM group level in this meeting.
Deze onderwerpen zijn in dit gesprek op Air France-KLM groepsniveau niet aan de orde geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the government, including the Minister responsible for education and media, about the Greta Thunberg COP24 speech and whether ministers accept responsibility for climate policy, with 20 questions on whether the government will change its climate and growth policy. The answer, sent jointly by several ministers, states only that the questions were answered by reference to an Aanhangsel in the parliamentary proceedings, without addressing the substance in this document.
The written questions from MP Van Raan (PvdD), question number 2018Z24282, have been answered by means of the Appendix to the Proceedings, parliamentary year 2018–2019, no. 1305.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Van Raan (PvdD), vraagnummer 2018Z24282 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr. 1305 .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

An MP asked the government, in 21 questions, whether it agrees with and will respond to numerous statements by Greta Thunberg at COP24 criticising climate policy, business-as-usual growth, and political inaction, and what concrete steps it will take. The ministers replied collectively and the answer is reproduced by reference to the Aanhangsel Handelingen rather than in full, so no substantive response is visible in the text.
The written questions from MP Van Raan (PvdD), question number 2018Z24291, have been answered by way of Appendix to the Proceedings, parliamentary year 2018–2019, no. 1305.
Antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Van Raan (PvdD), vraagnummer 2018Z24291 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Akerboom over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

MPs Van Raan and Akerboom asked the government whether it bears responsibility for climate policy and how it responds to a speech by Greta Thunberg at COP24, including whether ministers would act to keep warming to 1.5 degrees. The government answered only by referring to a previous answer, Aanhangsel Handelingen 2018-2019 nr. 1305, without addressing the substance.
The written questions from members Van Raan and Akerboom (both PvdD), question number 2018Z24281, have been answered by means of Appendix to the Proceedings, parliamentary year 2018–2019, no. 1305.
Antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Van Raan en Akerboom (beiden PvdD), vraagnummer 2018Z24281 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the government, in 21 questions, whether it will respond to and act on the criticisms voiced by climate activist Greta Thunberg at COP24, including on the government's climate policy, economic growth, and ties with Saudi Arabia. The government answers collectively, stating that the questions were answered by reference to the Aanhangsel Handelingen (the answers appended to the parliamentary record) rather than in the document itself.
The written questions from MP Van Raan (PvdD), question number 2018Z24286, have been answered by means of the Appendix to the Handelingen, parliamentary year 2018–2019, no. 1305.
Antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Van Raan (PvdD), vraagnummer 2018Z24286 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the government, in 21 questions, whether it agrees with and will respond to Greta Thunberg's COP24 speech, including whether it accepts co-responsibility for climate policy, whether it will commit to 1.5 degree-compatible measures and to changing its own ministry's practices. The joint government reply (on behalf of several ministers) was only a reference to an Aanhangsel and did not address the questions on substance.
The written questions from MP Van Raan (PvdD), question number 2018Z24284, have been answered by means of Appendix to the Proceedings, parliamentary year 2018–2019, no. 1305.
Antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Van Raan (PvdD), vraagnummer 2018Z24284 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

MPs Van Raan and Teunissen asked the government to respond to Greta Thunberg's COP24 speech, asking whether ministers agree with her criticism of climate policy, economic growth, and political inaction, and what concrete measures they will take (21 questions). The government's joint answer refers to the earlier answers to the questions and does not address the substance of the individual questions.
The written questions from MPs Van Raan and Teunissen (both PvdD), question number 2018Z24289, have been answered by way of Parliamentary Proceedings appendix, session 2018–2019, no. 1305.
Antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen (beiden PvdD) vraagnummer 2018Z24289 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Akerboom over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

Two PvdD MPs asked the government to react to Greta Thunberg's COP24 speech, including whether ministers accept her claims about growth, fossil fuels, and intergenerational justice, and what concrete steps they will take. The government answered that the questions were answered in an appendix to the parliamentary record, referring to a separate written answer rather than addressing the substance here.
The written questions from MPs Van Raan and Akerboom (both PvdD), question number 2018Z24283, have been answered by means of Parliamentary Proceedings appendix, session 2018–2019, no. 1305.
De schriftelijke van de leden Van Raan en Akerboom (beiden PvdD), vraagnummer 2018Z24283 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr. 1305 .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat het vliegverkeer over de Buitenveldertbaan sterk is toegenomen

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that daytime and night-time use of the Buitenveldertbaan at Schiphol had increased, and about measured noise exceeding modelled values. The minister answered that use rose about 24% by day but fell about 2% at night, attributed the increase to Kaagbaan maintenance and traffic growth, explained the preferential runway rules, acknowledged that measurements tend to exceed calculations, and announced a national programme to review noise measurement.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Verhoeven, Van der Graaf, Leijten, Van Ojik, Maeijer, Asscher, Van Rooijen, Van Raan, Bisschop, Azarkan en Baudet over de rechtsstatelijke aspecten van de machtigingsbepaling van

MPs from many parties asked the Foreign Affairs and Justice ministers whether article X of the Brexit omnibus bill, which lets ministers issue temporary general rules that can depart from existing law, undermines legislative primacy and rule-of-law safeguards, and whether they would add safeguards by amendment. The ministers reject the criticism, argue the power is a narrow, one-year transitional measure justified by Brexit's unprecedented nature and that the Council of State endorsed it, and say they will consider an amendment based on Chamber feedback.
We will, based on the views of the Chamber and further reactions from society, benevolently consider whether an amendment note is appropriate.
Wij zullen op basis van de zienswijze van de Kamer en verdere reacties uit de samenleving welwillend bezien of een nota van wijziging aangewezen is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Kröger over het bericht dat de Raad van State zich heeft laten misleiden door het ministerie van I&W

MPs Van Raan and Kröger asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the Council of State was misled by the ministry about Schiphol noise norms, and whether the 10,000-homes norm was binding and required a PKB procedure to change. The minister answered that the criteria figures are outcomes of a calculation rather than absolute limits, that the actualisation was communicated to parliament and was lawful, that no PKB procedure or law change was needed, and that the norm still applies.
In this respect, therefore, no homes have been built that should not have been built according to the norm.
Er zijn in dit opzicht dus ook geen woningen gebouwd die volgens de norm niet gebouwd hadden mogen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin, Van Raan en Van Brenk over kritiek op motie Lelystad Airport

MPs Kröger, Laçin, Van Raan and Van Brenk asked whether completing the airspace redesign by 2023 is realistic, whether low-flying routes from Lelystad Airport will be gone by then, how low-flying routes are defined, and whether a plan MER is needed. The minister says the 2023 target stands, a start decision follows in spring 2019 and a preferred variant in 2020, but gives no guarantee that low-flying routes disappear by 2023, offers no definition, and leaves the plan MER question open.
As agreed in the Coalition Agreement, the Cabinet will implement the planned adjustment of the airspace by 2023.
Zoals is afgesproken in het Regeerakkoord gaat het Kabinet de voorgenomen aanpassing van het luchtruim per 2023 realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat de Staat in cassatie gaat in de Klimaatzaak

An MP asked whether the State's litigation spending and the costs awarded to Urgenda in the climate case were proportionate, and whether NGOs winning against the State are fairly compensated for legal costs. The Minister said costs follow fixed rules, NGOs have the same cost claims as other legal persons, the State's appeal costs are not yet budgeted, and no change to the rules is planned.
There are fixed rules for the reimbursement of legal costs. An NGO has the same entitlement to a costs award as any other legal person incurring such costs.
Er zijn vaste regels voor de vergoeding van proceskosten. Een NGO heeft dezelfde aanspraak op proceskostenvergoeding als iedere andere rechtspersoon die dergelijke kosten maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Akerboom over het bericht dat 10 jaar lang pogingen van de EU en 1 miljard euro de opslag van CO2 niet van de grond hebben gekregen

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the minister whether the European Court of Auditors' finding that EU carbon capture and storage (CCS) programmes failed, and related court rulings, undermine reliance on CCS to meet CO2 targets.
