The minister answered that CCS remains a useful part of the emissions mix, that the EU programmes failed mainly due to an unfavourable investment climate, and that the government will not exclude options, while noting that 1.5 degrees pathways rely heavily on other measures.
The conclusion is that neither programme succeeded in ensuring CCS is applied in the EU, mainly due to the unfavourable investment climate.
De conclusie is dat beide programma's er niet in geslaagd zijn te zorgen dat CCS in de EU wordt toegepast, met name vanwege het ongunstige investeringsklimaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over het bericht dat Shell kinderen wurgcontracten zou hebben laten ondertekenen

MPs Van Raan and Teunissen asked ministers about reports that Shell had children sign contracts with broad rights waivers, English-law jurisdiction and confidentiality clauses for Generation Discover 2018, and about related questions on the Hogeschool Leiden and the festival. The government answered that the forms were sent in error, were replaced, and that affected children were not photographed, declined to answer questions 3 to 25 because Shell will destroy the contracts, and did not consider the other issues reason for action beyond general comments.
Because Shell will destroy the agreements you refer to and will therefore not rely on them, I will not address questions 3 through 25, as you yourself suggest.
Omdat Shell de overeenkomsten waar u naar verwijst, zal vernietigen en daar dus geen beroep op zal doen ga ik, zoals u zelf voorstelt, niet in op de vragen 3 tot en met 25.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het artikel ‘Shell en Unilever dreigen niet met vertrek, ze waarschuwen alleen maar’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about whether Article 15d of the corporate tax act imposes a final tax settlement on multinationals moving headquarters abroad, and whether it deters such moves, plus historical counts, rulings and valuation methods. The State Secretary confirmed the final settlement applies but said its amount depends on case-specific facts, declined to accept the claim it always amounts to a large sum, and said the Tax Administration does not systematically record headquarters relocations, rulings or the amounts involved.
The Tax Administration does not systematically record headquarters relocations.
De Belastingdienst registreert verplaatsingen van hoofdkantoren niet systematisch.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over VNO en het klimaatbeleid

An MP asked the ministers whether VNO-NCW's opposition to stronger climate policy, including arguments about carbon leakage that resemble a Business Europe lobbying strategy, undermines the Klimaatakkoord, and whether the government sees VNO-NCW as an obstacle. The minister acknowledges VNO-NCW's concerns about competitiveness and carbon leakage as shared points of attention, rejects the characterisation of the Klimaatakkoord as sabotaged, and states that the draft is on track to the 49% target with further elaboration needed.
I note that VNO-NCW calls attention to the international competitiveness of Dutch business and carbon leakage effects of CO2 emissions.
Ik constateer dat VNO-NCW aandacht vraagt voor de internationale concurrentiepositie van het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven en weglekeffecten van CO 2 -uitstoot.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat tientallen Haagse basisscholen Shell-festival Generation Discover boycotten

An MP asked the education minister about dozens of The Hague primary schools boycotting Shell's Generation Discover festival, whether schools should be urged to avoid it, and whether the ministry's secretary-general opening the festival is consistent with that. The minister answered that schools decide for themselves which events to attend, that the ministry will not urge a boycott, and that the festival serves technical education recruitment, with the ministry also joining the annual CEO consultation held there.
It is not for the government to judge whether or not to attend an event.
Het is niet aan de regering om het wel of niet bezoeken van een evenement te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat VNO-NCW is aangesloten bij een machtige lobbygroep die het verhogen van de Europese klimaatambitie actief tegenwerkt

MP Van Raan asked the government about reports that employers' federation VNO-NCW belongs to Business Europe, which lobbies against raising the EU 2030 climate target, and whether this conflicts with the coalition goal of 55% reduction and with the Dutch Climate Agreement talks. The minister acknowledged the notes, said the government works constructively with VNO-NCW, committed to pursuing 55% at EU level with allied member states, and declined to warn negotiators or officials specifically about the lobbying strategy.
Both government representatives in contact with VNO-NCW and the parties at the Industry table are aware of the international context in which industry operates.
Zowel overheidsvertegenwoordigers die in contact staan met VNO-NCW als de partijen aan de Industrietafel zijn zich bewust van de internationale context waarbinnen de industrie opereert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht dat farmaceutisch bedrijven voor miljarden aan belasting ontwijken

MPs Van Raan and Van Kooten-Arissen asked whether the government would tie pharmaceutical companies' tax conduct to drug price negotiations, and about tax competition, the innovation box and a sector code on pricing. The State Secretary replied that the corporate tax cut is largely financed by base broadening, defended the innovation box as meeting OECD standards, and said tax morality plays no role in price negotiations while welcoming the voluntary pharma code.
Under Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act I cannot discuss the way individual companies fulfil their tax obligations.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan ik niet ingaan op de manier waarop individuele bedrijven hun belastingplicht voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Ouwehand over de groeiplannen van Eindhoven Airport en de gevolgen voor de natuur

MPs Van Raan and Ouwehand asked whether Eindhoven Airport's growth scenarios would increase CO2, nitrogen and fine-particle emissions, conflict with Natura 2000 protection and the PAS, and whether a critical report was withheld. The government answered that the scenarios are analytical only, no decision has been taken, growth would be assessed as a priority project only later, and the report was not suppressed but published with a delay by the municipality.
The report concerned on nitrogen deposition was not withheld.
Het betreffende rapport over stikstofdepositie is niet achtergehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht ‘Hoe onafhankelijk is Yvon Jaspers?’

MP Van Raan asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about Yvon Jaspers' paid side activities for For Farmers and Farm & Countryfair and possible influence on public broadcasting programming, and whether the Commissariaat voor de Media should investigate. The Minister replied that the Commissariaat is investigating the arrangements with the presenter, that public broadcasters set their own programming and are responsible for transparency on conflicts of interest, and declined to comment further on individual personnel matters.
Following recent media reports on the presenter's side job, the Commissariaat voor de Media is examining the arrangements with this presenter regarding both programmes.

Naar aanleiding van de recente berichten in de media over de nevenfunctie van de betreffende presentatrice onderzoekt het Commissariaat voor de Media (hierna: het Commissariaat) de afspraken met deze presentatrice ten aanzien van beide programma’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Kooten-Arissen over ongewenste druk van de overheid en het bedrijfsleven op onderzoekers

MPs Van Raan and Van Kooten-Arissen asked about undue pressure from government and business on researchers, including the KNAW code on external funding, the new research integrity code, and Rijksvoorwaarden. The ministers answered that the new Dutch research integrity code covers all researchers, that universities must protect their researchers, and that the government will review the Rijksvoorwaarden and model contract to ensure they fit the integrity code.

I will, together with the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the drafting committee that prepared the new code, take another careful look at the Rijksvoorwaarden in combination with the model agreement for (policy-oriented) research.

Daarom ga ik samen met de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de schrijfcommissie, die de nieuwe gedragscode heeft opgesteld, nog eens goed naar de Rijksvoorwaarden in combinatie met de modelovereenkomst voor (beleidsgericht) onderzoek kijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat Shell-directeur Marjan van Loon de stad Den Haag gaat adviseren over duurzaamheid

An MP asked the ministers whether it is acceptable that Shell's director advises The Hague on sustainability, whether Shell's advice is credible, and what steps government will take regarding local advice and Shell's role. The minister answered that local advisory appointments are for the municipality and its council to oversee, that Shell is one of many parties in the energy transition, and that it is up to local governments to disclose their advisory bodies.
It is not for the national government to direct decentralised authorities, in this case the Hague municipal executive, on their hiring of advisers.
Het is niet aan het Rijk om decentrale overheden, en in dit geval het college van B&W van Den Haag, aan te sturen op hun inhuur van adviseurs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Wassenberg en Ouwehand over de jaarlijkse milieuschade van ruim 37 miljard euro

MPs Van Raan, Wassenberg and Ouwehand asked the government about the roughly 37 billion euro annual environmental damage from Dutch firms and consumers, the CO2 minimum price, aviation emissions, livestock and imported environmental costs, and whether environmental costs are included in fiscal and policy calculations. The Minister mostly defended existing policy, said the PBL figures are uncertain and not fully comparable, pointed to planned True Pricing work and aviation measures, and declined to give some requested estimates.
The multi-year programme I have in mind should provide more insight into the cost-shifting mechanisms.
Het meerjarenprogramma dat mij voor ogen staat moet meer inzicht in de afwentelingsmechanismen opleveren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van den Hul, Ploumen, Van Ojik en Van Raan over het bericht dat de VS alle hulp aan UNRWA stopt

MPs asked the government how it views the US decision to halt all funding to UNRWA, and whether it will press Washington, increase its own contribution, and address the wider political consequences. The government regrets the US decision, says it opposes politicising humanitarian aid, pledges to raise the issue with the US and other donors, and keeps its existing 13 million euro annual contribution while deferring any extra funding to year-end review.
As usual, at the end of the year the cabinet will assess, within existing humanitarian aid agreements, which additional Dutch contributions based on the humanitarian imperative are desirable.

Zoals gebruikelijk beoordeelt het kabinet aan het einde van het jaar binnen de bestaande afspraken over humanitaire hulp welke aanvullende Nederlandse bijdragen op basis van het humanitair imperatief wenselijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat het afschaffen van de dividendbelasting veel meer kost dan de 1,4 miljard euro die in het regeerakkoord voorzien was

Van Raan (PvdD) asked the Finance Minister whether the cost overrun of abolishing the dividend tax, reported as far above the 1.4 billion euro in the coalition agreement, counts as an unplanned tax cut that must be compensated, and whether the compensation falls on businesses and passes through to households and foreign shareholders. The Staatssecretaris answered that the higher revenue estimate is a tax cut to be fully offset by a higher burden on business (mainly by limiting the top corporate tax rate reduction), with uncertain pass-through, and declined to comment on media coverage.
That is correct: the tax cut from the higher estimated dividend tax revenue is fully offset by a compensating increase in the burden on businesses.
Dat is juist, de lastenverlichting door de hoger geraamde opbrengst van de dividendbelasting is volledig gedekt door compenserende lastenverzwaring bij het bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de uitspaken van de minister-president inzake de dividendbelasting

An MP asks the Prime Minister to explain his description of abolishing dividend tax as 'bizarre', and whether it protects Dutch firms from hostile takeovers, is linked to low interest rates, and offsets the valuation effects of earlier measures. The State Secretary answers that the measure is justified in the explanatory memorandum, that abolition may reduce takeover incentives, and that low rates are not decisive, while giving no commitment on reintroduction or on the valuation effects.
The Prime Minister meant that it is not the easiest measure to explain.
De Minister-President doelde erop dat het niet de makkelijkste maatregel is om uit te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Raan over het bericht dat Fransen nieuwe jacht op de grutto niet uitsluiten

MPs Van Kooten-Arissen and Van Raan asked whether France's hunting of protected migratory birds such as the curlew and black-tailed godwit harms Dutch populations and whether the Dutch government will protest or block imports. The minister said France has extended a hunting ban on the godwit and curlew (except coastal curlew hunting) until July 2019, will monitor the situation, and will support proposals at the AEWA meeting in December 2018.
The Netherlands is closely monitoring developments in France and the population status of the black-tailed godwit and curlew, as the Netherlands invests heavily in conserving these species.
Nederland volgt de ontwikkelingen in Frankrijk en de stand van de populaties van de grutto en de wulp nauwgezet, aangezien Nederland veel inspanningen doet om deze soorten te behouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het artikel ’Vlag, volkslied, vliegveld; de toekomst van Schiphol’

An MP (Van Raan, PvdD) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about critiques that the cost-benefit analysis for Schiphol growth fails criteria and contains errors, including on CO2 prices, discount rate, employment figures and the Rli advice on mainport policy. The minister defends the exploratory MKBA as a transparent, non-binding study, acknowledges a discount-rate issue that would raise climate costs by a factor 2-2.3 without changing conclusions, and promises a broader Luchtvaartnota with knowledge base and participation.
Therefore, but mainly because the main conclusions do not change, this exploratory MKBA will not be amended.
Daarom, maar vooral omdat de hoofdconclusies niet wijzigen, wordt deze verkennende MKBA niet aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat stukken Arctische permafrost zelfs in de winter niet meer zijn bevroren

An MP asked the ministers whether reports that some Arctic permafrost no longer freezes even in winter, and possibly thaws faster than expected, should affect climate policy and CO2 reduction targets. The minister answered that the IPCC projects substantial permafrost loss, that the next IPCC special report will incorporate recent studies, and that it is too early to say what this means for ambition levels, while noting that current models can still support climate policy if the extra emissions are subtracted from the remaining carbon budget.
It is still too early to make a statement about the consequences of these insights for the level of ambition and reduction targets.
Het is nog te vroeg om een uitspraak te doen over de consequenties van deze inzichten voor het ambitieniveau en reductiedoelstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat de CO2-uitstoot van de luchtvaartsector wéér is gestegen

An opposition MP asked the ministers whether rising aviation CO2 emissions, the role of market-based schemes and the government's international ambitions are acceptable and what the government will do. The minister answered that aviation emissions must fall, pointed to ICAO, CORSIA, the EU ETS and the national Duurzame Luchtvaarttafel, and rejected the claim that aviation has a free pass under Paris.
Aviation CO2 emissions must be reduced.
De CO 2 uitstoot door de luchtvaart dient te worden gereduceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Raan over de berichten dat de Nederlandse natuur verschrompelt en een noodplan nodig is

MPs Van Kooten-Arissen and Van Raan asked whether the government shares concerns that prolonged drought is withering Dutch nature and threatening species, and what measures will be taken. The minister acknowledges the concerns, describes crisis coordination, water allocation rules, the Deltaplan Zoetwater and planned nature-network and climate-stress-test steps, but gives no new binding commitments beyond existing programmes.
I too am concerned about the consequences for nature of the ongoing drought.
Ik maak mij ook zorgen over de gevolgen voor de natuur van de aanhoudende droogte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht ‘Minder efficiënt onderwijs is beter onderwijs’

MP Van Raan asked the education ministers about an article arguing that less efficient education is better education, touching on technology, globalisation, the purpose of schooling, and cost comparisons with other sectors. Minister Slob answered that the article has interesting analyses, that the curriculum review addresses broad social purposes, and that Baumol's cost-disease argument justifies deliberate budget choices.
The article contains some interesting analyses of the role of sociology and economics in thinking about education.
Het artikel bevat enkele interessante analyses over de rol van sociologie en economie in het denken over onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het gebruik van de 4e baan op Schiphol, gedurende gebruiksjaar 2017

An MP asked the minister about use of Schiphol's fourth runway on 9 May 2018 and in 2016-2017, including flight-movement counts, overruns of the 80-movement limit, and general aviation slot numbers. The minister declined to provide the movement data for now because a related objection procedure and court ruling are pending, promising to inform parliament after a decision in early September, and gave general aviation slot figures for 2016/2017 and 2017/2018.
A decision still has to be taken in this objection procedure, so I cannot provide you with information relevant to this objection procedure.
Er moet nog een besluit worden genomen in deze bezwaarprocedure, daarom kan ik u geen informatie verstrekken die van belang is voor deze bezwaarprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht ‘Onderzoek naar groei vliegveld Rotterdam rammelt’

An MP asks whether the cost-benefit analysis for Rotterdam The Hague Airport's growth underestimates health, climate, noise and employment effects and whether a new analysis should be commissioned. The Minister says the airport will update its MKBA under current guidelines, that the airport rather than government commissions such analyses, and declines to commission a new one now.
I have asked the management of RTHA to carry out the announced update of the MKBA based on the applicable guidelines, including for CO2 valuation.
Ik heb de directie van RTHA verzocht om de aangekondigde actualisatie van de MKBA uit voeren op basis van de geldende richtlijnen, zo ook voor CO2-waardering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Arissen over het door Shell georganiseerde festival Generation Discover 2017

Two MPs asked whether Defence and the national police, through paid stands and programme roles at Shell's Generation Discover festival, should withdraw support given Shell's fossil-fuel messaging to children. The Justice minister replied that no state subsidy was given, the stands were rented at market rates, and the government sees the partnerships as technology and cybercrime outreach, with no intention to withdraw.
There is no question of financial state support in the form of, for example, a subsidy.
Er is geen sprake van financiële rijkssteun in de vorm van bijvoorbeeld subsidie.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat twee NGO’s een klachtenprocedure zijn gestart tegen het Oekraïense kippenbedrijf MHP, dat zaken doet met Nederlandse bedrijven die hiervoor exportkredietverzek

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about NGO complaints against Ukrainian poultry firm MHP, its export practices via a Dutch facility, and export credit insurance from Atradius DSB, including whether the insurer will refuse risky applications. The government confirms the complaints and the EU-Ukraine association agreement tariff issue, reports 18 insured transactions and EUR 34.1 million outstanding risk, says Atradius assessed MHP as acceptable, and commits to refusing transactions with excessive human rights or environmental risk.
Transactions where the risk of human rights violations or environmental damage is too great I reject, in line with existing policy.
Transacties waarbij het risico op schending van mensenrechten of milieuschade te groot is keur ik af, in lijn met staand beleid.
Antwoord op  vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin, Van Brenk, Gijs van Dijk en Van Raan over geluidsnormen op Schiphol

MPs asked the minister whether the Schiphol noise criteria (the 'huizennorm' of 10,000 severely affected homes) were stretched to about 12,300 homes without justification, and whether enforcement uses flown routes. The minister acknowledges the criteria were actualised in 2007/2008 and 2013 after new insights, says enforcement now uses flown routes, and rejects the claim that the original limits were breached, while not fully explaining why the figure rose.
If an actualisation is carried out, the House of Representatives will be informed of it.
Indien een actualisatie wordt uitgevoerd, wordt Uw Kamer daarover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Ouwehand over het bericht dat het ABP 174 miljoen euro in de palmolie-industrie investeert

MPs Van Raan and Ouwehand asked whether the government finds the ABP's EUR 174 million investment in palm oil plantations in Papua, linked to rainforest clearance and human rights abuses, acceptable and whether it will press the fund to divest. The minister says the content is worrying, points to existing programmes on deforestation and land rights, and states that ABP decides its own investment policy while the government will pursue responsible-business covenants with the financial sector.
The pension fund ABP decides on its own investment policy and applies a specific responsible-investment policy.
Het pensioenfonds ABP gaat over het eigen beleggingsbeleid en hanteert specifiek beleid inzake verantwoord beleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het CBS-rapport Groene Groei

An MP asked the State Secretary for Finance about the CBS finding that the share of environmental taxes in total tax revenue has fallen, and how this squares with the polluter-pays principle and the cabinet's 'greenest cabinet ever' ambition. The government disputes the CBS conclusion of no further greening, citing rising absolute green tax revenue, and points to planned increases in energy and waste taxes and new green levies in the coalition agreement.
The greening of the tax system will continue unabated.
De vergroening van het belastingstelsel wordt onverkort voortgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht “CM en SuperRebel lanceren Qrtsjing”

MP Van Raan (PvdD) asked the Finance Minister whether the 16-digit payment reference required by the Tax Authority and CJIB is unnecessarily complicated, and whether a more user-friendly government payment system is planned. The Minister answered that the reference is needed for reconciliation, that the market rather than government should develop payment systems, and that iDEAL is being offered as an alternative, with no new government simplification announced.
The exact figure for payments reported as errors due to incorrect entry of the payment reference is not available.
Het exacte cijfer van betalingen die als fout worden gerapporteerd door incorrecte overname van het betalingskenmerk is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over nieuwe budgetvluchten naar New York

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about low-priced Norwegian flights from Amsterdam to New York, slot allocation linked to EU merger conditions, and whether sustainability criteria could be used in slot allocation. The minister answered that airlines may set fares freely under the EU-US aviation agreement, that KLM released slots under EU competition conditions, and that current EU rules do not permit environmental criteria in slot allocation, though the government will explore this further.
There are currently no possibilities for this within the existing European frameworks.
Hiervoor bestaan op dit moment binnen de huidige Europese kaders geen mogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het ETS in het kader van het rapport Groene groei van het CBS

An MP asked the ministers about the low Dutch emissions reduction under the EU ETS, whether the ETS and the MSR conflict with a national minimum CO2 price, how the surplus is determined, and whether binding reduction targets are preferable to price mechanisms. The government attributed the limited reduction to efficient, export-oriented sectors, denied any conflict, explained the surplus calculation, and rejected the preference for binding targets over pricing.
This has unfortunately not proven possible.
Dit is helaas niet mogelijk gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de schadelijke effecten van de groeiende luchtvaart op de luchtkwaliteit rond Schiphol

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked the government about the air-quality effects of growing aviation around Schiphol, including RIVM projections of NO2 exceedances in 2030 and whether environmental impact assessments adequately cover health and climate effects. The minister answered that the exceedances stem from Schiphol-related traffic, pointed to planned measures and the ongoing ultrafine particle research, and defended the scope of the MERs as adequate, while committing to take the Commission's suggestion into a future aviation strategy.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de dubbele petten van Pieter van Geel

An MP asked the minister whether Pieter van Geel, chair of the commission advising on the Oostvaardersplassen policy framework, had a conflict of interest through his supervisory board seat at LVNL and the link to Lelystad Airport expansion, and whether the advice should be independently reviewed. The minister saw no problem, said the Lelystad link had no effect on the commission's work, noted the side role was reported and cleared, and declined an independent review as the provincial states are responsible for the advice.
Finally, Mr Van Geel reported the side function to the supervisory board of LVNL, in accordance with the applicable rules.
Ten slotte heeft de heer Van Geel – conform de hiervoor geldende regels – de nevenfunctie gemeld bij de raad van toezicht van LVNL.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het versneld smelten van het ijs op Antarctica

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a UK study finding faster underwater melting of Antarctic ice, its link to a KNMI study, and whether it should accelerate climate policy. The minister confirmed the study, said the findings do not justify revising prior conclusions given model uncertainty, and said climate policy acceleration is already in the coalition agreement while sea-level policy falls to another minister.
The cabinet has chosen in the coalition agreement to accelerate climate policy.
Het kabinet heeft in het regeerakkoord gekozen voor een versnelling van het klimaatbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over een ernstig veiligheidsincident op Schiphol

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a near mid-air collision at Schiphol, its consequences, and when the government would consider safety compromised. The minister declined to speculate on consequences, said conclusions await the OVV and ILT investigations, and pointed to a letter of 25 April 2018 and promised to send the To70 study once received.
Only when all facts are known and the investigations have been completed can conclusions be drawn about the seriousness of the incident.
Pas wanneer alle feiten bekend zijn en de onderzoeken zijn uitgevoerd, kunnen conclusies worden getrokken over de ernst van het voorval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de drang naar groei binnen de luchtvaartsector

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about Schiphol's new pier, capacity growth, the OVV safety advice, Lelystad Airport flight routes, enforcement, environmental assessment independence, climate and bird-strike risks, and the Crisis- en Herstelwet. The minister confirmed the pier investment, said growth is possible only if demonstrably safe, promised a monitoring-based enforcement policy rule and further research, but gave largely policy-restating answers and did not address the dual-role concern in substance.
I take the OVV's recommendations seriously.
Ik neem de aanbevelingen van de OVV serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de bankenbuffers

An MP asks the Finance Minister about bank capital buffers, the risk of a new crisis, and whether systemic banks receive implicit subsidies. The minister says the leverage ratio will be introduced at 3%, Dutch systemic banks already hold higher buffers, and that the systemic bank category does not create an implicit subsidy.
The cabinet supports introducing this 3% requirement as a minimum requirement for all banks.
Het kabinet is voorstander van de introductie van deze eis van 3% als minimumeis voor alle banken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het afscheidsinterview van de president-directeur van Schiphol

An MP asked the ministers about the outgoing Schiphol CEO's farewell interview on airport capacity, connectivity, selectivity policy, Ryanair, Lelystad Airport and a flight tax. The minister answered that data on the economic value of connectivity are limited to existing studies, pointed to planned selectivity measures and a future Luchtvaartnota, and said a flight tax is being prepared for 2021.
I have no information on what specifically the increase in direct connectivity since 2009 has yielded.
Ik heb geen informatie over wat specifiek de sinds 2009 toegenomen directe connectiviteit heeft opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de juridische eigendomsrechten van slots

An MP asked the ministers about passenger growth at Schiphol in early 2018 and the legal status of airport slots, including whether slots can be withdrawn and how their number can be reduced. The minister replied that slots are permissions under EU Regulation 95/93, not property or landing rights, that they can be withdrawn only on specific legal grounds, and that the slot cap is set through capacity declarations and environmental rules.
Slots are not the same as landing rights.
Slots zijn niet hetzelfde als landingsrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de wetenschappelijke borging van het klimaatbeleid

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the scientific underpinning of climate policy is balanced, in particular whether the PBL study excluded production and behavioural measures and whether the KNAW should provide independent scrutiny. The minister replies that PBL is independent and responsible for its own study choices, that no new study is needed, that sector tables will decide measures, and that no second independent opinion is planned.

The independence of the PBL is legally anchored, and as an independent knowledge institute the PBL provides substantiated knowledge, facts and analyses for public debate and policy formation in the Netherlands.

De onafhankelijkheid van het PBL is wettelijk verankerd en als onafhankelijk kennisinstituut levert het PBL onderbouwde kennis, feiten en analyses ten behoeve van het maatschappelijk debat en de beleidsvorming in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de invloed van de fossiele industrie op de inhoud van het onderwijs

An MP asked whether fossil fuel industry involvement, such as Shell teacher training and industry-supplied teaching materials, risks influencing the content of education, and whether industry representatives shape the technology curriculum. The minister answered that schools are responsible for their own sponsorship and material choices under a sponsorship covenant, that curriculum consultation is open to all, and that the government will remind schools of the covenant rules.
The school is responsible for the quality and content of education. This also includes the school's sponsorship policy.
De school is verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit en inhoud van het onderwijs. Daaronder valt ook het sponsorbeleid van de school.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over potentiële gevaren bij de nieuwe vliegroutes Lelystad

An MP asked the ministers about staffing shortages at the military air traffic control station, whether it can safely handle extra traffic from Lelystad Airport, bird strike risks and flight routes, and who is responsible for airspace safety. The government answered that staffing gaps exist but traffic will be managed within a year, that bird-strike monitoring and studies are underway, and that the two ministers share responsibility with the air traffic service providers and the inspectorate.
To this end, already qualified and trained air traffic controllers will initially be deployed.
Daartoe zullen in eerste instantie reeds gekwalificeerde en getrainde verkeersleiders worden ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de evaluatie van het project Schoon Belonen

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the evaluation of the Schoon Belonen litter pilot, including its monitoring, municipal participation, scalability and whether it replaces a statiegeld (deposit) system. The State Secretary rejected the claim that the pilot failed the Chamber's conditions, pointed to independent Rijkswaterstaat monitoring and referred questions about participants' motives to the initiating organisations, while saying the pilot alone is insufficient for the petition motion and referring to a separate letter on the Raamovereenkomst.
For questions about participating organisations or municipalities and their motives, I refer you to the organisations named.
Voor vragen over deelnemende organisaties of gemeenten en hun beweegredenen verwijs ik u naar de genoemde organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de handhaving van het aantal vliegbewegingen op Schiphol

MP Van Raan asks the minister how the ILT rejects enforcement requests against exceeding Schiphol's flight-movement cap, whether the minister knew of the letter sent in her name, and how this fits her earlier statement that enforcement takes place. The minister explains that the Wet luchtvaart gives the Inspector-General sole enforcement power, that the 500,000 cap is not in the regulations, and that enforcement against the cap is not currently applied, only anticipatory enforcement on noise limits.
Within the ILT it is determined whether there is an exceedance and whether a measure must be imposed.
Binnen de ILT wordt bepaald of er al dan niet sprake is van een overschrijding en of er een maatregel moet worden opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de financiering van een kolencentrale in de Dominicaanse Republiek

An MP from the Partij voor de Dieren asks the government about ING's financing of the Punta Catalina coal plant in the Dominican Republic, including corruption concerns linked to Odebrecht and whether ING's coal policy and IMVO convenant apply. The government answers that ING bears its own responsibility, that existing financing commitments predate its 2015 policy, that due diligence is for ING to conduct, and that it sees no need to talk to ING's CEO.
It is the bank's own responsibility to set an appropriate sustainability policy and to account for it.
Het is de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van een bank om een passend duurzaamheidsbeleid vast te stellen en daarover verantwoording af te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over berichten in de media die het rapport “Veiligheid Vliegverkeer Schiphol” van de Onderzoeksraad voor de veiligheid (OVV) bevestigen

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about media reports confirming an OVV report on Schiphol flight safety, including air traffic controllers' warnings, bird strike risks near new Lelystad routes, and the role of the Alderstafel. The minister answered that the safety of operations is not at issue, pointed to internal LVNL matters, defended the routes and the planned environmental assessment, and said growth beyond 500,000 movements would first be analysed and advised on by the ORS.
The safety of the operation is not at issue, see the answers to questions 3 and 5.
De veiligheid van de operatie is niet in geding, zie daartoe de antwoorden op de vragen 3 en 5.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Kwint, Van den Hul en Van Raan over het bericht 'Steeds meer kinderen in 'plofklassen''

MPs from GroenLinks, SP, PvdA and PvdA-adjacent PvdD asked the ministers about reports that more children are in large classes, with questions on class size trends, staffing ratios, teacher workload and passend onderwijs. The minister answered that large-class shares fell in 2017, gave statistics across primary and secondary education, and said no binding class-size targets or sector-wide agreements would be made.
The share of large classes has fallen over the past year.
Het aandeel grote klassen is het afgelopen jaar gedaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het artikel “Zo maken we het basisinkomen werkelijkheid"

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a basic income or basic security, as proposed in an article, has been examined in parliament, whether the Participatiewet blocks such experiments, and whether municipalities may experiment. The minister answered that a basic income is incompatible with the Participatiewet's work principle, that no municipality has applied for such an experiment, and that the cabinet refuses to allow them.
A basic security or basic income therefore cannot exist alongside the Participatiewet and cannot be seen separately from the Participatiewet.
Een basiszekerheid of basisinkomen kan daarom niet naast de Participatiewet bestaan en niet los gezien worden van de Participatiewet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de indringende brief van 15.373 (klimaat)wetenschappers over de toestand van de aarde

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the 2017 World Scientists' Warning to Humanity and whether the government shares its concerns on climate, deforestation, meat production and the sixth mass extinction. The minister acknowledges the letter, points to the Montreal Protocol and Paris Agreement as frameworks, says Dutch climate policy stays ambitious without rethinking Dutch positions, and prefers technical over volume-limiting measures for livestock emissions.
It is important that countries now also deliver.
Het is wel zaak dat landen nu ook gaan leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het nieuws dat inwoners van Warmenhuizen al 25 jaar op sterk vervuilde bodem leven

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that residents of Warmenhuizen have lived on heavily contaminated soil for 25 years, asking how authorities missed it, whether laws are deficient, whether other sites are unnoticed, and whether RIVM should study health links. The state secretary answered that the site was remediated and deemed suitable for housing, that a new study found no unacceptable risks, that existing law gives authorities adequate tools, and that no new national inventory or RIVM study is currently warranted.
I currently see no reason to carry out a further inventory of contamination.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om een nadere inventarisatie naar verontreinigingen te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat de financiële sector vervuilers kan aanpakken

An MP asked whether a new CO2 footprint model for financial portfolios improves public transparency on sustainability and whether the sector should be bound by enforceable climate targets. The minister welcomed the model as increasing transparency, said a Climate Act is being explored and that the EU expert group will report in spring 2018, but noted the model covers only CO2, not broader environmental or social aspects.
I welcome the methodology developed by twelve Dutch financial institutions to map the CO2 footprint of the portfolio(s) of individual institutions.
Ik verwelkom de methodiek die door twaalf Nederlandse financiële instellingen is ontwikkeld om de CO 2 -voetafdruk van de portefeuille(s) van individuele instellingen in kaart te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin en Van Raan over het MAA-besluit

MPs Kröger, Laçin and Van Raan asked the minister about the Maastricht Aachen Airport (MAA) decision to allow more cargo flights, including the effects on residents, noise and air quality, compensation for planning damage, and whether residents were misled about flight numbers and should get a new objection period. The minister answered that the corrected noise inputs will be assessed in an amended procedure with a new m.e.r. notice and a draft amendment placed before parliament, that damage claims will be handled under the existing compensation policy, and that residents were correctly informed about annual flight numbers, so no new objection period is planned.
Yes, I am willing to do so.
Ja, daar ben ik toe bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het artikel dat Nederland nog altijd dwarsligt bij de EU-aanpak van belastingontwijking

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that the Netherlands obstructs EU efforts against tax avoidance and why it is absent from the EU list of non-cooperative jurisdictions, including whether Dutch tax practices should be tested against the same criteria. The Secretary of State replied that the Netherlands meets all EU standards, that external testing is unnecessary, and that the government will set out its broader anti-avoidance approach and countermeasures in a letter in February 2018.
The Netherlands does not belong on the EU list of non-cooperative jurisdictions, because the Netherlands meets all EU standards within the framework of the EU list.
Nederland hoort niet thuis op de EU-lijst van non-coöperatieve jurisdicties, omdat Nederland voldoet aan alle EU-standaarden in het kader van de EU-lijst
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over onderzoek waaruit blijkt dat de groeiende luchtvaart het halen van klimaatdoelstellingen onmogelijk maakt

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the minister whether research showing aviation growth makes Paris climate targets unattainable is accepted, and whether plans for more flights at Schiphol and Lelystad Airport are responsible. The minister acknowledged the research, said the government will pursue global and EU measures and a forthcoming aviation policy note will address flight growth, but declined to draw conclusions in advance.
Next year I will prepare a new aviation policy note, in which I will set out my vision on the development of aviation for the coming decades.
Komend jaar zal ik een nieuwe luchtvaartnota opstellen, waarin ik mijn visie op de ontwikkeling van de luchtvaart voor de komende tientallen jaren zal formuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het rapport Breaking the Barriers to the Circular Economy

An MP asked the state secretary about the report 'Breaking the Barriers to the Circular Economy', including low virgin-material prices, consumer knowledge and behaviour change, and how the Grondstoffenakkoord reduces total material use. The state secretary said the bottlenecks are taken seriously, pointed to forthcoming transition agendas, a monitoring system and annual progress reports, and described government circular procurement efforts.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het verhogen van de CO2-reductiedoelstelling naar 55%

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate how the EU 2030 CO2 target would be raised to 55%, what concrete steps, timelines and allies he has, and whether stronger measures such as livestock volume limits and a ban on oil and gas production should be adopted. The minister answered that raising the target requires EU unanimity, will be pursued with like-minded states toward 2020, rejects livestock volume limits in favour of technical measures and does not consider a fossil fuel ban desirable now, while promising a Climate Act and a Climate and Energy Agreement with a letter to parliament on short notice.
On the process and planning of both the Climate Act and the Climate and Energy Agreement, I will inform your House in a letter at very short notice.
Over het proces en de planning van zowel de Klimaatwet als (de totstandkoming van) het Klimaat- en energieakkoord zal ik uw Tweede Kamer op zeer korte termijn per brief nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het UNEP Emissions Gap Report en het Fourth National Climate Assessment van het USGCRP

The MP asks whether the minister knows of the UNEP Emissions Gap Report 2017 and the US Fourth National Climate Assessment showing Paris targets are extremely unlikely, and what Dutch policy will be on further emission cuts, coal plant closure costs, emission reduction tables and the INEK planning. The minister confirms awareness, says Dutch ambition of 49% (possibly 55%) by 2030 is in line with Paris, declines to plan coal closures before 2018 as not relevant, and says tables and the INEK timeline depend on pending work and negotiations.
I am aware of those reports.
Ik ben bekend met die rapporten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Van Raan en Kröger over de Jonge Klimaatagenda

Three MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the Young Climate Agenda, including how young people can be involved in climate policy and how its themes of work and education will be reflected in implementation. The minister acknowledged youth's importance, pointed to past support for youth participation and a Climate Envoy, and said work and education themes will be explored in coming months, including via a forthcoming SER advisory report.

In the coming months I will, together with relevant cabinet colleagues and in consultation with social partners and education, examine how these themes can be incorporated into the further elaboration of the plans.

In de komende maanden zal ik in samenwerking met de relevante collega’s uit het kabinet en in overleg met sociale partners en het onderwijs, bezien op welke wijze deze thema’s kunnen worden meegenomen in de verdere uitwerking van de plannen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de concentratie van broeikasgassen in de atmosfeer

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about rising atmospheric greenhouse gas concentrations and a PBL analysis showing the coalition agreement brings only half of the climate targets within reach, asking whether the government's plan is adequate and whether it will act decisively. The minister acknowledged the reports, argued Dutch emissions are on track for a 23% reduction by 2020 and that the 2030 49% target is the government's goal, promising a Climate Act and a Climate and Energy Agreement, while stating not all 2030 reductions will occur within this term.
we will set in motion measures in the coming period that prepare the Netherlands for a 49% reduction in 2030
we zullen de komende periode maatregelen in gang zetten die Nederland voorbereiden op een reductie van 49% in 2030
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Raan over het bericht dat olie- en gasbedrijven het Nederlandse onderwijs beïnvloeden

MPs Kwint and Van Raan asked the Minister of Education whether oil and gas companies influence Dutch schools, citing a report on fossil-industry teaching materials, and whether such materials should be banned. The Minister saw no reason to believe pupils are targeted, said schools are responsible for choosing materials, and refused a ban because the teaching materials market is free.
I have no reason whatsoever to assume that pupils are being 'bombarded' by oil and gas companies with arguments 'from the fossil industry'.
Ik heb daarbij geen enkele aanleiding om te veronderstellen dat leerlingen door olie- en gasbedrijven «worden bestookt» met argumenten «van de fossiele industrie».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Van Raan en Van der Lee over de APA-/ATR-praktijk

MPs Leijten, Van Raan and Van der Lee asked the State Secretary of Finance how the critical assumption in informal capital rulings (that a complete and accurate picture is given to foreign tax authorities) can be met without proactive disclosure, how compliance is checked, and about exchange of information, the Belgian state aid case, the 1986-1995 suspension, hybrid entities and the value involved. The State Secretary answered that non-compliance (failure to provide information on request) ends the APA/ATR, that 19 ATRs and 40 APAs were checked in 2016 leading to three ATR terminations, and that the government does not track the total value of informal capital rulings.
Since the introduction of the APA/ATR practice, the number of rulings with an informal capital element has not been systematically recorded when registering requested and granted APAs.
Sinds de invoering van de APA-/ATR-praktijk is bij het registeren van aangevraagde en toegewezen APA’s het aantal rulings met een informeel kapitaalelement niet systematisch bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de uitspraak in de rechtszaak van Milieudefensie rechtszaak

An MP asks the State Secretary about a court ruling against the state on air quality, whether the government will accelerate measures, whether enforcement gaps exist between municipalities, provinces and the state, and whether stricter national air quality norms will be set. The State Secretary rejects the claim of a enforcement vacuum, promises to inform parliament in November on accelerated measures and says a new air quality plan will be drawn up in 2017-2018 without committing to stricter national norms.
At the beginning of November I will inform your House further.
Begin november zal ik uw Kamer nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de gevolgen van de uitspraak in de rechtszaak van Milieudefensie

An MP asked the state secretary what the court ruling in the Milieudefensie case means for numerous road, airport and infrastructure projects (A2, A16, A27, Rotterdamsebaan, Blankenburgtunnel, Schiphol, RTHA, biomass plant), whether they can proceed, and why projects were exempt from air quality limits under the NSL. The secretary answered that the ruling is addressed to the State, that projects are assessed under current law and the NSL, that statistical exceedance tests will be developed with RIVM, and that the NSL remains usable despite the court's view.

In the ruling the judge additionally prohibited the State from taking measures which, in RIVM's view, are statistically expected to lead to continued or renewed exceedance of the PM10 and NO2 limit values.

In het vonnis heeft de rechter de Staat daarenboven verboden maatregelen te treffen waarvan in de visie van het RIVM statistisch verwacht moet worden dat deze tot voortgaande dan wel hernieuwde overschrijding van de grenswaarden PM 10 en NO 2 zullen leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de gevolgen van de uitspraak in de Milieudefensie rechtszaak

The MP Van Raan asks the State Secretary how the Milieudefensie air-quality ruling affects annual averages, hourly limits, enforcement, monitoring outside RIVM stations, and planned infrastructure and livestock projects. The State Secretary answers that hourly limits also apply, that rolling annual averages are rejected, that the ruling is being implemented via statistical exceedance probabilities and a map of locations, and that many projects are for decentralised authorities to decide.
I have sent you this overview by letter (TK 30 175 no. 256).
Dit overzicht heb ik u per brief toegestuurd (TK 30 175 nr. 256 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over administratieve rompslomp bij de import van elektrische auto’s

An MP asked whether Chinese low-speed electric vehicles face extra RDW inspection in the Netherlands unlike in other EU states, and whether the registration procedure is unnecessarily burdensome. The minister answered that vehicles with EU type approval and a CoC are registered without extra technical testing, that the procedure is comparable to other member states, and that stimulating light electric vehicles is part of existing policy.
There is therefore a level playing field.
Er is dus sprake van een gelijk speelveld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over zwerfafval

An MP asked the state secretary about litter on roads and waterways, RWS's lack of documentation and cost figures for litter removal, contract standards for litter, and whether producers should pay litter-removal levies. The state secretary answered that RWS relies on performance contracts with frequency left to contractors, cannot separate litter costs from other maintenance costs, is developing a litter framework, and will inform parliament further on possible levies.
Because various activities are bundled in the individual performance contracts, it is no longer possible to determine afterwards what RWS's annual costs were for litter-specific activities.

Door de bundeling van verschillende werkzaamheden in de afzonderlijke prestatiecontracten is het niet meer mogelijk om achteraf te bepalen wat voor RWS de jaarlijkse kosten waren voor specifiek zwerfafvalgerelateerde werkzaamheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Beckerman over het mogelijk steunen van de fossiele sector door middel van exportkredietverzekeringen, in dit geval Boskalis en van Oord

MPs Van Raan and Beckerman asked whether Dutch export credit insurance (Atradius DSB) would support Boskalis and Van Oord's role in the Nord Stream 2 pipeline and whether this conflicts with Paris climate goals. The government answered that a non-binding letter of interest was issued, that each application will undergo an environmental and social assessment, and that it sees no reason to exclude oil and gas projects from export credit insurance, while stating the political debate falls outside the scope of the export credit framework.
When assessing any applications, political and financial risks will be examined and an assessment of environmental and social impacts will be carried out.
Bij de beoordeling van eventuele aanvragen zal naar de politieke en financiële risico's worden gekeken en zal een beoordeling van de milieu en sociale gevolgen worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Beckerman over het steunen van de fossiele sector door middel van exportkredietverzekeringen

MPs Van Raan and Beckerman asked whether Dutch export credit insurance (EKV) support for fossil-fuel-related projects conflicts with the Paris Agreement, and asked about a phase-out plan, disclosure, coal and fossil exclusion lists and related OECD and fund matters. The Secretary of State answered that EKV is a generic, demand-driven instrument, that no phase-out plan is being prepared, that information disclosure and CSR policy are being developed, and that the government still supports ending public finance for new coal plants abroad but rejects an oil and gas exclusion list.
As described in the answer to question 2, no such plan is being worked on.
Zoals in het antwoord op vraag 2 beschreven wordt er niet gewerkt aan een dergelijk plan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het nieuws dat grote industrieën verdienen aan het ETS

An MP asked whether large industries profiting from surplus free EU ETS emission allowances is undesirable, and whether the ETS should be abolished or strengthened. The State Secretary acknowledged early free allocation was too generous, defended the ETS as a cost-effective instrument, and said she supports strengthening rather than abolishing it.
I am not in favour of abolishing the ETS. On the contrary, I am committed to strengthening the ETS, as in principle it is a good instrument for cost-effectively steering CO2 reduction.
Ik ben geen voorstander van afschaffing van het ETS. Ik zet me juist in voor versterking van het ETS, aangezien het in beginsel een goed instrument is om kosteneffectief te sturen op CO 2 -reductie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over zwerfafval

Van Raan (PvdD) asked the State Secretary about the CE Delft study on deposit schemes for small bottles and cans, challenging the independence of the study and the credibility of industry critics. The State Secretary defended the study's independence and quality, and said policy decisions on packaging will follow the completion of ongoing evaluations, with an update expected by end 2017.
I expect to be able to inform you by the end of 2017 about the next steps in the packaging dossier.
Ik verwacht u eind 2017 te kunnen informeren over de vervolgstappen in het verpakkingendossier.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de stijging van CO2-uitstoot in 2016

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked whether the 2020 CO2 reduction target (25% versus 1990), upheld by the court, is still achievable given a 1% rise in 2016 and a reduction of only 11% so far, and how the remaining 14% will be achieved year by year. The government denies the target is out of reach, says the Energy Agreement should close the remaining 4 Mton gap and that the NEV 2017 will be used to check course, with additional measures if needed.
At the NEV 2017 it will be examined whether we are still on track to implement the Urgenda judgment.
Bij de NEV 2017 zal worden bezien of we nog op koers liggen om uitvoering te geven aan het Urgenda-vonnis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de risico's en de gevolgen van het ECB-opkoopprogramma

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Finance Minister about risks of the ECB bond-buying programme, including its effects on inflation, asset prices, distribution and democratic control, and the pending German constitutional referral to the European Court. The minister answers that the ECB is independent, that effects are hard to quantify, that macroprudential measures address housing and financial stability risks, and declines to speculate on the court ruling.
The independence of the ECB is laid down in the EU Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (Article 130).
De onafhankelijkheid van de ECB is in het EU-Werkingsverdrag (artikel 130) vastgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de haalbaarheid van de emissiereductie van broeikasgassen van 25% in 2020

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked whether the CE Delft finding that the 25% greenhouse gas reduction target for 2020 (Urgenda ruling) is very likely unattainable with current policy is accepted, and how the 2017 projection handles the uncertainties (wind onshore, CCS ROAD, electricity imports) and what will be done if the analysis proves right. The Secretary of State disagrees, saying the Energy Agreement targets should close the remaining 4 Mton gap, that ROAD is no longer counted after withdrawal, and that the NEV 2017 will be reviewed with additional measures such as closing a coal plant if needed.
With the NEV 2017 it will be examined whether we are still on course to implement the Urgenda ruling.
Bij de NEV 2017 zal worden bezien of we nog op koers liggen om uitvoering te geven aan het Urgenda-vonnis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de banden tussen het onderwijs en de fossiele brandstofindustrie

An MP asks the Education Minister about ties between schools and fossil fuel companies, including misleading classroom materials, sponsorship rules, and curriculum involvement. The government says schools are responsible for their own partnerships and materials, the sponsorship covenant is adequate, and it will evaluate the covenant in 2018 but does not intend to ban fossil fuel firms from schools.
It is not for us to assess whether teaching material conflicts with the covenant.
Het is niet aan ons om te beoordelen of lesmateriaal in strijd is met het convenant.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Raan over de APA-/ATR-praktijk

MPs Leijten and Van Raan ask the State Secretary of Finance about the APA/ATR practice, including informal capital rulings, hybrid entities, financing and royalty activities, and re-invoicing. The State Secretary answers that the EU anti-tax-avoidance directives leave the informal capital doctrine intact but reduce risk through information exchange, and that the Tax Authority now tracks informal capital rulings and exchanges information on them.
From 1 July 2017 it will be explicitly recorded how many informal capital rulings are concluded.
Vanaf 1 juli 2017 wordt expliciet bijgehouden hoeveel informeel kapitaalrulings er worden gesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat de Panama Papers in bezit zijn van de Duitse federale recherche (het Bundeskriminalamt (BKA))

An MP asked whether the Netherlands could obtain a copy or purchase of the Panama Papers data held by the German Federal Criminal Police (BKA), and what to do if not. The state secretary confirmed contact with the BKA, which has said it will share Dutch-relevant data, with conditions still under review.
Yes, official consultation has meanwhile taken place with the BKA to obtain the information relevant to the Netherlands.
Ja, inmiddels heeft ambtelijk overleg plaatsgevonden met het BKA om de voor Nederland relevante informatie in bezit te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Karabulut, Van Raan, De Roon en Van der Staaij over de confiscaties door Turkse overheid van Aramese kerken en kerkbezittingen

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey's transfer of over 50 Aramaic churches and monasteries to the Diyanet amounts to confiscation, and whether the Netherlands would seek clarification and urge EU partners to respond. The minister said the transfers stem from administrative reorganisation under Turkish law, that Diyanet denied receiving property and Mardin confirmed this, but that the Aramaic community has lost property it used for over a thousand years; the embassy will raise minority rights and a field visit with EU partners is planned.
The Netherlands will continue to raise the rights of religious minorities in Turkey with the authorities.
Nederland zal de rechten van religieuze minderheden in Turkije bij de autoriteiten blijven aankaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Hijink, Ouwehand en Van Raan over het steunen van de fossiele sector dmv exportkredietverzekeringen

MPs from the SP and PvdD asked whether Dutch export credit insurance (ekv) substantially supports the fossil fuel sector, including the reported €7.3 billion Atradius DSB exposure, and whether it should be tightened to align with Paris goals. The State Secretary answered that the ekv is generic and demand-driven with no fossil-specific policy, that it is cost-covering, that about 39% of the portfolio (€6.4 billion) is fossil-related, that oil and gas transactions undergo environmental and social due diligence, and that he will not explicitly phase out support for non-Paris-aligned projects while promoting renewable and climate-related export cover.
There is no policy to support the fossil fuel sector in particular.
Er is geen beleid om de fossiele sector in het bijzonder te ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Arissen over de vorming van de ‘Stichting Aanmoedigingsfonds van de Koninklijke Facultatieve’

MPs Van Raan and Arissen asked whether a cremation association's transfer of about 17 million euros to a charitable foundation run by the same board was proper, and whether independent investigation, prosecutorial action or a supervisory protocol is warranted. The government declined to assess the facts, saying private associations are outside its remit, pointed to members' civil-law remedies and to the pending bill on governance of legal entities, and refused to instruct the prosecutor.
The cabinet has no involvement in the ownership and business transactions of individual private companies and organisations.
Het kabinet heeft geen bemoeienis met het eigenaarschap en de zakelijke transacties van afzonderlijke private ondernemingen en organisaties.

m: Motie van het lid Van Nispen c.s. over voorstellen om justitiële dwalingen makkelijker te kunnen herstellen
Asks the government to bring forward proposals making it easier to reopen closed criminal cases and remedy judicial errors, and to inform the House.
requests the government to come with proposals to make it easier to remedy judicial errors
verzoekt de regering, met voorstellen te komen om het makkelijker te maken om justitiële dwalingen te herstellen
Motie van het lid Bontes over een grondige hervorming van het EHRM en het EVRM
Asks the government to push for a thorough reform of the European Court of Human Rights and the European Convention on Human Rights.
requests the government to push for a thorough reform of the ECHR and the ECHR convention
verzoekt de regering ... in te zetten op een grondige hervorming van het EHRM en het EVRM
Motie van het lid Bontes over het stopzetten van de subsidie voor het meldpunt internet discriminatie
Asks the government to stop the subsidy to the internet discrimination reporting office MiND.
requests the government to stop the subsidy of MiND
verzoekt de regering, de subsidie van het MiND stop te zetten
Motie van het lid Bontes over het intrekken van het Nederlanderschap in het geval van zware misdrijven
Asks the government to work towards allowing revocation of Dutch nationality for other serious crimes beyond terrorism.
asks the government to work towards a situation in which other serious crimes can also lead to revocation of Dutch nationality.
verzoekt de regering, toe te werken naar een situatie waarbij ook andere zware misdrijven kunnen leiden tot het intrekken van het Nederlanderschap
Motie van het lid Bontes over zo snel mogelijk beëindigen van de subsidiëring van het Volksfront voor de Bevrijding van Palestina
Asks the government to end as soon as possible indirect subsidies flowing to the PFLP via affiliated organisations.
as soon as possible to end this subsidisation
zo snel mogelijk een einde te maken aan deze subsidiëring
Motie van het lid Bontes over definitieve beëindiging van de EU-toetredingsonderhandelingen met Turkije
Asks the government to work in the EU for definitive termination of Turkey's EU accession negotiations, citing the arrests and the abolition of the rule of law there.
requests the government to work at EU level to definitively end the EU accession negotiations with Turkey
verzoekt de regering, zich in Europees verband in te zetten om de EU-toetredingsonderhandelingen met Turkije definitief te beëindigen
Motie van het lid Voordewind c.s. over een rapport over het gebruik van de term genocide door politici
Asks the government to seek advice from the external international law adviser and the advisory committee CAVV on a joint report about politicians' use of the term genocide.
requests the government to seek advice from the External International Law Adviser (EVA) and the Advisory Committee on International Legal Issues (CAVV)
verzoekt de regering, advies in te winnen bij de Extern Volkenrechtelijk Adviseur (EVA) en de Commissie van advies inzake volkenrechtelijke vraagstukken (CAVV)
Motie van het lid Bontes over een stappenplan voor de stijging van het Defensiebudget naar 2% van het bbp
Asks the government to send parliament a step-by-step plan justifying raising defence spending to 2% of GDP before the March 2017 elections.
requests the government, before the March 2017 elections, to send the House a step-by-step plan substantiating the rise of the defence budget to 2% of GDP
verzoekt de regering, nog vóór de verkiezingen in maart 2017 de Kamer een stappenplan te sturen waarin de stijging van het Defensiebudget naar 2% van het bbp wordt onderbouwd
Motie van het lid Bontes over grondwettelijke toetsing van de voorstellen van de werkgroep Fractievorming door de Raad van State
Asks the Chamber to have the Raad van State constitutionally review the faction-formation proposals before amending the rules on split-off MPs.
requests the Chamber to first have these proposals constitutionally reviewed by the Council of State
verzoekt de Kamer, deze voorstellen eerst grondwettelijk te laten toetsen door de Raad van State
Motie van het lid Bontes over niet tornen aan de rechten van Tweede Kamerleden
Motion asks the House not to tamper with the rights of Tweede Kamer members in the faction-formation proposals.
not to tamper with the rights of Tweede Kamer members
niet te tornen aan de rechten van Tweede Kamerleden
Motie van het lid Bontes over garanderen dat een Nederlandse columniste niet aan Turkije wordt uitgeleverd
Asks the government to guarantee that the Dutch columnist Ebru Umar will not be extradited to Turkey.
requests the government to guarantee that Ebru Umar is not extradited to Turkey
verzoekt de regering, te garanderen dat Ebru Umar niet wordt uitgeleverd aan Turkije
Motie van het lid Bontes over een negatief reisadvies voor heel Turkije
Motion asking government to issue a negative travel advisory for all of Turkey because critics of the Turkish president may be arrested.
requests the government to issue a negative travel advice for all of Turkey
verzoekt de regering, een negatief reisadvies in te stellen voor heel Turkije
Motie van het lid Tellegen c.s. over het opstellen van een lijst van haatpredikers van binnen de EU
Motion asking the government to draw up a list of hate preachers from within the EU.
Requests the government to work on tackling hate preachers from within the EU by drawing up a list.
verzoekt de regering, werk te maken van de aanpak van haatpredikers van binnen de EU door een lijst op te stellen
Motie van het lid Tellegen c.s. over sanctioneren van organisaties die haatpredikers uitnodigen en/of een podium bieden
Motion asking the government to enable sanctions against organisations that invite or give a platform to hate preachers.
requests the government to make it possible that organisations and institutions that invite hate preachers can be sanctioned
verzoekt de regering, het mogelijk te maken dat organisaties en instellingen die haatpredikers uitnodigen en/of een podium bieden gesanctioneerd kunnen worden
Motie van het lid Bontes over het fors verlagen van de Mulderboetes
Asks the government to sharply lower Mulder traffic fines following a court ruling that they were unlawfully inflated.
requests the government, in view of this court ruling, to sharply lower the relevant traffic fines
verzoekt de regering, gezien deze rechterlijke uitspraak de betreffende verkeersboetes fors te verlagen
Motie van het lid Bontes over stoppen met de reorganisatie van de Nationale Politie
Asks the government to stop the current reorganisation of the National Police, except for three quick wins in ICT, procurement and work processes.
requests the government to stop the current reorganisation of the National Police, except for three quick wins
verzoekt de regering, te stoppen met de huidige reorganisatie van de Nationale Politie, met uitzondering van drie quick wins
Motie van het lid Bontes over zwaardere bewapening voor politie en Koninklijke Marechaussee
Asks the government to arm the police and the Royal Marechaussee more heavily and allow them to carry service weapons off duty.
requests the government to arm the police and the Royal Marechaussee more heavily
verzoekt de regering, de politie en de Koninklijke Marechaussee zwaarder te bewapenen
Motie van het lid Bontes over rechtshulpverzoeken aan Turkije inzake de kwestie-Demmink
Asks the government to put more pressure on Turkey to execute outstanding legal assistance requests in the Demmink case.
requests the government to put more pressure on Turkey to carry out the legal assistance requests in the Demmink affair
verzoekt de regering, meer druk te zetten op Turkije om de rechtshulpverzoeken inzake de kwestie-Demmink uit te voeren
Motie van het lid Bontes over afstand nemen van het opengrenzenbeleid van Merkel
Asks the government, as EU presidency holder, to firmly distance itself from Chancellor Merkel's open-borders policy.
requests the government, in its role as presidency, to firmly distance itself from the open-borders policy of German Chancellor Merkel
verzoekt de regering, in deze rol als voorzitter krachtig afstand te nemen van het opengrenzenbeleid van de Duitse bondskanselier Merkel
Motie van het lid Bontes over uitbreiding van de militaire inzet naar Syrië
Asks the government to expand military action against IS into Syria and to free up funds for it.
requests the government to expand the military deployment against IS to Syria as quickly as possible
verzoekt de regering, zo snel mogelijk de militaire inzet tegen IS uit te breiden naar Syrië
Motie van het lid Eijsink c.s. over oriëntatie op de voordelen van meerjarige defensieplannen
States that the House will explore whether multi-year defence plans could offer benefits in the Dutch context.
states that the House will explore whether multi-year defence plans could have benefits in the Dutch context
spreekt uit dat de Kamer zich gaat oriënteren of meerjarige defensieplannen ook in de Nederlandse context mogelijke voordelen kunnen hebben
Motie van het lid Bontes over het Defensiebudget jaarlijks met 1 miljard verhogen gedurende vijf jaar
Asks the government to raise the defence budget by €1 billion a year for five years.
requests the government to increase the defence budget by 1 billion euro annually over the next five years
verzoekt de regering, het defensiebudget de komende vijf jaar jaarlijks met 1 miljard euro te verhogen
Motie van het lid Bontes over niet langer financieren van de onderhoudskosten van De Groene Draeck
Asks the government to stop financing the maintenance costs of the royal yacht De Groene Draeck, which the main user should pay.
requests the government to no longer finance the maintenance costs of De Groene Draeck
verzoekt de regering, niet langer de onderhoudskosten van De Groene Draeck te financieren
Motie van het lid Bontes over een einde maken aan de fiscale voordelen van de leden van het Koninklijk Huis
Asks the government to prepare a constitutional amendment ending the generous tax advantages for members of the Royal House.
requests the government to draft a proposal to amend the Constitution to end the generous tax benefits for members of the Royal House
verzoekt de regering, een voorstel van wijziging van de Grondwet op te stellen om een einde te maken aan de royale fiscale voordelen
Motie van het lid Bontes over een parlementair onderzoek naar de ambtelijke top van het ministerie van V en J en het OM
Asks the presidium to set up a parliamentary inquiry into the functioning of the senior civil service at the Ministry of Justice and Security and the Public Prosecution Service.
requests the presidium to launch a parliamentary inquiry into the functioning of the senior civil service at the Ministry of Justice and Security and the Public Prosecution Service
verzoekt het presidium, een parlementair onderzoek in te stellen naar het functioneren van de ambtelijke top bij het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie en het Openbaar Ministerie
Motie van het lid Bontes over per direct stoppen van de beveiliging
Motion asking the government to immediately stop the state security protection of Volkert van der Graaf and never reinstate it.
requests the government to stop the protection of Volkert van der Graaf immediately and never reinstate it
verzoekt de regering, de beveiliging van Volkert van der Graaf per direct te stoppen en deze nimmer opnieuw in te stellen
Motie van het lid Bontes over de plaatsing van nieuwe Amerikaanse kruisraketten op Europees grondgebied
Asks the government not to oppose placing new American cruise missiles on European soil.
requests the government not to oppose placing new American cruise missiles on European territory
verzoekt de regering, niet afwijzend te staan tegenover de plaatsing van nieuwe Amerikaanse kruisraketten op Europees grondgebied
Motie van het lid Bontes over opzeggen van het vertrouwen in de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie
Motion expressing no confidence in the Minister of Security and Justice over police failures, unsolved crimes, jihadism and disaster protection.
expresses no confidence in the Minister of Security and Justice
zegt het vertrouwen op in de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie
Motie van het lid Van der Staaij c.s. over de EU oproepen zich te keren tegen het eenzijdig uitroepen van een Palestijnse staat
Asks the government to keep its policy line of urging the EU to oppose unilateral recognition of a Palestinian state and to press for negotiations.
requests the government to keep to the policy line from the Van der Staaij motion
verzoekt de regering, vast te houden aan de beleidslijn uit de motie-Van der Staaij
Motie van het lid Bontes over terugroepen van de Nederlandse ambassadeur uit Moskou
Motion asks the government to recall the Dutch ambassador from Moscow in response to Russian aggression and MH17 obstruction.
requests the government to recall the Dutch ambassador from Moscow
verzoekt de regering, de Nederlandse ambassadeur terug te roepen uit Moskou
Motie van het lid Hachchi c.s. over het aanstellen van een nieuwe, onafhankelijke taskforceleider
Asks the government to appoint a new, independent task force leader with no prior involvement in the gifverf (toxic paint) file to avoid any appearance of conflict of interest.
requests the government to appoint a new, independent task force leader who has had no prior involvement in the gifverf file
verzoekt de regering, een nieuwe, onafhankelijke taskforceleider aan te stellen die in het verleden geen betrokkenheid heeft gehad bij het gifverfdossier
Motie van het lid Bontes over het opnieuw in gebruik nemen van wapensystemen
