Asks the government to remove the CV90s, self-propelled howitzers, minehunters and remaining tanks from the sale list and put them back into military use.
requests the government to remove the CV90s, armoured howitzers, minehunters and remaining combat tanks from the sales list
verzoekt de regering om, de CV90's, pantserhouwitsers, mijnenjagers en resterende gevechtstanks van de verkooplijst te halen

Amendement van het lid Bontes over het overhevelen van middelen van Koninkrijksrelaties naar Defensie ten behoeve van ondersteuning van de Kustwacht in het Caribisch gebied en de regionale drugsbestri
Transfers funds from Kingdom Relations cooperation programmes to the Defence budget for coast guard support and regional drug interdiction.

This amendment aims to transfer funds from the cooperation programmes within the budget item Contributions to (inter)national organisations in the Kingdom Relations budget to the budget of the Ministry of Defence.

Dit amendement strekt ertoe middelen van de samenwerkingsprogramma's binnen de begrotingspost Bijdragen aan (inter)nationale organisaties op de begroting van Koninkrijksrelaties over te hevelen naar de begroting van het Ministerie van Defensie.

Amendement van het lid Bontes over het overhevelen van middelen van Koninkrijksrelaties naar Defensie ten behoeve van ondersteuning van de Kustwacht in het Caribisch gebied en de regionale drugsbestri
Transfers funds from the Kingdom Relations budget to the Defence budget to support the Coast Guard and regional drug interdiction in the Caribbean.
to transfer funds from the Kingdom Relations budget to the Ministry of Defence budget
om middelen over te hevelen van de begroting van Koninkrijksrelaties naar de begroting van het Ministerie van Defensie
Motie van het lid Bontes over fors verkleinen van de overheid
Motion asking the government to substantially reduce the size of the government because it spends more than it receives each year.
requests the government to substantially reduce the size of the government
verzoekt de regering, de omvang van de overheid fors te verkleinen
Motie van het lid Bontes over het invoeren van minimumstraffen voor financieel-economische criminaliteit
Asks the government to introduce minimum prison sentences for financial-economic crime.
requests the government to introduce minimum penalties for financial-economic crime
verzoekt de regering, minimumstraffen voor financieel-economische criminaliteit in te voeren
Motie van het lid Bontes over het benutten van alle juridische middelen om Volkert van der Graaf zijn volledige gevangenisstraf te laten uitzitten
Asks the government to urge the Public Prosecution Service to use all legal means to keep Volkert van der Graaf in prison for his full sentence.
to move the Public Prosecution Service to use all legal means to have Volkert van der Graaf serve his full eighteen-year prison sentence
het Openbaar Ministerie ertoe te bewegen alle juridische middelen te benutten om Volkert van der Graaf zijn volledige gevangenisstraf van achttien jaar uit te laten zitten
Motie van het lid Bontes over stijging van het percentage opgepakte en bestrafte criminelen
Asks the government to ensure the share of arrested and convicted criminals rises sharply from 1.8%.
requests the government to ensure that this percentage rises sharply
verzoekt de regering, ervoor te zorgen dat dit percentage fors gaat stijgen
Motie van het lid Bontes over Volkert van der Graaf
Asks the government to do everything possible to prevent conditional release of a specific prisoner whose sentence ends in 2020.
requests the government to go to the utmost lengths to prevent conditional release of Volkert van der Graaf
verzoekt de regering, tot het uiterste te gaan om een voorwaardelijke invrijheidsstelling van Volkert van der Graaf te voorkomen
Motie van het lid Bontes over toepassing van het volwassenenstrafrecht op minderjarigen
Asks the government to amend the Criminal Code so judges must always apply adult criminal law to minors convicted of serious violent or sexual offences.
the judge must always apply adult criminal law when a minor is convicted of a serious violent or sexual offence
de rechter altijd het volwassenstrafrecht moet toepassen indien een minderjarige wordt veroordeeld voor een ernstig gewelds- of zedendelict
Motie van de leden Bontes en Fritsma over een opt-out
Asks the government to use an opt-out so that the Netherlands keeps full control over asylum and immigration policy instead of European influence.
requests the government to ensure through an opt-out that the Netherlands gets full control of asylum and immigration policy
verzoekt de regering om, er middels een opt-out zorg voor te dragen dat Nederland het asiel- en immigratiebeleid volledig in eigen handen krijgt
Amendement van de leden Fritsma en Bontes over uitbreiding van de bevoegdheid tot doorzoeking van de woning van betrokken vreemdelingen
Extends police and immigration officers' power to search a foreigner's home without consent to cases where the foreigner was apprehended elsewhere, such as on the street, to establish identity.
also in cases where such a foreigner was stopped elsewhere than in the home, for example on the street, the home may be searched
ook in gevallen waarin een dergelijke vreemdeling op een andere plaats dan in de woning staande is gehouden, bijvoorbeeld op straat, kan worden overgegaan tot het doorzoeken van de woning
Motie Bontes over het verhogen van het aantal aangehouden verdachten
Motion asking the government to increase by 20% the number of arrested suspects for burglary, robbery and homicide by end 2014.
requests the government to increase by 20% the number of arrested suspects of burglaries, robberies and homicide by end 2014
verzoekt de regering, het aantal aangehouden verdachten van woninginbraken, overvallen op ouderen en supermarkten en van moord en doodslag voor eind 2014 met 20% te verhogen
Motie Bontes over geweld tegen agenten en andere functionarissen met een publieke taak
Asks the government to ensure that perpetrators of violence against police and public officials do not receive community service sentences.
requests the government to ensure that perpetrators of violence against police and public officials do not escape with a community service sentence
verzoekt de regering, ervoor te zorgen dat geweldplegers tegen agenten en andere functionarissen met een publieke taak niet wegkomen met een taakstraf
Amendement van de leden Bontes en Kooiman om de begroting van de nationale politie integraal onderdeel te laten zijn van de begroting van Veiligheid en Justite
Asks that the national police budget become a fully integral part of the Justice and Security ministry budget, requiring approval by both chambers, so parliament can amend it.
The contributions form an integral part of the ministry budget referred to in the first sentence and require approval of both chambers of the States General.
De bijdragen maken integraal deel uit van de begroting van het ministerie, bedoeld in de eerste volzin en behoeven goedkeuring van beide kamers der Staten-Generaal.
Amendement van het lid Bontes over het treffen van een vergelijkbare regeling voor leden van (toezichthoudende organen bij) Zbo's
Amendment extending the limit on supervisory positions held by executives to members of boards and supervisory bodies of independent administrative bodies (zbo's).
This amendment also aims to prevent conflicts of interest from holding multiple ancillary positions.
Dit amendement heeft tevens de strekking belangenverstrengeling door het bezitten van meerdere nevenfuncties te voorkomen.
Amendement van het lid Bontes dat beoogt een gelijksoortige regeling als de artikelen 297a en 297b te treffen voor verenigingen, cooperaties en onderlinge waarborgmaatschappijen
Extends the board-appointment restrictions on multiple supervisory roles to associations, cooperatives and mutual guarantee societies.
and to make a corresponding arrangement for associations, cooperatives and mutual guarantee companies
en een overeenkomstige regeling te treffen voor verenigingen, coöperaties en onderlinge waarborgmaatschappijen.
Amendement van het lid Bontes dat beoogt een beperking aan te brengen in het aantal toegestane toezichthoudende functies
Amendment limits supervisory board seats for commissioners and non-executive directors in companies to three, and one legal entity for combined roles.
the number of supervisory functions a commissioner or non-executive director may hold should be limited to a maximum of three
het aantal toezichthoudende functies dat een commissaris of niet-uitvoerend bestuurder mag vervullen gelimiteerd moet worden tot een maximum van drie
Amendement van het lid Bontes over het niet verlengen van de adviestermijn voor het Bureau Bibob
Proposes keeping the Bureau BIBOB advice period at four weeks rather than extending it to eight weeks.
that the advice period within which the Bureau BIBOB must advise is not extended.
dat de adviestermijn waarbinnen het Bureau BIBOB moet adviseren niet wordt verlengd
Amendement van het lid Bontes over het aanpakken van de problematiek omtrent huisjesmelkers via de wet Bibob

Lets mayors and aldermen refuse or withdraw housing permits on Bibob integrity grounds, with an optional advisory request to the Bureau Bevordering Integriteitsbeoordelingen, widening local executive discretion.
Mayor and aldermen may refuse the housing permit, deviating from articles 25(1) and 26(1)
Burgemeester en wethouders kunnen in afwijking van de artikelen 25, eerste lid, en 26, eerste lid, de huisvestingsvergunning weigeren
Motie-Bontes over een eenduidige werkwijze van gemeenten
Asks the government to develop model policy with indicators for when municipalities should apply the Bibob integrity screening law, for uniform practice.
requests the government to come up with model policy with indicators
verzoekt de regering om met modelbeleid te komen met daarin indicatoren
Motie Bontes over een wettelijk beschermde titel
Asks the government to give debt collection agencies a legally protected title or a statutory quality mark to protect debtors.
requests the government to give debt collection agencies a legally protected title or introduce a statutory quality mark for them
verzoekt de regering om incassobureaus een wettelijk beschermde titel te geven dan wel een wettelijk keurmerk voor incassobureaus in te voeren
Motie Van der Burg en Bontes over verbreding van de meldplicht
Motion asks government to extend the mandatory reporting duty for child abuse by professionals to the education sector beyond sexual offences.
requests the government to broaden the child abuse reporting duty for professionals in the education sector
verzoekt de regering de meldplicht kindermishandeling gepleegd door professionals in de sector onderwijs te verbreden

Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Bontes en Van der Burg ter vervanging van nr. 13 over het tegengaan van de uitbreiding van de gronden voor gezagsbeëindiging naar kinderen met relatief lichte problem
Adds the word 'ernstig' (serious) to the grounds for ending parental authority, so that the grounds do not extend to milder cases.
In article I, part J, article 266, first paragraph, under a, the word 'serious' is inserted after 'in his development'.
In artikel I, onderdeel J, wordt in artikel 266, eerste lid, onder a, na «in zijn ontwikkeling» ingevoegd: ernstig.

Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Van der Burg en Bontes ter vervanging van nr. 12 over het tegengaan van de uitbreiding van de gronden voor voogdijbeëindiging naar kinderen met relatief lichte proble
Adds the word serious as a condition for ending guardianship and parental authority, narrowing the group of children subject to state intervention.
the grounds for ending parental authority and guardianship should therefore also be adjusted by adding the word serious
dienen derhalve ook de gronden van gezags- en voogdijbeëindiging aangepast te worden door toevoeging van het woord «ernstig»
Amendement van de leden Bontes en Van der Burg ter vervanging van nr. 11 over het tegengaan van de uitbreiding van de gronden voor gezagsbeëindiging naar kinderen met relatief lichte problemen
Replaces an earlier amendment so that grounds for ending parental authority require the child's developmental problems to be serious, preventing extension to milder cases.
In article I, part H, the word 'serious' is inserted after 'in his development' in article 266(1)(a).
In artikel I, onderdeel H, wordt in artikel 266, eerste lid, onder a, na «in zijn ontwikkeling» ingevoegd: ernstig.
Amendement van de leden Van der Burg en Bontes over het tegengaan van de uitbreiding van de gronden voor gezagsbeëindiging naar kinderen met relatief lichte problemen
Adds the word 'ernstig' (serious) to the grounds for ending parental authority and guardianship, so that they match the narrower child-protection ground and do not extend to milder cases.
Amendement van de leden Van der Burg en Bontes over het tegengaan van de uitbreiding van de gronden voor voogdijbeëindiging naar kinderen met relatief lichte problemen
Amendment adding the word 'serious' to the grounds for ending guardianship and parental authority, so lighter cases do not widen state child-protection intervention.
To prevent widening the target group and stay aligned with the OTS ground, the grounds for ending parental authority and guardianship should be amended by adding the word 'serious'.

Om de uitbreiding van de doelgroep te voorkomen en te blijven aansluiten bij de grond van OTS dienen derhalve ook de gronden van gezags- en voogdijbeëindiging aangepast te worden door toevoeging van het woord «ernstige».
Amendement van de leden Van der Burg en Bontes over het tegengaan van de uitbreiding van de werking van OTS naar kinderen met relatief lichte problemen
Adds the word 'ernstige' so that a child protection supervision order (OTS) requires a serious threat to development, limiting state intervention in family life.
In article I, part H, article 255, first paragraph, the word 'serious' is inserted after 'in his development'.
In artikel I, onderdeel H, wordt in artikel 255, eerste lid, aanhef, na «in zijn ontwikkeling» ingevoegd: ernstig.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de Turkse regering die campagne voert in Nederland

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government would act against Turkish ministers campaigning in the Netherlands, including by pressing the Turkish government and preventing municipalities from hosting such events, as Germany had done. The answer refers to a separate letter to the House on the campaign visits and the events around 11 March 2017, rather than answering the questions on substance.
The written questions from MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes ... have been answered by way of the letter 'Campaign visits by Turkish ministers and the events that took place around 11 March 2017'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes ... zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Campagnebezoeken van Turkse ministers en de gebeurtenissen die daaromtrent plaatsvonden rond om 11 maart 2017»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de schoffering van Nederland door de Turkse regering

Two MPs from the Bontes/Van Klaveren group asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister about Turkey's alleged insults to the Netherlands, dual nationality and loyalty, expelling the Turkish ambassador, and halting EU accession talks. The government referred to a separate letter on Turkish ministers' campaign visits and did not answer the substantive questions directly.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de aanstaande Hamas-conferentie in Rotterdam

Two MPs asked the Justice and Home Affairs ministers whether a Palestinian conference in Rotterdam organised by the Palestinian Return Centre, alleged to be linked to Hamas, should be stopped, and whether the mayor should be pressed to cancel it. The minister replied that the conference was not established as Hamas-organised, that no threat or legal breach was indicated, that public order lies with the municipality, and that action would follow if laws were broken.
However, from the information known to us it cannot be concluded that the conference in Rotterdam is organised by Hamas, so there is also no reason to exclude the organisation of the conference.

Uit de bij ons bekende informatie kan echter niet geconcludeerd worden dat de conferentie in Rotterdam georganiseerd wordt door Hamas, waardoor er ook geen reden is om de organisatie van de conferentie te weren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de enorme tekorten aan marechaussees op Schiphol

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked about the reported shortage of Royal Marechaussee staff at Schiphol and the government's response to warnings that security was at risk. The ministers replied that temporary extra capacity (135 fte) and e-gates will allow minimum performance in 2017, with structural needs to be considered in the 2018 budget and formation options to be proposed.
Together with the airports, the aim is a safe yet swift flow of passengers, and a proper balance between mobility and security is continually sought.
Gezamenlijk met de luchthavens, wordt gestreefd naar een veilige doch snelle doorstroom van passagiers en wordt voortdurend naar een juiste balans tussen «mobiliteit» en veiligheid gezocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een terreur-imam in Eindhoven

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked why a Kuwaiti preacher placed on a US terrorism list could speak at an Eindhoven mosque the next day, how the listing procedure works, and why mosques hosting such preachers are not closed or their foundations dissolved. The minister replied that a US sanctions listing alone is not sufficient grounds to bar a speaker, that Dutch listing is an independent procedure, that the high legal bar for dissolving a legal entity under Article 2:20 BW applies, and that measures for visa-required preachers are set out in the Integrated Approach to Jihadism programme.
Listing on the American sanctions list alone is insufficient grounds to refuse a speaker entry.
Vermelding op de Amerikaanse sanctielijst alleen is onvoldoende grond voor het weren van een spreker.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het verlof van de moordenaar van het meisje van Nulde

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the state will abolish unaccompanied leave for TBS detainees after a murderer of a girl from Nulde was granted such leave, and how the victim's father can be supported. The state secretary answered that leave is carefully phased with multiple assessments and revocation rules, that the government will not abolish unaccompanied leave, and that victims' relatives can use free support from Slachtofferhulp Nederland.
No, TBS treatment is aimed at a responsible and safe return to society.
Nee, de tbs-behandeling is gericht op een verantwoorde en veilige terugkeer in de maatschappij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over de schimmigheid omtrent teruggekeerde jihadisten

An MP asked the ministers of Justice and Security and of the Interior about the status of 31 returned jihadists, how many are free or convicted, and whether all should be preventively detained. The minister said seven have been convicted and a prosecution decision has been taken on about eight more, withholding further detail to protect ongoing investigations, and rejected administrative detention as incompatible with the rule of law under Article 5 ECHR.
Providing further criminal-law information about persons designated as returnees, including any pending prosecution decisions, could possibly harm ongoing investigations.

Het verstrekken van nadere strafrechtelijke informatie over als terugkeerder aangemerkte personen, inclusief eventuele op handen zijnde vervolgingsbeslissingen, kan mogelijk lopende onderzoeken schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de aanstaande Midden-Oosten conferentie in Parijs

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether Israel had lobbied the Netherlands to stay away from the Paris Middle East conference and whether the Netherlands would oppose anti-Israel UN steps. The minister confirmed Israel asked for ministerial non-attendance, said he attended to argue for the two-state solution, and rejected the premise that settlements are Israeli domestic policy.
Israel asked the Netherlands, in a conversation between the National Security Council and the Dutch ambassador in Tel Aviv, not to take part at ministerial level in the Paris conference.
Israël heeft Nederland in een gesprek tussen de National Security Council en de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Tel Aviv verzocht niet op ministerieel niveau deel te nemen aan de conferentie in Parijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het Meldpunt Discriminatie Internet (MiND) dat stelt gewelddadige homohaat mag op grond van de islam

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether MiND (Meldpunt Discriminatie Internet) was right to say that violent anti-gay hatred based on Islam is not discrimination, and whether it should be subsidised. The Minister acknowledged a serious error by MiND, which has apologised and had the posts removed, but said the Public Prosecution Service is the body that judges criminal conduct and that he will talk with MiND without ending the subsidy for now.
MiND's response to the posts submitted to them was a serious error.
De reactie van MiND op de aan hen voorgelegde uitingen was een ernstige fout.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de terreurdreiging van een synagoge

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a terrorist threat to a synagogue in Amsterdam, the removal of police posts from Jewish sites, and whether the municipality should keep police posts alongside camera surveillance. The minister answered that current protective measures match the threat, that consultation with the Jewish community has occurred, and that Amsterdam chose camera surveillance as a more effective and efficient option within a broader package, declining to detail that package for security reasons.
For security reasons, I will not comment on the further content of this package.
Uit veiligheidsoverwegingen doe ik over de verdere inhoud van dit pakket geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de geheime moskeelijst van het kabinet

Two MPs asked whether a list of mosques and Islamic organisations receiving Saudi funding exists, why parliament was allegedly misinformed, and whether anything is being withheld. The government refers to earlier answers on the matter, says there is nothing further it is withholding, and states that the overview was shared confidentially with parliament.
The cabinet has shared the relevant overview with your House on a confidential basis.
Het kabinet heeft het betreffende overzicht vertrouwelijk met uw Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over terreursteun voor Rotterdamse salafistenschool

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a Qatari charity linked to terrorism financed a Rotterdam salafist school, whether its foundations should be dissolved, and whether salafist schools and foreign funding should be banned. Minister Plasterk answered that the property was bought with Qatari funds but that the organisation is not on Dutch, EU or UN sanctions lists, that dissolution is a matter for the Public Prosecution Service, and that the government will address foreign funding in a letter in November.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to assess whether there are facts and circumstances that give cause to file a request with the court for civil prohibition or dissolution under art. 2:20 BW.

Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te beoordelen of er feiten en omstandigheden aanwezig zijn die aanleiding vormen om een verzoek tot civielrechtelijke verbodenverklaring of ontbinding ex art. 2:20 BW bij de rechtbank in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het stoppen van ontwikkelingshulp aan de Palestijnse Autoriteit

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government shares concerns that the Palestinian Authority and other Palestinian organisations still receive Dutch and EU funds despite alleged terrorism links, and whether it will stop subsidising antisemitic and anti-Israeli organisations as the UK did. The minister denied any facilitation of terrorism, said the PA should do more to condemn violence and pressed this point, and stated the government will not fund organisations that make antisemitic statements or glorify terror.
There is no question of the Palestinian Authority or other Palestinian organisations supported by the Netherlands or the EU facilitating terrorism.
Er is geen sprake van faciliteren van terrorisme door de Palestijnse Autoriteit of andere door Nederland of de EU gesteunde Palestijnse organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over discriminatie van autochtonen door een Haagse wethouder

Two MPs asked the ministers whether a The Hague alderman's plan to give preference to candidates of migrant background in hiring, when equally qualified, amounts to discrimination against natives and whether the alderman should be called to account. The minister answered that such preferential policy is permitted under strict conditions of the Algemene wet gelijke behandeling, that municipalities bear their own responsibility, and that he sees no reason to intervene for now, while promising to inform the House on follow-up action after an anti-discrimination monitor.
A municipality has in principle its own responsibility, and the municipal executive must account for this to the municipal council.
Een gemeente heeft in beginsel een eigen verantwoordelijkheid en het gemeentebestuur dient hierover rekenschap te geven aan de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over Lespakketten over Zwarte Piet

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a municipality (Maassluis) was distributing controversial lesson packs on Zwarte Piet to primary schools, including a quiz with racist-tinged questions, and whether the mayor should be urged to stop. The state secretary replied that the municipality only helped connect schools with an outside foundation, that schools decide their own teaching materials, that the government takes no position on the origins of Piet, and that it would not intervene.
No lesson packs are distributed to primary schools from the municipality of Maassluis.
Vanuit de gemeente Maassluis worden geen lespakketten onder basisscholen verspreid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes inzake een nieuw formaldehydelek

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the State Secretary about a new formaldehyde leak at a DuPont plant, whether Chemours failed to report it to municipalities, and why detectors allegedly did not alarm the regional service. The State Secretary answered that the company was only obliged to report to the province, that detectors did register a raised value on 10 August, and that the province imposed an order under penalty and stricter inspections.
There is no legal obligation for the company to report to other authorities.
Er bestaat voor het bedrijf geen wettelijke plicht tot het melden bij andere overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over doodsbedreigingen aan adres Nederturken door Erdogan-aanhangers

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the ministers about threats, boycott lists and demonstrations by Erdogan supporters against critical Turkish-Dutch people, and about foreign influence via Diyanet. The government condemns intimidation and refers to earlier letters, says foreign funding of mosques is not banned but is watched for undue influence, and states that Turkish-Dutch integration is a concern to be discussed with communities.
The Netherlands has no ban on foreign financing of mosque associations, general religious associations or institutions.
Nederland kent geen verbod op buitenlandse financiering van moskeeverenigingen, algemene religieuze verenigingen of instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Van Bommel, Bontes, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Knops en Sjoerdsma over het uitoefenen van internationale druk op Noord-Korea

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister how North Korea's missile launches and nuclear tests affect regional stability, what diplomatic and sanctions pressure can be applied via China and the UN/EU, and how the Netherlands prepares for regime destabilisation. The minister answered that the Netherlands condemns the launches, supports UN sanctions enforcement and IAEA action, will press for a human rights resolution at the UN General Assembly, and sees no concrete signs of regime collapse.
The Netherlands will – as in recent years – continue to raise human rights violations both bilaterally and in relevant international forums.
Nederland zal – net als in afgelopen jaren – zowel bilateraal als in relevante internationale fora aandacht blijven vragen voor mensenrechtenschendingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over een Erdogan-informant bij de politie

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether police data on victims of threats linked to criticism of Erdogan was leaked to Erdogan supporters, how many such cases exist, what measures will protect victims, and whether the situation undermines the rule of law. The Minister said leaks are unacceptable, an investigation into the reported case is ongoing so no conclusions can be drawn, no similar reports are known, and any officer can take a complaint regardless of background.
If there are reasons to assume this is the case, an investigation will be launched.
Indien er redenen zijn om aan te nemen dat hier sprake van is, wordt een onderzoek ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over "leenhelmen" voor militairen

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked the Defence Minister about reports that soldiers on missions must share helmets, and about shortages of equipment and ammunition, asking whether every soldier will get a helmet and whether the 2% NATO spending target will be met. The minister answered that 22,500 new helmets are being bought, 18,000 for operational personnel and 4,500 for a central pool, that equipment is issued on a need-to-have basis, that ammunition stocks are being raised, and that the government is taking steps toward the NATO spending commitment.
Defence is therefore purchasing 22,500 new helmets, of which 18,000 will be issued to military personnel with an operational function.
Defensie schaft daarom 22.500 nieuwe helmen aan, waarvan 18.000 worden verstrekt aan militairen met een operationele functie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het Turkse dreigement de vluchtelingendeal op te blazen

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the government would yield to Turkey's threat to end the refugee deal unless visa liberalisation for Turks is granted by October, and whether the deal was wise given Turkey's authoritarian turn. The minister answered that government visa policy is unchanged (visa-free travel only once all roadmap benchmarks are met), that the deal is needed to manage migration, that criticism of Turkey's post-coup developments stands, and that pre-accession aid would be cut and the death penalty is a red line if the rule of law deteriorates further.

Government visa liberalisation policy remains unchanged: only when Turkey meets all benchmarks of the Roadmap for visa liberalisation can the Netherlands agree to visa-free travel for Turkish citizens.

Het kabinetsbeleid ten aanzien van visumliberalisatie blijft onveranderd: enkel wanneer Turkije aan alle benchmarks van de Roadmap visumliberalisatie voldoet, kan Nederland instemmen met het invoeren van visumvrijheid voor Turkse burgers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de intimidatie en doodsbedreiging aan het adres van een homostel

Two MPs asked the ministers about intimidation and death threats against a gay couple in Amsterdam, including whether police advised them not to file a complaint and whether non-Western minorities are overrepresented in anti-gay violence. The minister condemned the threats, said police encouraged mediation but that a discrimination complaint should always be recorded, rejected the statistical framing, and pointed to existing action plans and a planned protocol with partners.
A complaint of discrimination must always be recorded under the Discrimination Directive.
Een aangifte van discriminatie dient volgens de Aanwijzing Discriminatie altijd opgenomen te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de noodzaak om NAVO-kernwapens weg te halen uit Turkije

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the government shares concern about NATO nuclear weapons stored at Incirlik in Turkey, whether they should be removed, and whether Turkey should be expelled from NATO after the post-coup crackdown. The ministers declined to confirm locations or numbers of nuclear weapons, stated that Turkey's NATO membership is not under discussion, and said the Netherlands will keep urging Turkey to respect the rule of law.
Based on alliance and legally binding agreements, no statements are made about the locations and numbers per location of these nuclear weapons in Europe.
Op grond van bondgenootschappelijke en juridisch bindende afspraken worden geen mededelingen gedaan over locaties en aantallen per locatie van deze kernwapens in Europa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over antisemitische bedreiging na tonen Israëlische vlag

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether they recognise that Jewish citizens are threatened for displaying an Israeli flag, whether they share concern about rising antisemitism and its causes, and what measures the government will take. The minister says such threats are unacceptable, cites research linking Middle East tensions to antisemitism, and points to the existing National Action Programme against Discrimination, with a progress report promised for early 2017.
The cabinet takes the feelings of fear and unease within the Jewish community seriously.
Het kabinet neemt de gevoelens van angst en onbehagen binnen de joodse gemeenschap serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over Italiaanse banken en “plannen” voor een EU-noodpakket van 150 miljard euro

Two MPs asked the Finance Minister about reports of a proposed EU 150 billion euro rescue package for Italian banks, Italy's high non-performing loan rate, and whether Italy could be allowed exceptions to EU rules or leave the eurozone. The minister replied that no EU rescue package is planned, that bank problems must be solved by banks first under the banking union bail-in rules, that no exceptions to EU rules will be made, and that leaving the eurozone is not a solution.
There are no European plans for such an EU rescue package, and as far as I am concerned there will not be one.
Er zijn geen Europese plannen voor een dergelijk EU-noodpakket en wat mij betreft komt dat er ook niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over de oproep van de Vakvereniging Brandweer Vrijwilligers voor een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar de fatale brand in Hellevoetsluis

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether he would order an independent investigation into the fatal Hellevoetsluis fire, after a volunteer firefighters union called the Rotterdam-Rijnmond safety region's own report inadequate. The minister replied that the Inspectorate does not consider further investigation necessary, but will include the Hellevoetsluis fire in a nationwide review of firefighting response in all 25 safety regions.
The Inspectorate has studied the investigation report of the Rotterdam-Rijnmond safety region on the Hellevoetsluis fire. It does not consider further investigation necessary at this time.
De Inspectie heeft het onderzoeksrapport van de veiligheidsregio Rotterdam-Rijnmond naar de brand in Hellevoetsluis bestudeerd. Een nader onderzoek acht zij nu niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over busterreur in Almere

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked why bus service in Almere was halted after stone-throwing attacks by youths, why no arrests were made, and whether the mayor should adopt zero tolerance. The Minister of Justice replied that service was halted only for hours, that about ten incidents are under investigation with some arrests, that the OM and police have national enforcement agreements, and that enforcement of public order is primarily the mayor's responsibility.
As the investigation into these various incidents is still ongoing, I cannot currently provide further substantive information on this.
Nu het onderzoek naar deze diverse incidenten nog loopt, kan ik hier op dit moment geen verdere inhoudelijke mededelingen over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bezoek van een antisemitische geweldsimam

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a preacher with antisemitic violent rhetoric would speak in the Netherlands and why he was not barred, and urged dissolving the inviting organisation. The minister said there was no confirmation of a Dutch appearance, declined to comment on individual cases, pointed to visa and entry-refusal tools and the courts' power to dissolve organisations, and considered current practice consistent with the Bontes motion.
I do not make statements about individual cases.
Over individuele casuïstiek doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de plannen om mensen met zware schulden geen rekeningen te laten betalen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the proposed Breed Moratorium (blanket debt-collection pause) for heavily indebted people unfairly harms creditors and encourages payment laxity. The State Secretary replied that the moratorium only suspends collection, not repayment, is reserved for exceptional cases, and requires the debtor to make efforts to repay.
The moratorium does not suspend the repayment of debts, only the collection.
Het Moratorium schort niet het afbetalen van schulden op, maar enkel de incasso.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht 'Samenscholingsverbod na 'Marokkaanse' onlusten in Ede'

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about a ban on gatherings after riots in Ede, the arrests made, and whether Moroccan youth over-representation in crime and military-style discipline should be pursued. The government answered that 10 suspects were arrested and released, that youth crime risk factors are social and spatial rather than ethnic, and that it does not support military discipline, favouring tailored interventions.

So far 10 suspects have been arrested for violating the gathering ban, resisting officers, insult, failure to obey an official order, deliberately violating the area ban, violating the Identification Act, rowdiness, or a combination of these offences.

Er zijn tot nu toe 10 verdachten aangehouden voor respectievelijk overtreding van het samenscholingsverbod, wederspannigheid, belediging, niet voldoen aan een ambtelijk bevel, het opzettelijk overtreden van het gebiedsverbod, overtreding van de Wet op de Identificatieplicht, baldadigheid of voor een combinatie van deze feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het inroepen van hulp van de Marokkaanse consul bij rellen Ede

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether calling in the Moroccan consul to restore order among rioting youths in Ede undermined Dutch authority, and what the government would do to restore order. The minister replied that the consul only sought talks at the mayor's request, that Dutch authorities alone hold authority, and that maintaining public order is a local responsibility with no further central measures announced.
Maintaining public order is a local responsibility.
Het handhaven van de openbare orde is een lokale verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een verbod op de anti-Israëlische Boycot, Desinvestering en Sancties (BDS)-beweging

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether publicly funded bodies should be banned from boycotting Israeli products, whether the ANBI status of BDS-linked organisations such as docP should be revoked, and about reported supermarket patrols. The minister answered that consumers may investigate product origins, that ANBI status is granted and revoked only by the Tax Authority under neutral criteria, and that no ban on boycotts is planned.
The cabinet has no power to revoke a granted ANBI status.
Het kabinet heeft geen bevoegdheid om een verleende ANBI-status in te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een gesubsidieerd haatfeest

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether The Hague municipality sponsors a Ramadan festival that allegedly features gender segregation and glorification of terrorists, and whether the government will stop such support or cut the municipal fund. The minister answered that The Hague gave no sponsorship or other support to the event, that the municipality has a policy of not subsidising religious gatherings, that subsidy decisions are a local matter, and that cutting the municipal fund is not possible.
Furthermore, the decision whether or not to subsidise initiatives is a local matter.
Voorts is het zo dat de afweging om wel of niet over te gaan tot het subsidiëren van initiatieven een lokale aangelegenheid is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over een Nederlandse die vast zat in Qatar

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he was aware that a Dutch woman had been detained in Qatar since March after reporting being raped, why she remained in custody, what had been done to bring her home, and whether the Qatari ambassador would be summoned. The minister referred to his answers to earlier written questions on the same case without restating substance in this document.
See my answers to the written questions from MPs Ten Broeke, Servaes, Knops, Van Bommel, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Grashoff and Sjoerdsma on the arrest of a Dutch woman in Qatar.
Zie mijn antwoorden op de schriftelijke vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Servaes, Knops, Van Bommel, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Grashoff en Sjoerdsma
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de komst van een jihad-prediker naar de As Soennah moskee

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a Belgian imam who allegedly preaches violent jihad could speak at the As Soennah mosque in The Hague, and whether the mosque should be closed or dissolved and the municipality should stop cooperating with it. The minister answered that the imam showed no incitement to violence, that as an EU national he cannot be barred, that the prosecutor has seen no grounds to seek dissolution, and that cooperation with the mosque is a municipal matter.
Based on the facts and circumstances, the prosecution service has so far seen no reason to ask the court to close a mosque.
Op basis van feiten en omstandigheden heeft het OM tot op heden geen aanleiding gezien om de rechter te verzoeken een moskee te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over Vrij reizen voor veteranen op Veteranendag

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether free travel for veterans on Veteranendag could be extended to active veterans, and whether the government shares the view that veterans deserve more open recognition. The Minister of Defence answered that the 76 percent public support for veteran recognition is noted, that recognition policy is already in place, and that active veterans can already claim travel costs to veteran events.
Veterans in active service already have that option. They can claim travel to veterans' events.
Veteranen in werkelijke dienst hebben die mogelijkheid al. Zij kunnen reizen naar veteranenevenementen declareren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over €10.000 aan shoptegoed voor asielzoekers

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked why refugee families in Oisterwijk receive EUR 10,000 in shopping credit from the municipality without repayment, whether a national guideline with lower costs and loans should be set, and whether Australian-style regional-only reception should be adopted. The State Secretary answered that individual special assistance is a municipal competence accountable to the municipal council, the ministry has no overview of municipalities above EUR 2,000, and regional reception is part of the cabinet's migration approach.
The granting of special assistance is decentralised both in policy and financially to the mayors and aldermen (colleges of B&W).
De verlening van bijzondere bijstand is zowel beleidsmatig als financieel gedecentraliseerd aan de colleges van burgemeester en wethouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bezoek van een terreurprediker aan een moskee in Boskoop

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a controversial imam speaking at a mosque in Boskoop and whether such preachers should be barred, mosques closed, or ANBI status withdrawn. The minister said the cleric is Belgian and EU free-movement rules limit exclusion, that the government opposes intolerant speakers and will act on criminal conduct, and that no mosque closure or ANBI revocation was warranted so far, while noting the mayor's response.
I do not comment on individual cases.
Over individuele casuïstiek doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over het bericht dat Turkije niet meewerkt in de zaak-Demmink en het onderzoek daarmee is afgerond

MP Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether it is unacceptable that Turkey refuses Dutch legal assistance requests to hear witnesses in the Demmink case, and what steps the government has taken. The Minister answered that Turkey invoked the ne bis in idem ground, that this has no consequences for judicial cooperation, that he has pressed Turkish counterparts repeatedly, and that he must respect Turkey's decision.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het bericht dat de verdachte van de liquidatie in IJsselstein op voorwaarden vrij was

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked how a suspect in an IJsselstein killing could evade reclassering supervision while on conditional release, and whether TBS and PIJ leave should be abolished. The state secretary said supervision was carried out properly according to the Inspectie, and defended PIJ and TBS leave as necessary for resocialisation, declining to abolish it.
Because this is an individual case, I cannot go into the arrangement of the supervision in this specific case.
Omdat het een individuele casus betreft kan ik niet ingaan op de invulling van het toezicht in dit specifieke geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de zorgelijke financiële positie van veel gepensioneerden

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Secretary of State whether the financial position of middle-income pensioners, who miss out on many allowances, has worsened, whether pensions should be compensated for non-indexation, and whether the mandatory pension system unduly restricts members' freedom to safeguard accrued pensions. The Secretary of State acknowledged pressure on older people's incomes, pointed to CBS and CPB figures showing improvement and a 2016 purchasing-power rise for most older people, and defended compulsory pension participation as a core feature of the system.
Any imbalances in the purchasing-power picture for next year will be considered in the August budget decision-making.
Eventuele onevenwichtigheden in het koopkrachtbeeld voor volgend jaar zullen in de augustusbesluitvorming worden bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de passieve rol van de Nederlandse overheid ten tijde van de jodenvervolging

Two MPs asked the Prime Minister whether the Dutch government should give fuller expression to commemoration of WWII, how it judges the Dutch government-in-exile's inaction on reports of Jewish deaths and deportations, and why the Netherlands has never apologised for its passive role in the persecution of Jews. The government answered briefly, pointing to commemorations, to publications and an independent institute as the proper domain of historiography, to Queen Beatrix's 1995 speech to the Knesset, and to earlier condemnations of antisemitism; it did not apologise.
The assessment of publications on these subjects belongs to the domain of science and society.
De beoordeling van publicaties over deze onderwerpen behoren tot het domein van wetenschap en samenleving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het initiatief van het Europees Parlement om Turks toe te voegen als officiële EU-taal

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the Netherlands, as Council presidency, received a Cypriot request to add Turkish as an EU official language, and urged rejection given Turkey's human rights record. The minister confirmed the Cypriot request is linked to Cyprus reunification preparations, that its scope is unclear, that treaty change would require all member states' consent, and that the Netherlands will stay in contact with Cyprus and the Commission on it.
The request is not related to the EU accession negotiations with Turkey.
Het verzoek houdt geen verband met de EU-toetredingsonderhandelingen met Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de oproep van het Turkse consulaat in Nederland om beledigingen van Erdogan te melden

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the Turkish consulate in Rotterdam was right to call on Turkish organisations in the Netherlands to report insults of Erdogan, and how the government would respond. The answer is a cross-reference to a letter on a related request from MP Karabulut, so the substance of the government's position is not set out in this document.
The written questions from MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes, question number 2016Z08377, have been answered by means of the letter
De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes (beiden Groep Bontes/Van Klaveren), vraagnummer 2016Z08377 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de grote bezwaren tegen de komst van honderden extra asielzoekers naar Maastricht

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about strong local objections to hundreds of extra asylum seekers in Maastricht and whether municipalities should hold referendums before asylum centres are opened. The State Secretary confirmed the numbers, described local consultation and information evenings, and said regional reception remains a key principle while international obligations still apply.
The municipal government decides on the arrival of an asylum centre.
Het gemeentebestuur besluit over de komst van een asielzoekerscentrum.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een door de school in de steek gelaten geïntimideerde homo-leerling

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a gay pupil was moved out of class after bullying and whether the school yielded to homophobia, and what the minister will do. The minister denies the reported framing, says the placement was pedagogical and not a punishment, cites the school safety law, sexuality curricula and an ongoing inspectorate study, and calls the asylum comparison inapt.
In general terms I believe victims should not be relocated, but perpetrators should be punished.
In algemene zin ben ik van mening dat slachtoffers niet herplaats moeten worden, maar daders gestraft moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over aanwezigheid van de minister president in het buitenland terwijl in Nederland grote onrust heerst

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Prime Minister why he was abroad on an economic mission to Atlanta during the 2015 asylum unrest in the Netherlands and whether he would cut short his trip and refrain from further travel. Rutte replied that the mission served Dutch interests, that he stayed in contact with ministers at home, particularly on asylum, and that return was unnecessary; he did not name a maximum number of asylum seekers and referred to earlier letters and debates.
Modern communication allows us to stay in permanent contact with each other, so returning to the Netherlands was not necessary.
Moderne communicatie stelt ons in staat permanent met elkaar in contact te staan, waardoor terugkeer naar Nederland niet noodzakelijk was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over Nederlandse subsidie voor antisemitisme- en terreurverheerlijking

Two Dutch MPs asked whether the government funds the Palestinian NGO RWDS, which held events honouring a terrorist, and whether it will stop indirect subsidies to organisations promoting antisemitism and terrorism. The minister confirmed past funding of RWDS (about 460,000 euro and 104,852 euro via Oxfam Novib), denied any support for the event, and said the government will not fund such organisations and will suspend or end grants if subsidy conditions are breached, though it did not commit to a specific new stop or the requested EU/UN initiative.
If, however, it is established that an organisation has breached the subsidy conditions, measures will be taken, including suspending or ending the contribution.

Indien evenwel geconstateerd wordt dat er sprake is van schending van de subsidievoorwaarden door een organisatie, zullen maatregelen worden getroffen, waarbij het opschorten of beëindigen van de bijdrage tot de mogelijkheden behoort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de zwakke beveiliging van de Nederlandse kerncentrales tegen terrorisme

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the weak protection of Dutch nuclear power plants against terrorism, with only unarmed guards, is acceptable, and whether the government will follow US experts' advice to station armed teams on site. The minister answered that protection meets national and international rules, threat levels are monitored, no concrete threat information exists, and the government will not change its approach without concrete threat intelligence.
No substantive information is provided about specific security measures.
Over specifieke beveiligingsmaatregelen worden verder geen inhoudelijke mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over ‘de aantasting van de pensioenen’

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether ECB policy threatens pensions, whether rate windfalls on state debt could fund AOW or pension compensation, and whether the mandatory supplementary pension should be replaced by an opt-out. The government said it is in talks with social partners, DNB and others and will send a DNB report in May, declined to make theoretical windfall calculations, would consider pensioners in the purchasing-power decisions, and kept mandatory pension participation while planning a differentiated approach to be sent to parliament before summer.
In May the cabinet will send the DNB report with an assessment of the figures to your House.
In mei stuurt het kabinet de rapportage van DNB met een appreciatie van het cijferbeeld naar uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over politiebezoek na een tweet over juichende leerlingen vanwege aanslagen België (Herdruk)

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether police visits to a Breda resident after a tweet about students cheering the Brussels attacks were intimidating, what the police meant by a quoted remark, and what the government thought of cheering students. The minister said wijkagents may judge such conversations part of normal policing under local authority responsibility, that the quoted remark was not used by police, and that teachers should be equipped to handle such reactions.
I therefore see no reason to change the police's approach on this point.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om de werkwijze van de politie op dit punt te veranderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het verminderde aantal verkiezingsborden voor het referendum

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked why a January 2016 ministry circular told municipalities that election boards were unnecessary for the referendum, in contrast to the 2005 campaign that used A2 posters on election boards. Minister Plasterk answered that extra funds were used in 2005 at parliament's request, that information for this referendum is now provided via a digital toolkit, abri posters, newspaper ads and websites, and that the government will not deploy extra funds to get municipalities to place boards, though municipalities may do so.
The cabinet is not deploying extra funds to encourage municipalities to place election boards.
Het kabinet zet geen extra middelen in om gemeenten ertoe te bewegen verkiezingsborden te plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over niet (tijdig) verstuurde stempassen voor het referendum

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether voting passes for the 6 April 2016 referendum were sent late to voters in several municipalities, and what measures would ensure voters receive them. Minister Plasterk answered that the deadline was 23 March, that passes were sent in time in the named municipalities, that individual non-receipt can occur and is handled by reissue on request, and that no late dispatches are known so no measures are planned.
Enquiries have informed me that the voting passes in each of the named municipalities were sent before this deadline.
Navraag heeft mij geleerd dat de stempassen in elk van de genoemde gemeenten vóór deze deadline zijn verstuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het antisemitische motief van een extreem gewelddadige overval

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a violent robbery of an elderly Jewish couple with alleged antisemitic motive, including whether the Public Prosecution Service withheld the antisemitic aspect from a TV appeal. The minister said the investigation covers all aspects including discrimination, declined to discuss ongoing investigative details, explained that appeal content was limited to verified information, and listed prevention measures against antisemitism without addressing the withholding question substantively.
Since this is an ongoing investigation, I cannot provide further information on the content of the investigation.
Aangezien het een lopend onderzoek betreft kan ik over de inhoud van het onderzoek geen nadere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over het bericht dat elk jaar duizenden uitspraken van de rechter waardeloos zijn

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether an estimated 100,000 civil court judgments go unenforced each year, and whether non-compliance should be registered or sampled so citizens can weigh whether litigation is worthwhile. The minister answered that no registration exists or is planned, since enforcement is the creditor's own responsibility, and pointed to a 2009 WODC study and the new central attachment register and creditor-debtor signalling tools as alternatives.
I do not intend to start keeping a registration.
Ik ben niet voornemens een registratie bij te gaan houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over plannen om het referendum te verstoren

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Interior and Foreign Ministers about reports of plans to disrupt the Dutch referendum on the EU-Ukraine Association Agreement through intimidation and other pressure, and whether these threats are serious. Minister Plasterk answered that reports are investigated by relevant bodies and security measures taken where risk warrants, noting Ukrainian authorities say the documents are forged and referring to a separate answer on militia threats.
Reports of possible attempts to disrupt the referendum are investigated by the relevant authorities where necessary.
Meldingen van mogelijke pogingen om het referendum te verstoren, worden waar nodig onderzocht door de relevante instanties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over groeiende Turkse staatscensuur

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the government knows of the Turkish state takeover of a critical newspaper, shares concern over intensifying censorship, and whether it will press Turkey on press freedom and oppose its EU membership. The minister confirmed the reports and concern, said the Netherlands raises press freedom bilaterally and in the EU, and opposed the view that Turkey should never join the EU, preferring accession talks as the framework for reform.
The Netherlands therefore continues to proactively raise press freedom with Turkey, bilaterally and within the EU.
Nederland blijft Turkije daarom proactief aanspreken op persvrijheid, bilateraal en in EU-verband.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de financiële puinhoop in Amsterdam

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Interior about the financial mess in Amsterdam and whether it warranted measures, and whether Deputy PM Asscher could responsibly manage the SZW budget. The minister said the municipal council and provincial supervisors must judge Amsterdam's finances, that the city is financially sound, and that the Tweede Kamer assesses ministerial spending through the annual accountability process.
It is up to the Amsterdam municipal council to pass judgment on this.
Het is aan de gemeenteraad van Amsterdam om hierover een oordeel uit te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de doodsbedreigingen aan het adres van een anti-IS-strijder

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked the Justice Minister about death threats against Jitse Akse, a Dutch anti-IS fighter who is under criminal investigation, and whether the government would instruct the prosecutor to drop the case. The minister condemned threats, said protective measures are not disclosed, and stated the prosecution decision is for the Openbaar Ministerie without a directive.
The investigation by the Openbaar Ministerie into Jitse A. is still ongoing.
Het onderzoek door het Openbaar Ministerie naar Jitse A. loopt nog.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de aanhoudende bedreigingen door een militie uit Oekraïne in verband met het referendum

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a threatening video from a Ukrainian militia against the Dutch public in connection with the referendum is authentic, whether earlier threats were investigated, and whether security measures will be taken, including for referendum initiators. The minister answered that the Ukrainian government and the Azov battalion distance themselves from the threats, the videos are known to Dutch investigative authorities, and security measures would be taken under local authority if the threat warrants it.
The videos are known to the Dutch investigative authorities.
De filmpjes zijn bekend bij de Nederlandse opsporingsinstanties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de Franse dreiging om de content van een Nederlandse website te censureren

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether France's threat to block content of the Dutch website TPO.nl, and possible censorship, is compatible with freedom of expression and how the Netherlands would respond. The Minister answered that such requests are specific, that member states implement EU counter-radicalisation commitments under their own law, that the Netherlands uses notice-and-take-action procedures and stresses rule-of-law limits, and that the Turkish YouTube case differs because the French request is targeted and providers can go to French courts.
The specific request referred to in the TPO article came from the French authorities.
Het specifieke verzoek waaraan wordt gerefereerd in het TPO-artikel is uitgegaan van de Franse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en  Bontes over het doorgaan van een bijeenkomst met een islamitische geweldsprediker

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government would bar an Islamist preacher of violence from a planned gathering in Almere, in line with their motion. The Minister of Security and Justice said visa-required speakers who spread anti-integrative or anti-democratic messages are not welcome, that individual cases are assessed on their merits, that EU-national access can only be refused for a current, serious threat, and that criminal law and mayoral area bans remain available.
I do not comment on individual cases.
Over individuele casuïstiek doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over een opgepakte anti-IS-strijder

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the arrest and possible prosecution of a Dutch veteran who fought against IS in Syria, and why returning jihadists receive assistance while he is detained. The minister declined to comment on the individual case under investigation, described the general approach to returning jihadists, and explained that fighting IS can in principle be prosecuted under ordinary criminal law.
The investigation by the Public Prosecution Service into Jitse A. is still ongoing. I will not comment on an individual case that is still the subject of a criminal investigation.
Het onderzoek door het Openbaar Ministerie naar Jitse A. loopt nog. Ik ga niet in op een individuele casus die nog onderwerp is van een strafrechtelijk onderzoek.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Servaes, Van Bommel, Omtzigt, De Roon, Sjoerdsma en Bontes over het rondetafelgesprek van 22 januari 2016 over de beleidsreactie onderzoeksrapporten over MH17

MPs asked the government to reflect on the January 2016 round-table discussion on prosecution of the MH17 downing, including suggestions on a possible Dutch-Russian tribunal, the interpretation of article 552y of the Dutch Code of Criminal Procedure, and victims' relatives' rights in proceedings. The government answered that it keeps both national and international prosecution options open pending the criminal investigation, acknowledges that article 552y should be amended (a bill is with the Council of State), and will consider the concerns raised about relatives' participation.
Should there be a need to speed up the legislative process with a view to possible prosecution of offences related to the downing of MH17, the available options will be used.

Mocht er met het oog op de eventuele berechting van misdrijven gerelateerd aan het neerhalen van MH17 behoefte zijn om het wetgevingsproces te versnellen zullen de beschikbare mogelijkheden daartoe aangegrepen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de komst van een  geweldsprediker naar Utrecht

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a violent preacher (al-Haddad, who reportedly calls for killing adulterers and apostates) should be denied entry to the Netherlands, how this fits the Bontes motion, whether foundations inviting such preachers could be banned, and whether a database of such preachers exists. The government answered that intolerant preachers are unwelcome and that visa or entry refusal depends on individual assessment and legal status (for this UK national, entry can only be refused on an actual, serious threat), that a study on the 'danger criterion' for banning associations is underway, and that no blacklist exists, only an alert list.
I do not comment on individual cases.
Over individuele casuïstiek doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het intrekken van een subsidieaanvraag voor het referendum door de handelswijze van de referendumcommissie

Two MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether unclear forms, poor communication and an unsupportive attitude by the Referendum Commission caused applicants, including the initiators of a referendum, to withdraw subsidy requests, and whether this obstructs the democratic process. The Minister answered that withdrawing is applicants' own responsibility, that the forms and procedure were clear to most applicants, that subsidy statistics show many applicants did receive funds, and that he does not share the view that the process amounts to obstruction.
It is the applicants' own responsibility to withdraw a subsidy application.
Het is de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van aanvragers om een aanvraag voor een subsidie in te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes inzake het weren van journalisten bij informatieavonden over azc's

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the exclusion of journalists from information evenings on asylum centres threatens press freedom and what measures the government will take. The state secretary said municipalities weigh safety and space against openness, that press freedom is protected but restrictions must be proportionate, and that municipalities must account for their choices to their councils.
Municipalities have their own responsibility to make a proportionate assessment between safety and openness when organising information evenings.
Gemeenten hebben een eigen verantwoordelijkheid om bij de organisatie van informatieavonden een proportionele afweging te maken tussen veiligheid en openheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over consulaten die geen registratieformulieren voor het referendum hebben ontvangen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether consulates abroad failed to receive pre-printed registration forms for the 2016 advisory referendum, whether this frustrated expatriate voters, and whether all consulates would be sent forms. The minister answered that one case was known, that posts were told to point voters to the Den Haag website and print forms on request, and that registration procedures match those for regular elections.
All embassies and consulates-general have since been reminded of this once more.
Inmiddels zijn alle ambassades en consulaten-generaal hier nogmaals op gewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de registratie van criminele asielzoekers

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the ministry lacks central oversight of how many criminal asylum seekers lose or are denied residence permits, and whether a central register will be created. The State Secretary rejected the premise of missing central oversight, explained that the IND assesses these cases and that rules were recently tightened, and noted that public order can now be recorded as a refusal or withdrawal ground.
I do not share the picture described regarding the absence of oversight in the registration of criminal asylum seekers.
Het geschetste beeld met betrekking tot het ontbreken van regie op het vlak van registratie van criminele asielzoekers deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een subsidie aan hulporganisatie B’Tselem die Palestijnse doodseskaders faciliteert

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the Dutch government funds B'Tselem, which they say informs on Palestinians selling land to Jews, leading to torture and death, and whether that funding will be stopped and recovered. The Minister says the government is aware of the reports, that the Palestinian law carries prison or forced labour rather than death, that the Israeli investigation found no link to injury or death, and that Netherlands jointly funds B'Tselem (USD 710,000 for 2014–2016) as a legitimate human rights voice, so no halt or recovery is planned.
Organisations like B'Tselem represent a legitimate voice in Israeli society and strengthen the democratic character of Israel.
Organisaties als B’tselem vertegenwoordigen een legitieme stem in de Israëlische samenleving en versterken het democratische karakter van Israël.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het weren van journalisten bij een informatieavond over een asielzoekerscentrum (azc) in de Noord-Oostpolder

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether police barring journalists from an information evening on an asylum centre in Noordoostpolder, and home visits to critical residents, unduly restrict press freedom and intimidate citizens. Minister Plasterk said press freedom is protected, noted the matter is before the court and so declined to judge the case, and placed responsibility for proportionate decisions with municipalities accountable to their councils.
The specific situation in Noordoostpolder has now been submitted to the court. For that reason I will not make a further statement on it.
De specifieke situatie in de Noordoostpolder is inmiddels voorgelegd aan de rechter. Om die reden doe ik hierover verder geen uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de ‘doofpot’ na aanrandingen in Almere

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether sexual assaults by asylum seekers in Almere were withheld or discouraged from reporting by police. The Minister said one case with four suspects was known locally, three victims filed complaints, police did not discourage reporting, and publicising incidents is for local authorities and the prosecution service.
Making incidents and reports public falls under the responsibility of local authorities.
Het openbaar maken van incidenten en meldingen valt onder de verantwoordelijkheid van het lokaal gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over politiebezoek om twitter-kritiek op AZC

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police home visits over critical tweets about asylum centres were intimidating and how to stop them. The Minister rejected the concern, saying police may verify social media signals of possible public order disturbances, that home visits are normal policing under the mayor's authority, and that no change in policy is planned.
No, I do not share that. The police have the task of maintaining public order.
Nee, die deel ik niet. De politie heeft tot taak het handhaven van de openbare orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over een journalist die maandenlang is gevolgd door de recherche

MP Bontes asked whether a police investigation of a journalist, who had been followed for months, was connected to his journalistic work on trafficking and abuse, and whether the press-facing directive on coercive measures against journalists applied. The minister answered that the suspicion concerned the journalist as a private individual, unrelated to his journalism, so the directive did not apply, and gave no further detail on the offences.
The Public Prosecution Service further makes no statement about the nature of the criminal offences to which the suspicion related.
Het Openbaar Ministerie doet verder geen mededeling over de aard van de strafbare feiten waarop de verdenking zag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het antisemitisch Nieuwjaarsgeweld

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about antisemitic violence during New Year's Eve 2015 in Amsterdam, the scale of antisemitism, Holocaust teaching and security needs of Jewish institutions. The minister answered that the suspects were sent home with a conduct order, that the government rejects antisemitism, and listed measures such as teacher support, a dialogue with community leaders and recording of incidents.

Early 2016 SZW therefore organises a consultation with key figures from the Jewish and Islamic communities on their efforts to reduce the impact of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict in the Netherlands.

Begin 2016 organiseert SZW daarom een overleg met sleutelfiguren uit de Joodse en islamitische gemeenschap over hun inzet om doorwerking in Nederland van het Israelisch-Palestijnse conflict te verminderen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een van groepsverkrachting verdachte asielzoeker

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about an asylum seeker suspected of group rape, including his status, his reception centre, whether such offenders always forfeit residence, and how EU border travel is controlled. The State Secretary answered that the suspect is a family member of an admitted asylum seeker, that stricter criminal-conviction thresholds apply and the IND will await court outcomes, and that Schengen alerts would ensure his return and prosecution.
The IND will, where necessary, wait as long as legally permitted to decide on the asylum application until the court's ruling in any criminal case is known.
De IND wacht, indien nodig, zo lang als wettelijk toegestaan met de beslissing op de asielaanvraag tot de uitspraak van de rechter in een eventuele strafzaak bekend is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht dat de Amerikaanse inlichtingendiensten onderzoek doen naar onder meer het GeenPeil-initiatief

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether US intelligence services are investigating Russian influence on European initiatives including the GeenPeil referendum initiative, whether the Dutch government will check on US monitoring of its initiators, how Dutch intelligence is involved, and whether this is worrying. The minister answered that US services may not conduct operations in the Netherlands without Dutch government consent, that the cited article is insufficient evidence of such activity, and that the government cannot publicly comment on alleged activities of Dutch intelligence services.
The cabinet cannot publicly address (alleged) activities of the Dutch intelligence services.
Het kabinet kan niet in het openbaar ingaan op (vermeende) activiteiten van de Nederlandse inlichtingendiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de komst van verschillende geweldspredikers naar Eindhoven

Two MPs asked whether preachers who legitimise suicide bombings and call for the death penalty for homosexuals should be denied entry, why such visits keep being allowed despite a motion to bar them, and whether foundations inviting them should be dissolved under Book 2 of the Civil Code. The government answered that visas are refused or withdrawn for preachers threatening public order, that each case is assessed individually and some visas were withdrawn, that it is pursuing a three-track approach, and that dissolution of legal persons is a matter for the courts on request by the public prosecutor.
Each individual case is assessed on its own merits and tested against these principles.
Elk individueel geval wordt op zijn eigen merites beoordeeld en getoetst aan deze uitgangspunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het succesvolle ontmoedigingsbeleid van België

Two MPs asked whether the government will adopt a Belgian- and Danish-style discouragement campaign aimed at asylum seekers to reduce inflows. The State Secretary answered that the government supports providing accurate information about the asylum process and reception conditions, but sees no reason to expect higher inflows from other countries' policies and therefore no additional measures.
I have no reason to assume that the countries mentioned choose to paint an incorrect picture in their information provision.
Ik heb geen redenen om te veronderstellen dat de genoemde landen er voor kiezen een onjuist beeld te schetsen in hun informatievoorziening.
