The ministers reject the claim, say cooperation is good, report frequent ministerial and ministerial-commission contact, and decline further talks as unnecessary.
In response to the report "AIVD frustrates MH17 investigation", the cabinet strongly denies that the AIVD is withholding information in the investigation into the MH17 air disaster.
In reactie op het bericht «AIVD frustreert MH17-onderzoek» weerspreekt het kabinet met klem dat in het onderzoek naar de vliegramp met de MH17 door de AIVD informatie wordt achtergehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de samenwerking tussen de Haagse politie en een salafistische moskee

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked why the Hague police again cooperated with the salafist As-Soennah mosque in the New Year's Eve neighbourhood project, and whether this partnership should be ended given the mosque's views. The minister answered that participants, including mosques, act under police supervision within legal limits with no more powers than ordinary citizens, and that the local authority sees no reason to end the cooperation.
The participants do so under police supervision and within the framework of the law, and have no more powers than any other citizen.
De deelnemers doen dat onder toezicht van de politie en binnen de kaders van de wet en hebben niet meer bevoegdheden dan iedere andere burger.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht dat de krijgsmacht niet klaar is voor een situatie van oorlogsdreiging

Two MPs asked the Defence Minister about reports that the armed forces are not ready for a threat of war, including shortages of equipment, fuel, personnel and pay issues. The minister answered that operational readiness has limitations but denied a fuel shortage, said outflow of staff is in line with planning, and declined to commit to a 10% pay rise or a specific defence budget increase pending ongoing negotiations and cabinet deliberations.
However, I do not recognise the shortage of fuel.
Het tekort aan brandstof herken ik echter niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de aanslag bij een synagoge in Kopenhagen

Two MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the Copenhagen attacks, including whether they were linked, whether the threat to Jewish institutions was recognised, and whether protection would be maximised. The minister confirmed the same suspect was reported for both attacks, stated Jewish objects are targets, and said additional security measures are being taken while declining to give details.
As usual, we do not make statements about the security measures.
Over de beveiligingsmaatregelen doen wij zoals gebruikelijk geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de komst van een islamitische geweldsprediker naar Rijswijk

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a Salafist preacher, Muhammad Hassan, invited to a Rijswijk fundraiser, has links to the Muslim Brotherhood, poses a public-safety threat, and whether preachers calling for violence should be barred and mosques calling for violence closed. The minister answered that Hassan is a Salafist with an ambiguous link to the Brotherhood, that visas of three speakers were withdrawn on public-order grounds, that the foundation cancelled the event in its original form, and that closing a mosque is only possible for building-safety or drug violations or if a legal entity's aims breach public order.
The visas of three speakers were withdrawn with a view to public order, against the background of social unrest.
De visa van een drietal sprekers zijn ingetrokken met het oog op de openbare orde, tegen de achtergrond van de maatschappelijke onrust.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over maatregelen na de falende visumaanpak inzake extremistische imams

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the government how extremist imams obtained visas that were later revoked, whether individual visa checks and a blacklist will be strengthened, what steps follow against the organiser of a jihadist gala, and whether other ANBI-status organisations facilitating such preachers should lose that status. The Minister answered that the visa procedure was correctly followed, that risk profiles are being enriched and visas can be revoked on new information, that the event was not prohibited but was changed after visas were withdrawn, and that the Tax Authority can investigate ANBI status where there are signals.
In the visa granting to the three imams, nothing went wrong in the procedure.
Bij de visumverlening aan de drie imams is in de procedure niets fout gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de mogelijke overplaatsing van een Belgische lustmoordenaar en verkrachter naar Nederland

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the minister would block the proposed temporary transfer of a Belgian interned sex offender to a Dutch forensic psychiatric centre, and why he engages with a neighbouring minister on it. The minister confirmed the talks, said the transfer is not yet certain, ruled out leave and a permanent transfer, and declined to withdraw from the request.
I am pleased that the excellent performance of the Dutch forensic care sector is also noticed beyond our national borders.
Het verheugt mij dat de uitstekende prestaties van de forensische zorgsector in Nederland ook buiten onze landsgrenzen worden opgemerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het uitblijven van excuses voor de passieve houding van de Nederlandse regering ten tijde van de jodenvervolging

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked why the Dutch government never apologised for its passive role in the persecution of Jews during WWII, including inaction on wartime reports of mass murder, and whether it will now apologise. The Prime Minister's answer refers only to Queen Beatrix's 1995 Knesset speech, which assessed the Dutch stance, and to his own condemnations of antisemitism, without addressing the apology question.
Queen Beatrix's speech to the Knesset on 28 March 1995 contains the government's assessment of the Dutch stance towards the persecution of Jews in the Second World War.
De rede van Koningin Beatrix voor de Knesset op 28 maart 1995 bevat de beoordeling door de regering van de Nederlandse opstelling ten aanzien van de jodenvervolging in de Tweede Wereldoorlog.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over het bericht dat het verslag van de diplomatenbriefing geheim blijft

An MP asked why the government will not send the report of the diplomatic briefing on MH17 to parliament, even confidentially, and whether withholding it limits parliamentary scrutiny. The minister answered that the report is confidential, was given to the Safety Board (OVV) for its ongoing independent investigation, that only its gist was shared with parliament, and that findings will be shared later.
The report has been made available to the OVV in accordance with the Safety Board Act, for the purpose of the ongoing and independent investigation.
Het verslag is ter beschikking gesteld aan de OVV in overeenstemming met de rijkswet Onderzoeksraad voor veiligheid, ten behoeve van het lopende en onafhankelijke onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het voortgaande anti-homogeweld in Amsterdam

Two MPs asked the Ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Security and Justice about rising anti-gay violence in Amsterdam, including the share of non-Western suspects and whether funds should go to prosecution instead of dialogue projects. The government answered that reporting and reduced tolerance explain the figures, that every incident is unacceptable, and that it pursues criminal enforcement alongside prevention, education and awareness campaigns.

For the cabinet, every violent incident is one too many, and the message is clear that aggressive behaviour towards LGBT people is unacceptable and will be firmly addressed, regardless of the perpetrator's background.

Voor het kabinet is ieder geweldsincident er één te veel, en is de boodschap duidelijk dat agressief gedrag jegens LHBT's onacceptabel is en hard wordt aangepakt – los van de achtergrond van de dader.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de lage scores van Nederland in de ‘Index of Economic Freedom’

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Finance Minister why the Netherlands scores poorly on labour freedom, government spending and fiscal freedom in the Heritage Foundation's Index of Economic Freedom, and whether a flat tax, uniform VAT and smaller state would boost growth. The state secretary replied that the Dutch scores reflect its social security system, that the Netherlands remains among the most competitive countries, and that tax options will be considered in the ongoing tax reform.
Possible adjustments to wage and income tax, such as a flat tax, and VAT rates will be considered within the planned revision of the tax system.
Mogelijke aanpassingen in de loon- en inkomstenbelasting – zoals een vlaktaks – en de btw-tarieven worden bezien in het kader van de voorgenomen herziening van het belastingstelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over de affaire Demmink

Bontes asks about the status of the criminal investigation into former secretary-general Demmink, Turkey's non-cooperation with mutual legal assistance requests, the handling of intelligence reports and the Rolodex inquiry, the civil case against AD, and legal aid costs. Minister Opstelten answers that the investigation is ongoing with requests to Turkey still pending, declines comment on the witness statements because of the parallel investigation, reports legal aid costs of about 16,343 euro, and notes that no appeal is expected.
In that light, I refrain from commenting.
In dat licht onthoud ik mij van commentaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht dat Nederland totaal niet voorbereid is op een terreuraanval

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the Netherlands is unprepared for a commando-style terrorist attack, whether the police, defence and intelligence services should be heavily funded, whether the Marechaussee should guard sensitive sites, and whether administrative detention, a public jihad register and a ban on return for departed jihadists should be adopted. The Minister rejected the claim of unpreparedness, pointed to extra funding, Marechaussee redeployment and planned exit-ban and citizenship-revocation measures, but declined administrative detention and a public register as unnecessary or incompatible with the rule of law.
The Cabinet is of the view that a public list is not in line with the principles of our rule of law.
Het Kabinet is van mening dat een openbare lijst niet in overeenstemming is met de beginselen van onze rechtsstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht dat Nederland in het vizier is van terreurcellen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Justice Minister about reports that the Netherlands is a target of terror cells, including whether jihad is linked to Islam, whether jihadists' names and photos should be published, and why administrative detention and border interception of returnees are not introduced. The minister acknowledged the reports, described jihad as an Islamic concept with contested meanings, refused public listing of names, stated that the threat level is substantial and that further measures are underway, and rejected administrative detention while pointing to expanded administrative tools and nationality revocation proposals.
Creating an additional power of administrative detention for counterterrorism purposes is, as previously stated, not necessary in my view.
Het creëren van een aanvullende bevoegdheid tot administratieve detentie ten behoeve van terrorismebestrijding acht ik zoals gemeld niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de enorme steun van Turkse jongeren voor jihadistisch geweld tegen niet moslims

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a poll showing strong support among Turkish-Dutch youth for jihadist violence against non-Muslims, and whether there is a link to Islam. The minister disputed the Islam link, said a structural budget increase of EUR 25 million was given to the AIVD, and pointed to existing measures in the jihadism action programme, without addressing the questions on Fortuyn's remarks in full detail.
The cabinet has decided on a structural addition of EUR 25 million to the budget of the AIVD.
Het kabinet heeft besloten tot een structurele toevoeging van € 25 miljoen euro aan het budget van de AIVD.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de Oostenrijkse islamwet

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether Dutch law should restrict foreign funding of mosques and imams, and whether Austria's Islam law elements should be adopted to curb Turkish state influence. The government answered that foreign funding of worship is not to be banned in principle, that Austria's model does not transfer to the Dutch church-state context, and that talks with Turkish authorities on transparency are ongoing.
Banning foreign funding of religious practice as such is not at issue, except where it finances violence or unlawful or criminal practices.

Het als zodanig verbieden van buitenlandse financiering van geloofsuitoefening is niet aan de orde, behalve voor zover er sprake is van financiering van geweldsuitoefening of onrechtmatige dan wel criminele praktijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de toegepaste strafmaat in een zaak waarbij een meisje van zestien om het leven is gekomen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Justice about the light sentence (a community service order) given for fatally speeding into a sixteen-year-old girl, and about the defendant's absence from the verdict and the case for mandatory minimum sentences. The Minister answered that sentencing is for the independent judge, that the case turned on establishing the facts, and that minimum sentences are not desirable in general.
The prosecution of criminal offences in our democratic constitutional state is entrusted to the independent judge.
De berechting van strafbare feiten is in onze democratische rechtsstaat opgedragen aan de onafhankelijke rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Bommel, Bontes, De Roon, Thieme en Van Ojik over de tussenrapportages van de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid (OVV) onderzoeken

MPs asked whether the Safety Board (OVV) runs three MH17 investigations, whether interim reports were published, and under which ICAO Annex 13 reporting obligations. The minister confirmed three investigations, that only the cause investigation has a published preliminary report, and that the other two have no interim reports.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de voortgaande misstanden bij moskee-internaten

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether three Rotterdam mosque boarding schools still fail national quality standards, whether other schools comply, and whether they should be closed. The minister said the Rotterdam schools do not yet meet all standards but are working on improvement, that municipalities are responsible for enforcement, closure is not justified, and a bill giving municipalities supervision powers has been submitted.
It is primarily the responsibility of municipalities to assess whether individual boarding schools meet the required standards.
Het is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten om te beoordelen of individuele internaten voldoen aan de gestelde eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over geweld in en om asielzoekerscentra

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about violence in and around asylum centres, including reports of ethnic and religious tensions and the sustainability of the current asylum intake. The Secretary of State reported 72 violent incidents registered by COA in 2014, described existing house rules and sanctions, and said the government would not cap the number of asylum seekers while stressing public support and local consultation.
In 2014 COA registered a total of 72 violent incidents.
Het COA heeft in 2014 in totaal 72 geweldsincidenten geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een steekpartij in het Asielzoekerscentrum in Dronten

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the government about a stabbing at an asylum centre in Dronten, whether it shares outrage at repeated violent incidents, what measures will stop them, how violent asylum seekers can be detained and denied residence, and whether regional reception should replace reception in the Netherlands. State Secretary Teeven answered that safety is a priority with COA house rules, supervision, police involvement and consequences for asylum procedures, and that reception in the region and Dutch international obligations remain the government's starting points, without capping numbers.
Safety and liveability inside and outside the asylum centre have the highest priority.
Veiligheid en leefbaarheid binnen en buiten het asielzoekerscentrum geniet hoogste prioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de plicht voor politiemedewerkers om rittenboekjes te gaan invullen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether police officers must now fill in logbooks for unmarked vehicles from 1 January 2015 and whether this bureaucracy should be scrapped. The minister answered that the registration is a tax-law requirement to prove private use is excluded, is now uniform and low-burden, and that it will not be scrapped.
No, the trip registration of the police's use of unmarked service vehicles remains necessary for the reasons mentioned above.
Nee, de rittenregistratie van het gebruik van niet-herkenbare dienstvoertuigen van de politie blijft noodzakelijk om de hiervoor genoemde redenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het massale vandalisme in Utrecht tijdens de jaarwisseling

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked the Minister of Security and Justice about mass vandalism in Utrecht during New Year's Eve, including whether the city's 'fairly quiet night' framing was wrong, how many suspects were arrested, whether damages can be recovered, whether minimum sentences should be introduced, and whether police and prosecution need more investment. The minister said he is not yet satisfied but sees a slight decline in incidents, that the OM cannot guarantee damage recovery though victims can join criminal proceedings, that minimum sentences are not desirable under the coalition agreement, and that no extra investment is warranted as performance is on track.
I see no reason for that.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de integratie van een Nederlandse gemechaniseerde brigade in het Duitse leger

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the 43rd Mechanised Brigade's integration into the German army was finalised and why, and whether Dutch tank capability and sovereignty were being eroded after the sale of Leopard tanks. The minister replied that integration is still under study, that a small non-operational tank training unit was created, that Dutch and German governments always retain final say over deployment, and that defence cooperation does not conflict with sovereignty.
Both Germany and the Netherlands always retain the final word over the deployment of their own military personnel.
Zowel Duitsland als Nederland behoudt altijd het laatste woord over de inzet van eigen militairen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een jihadistische dreiging voor de NAVO-basis in Brunssum

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about reported jihadist threats to the NATO base in Brunssum, the link to a nearby mosque, possible closure of that mosque, and security measures. The minister declined to discuss specific threats or measures publicly, said responsibility is shared between defence, local authorities and NATO, and referred to the general threat assessment.
For security reasons I do not make public statements about threats and risks concerning specific objects and services.
Uit veiligheidsoverwegingen doe ik in het openbaar geen uitspraken over dreigingen en risico’s ten aanzien van specifieke objecten en diensten.
Antwoord van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over “noodkreet van een Nederlandse militair”

Two MPs asked the Defence Minister about a soldier's public complaint that the government is too afraid to let the armed forces defend themselves, including the ban on wearing uniforms during commuting, unarmed civilians at military gates, threat statistics, a pay rise, and budget increases. The minister explained the uniform ban as a precautionary measure given higher jihadist threat, declined to detail security measures or individual cases, confirmed CAO negotiations had started, and deferred budget questions to a spring 2015 reply.
Defence generally makes no statements about security measures, so also not about how access to military sites is organised.
Over beveiligingsmaatregelen doet Defensie doorgaans geen uitspraken, dus ook niet over de wijze waarop de toegang tot militaire objecten is georganiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de affaire Demmink

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked about the Demmink affair, including a Turkish document on entry records, the handling of security reports, costs of legal aid for former secretary-general Demmink, and contacts between officials and MPs. The minister answered that the Turkish document was passed to the Public Prosecution Service and a letter rogatory was sent, declined to comment on the content of documents in an ongoing criminal investigation, provided cost tables, and said security dossiers are kept by the AIVD and that the department does not keep records of MP contacts.
I do not comment on the content of documents that form part of an ongoing criminal investigation.
Ik doe geen mededeling over de inhoud van documenten die onderdeel zijn van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de affaire Demmink

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked the Minister of Justice to comment on testimony that former SG Demmink was under investigation in the Rolodex case, contrary to earlier denials, and on a former detective's statement that he was tasked to follow Demmink. The Minister said the Public Prosecution Service found no information confirming the testimony, and that the statements are being considered in a separate prosecutorial investigation, so he declined to comment further.
In that light, I refrain from commenting.
In dat licht onthoud ik mij van commentaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de uitspraak van de rechter die het AD in het gelijk heeft gesteld in de zaak Demmink

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the Justice Ministry would pay the legal costs of former secretary-general Demmink after a court ruled the AD's publications lawful, and whether the ministry would further investigate the allegations. Minister Opstelten answered that the Public Prosecution Service is investigating other allegations, that he will not judge any investigation, and that he would reconsider reimbursement if Demmink appealed and sought costs.
Against that background, I will therefore refrain from giving a substantive judgement on any investigation into the former secretary-general of my ministry.
Tegen die achtergrond zal ik mij dan ook onthouden van het geven van een inhoudelijk oordeel ten aanzien van enig onderzoek naar de voormalige secretaris-generaal van mijn ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het bericht “Rechter geeft AD gelijk in zaak topambtenaar Demmink”

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the Rotterdam court ruling that AD's 2012 reporting on former secretary-general Demmink was lawful changes the minister's earlier view, whether investigations were flawed, and whether a new inquiry will be ordered. The minister acknowledged the ruling, declined to judge any investigation given parallel Public Prosecution Service work, and said he would consider recovery of costs if the allegations were proven.
Against that background I will therefore refrain from giving a substantive judgment on any investigation into the former secretary-general of my ministry.
Tegen die achtergrond zal ik mij dan ook onthouden van het geven van een inhoudelijk oordeel ten aanzien van enig onderzoek naar de voormalige secretaris-generaal van mijn ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht dat België radicale moslimgevangenen spreidt

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether Belgium's dispersal of radical Muslim prisoners is correct, whether isolation and deportation after sentence would be better, and what the extent of radicalisation in Dutch prisons is. The state secretary said he cannot judge Belgian policy, described the Dutch terrorist-ward placement rules and ongoing review, stated that deportation of illegal prisoners is standard policy, and said no specific investigation into radicalisation in prisons is needed at this time.
Given the picture of the extent and manner in which radicalisation occurs in Dutch penal institutions, I do not consider specific further investigation necessary at this time.
Gelet op het beeld van de mate en de wijze waarop radicalisering zich voordoet in de Nederlandse penitentiaire inrichtingen acht ik een specifiek nader onderzoek op dit moment nog niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over Nederlandse steun aan het Jordaanse Media Instituut in relatie tot uitlatingen over Hamas

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the ministers whether Dutch support to the Jordan Media Institute was acceptable given that an article on its website praised a Hamas-linked figure as a role model, and whether funding should be withdrawn or other donors urged to stop. The minister answered that the funded women's rights project had no link to the article, the institute said the article was written by a student and has been removed, and there is no reason to reclaim funds or urge other donors to act.
There is no connection whatsoever between the article on the JMI website and the project supported by the Netherlands.
Er is geen enkele relatie tussen het artikel op de website van het JMI en het door Nederland gesteunde project.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de plannen de beveiliging van Joodse instellingen per februari te verminderen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether security measures at Jewish institutions would be scaled back from February 2015 and whether they would be increased and extended given the threat. The minister replied that no reduction is planned, measures stay in place while threat and risk warrant them, and structural long-term protection is being discussed with the Jewish community and local authorities.
There is no question of scaling back measures.
Er is geen sprake van afbouw van maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de gevaarlijke uitspraak van het Hof van Justitie van de EU dat Hamas van de terreurlijst af moet

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Foreign Minister about the EU General Court ruling that annulled Hamas's listing on the EU terrorist list, and what follow-up steps the government would take. The minister replied that the ruling was on procedural grounds only, that the listing remains in force for three months, and that the Council may re-adopt the measure or appeal, with the Netherlands working with other member states to address the defects.
The Netherlands will work with other member states to address the defects identified by the General Court.
Nederland zal zich met andere lidstaten inzetten om de door het Gerecht geconstateerde gebreken te adresseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over Marokko dat asielzoekers gaat opvangen voor de EU

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the EU paying Morocco to host asylum seekers, whether reception in the region should be prioritised over resettlement in the Netherlands, and whether an immigration opt-out is the best solution. The State Secretary answered that the government supports regional reception, that Morocco is implementing its own asylum system, that the Dublin-based right to asylum cannot be guaranteed to be avoided, and that structural solutions lie in countries of origin.
Because of the diversity of the activities and because part of it concerns staff deployment, it is not possible to state which amounts are involved.
Vanwege de diversiteit van de activiteiten en omdat het voor een deel ook personele inzet betreft, is het niet mogelijk aan te geven welke bedragen hiermee zijn gemoeid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het bericht dat een Nederlandse columnist met de dood bedreigt wordt

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked about reports that a Dutch columnist was threatened with death and what protective measures and knowledge of the threatener existed. Minister Opstelten said he is deeply concerned and had contacted journalists and columnists after the Paris attack, but declined to disclose protective measures or whether the threatener is known to police, citing ongoing investigation.
While the investigation is ongoing, I will not make any statements on this.
Lopende het onderzoek doe ik hier geen uitspraken over.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de reconstructie van gebeurtenissen na de aanslag op de MH17 in het politievakblad Blauw

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked about a Blauw police magazine reconstruction of the Dutch forensic team's work after MH17, including contacts with separatist leader Borodai, a request to Van Vliet to approach separatists, and surprise at Malaysian investigators on the train. The government answered that no direct negotiations took place, that contacts ran via the OSCE, that the SGBO asked Van Vliet to arrange access via the OSCE, and that the Malaysian presence was on Malaysia's own initiative with no concrete cooperation agreements yet.
On 21 July there was no question of direct negotiations with the separatists.
Er was op 21 juli geen sprake van rechtstreekse onderhandelingen met de separatisten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de aangifte tegen het ministerie van Financiën en antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over getuigenissen van belastingambtenaren in rechtbanken

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about a criminal complaint against the Ministry of Finance over alleged witness influencing in a tax case, the instructions given to tax witnesses, the payments to an anonymous tipster, and why the court's order to disclose the tipster was not followed. The State Secretary confirmed the complaint, explained that the 'other interests' remark referred to the policy of keeping tipster identities secret, declined to disclose the exact tipster payment terms citing tax secrecy, and argued the court's sanction did not require disclosure.

The exact agreement (including the percentages) made with this tipster about his payment falls under the fiscal confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the General State Taxes Act and I cannot make it public.

De exacte afspraak (waaronder de percentages) die met deze tipgever over zijn vergoeding zijn gemaakt valt onder de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen en kan ik niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het Britse voornemen om vertrokken jihadisten te denaturaliseren

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the Netherlands would follow the UK in revoking passports of departing jihadists, and about the government's stance on radicalisation and extremism in schools, universities and prisons. The minister replied that passport flagging and refusal procedures already apply, that policy combines several measures, and that a national reporting point and expert support for schools exist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een demonstratie van Moslimbroeders in Amsterdam

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about a Muslim Brotherhood demonstration in Amsterdam, including alleged links to Islamic Relief, the use of the Rabia sign, and whether the group is extremist. The minister answered that individuals linked to Islamic Relief may have attended but the organisation itself is not officially linked, the Rabia sign is used more broadly by opponents of the 2013 Egyptian military takeover, and AIVD found no radical or violent course for the Brotherhood in the Netherlands, with no indications of change.
In the view of the AIVD, the Muslim Brotherhood at that time did not pose a threat to national security or the democratic legal order.
Het Moslimbroederschap vormde naar het oordeel van de AIVD toen geen bedreiging voor de nationale veiligheid of de democratische rechtsorde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een vrouwenquotum

Two MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a possible gender quota for company top positions, whether she threatened one, and whether it is discriminatory and infringes freedom. The minister said a quota is a last resort to be avoided, that companies must show notable progress next year, and that she is closely monitoring compliance with reporting duties under the Wet Bestuur en Toezicht.
If this does not happen, political pressure to introduce a quota will increase.
Gebeurt dit niet, dan zal de politieke druk toenemen om met een quotum te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over winterse illegalenopvang in Amsterdam

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether Amsterdam's winter night shelter for rejected asylum seekers rewards illegal residence, whether the state should cut the municipality's fund, and how the government will enforce return. The State Secretary answered that only rejected asylum seekers qualify for a basic night shelter, that the government will not compensate or cut municipal funds, and that it will stress return in dialogue with municipalities and use detention where removal is feasible.
In my discussions with the municipality of Amsterdam I will continue to emphasise the importance of return.
Ik zal in mijn gesprekken met de gemeente Amsterdam het belang van terugkeer blijven onderstrepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over Turkse racismebeschuldiging

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Foreign Minister whether he agreed that Turkey makes itself ridiculous by accusing the Netherlands of racism, and whether he would raise Turkish-minority integration problems, Turkish-funded mosques, and the EU accession talks with Turkey. The minister said he had phoned his Turkish counterpart to express concern and reiterated that the Netherlands runs its own integration policy, but gave no concrete commitment on the accession talks, which he refused to stop.
No. Turkey is a candidate member state, negotiations have been ongoing since 2005, and are conducted according to the criteria previously discussed with the House.
Nee. Turkije is kandidaatlidstaat, onderhandelingen vinden plaats sinds 2005, en worden gevoerd volgens de eerder met Uw Kamer besproken criteria.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over groeiende Russische agressie

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked about growing Russian military assertiveness, NATO's response, defence spending toward the 2% target, and whether the Russian ambassador would be summoned over unannounced bomber flights. The government answered that assertive Russian behaviour has increased, described NATO's reassurance and Readiness Action Plan measures, pointed to a letter on defence spending, and said the ministry had already raised concerns with Russia's chargé d'affaires.
On 30 October the Ministry of Foreign Affairs conveyed the Dutch concerns about the unannounced flights to the chargé d'affaires of the Russian embassy at senior official level.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft op 30 oktober jl. op hoogambtelijk niveau in een onderhoud met de Tijdelijk Zaakgelastigde van de Russische ambassade de Nederlandse zorgen over de onaangekondigde vluchten overgebracht
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over een mogelijke moordaanslag in Almere

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a reported car collision and shooting in Almere, including whether suspects were identified, whether the shot men were arrested, a possible link to a murdered criminal, and how underworld violence spreading to neighbouring municipalities is handled. The minister confirmed the incident, declined to comment on suspects or links for investigative reasons, and explained that police coordinate across regions and that the case remains under investigation.
In the interest of the criminal investigation, no statements can be made about this.
In het belang van het opsporingsonderzoek kunnen hier geen uitspraken over worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het bericht dat de Duitse ambassadeur aanstaande zondag ook Duitse SS’ers wil herdenken

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked the Foreign Minister about reports that the German ambassador would commemorate SS members in the Netherlands, asking who attended and whether this trivialises Nazi crimes. The minister confirmed attendance by local officials and military personnel and argued the ceremony honours all war victims rather than SS members, while declining to commit to preventing attendance.
The ceremony at the Ysselsteyn cemetery is not intended as a "commemoration of SS members".
De ceremonie op de begraafplaats Ysselsteyn is niet bedoeld als een «herdenking van SS’ers».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het buigen van de kunstwereld voor islamitische radicalen

MPs asked whether the government shares concern that an artist's work was not exhibited out of fear of Muslim radicals, and what measures will protect freedom of expression. The minister answered that artistic choices belong to museum professionals, that concrete threats can be reported to police, that he sees no concrete evidence of extremists undermining artistic expression, and that current law adequately guarantees freedom of expression.
In our current legislation and regulations, freedom of expression is already sufficiently guaranteed.
In onze huidige wet- en regelgeving wordt de vrijheid van meningsuiting reeds voldoende gewaarborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Omtzigt, Voordewind, Van Ojik en Bontes over Satellietbeelden/MH17

Five MPs asked the government about reports that the Netherlands holds satellite images showing who is responsible for the MH17 downing, including whether intelligence from the US and Germany has been verified and what political conclusion the cabinet draws. The government answered that it does not comment publicly on verification of foreign intelligence and will not give a political verdict on the cause while the Dutch-led investigations are ongoing, to protect their independence.
The Cabinet cannot draw conclusions without undermining the independence of these official investigations.
Het Kabinet kan geen conclusies trekken zonder de onafhankelijkheid van deze officiële onderzoeken aan te tasten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over terrorismeverheerlijking door de Palestijnse leider Abbas

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Foreign Minister whether he condemns Palestinian leader Abbas's reported praise of the would-be assassin of Yehuda Glick, and whether aid to the Palestinian Authority will be cut. The minister rejects the letter as contrary to official PA policy and unhelpful to de-escalation, says the Netherlands condemns terrorism and will raise the issue bilaterally, but does not commit to suspending the 16.3 million euro aid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de asielexplosie in het Drenthse Oranje

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether it is reasonable that a village of 140 residents is multiplied tenfold by an asylum centre, whether residents should be able to block such centres, and whether regional reception and an EU opt-out would be a structural solution. State Secretary Teeven acknowledged the impact on residents and said reception is necessary, referred back to earlier answers on the location, and rejected an opt-out as the only structural solution, saying solutions lie mainly in countries of origin.
I realise that this has an impact on the residents.
Ik realiseer mij dat dit impact heeft op de omwonenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over gesubsidieerde Turks-Marokkaanse apartheid in een zwembad

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the minister whether he knows of, and will act against, a Amsterdam-subsidised swimming activity reserved for Turkish and Moroccan men, and whether the EUR 55,000 subsidy should be withheld. The minister answered that the activity is part of a municipal programme for socially isolated men over 50, uses a separate pool only for guided sessions, is open to all men per the foundation, and that municipalities decide their own subsidy policy within the law.
As regards subsidy policy, municipal authorities are free to determine their own position, within the applicable laws and regulations.
Wat betreft het beleid ten aanzien van subsidieverleningen zijn gemeentelijke overheden, binnen de geldende wet- en regelgeving, vrij hun eigen standpunt te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een asielzoekerscentrum in Winschoten of Scheemda

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether residents of Winschoten and Scheemda were consulted about a possible asylum reception centre, and what measures would reduce asylum inflow. State Secretary Teeven answered that municipalities decide on reception centres and on whether to hold referendums, and that migration flows cannot be fully steered, while stating measures from an earlier letter remain in force.
It is up to the municipalities to decide whether, and if so in which cases and under which conditions, a public consultation takes place on matters that fall within municipal autonomy.
Het is aan de gemeenten om te bepalen of en zo ja, in welke gevallen en onder welke voorwaarden, een bevolkingsraadpleging plaatsvindt over onderwerpen die tot de gemeentelijke autonomie behoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de vergelijking tussen joden en ISIS-jihadisten door de burgemeester van Hilversum

Two MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the Hilversum mayor's comparison of jihadist travel to Syria and Iraq with Jewish emigration after WWII was acceptable, and whether he should apologise. The minister said the mayor's intent was to argue for legal grounds to withdraw passports, that the mayor has explained himself to the council, and that the council is responsible for judging his conduct.
It is in the first place for the Hilversum municipal council to assess the conduct of Mayor Broertjes.
Het is in de eerste plaats aan de gemeenteraad van Hilversum om de handelwijze van burgemeester Broertjes te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een anti-joodse mishandeling in Arnhem

Two MPs asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about an anti-Jewish assault in Arnhem and whether they would act on an anti-antisemitism action plan. The minister said a criminal complaint was filed and under investigation, that the government is convening dialogue and educational initiatives, but sees no added value in the proposed action plan beyond existing policy.
Because of the interests of investigation and prosecution, I cannot provide any information on that.
Vanwege de belangen van opsporing en vervolging kan ik daar geen mededelingen over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de gewelddadige en  antisemitische bedreigingen door een pro-ISIS scholier

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice about threats by a pro-ISIS pupil against Jews, the safety of pupils and staff, the rise of antisemitism among Muslim pupils since the AIVD warned in 2004, and whether anti-terrorism laws such as administrative detention will be introduced. The Minister said the OM will assess prosecution for the statements, declined to discuss security arrangements in public, pointed to schools' duties and existing support, and held that new administrative measures are not necessary because the OM has sufficient criminal tools.
I cannot make public statements about the security situation of persons or organisations.
Over de veiligheidssituatie van personen of organisaties kan ik in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het aftuigen van een tiener door dertig man

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a teenager beaten by a group of about thirty people, including whether the suspects were mainly of Turkish origin and whether multicultural tensions are growing. The Minister replied that the police investigation is ongoing, one minor suspect was arrested and released pending further inquiry, the group members had varied ethnic backgrounds, and that existing local tools would be used if threats to public order arise.
Because of conflicting witness statements, it is among other things still not clear what the circumstances were and who was all involved.
Door tegenstrijdige getuigenverklaringen is onder meer nog niet duidelijk wat de toedracht was en wie allemaal betrokken waren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de aanval op een student in defensie-uniform

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether an alleged knife threat and car incident against students in defence uniform were linked to jihadist danger, and what measures would be taken. The minister replied that police found the threat report was false and the car incident was not deliberate, that no other such incidents are known, and that Defence takes staff safety seriously but will not disclose its measures.
So as not to undermine the intended effect, no statements are made about measures taken or still to be taken.
Om het beoogde effect hiervan niet te ondergraven, worden over genomen of nog te nemen maatregelen geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de grote zorgen van de Commandant der Strijdkrachten

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Defence Minister about the Commander of the Armed Forces' concerns over underfunding, NATO's 2% target, limits on possible ISIS operations, a stepwise budget plan and a 15-year vision. The minister acknowledged the remarks, pointed to a forthcoming letter on the motion-Van der Staaij and NATO summit commitments, noted some operational constraints, and referred to earlier reports without committing to a budget schedule.

As the Prime Minister committed during the General Political Considerations, the cabinet will inform the House by letter before the Defence budget debate on how it intends to implement the Van der Staaij motion.

Zoals de Minister-President heeft toegezegd tijdens de Algemene Politieke Beschouwingen zal het kabinet de Tweede Kamer vóór de begrotingsbehandeling van Defensie per brief informeren over de wijze waarop het kabinet uitvoering wil geven aan de motie-Van der Staaij
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over potentiële jihadisten op luchthavens

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether jihadists working at airports had been arrested in the Netherlands, whether Dutch and Belgian intelligence services were in contact, and whether airport staff should be screened like in Belgium. The minister answered that no such cases were known to the Public Prosecution Service, declined to comment on international intelligence cooperation, and explained that airport positions with national security risk are designated as trust positions requiring a security clearance from the AIVD.
No public statements can be made about international cooperation between intelligence and security services.
Over de internationale samenwerking tussen inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het groeiende aantal jihadgezinnen

MPs asked about the growing number of jihadist families, reported departures from several municipalities, information sharing with mayors, and passport and nationality measures against departing jihadists. The Minister declined to give municipality-level details, described AIVD and municipal information sharing, outlined the passport and citizenship-revocation options, and described counter-radicalisation communication efforts.
I cannot go into individual cases in public.
Ik kan in het openbaar niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het gegeven dat er een ‘Pietoverleg’ zal plaatsvinden

Two MPs asked the government about a reported meeting on Sinterklaas and Zwarte Piet, which organisations attended, and whether the government would oppose the 'Zwarte Piet' criticism and accept the political-correctness pressure. The minister listed the attending organisations, stated that the feast is a societal tradition with no government rule on how it is celebrated, and said the government appeals to everyone's responsibility rather than imposing terms.
There is no law, guideline or other form of obligation imposed by the government regarding the way the Sinterklaas feast is celebrated.
Er is geen sprake van een wet, richtlijn of andere vorm van verplichting die door de overheid wordt opgelegd als het gaat om de wijze waarop het Sinterklaasfeest wordt gevierd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht dat 60 procent van het Defensiepersoneel geen vertrouwen in de minister heeft

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Defence Minister whether she is aware that 60% of defence personnel reportedly lack confidence in her, whether she still considers herself credible, and when a new collective labour agreement and compensation for the WUL and AOW gap will follow. The minister acknowledges eroded staff confidence due to cuts and reorganisations, says a new cao cannot be guaranteed before the November budget debate, and declines to detail negotiation content while pointing to a structural 50 million euro allocation and a planned AOW-gap solution.
I cannot give guarantees on the timing of completion, but my aim is to reach good cao agreements as quickly as possible.
Ik kan geen garanties geven voor het tijdstip van voltooiing, maar mijn streven is zo snel mogelijk tot goede cao-afspraken te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over verijdelde islamitische terreuraanslagen in België

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about foiled jihadist attacks in Belgium, whether Dutch threat levels will rise, links to Dutch jihadists, attack counts, and whether administrative detention and loss of nationality for recruiters will be introduced. The minister said the threat level stays at Substantieel, declined to discuss individual cases or attack numbers, and rejected administrative detention for now while noting other measures, including possible reporting duties and contact bans, are being considered.
Recruiting for jihad is a criminal offence. The public prosecution service decides case by case on possible prosecution.
Het ronselen voor de jihad is een misdrijf. Het openbaar ministerie beslist per geval over eventuele vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het op vrije voeten stellen van jihadgangers

Two MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the release of jihadist fighters after pre-trial detention was not extended for three of four suspects, and whether administrative detention would help prevent such outcomes. The minister explained the court process (appeal, detention reinstated then suspended with passports seized) and said existing criminal and administrative tools suffice, so administrative detention is not necessary, though temporary measures are being considered.
I do not currently consider it necessary to create administrative detention possibilities.
Ik acht het creëren van administratieve detentiemogelijkheden op dit moment niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over Italiaanse illegalen-taxi's

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether Italian taxi drivers are smuggling illegal migrants into the Netherlands, how many were caught, and what measures are taken. The State Secretary said the number transported by taxi is unknown, about 150 smugglers were arrested (none Italian), and pointed to EU-level and bilateral measures against secondary migration.
It is not known how many illegal migrants have been transported by Italian taxi drivers.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel illegale migranten door Italiaanse taxichauffeurs zijn vervoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het wegsturen van een agent in de Schilderswijk

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a police officer was removed from the Schilderswijk after firm action, under foreign pressure, and whether officers should receive special tension training. The minister denied that the officer was dismissed or disciplined, saying his posting change was planned for training reasons before the incident, and declined to return him.
No, that is not correct. The police officer was not sent away.
Nee dat klopt niet. De politiemedewerker is niet weggestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over ebola in Nederland

Two Groep Bontes/Van Klaveren MPs asked the Minister of Health about a possible Ebola case in Roelofarendsveen and whether Dutch ebola medicines and preparedness were adequate. The minister replied that the suspected patient, a returning doctor, tested negative for Ebola (malaria was the cause), that hospitals and GGDs are prepared, and that the RIVM is pursuing experimental drug supply.
I have asked the RIVM to actively follow developments in experimental ebola medicines and to keep me informed.
Ik heb het RIVM gevraagd de ontwikkelingen van experimentele medicijnen tegen ebola actief te volgen en mij daarvan op de hoogte te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een oplossing voor de massale toestroom van asielzoekers

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the State Secretary whether the asylum system is inadequate given mass inflow, whether asylum seekers could be housed in other countries, and why the government will not push for a Dutch opt-out in EU migration policy. The State Secretary rejected the claim that the system is inadequate, rejected housing asylum seekers abroad as a general principle while allowing it in acute emergencies, and argued that migration must be tackled through joint European action.
The Cabinet stands for ensuring that persons who need protection actually receive that protection.
Het Kabinet staat er evenwel voor dat personen die bescherming nodig hebben, deze bescherming ook daadwerkelijk krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de enorme geweldsdruk op gevangenisbewakers

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about rising violence against prison guards and whether planned job cuts in prison staffing are wise. The State Secretary reported falling incident numbers, said staff safety is a condition of DJI's budget cuts, and gave no new commitments beyond continued monitoring.
The development in the number of violent incidents is closely monitored by the Custodial Institutions Agency.
De ontwikkeling van het aantal geweldsincidenten wordt door de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen nauwlettend gevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over onze ontmantelde krijgsmacht

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Defence Minister about the state of the Dutch armed forces, including whether they can contribute to fighting ISIS, the NATO 2% spending norm, and a long-term vision. The minister answered that the armed forces remain capable, that the 2% commitment will be addressed in a letter before the budget debate, and that the existing course in the 2013 policy note still applies.

As the Prime Minister promised during the General Political Considerations, the cabinet will inform the House of Representatives by letter before the Defence budget debate, planned for 12 and 13 November, on how it implements the Van der Staaij motion.

Zoals de Minister-President heeft toegezegd in de Algemene Politieke Beschouwingen zal het kabinet de Tweede Kamer vóór de begrotingsbehandeling van Defensie, gepland op 12 en 13 november, per brief informeren over de wijze waarop het kabinet uitvoering geeft aan de motie-Van der Staaij
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht Kogel voor een allochtone familie

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a report on threats against a migrant family, including a bullet delivered to their home, and how the family's safety is guaranteed. The minister confirmed awareness, said an investigation is ongoing and declined to give details on the status of the investigation or on any protective measures.
I cannot give you any information about the status of this criminal investigation.
Over de stand van zaken van dit opsporingsonderzoek kan ik u geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de islamitische bedreiging van een christen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about reports of a Christian man being spat on and threatened by Muslims, whether the perpetrators were arrested, whether Yezidis are also threatened, and what measures will prevent escalating violence linked to returning jihadists. The minister answered that a complaint was filed, no arrests yet, no indications of threats to Yezidis, and pointed to the integrated jihadism action programme for measures.
The criminal investigation has not yet led to arrest(s).
Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek heeft nog niet tot aanhouding(en) geleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over onzalige accijnsverhogingen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether excise increases on fuels yielded little or a net loss, whether fuel sales dropped, and whether the planned 2015 inflation adjustment would be cancelled. The State Secretary referred to his cover letter for most questions and said the 2014 excise revenue trend and falling sales do not justify cancelling the 2015 inflation correction.

Neither the development of fuel excise revenue in the first half of 2014 nor the trend of declining fuel sales, due among other things to a more fuel-efficient vehicle fleet and the economic situation, give cause to suspend the inflation correction as of 1 January 2015.

Noch de ontwikkeling van de accijnsopbrengst van brandstoffen in het eerste halfjaar van 2014 noch de trend van teruglopende brandstofverkopen als gevolg van onder meer een zuiniger wordend wagenpark en de economische situatie geven aanleiding om de inflatiecorrectie per 1 januari 2015 buiten werking te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de enorme geweldsterreur door Marokkaanse criminelen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of hundreds of Moroccan-Dutch youths involved in shootings and robberies, and about tougher sentencing, deportation of criminal immigrants and more police funding. The minister declined to give numbers citing ongoing investigations, said existing sentencing law suffices, rejected deportation-by-default and extra police funding, and gave no new commitments.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed me that concrete numbers of persons involved cannot be linked to this.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) heeft mij bericht dat concrete aantallen van betrokken personen hieraan echter niet kunnen worden verbonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het tekort aan politierechercheurs door liquidatiegolf

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the shortage of detectives caused by the rise in liquidations is acceptable, whether assaults go unpursued because of police capacity problems, how the many violent offences will be reduced, and whether one billion euros extra should be invested in the police. Minister Opstelten answered that police detective capacity has grown to about 14,000 FTE, that cases are prioritised by seriousness, that a violence-reduction approach is being pursued, and that he is not willing to invest an extra billion.
There is sufficient capacity available at the national police.
Er is voldoende capaciteit bij de nationale politie beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een nieuw treindebacle

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the State Secretary about high breakdown rates and falling punctuality of the IC Direct trains, the reliability of NS's Traxx locomotives, and what measures would be taken. The State Secretary answered that NS and ProRail have introduced measures including a quick-response team, new rolling stock, and periodic reporting to parliament.
I have asked NS and ProRail to periodically inform me about the progress and effects of these measures.
Ik heb NS en ProRail gevraagd mij periodiek te informeren over de voortgang en de effecten van deze maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de groep wetsondermijnende uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about an Amsterdam group of rejected asylum seekers ('We are here') that keeps squatting buildings, and whether national government should cut Amsterdam's municipal fund payments, detain or expel the group, and press Brussels for an immigration opt-out. Secretary Teeven confirmed the squatting, said Amsterdam's policy does not amount to structural undermining of the law, rejected a funding cut, and stated national policy gives no shelter to rejected asylum seekers while pledging EU-level efforts on returns.
I believe the approach of the municipality of Amsterdam described above cannot be characterised as structural undermining of the law through facilitating asylum seekers.
Ik meen dat het hiervoor beschreven uitgangspunt van de gemeente Amsterdam niet kan worden geduid als structurele ondermijning van de wet door het faciliteren van asielzoekers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over grote geldproblemen bij de recherche

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that overtime budgets for detectives were running out and that surveillance and arrest teams might withdraw their labour. The Minister replied that overtime is compensated first by time off and otherwise by money within budgets, that Amsterdam has already used much of its 2014 overtime budget, and that police capacity is adequate and must be prioritised, rejecting the call for an extra billion euros.
I expect that management and staff will jointly arrive at solutions.
Ik ga ervan uit dat leiding en medewerkers in deze gezamenlijk tot oplossingen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de angst van joodse burgers in de Haagse Schilderswijk

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Social Affairs about fear among Jewish residents of The Hague's Schilderswijk after recent antisemitic incidents, including whether extra protection and an investigation into those planning to leave were warranted. Minister Opstelten answered that additional protective measures are being taken at Jewish institutions, that no separate investigation will be carried out, and that the government will raise the issue at a roundtable on antisemitism.
We do not intend to carry out an investigation as suggested in the question.
Wij zijn niet voornemens tevens een onderzoek zoals in de vraag wordt gesuggereerd te verrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de onbeheersbare georganiseerde criminaliteit in Noord-Brabant en Limburg

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked about organised crime in Noord-Brabant and Limburg, including drug production, criminal earnings, corruption of officials and threats to mayors, and whether a national coordinator for organised crime should be appointed. The Minister declined to confirm or give figures on many allegations, noted the Public Prosecution Service does not comment on threats or rumours about individuals, and said intensified regional police capacity and existing structures make a national coordinator unnecessary.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed me that it does not make statements about possible threats against public officials.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij bericht dat het geen mededelingen doet over eventuele bedreigingen van openbaar bestuurders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over ‘Nederlands geld voor terreurorganisaties’

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of money flowing from the Netherlands to terrorist organisations, including the number of FIU reports, amounts, and arrests, and whether anyone sending money should be treated as a member and prosecuted. The Minister confirmed 108 terrorism files were reported to the FIU in 2013, said suspicious transactions do not themselves prove a crime, declined to disclose report contents, and stated that terrorist financing is punishable and that a planned extension of nationality revocation is coming.
I cannot make any statements about the content of the reports.
Ik kan over de inhoud van de meldingen geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de  'radicaliseringsaanpak' van dit kabinet

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about the government's approach to radicalisation, including meeting hate imams with mayors, the failure of the earlier 2007-2011 programme, the link between jihadism and Islam, and closing mosques or expelling imams and returning Syria fighters. The ministers answered that hate preachers are denied visas and can be handled administratively, that prior programme lessons are kept in a knowledge bank, that violent jihadism conflicts with the rule of law, and that nationality revocation for terrorist offences is being prepared.
Preachers or imams from visa-required countries who are known to call for hatred and violence are refused a visa.
Aan predikers of imams uit visumplichtige landen en van wie bekend is dat zij oproepen tot haat en geweld, wordt een visum geweigerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het opheffen van het locatieverbod en enkelband voor Volkert van der Graaf

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the minister finds it outrageous that a court lifted the location ban and electronic tag for Volkert van der Graaf, the murderer of Pim Fortuyn, and what steps would be taken against it. State Secretary Teeven replied that it is not for him to judge court rulings, noted the decision was an interim measure, and said the Public Prosecution Service has appealed and he awaits the higher court's ruling.
It is not for me to judge rulings of a judge.
Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen over uitspraken van een rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de stelselmatige terreur tegen joden in Nederland

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked how the government will respond to reported systematic intimidation and threats against Jewish people in the Netherlands, including antisemitism linked to anti-Israel demonstrations, and who pays for security costs. The minister condemns antisemitism, outlines dialogue and an interfaith meeting, explains the limits of the mayor's powers over demonstrations, and says the state covers security measures it imposes while individuals are first responsible for their own protection.

The cabinet will, as also announced in the joint statement after consultation with Jewish organisations on 4 August, take the initiative with all relevant parties to discuss the rising tensions between groups and intervene where necessary.

Het kabinet zal, zoals ook is aangekondigd in de gemeenschappelijke verklaring na het overleg met de Joodse organisaties op 4 augustus jongstleden, in navolging van verschillende gemeenten, het initiatief nemen met alle betrokken partijen om de oplopende spanningen tussen groepen te bespreken en waar nodig te interveniëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een anti-Israëlische ambtenaar op het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a civil servant at the ministry who publicly claimed ISIS was a Zionist plot, and whether such a person could pose a state security risk given access to sensitive information. The minister distanced the government from the statements, explained the official was in a support role outside the NCSC's operational work, and reported her secondment was ended and she was suspended pending possible employment consequences.
At this stage the person concerned has been informed of the intended employment-law consequences.
In dit stadium is betrokkene geïnformeerd over de voorgenomen rechtspositionele gevolgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de groei van het anti-homogeweld

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about a reported rise in violence against gay people in Amsterdam, whether it is structural, the ethnic background of suspects, and whether repressive measures should replace prevention. The minister acknowledged a modest rise in registered incidents (176 to 189), declined to record suspects' ethnicity, and restated a combined prevention and repression approach included in the Veiligheidsagenda 2015-2018.
The national police does not record the ethnic background of suspects or perpetrators.
De Nationale politie registreert niet op de etnische achtergrond van verdachten of daders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de aanhoudende antisemitische golf die ons land overspoelt

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the government about a rising wave of antisemitic incidents in the Netherlands, including a violent attack, and why they had not yet adopted ten proposed action points. Minister Asscher answered that the government rejects antisemitism, will hold a round table and an interfaith meeting, and will inform parliament on jihadism and prevention measures, but did not commit to adopting the specific ten action points.

The cabinet will, as also announced in the joint statement after the meeting with Jewish organisations on 4 August, take the initiative with all parties involved, following several municipalities, to discuss the rising tensions between groups and intervene where necessary.

Het kabinet zal, zoals ook is aangekondigd in de gemeenschappelijke verklaring na het overleg met de Joodse organisaties op 4 augustus jongstleden, in navolging van verschillende gemeenten, het initiatief nemen met alle betrokken partijen om de oplopende spanningen tussen groepen te bespreken en waar nodig te interveniëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de NAVO-vrees voor een Russische inval

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Defence Minister about NATO fears of a Russian invasion of Ukraine, the value of Russia's humanitarian convoy proposal, next NATO steps, a defence vision, and reaching 2% of GDP on defence. The minister answered that Russian forces are massed at the border, that NATO is preparing reassurance measures to be decided at the Wales summit, and that further defence cuts are not advisable, with the spending question left to Prinsjesdag.
The cabinet is of the view that further cuts to Defence do not seem advisable, given the developing security situation in the Euro-Atlantic region.
Het kabinet is van mening dat verdere bezuinigingen op Defensie, gegeven de zich ontwikkelende veiligheidssituatie in de Euro-Atlantische regio, niet voor de hand liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het schrappen van vluchten van en naar ebola-landen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked why KLM still flies to Nigeria during the Ebola outbreak while British Airways suspended flights, how the government views staff fear, and whether it will close Dutch airspace to Ebola-country flights. The minister answered that airlines make their own assessments, that the WHO advises no travel restrictions which the government follows, that screening and guidance are in place, and that closing airspace is not proposed.
No. We currently follow the WHO advice, which states that no restrictions on international traffic are necessary.
Nee. Wij volgen op dit moment de adviezen van de WHO die aangeeft dat er geen beperkingen van internationaal verkeer nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over hakenkruizen bij een anti-Israëldemonstratie

Two MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about swastika flags shown at an anti-Israel demonstration in The Hague, whether anyone had been arrested, what measures would be taken, and about rising antisemitism. The minister answered that the mayor had acted within the Municipal Act after the organiser was warned, that no arrests had been made, that a criminal complaint is being examined by the Public Prosecution Service, and that the government is addressing antisemitism with stakeholders.
With regard to the statements made during the demonstration of 12 July 2014 in The Hague, a criminal complaint has been filed.
Ten aanzien van de uitingen die zijn gedaan tijdens de demonstratie van 12 juli 2014 in Den Haag, is aangifte gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de antisemitische demonstratie in Den Haag

Two MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about an antisemitic demonstration in The Hague, including Hitler salutes, threats to journalists and calls to kill Jews, and why no arrests were made. The minister condemned antisemitism, attributed the rise in incidents to tensions linked to the Middle East conflict, referred to answers given to parallel questions, and said the mayor is accountable to the municipal council, with no commitment to new action.
The assessment of the mayor's conduct is therefore primarily reserved for the municipal council.
De beoordeling van de handelwijze van de burgemeester is dan ook primair voorbehouden aan de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een demonstratie in de Schilderswijk

Two MPs asked the ministers about a demonstration in the Schilderswijk in The Hague, including why police rerouted an anti-ISIS march, how many people were arrested, whether such neighbourhoods undermine state authority, and whether a billion euros should be invested in the police. The government answered that six people were arrested, referred to earlier answers on the policing and order questions, rejected the call for an extra billion euros for the police, and said the police have sufficient resources.
During the demonstration of 10 August, six persons were arrested.
Tijdens de demonstratie van 10 augustus jl. zijn er 6 personen aangehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over visserij-uitspraken van Eurocommissaris Damanaki

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the State Secretary shares criticism of EU Commissioner Damanaki's call for consumers to avoid fish caught with bottom-disturbing methods, and whether she will publicly oppose the remarks to defend Dutch fisheries. The State Secretary answered that the Commissioner's views are her own responsibility, that bottom trawling does affect ecosystems, that she supports pulse fishing, and that the Commissioner did not target Dutch fishing specifically.
What the Commissioner writes in her weblog is primarily her own view and her own responsibility.
Wat de Eurocommissaris in haar weblog schrijft, vind ik primair aan haar en is haar verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het bericht inzake felicitaties van het kabinet aan Erdogan met zijn verkiezing

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government condemns Erdogan's antisemitic remark comparing Israeli policy to Hitler's, whether it is aware of his record on press freedom and human rights, and why it congratulated him on his election. The Minister answered that congratulating heads of state with regular relations with the Netherlands is customary and the government sees no reason to depart from it.
It is customary to congratulate heads of government of states with which the Netherlands maintains regular relations on such occasions.
Het is gebruik om regeringsleiders van staten waarmee Nederland reguliere betrekkingen onderhoudt bij dergelijke gelegenheden te feliciteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het EU-advies om onder andere belastingen op consumptiegoederen te verhogen

Two MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about an EU Eurogroup statement urging Dutch labour tax reduction offset by higher consumption or environmental taxes, and whether the government would commit to no tax increases until 2017. The State Secretary confirmed the statement, said tax shifting is for member states to decide, and promised a broader letter on the tax system after the summer, without committing to the requested tax freeze.
Whether and how tax shifting takes place is, given the sovereignty of Member States in fiscal matters, up to the Member States themselves.
Of en hoe verschuiving van belastingen plaatsvindt, is gezien de soevereiniteit van de Lidstaten op fiscaal gebied aan de Lidstaten zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht dat de marineleiding helikopters wil kopen als alternatief voor de NH-90

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Defence Minister whether, after the NH-90 problems, a replacement combat helicopter should be bought quickly and whether the Seahawk should be considered. The Minister replied that compensating measures are being worked out, that the NH-90 problems are being addressed with NAHEMA and the manufacturer, that there is no reason yet to consider another helicopter type, and that the defence budget is part of the overall budget deliberations.
Defence is currently working on compensating measures to reduce the capacity shortfall, including the deployment of additional own Cougar helicopters.
Defensie werkt momenteel compenserende maatregelen uit om het capaciteitstekort te verminderen, waaronder de inzet van extra eigen Cougar-helikopters.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over meer dan 500 dagen geen Defensie-CAO

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Defence Minister why more than 500 days have passed without a new collective labour agreement for defence personnel, citing financial pressure and asking for a 10% pay rise for 2015.
