The minister answered that the previous agreement's terms remain in force, that delays are normal under a wage freeze, promised an study of financial problems among soldiers, and said pay talks with unions are ongoing without committing to a specific figure.
I promised your House during the oral question hour on 15 April that research would be carried out into financial problems among military personnel.
Ik heb uw Kamer in het mondelinge vragenuur op 15 april jl. toegezegd onderzoek te laten doen naar financiële problemen onder militairen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het verbod op de Morgenstervlag tijdens Veteranendag

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Defence Minister whether the government bears responsibility for the Veterans' Day committee, which includes military staff, banning the Morgenstern flag, and whether it would ask the committee to allow it. The minister answered that the committee is independent, understands the ban as reinforcing the formal character of the parade, and refused to request that the flag be allowed.
The Netherlands Veterans' Day Committee has an independent status, in line with the advice of the Van Eekelen Committee in 2003.
Het Comité Nederlandse Veteranendag heeft een onafhankelijke status, overeenkomstig het advies van de Commissie-Van Eekelen in 2003.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de militaire dreiging door Venezuela om Aruba binnen te vallen

MPs asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs about reports of a Venezuelan military threat to invade Aruba, the release of Venezuelan intelligence chief Carvajal, and Maduro's remarks about escalation, and whether defence spending should rise. The minister answered that Carvajal was released because he enjoys consular immunity under international law, that justice is autonomous for Aruba, that Maduro's remarks were noted from the media, and that further defence cuts are not advisable though any increase will be considered in budget talks.
Diplomatic and consular relations, including immunity, are powers of the Kingdom.
Diplomatieke en consulaire relaties, inclusief immuniteit, zijn bevoegdheden van het Koninkrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het hoogste aantal asielzoekers in 13 jaar

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about the highest number of asylum seekers in 13 years, including concerns about integration, welfare, police and courts burden, and whether opt-outs on immigration should be pursued in the EU. The State Secretary answered that the surge requires extra effort across the migration chain, that opening reception locations is being accelerated with local information, that Eritrean and Syrian applicants are often granted protection, and that Netherlands will not seek an EU immigration opt-out but will pursue joint EU action on return.
I also want to push ahead with a joint, effective EU approach to return.
Ook wil ik graag doorpakken op een gezamenlijke, effectieve EU-aanpak voor terugkeer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht “VS willen meer veiligheid luchthavens Europa”

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the US is pressing for tighter security at European airports with direct flights to the US, whether Dutch airports are affected, and whether explosives without metal are a threat to Schiphol. The government confirmed that only Schiphol is affected, that the threat of non-metal explosives is known and monitored with the US and partners, and that additional security measures for US-bound flights took effect on 8 July.
Schiphol is the only Dutch airport to which this applies.
Schiphol is de enige Nederlandse luchthaven waarop dit van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een veroordeelde pedofiel

MPs asked how a convicted sex offender was able to obtain housing above a childcare centre in Amersfoort and whether such offenders could be barred from child-rich areas. The State Secretary said the municipality did not allocate the home, the offender arranged it himself and the mayor was informed only after the move, and that barring offenders from all child-rich areas is not practically feasible, while pointing to a bill on longer supervision.
The mayor of Amersfoort informed me that there was no allocation of a home by the municipality.
De burgemeester van Amersfoort heeft mij gemeld dat er geen sprake was van toewijzing van een woning door de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over het bericht dat de grootste pensioenbeheerder van Nederland niet gaat beleggen in windmolenparken op zee

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the largest Dutch pension manager's refusal to invest in offshore wind farms, and the need for subsidies on wind turbines, and whether drilling for shale gas should start soon. The minister acknowledged the news, deferred the pension fund's return criteria to the fund, kept offshore wind subsidies under the Energy Agreement, and refused to start shale gas drilling until pending studies and a structure vision are completed.
As I indicated in the consultation with your House on 5 June, I first want to await all announced studies.
Zoals ik in het overleg met uw Kamer op 5 juni heb aangegeven wil ik eerst alle aangekondigde onderzoeken afwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het niet vervolgen van vluchtelingen met valse papieren

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether a Supreme Court ruling stops prosecution of refugees entering with false papers, its effect on asylum policy, the expected number affected and pull effect, and whether the government would denounce the Refugee Convention to reverse it. State Secretary Teeven answered that prosecution remains possible only after a final asylum refusal or after a residence permit is granted, the ruling does not directly affect admission policy, and denouncing the Convention is not an option.
The Supreme Court ruling concerns the criminal prosecution of foreigners for using false or forged travel documents.
Het arrest van de Hoge Raad ziet op de strafrechtelijke vervolging van vreemdelingen voor het gebruiken van valse of vervalste reisdocumenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de relatie tussen de bekostiging van de jihad en de georganiseerde criminaliteit

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether jihadists who went to Syria had prior police or prosecution contact, whether criminal money funds jihad, how counterterrorism policy addresses links with organised crime, and whether all returning jihadists should be placed in administrative detention. The minister answered that criminal backgrounds are weighed in threat assessments, that financial flows are mapped but criminal funding is often unclear, that existing criminal and administrative tools suffice, and that additional administrative detention is not considered necessary.
In line with earlier correspondence with your House on this subject, the Cabinet currently does not consider it necessary to create additional administrative detention powers for counterterrorism.

Conform eerder correspondentie met uw Kamer over dit onderwerp, acht het Kabinet het creëren van aanvullende administratieve detentiemogelijkheden ten behoeve van terrorismebestrijding, op dit moment niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een verboden vlag tijdens Veteranendag

MPs asked the Defence Minister whether the Indonesian embassy pressured organisers to ban the Morgenster flag at the Veterans Day parade and why it was banned for the first time. The minister replied that the organising committee decided in 2013 to allow only regiment flags at the formal parade, that veterans may carry the flag on the Malieveld, and that the decision is the committee's responsibility.
The organisation of Veterans Day falls under the responsibility of the Dutch Veterans Day Committee.
De organisatie van de Veteranendag valt onder de verantwoordelijkheid van het Comité Nederlandse Veteranendag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen, Segers, Kooiman, Van der Steur, Van Oosten, Oskam, Rebel, Van Laar, Bontes en Jadnanansingover mensenhandel

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Security and Justice about cooperation with Romania and Bulgaria on human trafficking, including police results, victim reception and return programmes, liaison posts, Roma victims, EU funds and border controls. The minister answered in detail on operational cooperation, joint investigation teams, return and reintegration projects, and border checks, giving substantive answers while noting that some data is unavailable.
There are no figures available on the number of people travelling from countries such as Bulgaria and Romania to other European countries, including the Netherlands.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal personen dat vanuit landen als Bulgarije en Roemenië naar andere Europese landen, waaronder Nederland, reist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de onmogelijkheid tot herinvoering van grenscontroles

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the Eritrean influx justified reinstating internal border controls, what counts as a threat to public order, and whether EU asylum and migration directives harm the Netherlands and warrant an opt-out. Secretary Teeven answered that the influx is not a serious threat under EU law, that border checks mainly target illegal stay and cannot stop asylum applicants, that the directives harmonise law usefully, and that an opt-out would need a treaty change so it is not on the table.
Migration and crossing of external borders by a large number of third-country nationals may in principle not be regarded as a threat to public order or internal security.

Migratie en het overschrijden van buitengrenzen door een groot aantal onderdanen van derde landen mag in beginsel niet worden gezien als een bedreiging van de openbare orde of de binnenlandse veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over Turkse rellen in Rotterdam

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked why only one person was arrested after riots by Turkish football supporters in Rotterdam, how costs would be recovered, and whether the riots reflect failed integration. The minister said the response focused on restoring public order, camera footage would be used to investigate offenders, damage recovery would be pursued through criminal and civil routes if damage is identified, and the incidents were treated as isolated.
Based on camera footage, further investigation will be carried out into persons who committed criminal offences.
Op basis van camerabeelden zal nader onderzoek worden gedaan naar personen die strafbare feiten hebben gepleegd.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes (Groep Bontes/Van Klaveren) aan de Ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de dreiging na een antisemitische aanslag in Brussel (ingezonden 27 mei 20

Two MPs asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about security threats to Jewish institutions in the Netherlands after an antisemitic attack in Brussels, and whether the Jewish community should contribute to its high security costs. The minister answered that Dutch authorities monitor the situation closely, that no official data confirm growing European antisemitism, that one suspect with Syria links is known, and referred the cost question to an earlier answer.
Yes, that is correct. The security situation in the Netherlands is closely monitored by the Dutch authorities.
Ja, dat klopt. De (veiligheids)situatie in Nederland wordt door de Nederlandse autoriteiten nauwlettend in de gaten gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over Nederlandse zelfmoordterroristen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about Dutch nationals who became suicide bombers abroad, the victims, their dual nationality, whether AIVD budget cuts should be reversed, and whether the threat level will be raised. The minister confirmed two Dutch suicide attacks, declined to give victim or nationality details for operational reasons, said jihadist investigations were prioritised through internal reprioritisation, and stated the threat level remains substantial with no direct change.
For operational reasons I cannot publicly address matters that could reveal the identity of the two Dutch suicide bombers.
Ik kan om operationele redenen niet in het openbaar ingaan op zaken die de identiteit van de twee Nederlandse zelfmoordterroristen kunnen prijsgeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het bericht dat Duitse agenten asielzoekers weigeren aan de grens

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether German police really turn asylum seekers back at the border and whether the Marechaussee should get the same powers. State Secretary Teeven answered that German authorities forward asylum requests to their federal migration office rather than returning people, that border handover under the Benelux-German treaty applies to illegal immigrants, and that he sees no reason to change Marechaussee powers.
Following the Telegraaf report, I immediately made inquiries with my German colleague.
Naar aanleiding van het bericht in de Telegraaf heb ik direct navraag gedaan bij mijn Duitse collega.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de zware en zinloze mishandeling van een voorbijganger

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a severe group assault on a passer-by in Gulpen and whether suspects had been arrested and whether perpetrators should always face prison rather than community service. The minister condemned the violence, said an investigation is ongoing with several suspects arrested, declined further comment for investigative reasons, and noted that the law requires a custodial element when serious assault is prosecuted.
In view of the interests of investigation and prosecution, I cannot make further statements about this incident.
In verband met de belangen van opsporing en vervolging kan ik verder geen uitspraken doen over dit incident.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over de oproep van de directievoorzitter van Vitens om de waterbelasting af te schaffen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Vitens chief's call to abolish the water tax, whether other EU countries levy similar taxes, whether tax makes up over 30% of tap water bills, and whether it should be halved. The State Secretary answered that Denmark has a similar tax, the Dutch tax replaced an unsustainable VAT measure, water prices vary by region, and a review of bottlenecks with the sector will be sent to parliament soon.
My predecessor committed that possible bottlenecks in the water tax would be examined together with the sector.
Mijn ambtsvoorganger heeft daarbij toegezegd dat samen met de sector mogelijke knelpunten in de leidingwaterbelasting zullen worden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over afgekeurde veiligheidsvesten bij de politie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police officers in Limburg were working with rejected tactical safety vests, and how often this occurred. The minister denied that rejected vests are in use, said rejected vests are destroyed, and promised new vests for the Limburg unit by June 2014.
No, this is not correct. The national police naturally do not work with rejected tactical safety vests.
Nee, dit klopt niet. De nationale politie werkt vanzelfsprekend niet met afgekeurde tactische veiligheidsvesten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over het bericht dat politiechefs zinloze cursussen en trainingen volgen

MP Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police chiefs' training courses (such as cow-hugging and horse mirroring) are a waste of police capacity and money, and what will be done about it. Minister Opstelten rejected the broadcast's portrayal as not reflecting the quality of police leadership education, noting that recent evaluations found some alignment problems and that a new, practice-oriented leadership programme will be piloted from summer 2014.
Recent evaluations (June 2013: 'Schoolmaken in de praktijk' and November 2013: 'Tussen hei en hoofdbureau') of all leadership training courses showed that this was the case in some parts.
Uit recente evaluaties (juni 2013: «Schoolmaken in de praktijk» en november 2013:»Tussen hei en hoofdbureau») van alle leiderschapsopleidingen bleek dat dit op onderdelen het geval was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over een grote criminele jeugdgroep in Den Haag

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a Hague youth gang whose members fled police, including reported help from family and others, and what would be done to dismantle the group. The Minister said such fleeing does not mean escaping view, that helping offenders would be punishable if true, and that a multi-track approach with the municipality and prosecutors is underway.
Police and justice have these boys closely in their sights.
Politie en justitie hebben deze jongens scherp in het vizier.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over het rapport ‘Metamonitor veilige publieke taak 2013’ inzake geweld en agressie tegen hulpverleners

Member Bontes asked the ministers about a 2013 report showing high rates of violence and aggression against public-sector workers in police, care and education, and whether the government would act. The minister states the government finds this unacceptable, points to a zero-tolerance policy and improved reporting, and says existing measures and municipal-led efforts will continue with six-monthly progress reports to parliament.
From the programme and the Safe Public Task expertise centre (VPT), all employers and employees involved are encouraged and supported to implement the eight VPT measures down to the shop-floor level.

Vanuit het programma en het expertisecentrum Veilige Publieke Taak (VPT) worden alle betrokken werkgevers en werknemers gestimuleerd en ondersteund om de acht VPT-maatregelen 3 tot op het niveau van de werkvloer te implementeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over het bericht dat geadviseerd wordt overvallers ruim baan te geven

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police advice to let home robbers take their loot and stay passive, from a study funded by the Commissie Politie & Wetenschap, was damaging and made citizens easy targets. The minister defended the RAAK principle as protecting victim safety and improving solving rates, and said the study was funded by an independent commission at a subsidy level of 1.815 million euro.
A victim of a home robbery may always defend himself and his belongings.
Een slachtoffer van een woningoverval mag zichzelf en zijn spullen altijd verdedigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over het bericht ‘Nederlander onder daders Nairobi’

An MP from the PVV asked the ministers whether a perpetrator of the Nairobi attack is a Dutch national, how the AIVD missed him, whether Al-Shabaab should be put on the terror list, and whether he should be denaturalised. The government answered that it has no information showing any perpetrator is Dutch, that the AIVD annual report notes support activities for Al Shabaab in the Netherlands, and that denaturalisation is therefore not applicable.
The cabinet has no information showing that one of the perpetrators of the Nairobi attack is a Dutch national.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over informatie waaruit blijkt dat een van de daders van de aanslag in Nairobi een Nederlander is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bontes over het ontkennen van het Marokkanenprobleem door de politie

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police in Assen tolerated serious disorder by Marokkaans youths in nightlife, whether the police spokesperson's denial of a 'Moroccan problem' is acceptable, and whether the police will take Moroccan street violence seriously. The minister answered that police were not present during the incident, that a report was taken and an investigation started afterward, and that local authorities determine police deployment and accountability, referring to earlier answers on crime figures.
Local authorities determine the deployment of police action.
Door het lokale gezag wordt de inzet van het politieoptreden bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over het bericht dat een hoge politiefunctionaris buiten functie is gesteld wegens het lekken van informatie

A PVV MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a senior police official was removed from office for leaking information, whether it is acceptable that he received top posts, and what will be done about leaking or corrupt police managers. The minister confirmed awareness, said a disciplinary investigation is ongoing and withheld further details for privacy and procedural reasons, and stated general commitment to integrity without concrete new measures.
In the context of the investigation and the importance of the privacy of the employees involved in this ongoing investigation, I cannot provide further information.
In het kader van het onderzoek en het belang van de privacy van de bij dit lopende onderzoek betrokken medewerkers, kan ik geen verdere informatie verstrekken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bontes over de politiechef van de regionale eenheid Amsterdam, die niet Roemeense zakkenrollers, maar smartphones het probleem vindt

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether the Amsterdam police chief was wrong to blame smartphone theft rather than Romanian pickpockets for the thefts during Gay Pride, and what will be done about Romanian criminals and labour migration. The minister acknowledges the problem, points to phone-blocking measures with providers, pickpocket teams, EU information sharing, possible unwelcome declarations by the IND, and says EU labour market restrictions on Romania and Bulgaria end on 1 January 2014 while the Social Affairs minister tackles abuse.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Bontes en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de islamitische bedreigingen na arrestatie ronselaarster (ingezonde

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister whether more recruiters for jihad should be arrested, how Islamic threats after a Zoetermeer recruiter's arrest should be viewed, whether Islam should be combated structurally, and whether jihadist recruiters can be denaturalised and deported. The minister answered that only one arrest has been made so far, rejected all threats, refused to treat Islam as a totalitarian ideology, and said citizenship can be revoked only for dual nationals convicted of terrorism.
For persons holding Dutch nationality, Dutch citizenship can be revoked if the person has been finally convicted of a terrorist offence.
Bij personen die in bezit zijn van de Nederlandse nationaliteit kan het Nederlanderschap worden ingetrokken als de betrokkene onherroepelijk is veroordeeld wegens een terroristisch misdrijf.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Bontes (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het onophoudende Marokkaanse geweld (ingezonden 4 juli 2013).

Three PVV MPs asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers how to interpret reports that Moroccan Dutch are over-represented in violent and property crime, whether mass immigration has made society less safe, and whether a harsher repressive approach and immigration stop are warranted. The minister acknowledged the high crime rates, said SCP research shows background factors explain only part of the gap, and rejected group-based measures and denaturalisation for common crimes, favouring prevention and tough action without ethnic distinction.
Revoking Dutch nationality following a conviction for common crimes is not possible.
De intrekking van de Nederlandse nationaliteit wegens een veroordeling voor commune misdrijven is niet mogelijk.
Vragen van de leden Bontes en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Haagse jihadisten vrijuit» (ingezonden 26 juni 2013).

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Dutch jihadists fighting with Jabhat al-Nusra in Syria are committing terrorist offences, whether the Hague mayor was wrong to say they cannot be prosecuted, and how society will be protected. The state secretary answered that participation is a terrorist offence and prosecution is legally possible though difficult, and pointed to intensified intelligence, enforcement and personal-approach measures referenced in an earlier policy letter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren,  Bontes en Wilders over 'Ramadandiensten' bij de politie

PVV MPs asked whether police receive extra Ramadan shifts, whether Ramadan and Eid generate more reported nuisance and crime, whether police adapt to Islamic practice, and whether extra deployment could be recovered from convicted offenders. The state secretary confirmed the news report, said police and prosecutors do not record Ramadan-related incidents, stated that the mayor decides deployment based on safety needs, and saw no reason to recover costs.
Neither the police nor the Public Prosecution Service records how many reports are related to Ramadan or the Eid festival.
Er wordt door de Politie of OM niet bijgehouden hoeveel meldingen gerelateerd zijn aan de Ramadan of het Suikerfeest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over het bericht dat dertien politiechefs meer verdienen dan de minister

Member Bontes (PVV) asked why thirteen police chiefs earn more than the minister and how the government would end this situation that conflicts with the agreed pay framework for police leadership. The state secretary said the figures are WOPT income totals not directly comparable to the minister's salary, acknowledged that five salaries do not fit the new framework, and explained that without legal means to lower them, the government can only appeal to voluntary waiver, which was refused, so existing terms must be respected for now under a transitional arrangement.
As stated in the letter of 3 July to your House, there are no legal means to directly reduce the incomes of the five persons mentioned.
Zoals per brief van 3 juli jl. aan uw Kamer is bericht zijn er geen juridische mogelijkheden om de inkomens van bovengenoemde vijf betrokkenen direct te verlagen.
Antwoord vragen Bontes en Wilders over de gezochte Syrië-ronselaar die opduikt in Shariawijk

MPs Bontes and Wilders asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether complaints had been filed three times against a jihad recruiter seen in a The Hague neighbourhood, why he and possibly others were not arrested, and whether he could be denaturalised. The minister declined to comment on individual criminal cases, confirmed complaints had been filed and an investigation is ongoing, but no arrests have been made.
I make no statements about individual criminal cases, partly to avoid harming possible investigative interests.
Ik doe geen uitspraken over individuele strafzaken, mede om te voorkomen dat eventuele opsporingsbelangen zouden kunnen worden geschaad.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren, Bontes en Helder over de Nederlandse politie als islamitische huwelijksbemiddelaar

Three PVV MPs asked whether police and the subsidised organisation Fier Fryslân helped arrange an Islamic marriage of minors, how many police hours this cost, how many Islamic marriages occur, the link between Islam and honour-related violence, and whether perpetrators should be denaturalised. The minister replied that both organisations did not assist in a religious marriage of a minor, that no data exist on Islamic marriages, that honour codes are cultural rather than religious, that prosecution was suspended in favour of mediation, and that the Nationality Act does not allow denaturalisation for these offences.
That is not correct. Based on the factual account requested from Fier Fryslân and the official police report, both organisations did not assist in a religious marriage of a minor.

Dit klopt niet. Op basis van het bij Fier Fryslân opgevraagde feitenrelaas en het bij de politie opgevraagde ambtsbericht blijkt dat beide organisaties niet hebben meegewerkt aan een religieus huwelijk van een minderjarige.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over het bericht dat een heftige tripdrug vrij verkrijgbaar is

An MP asked whether the government would ban Salvia divinorum, given expert warnings about its dangers, and whether long-term health research would be done. The state secretary answered that the risks are low, the user base is very small, and a ban is not desirable, so no research is planned.
Given the limited risks to public health and the fact that a ban could push sales into other, illegal channels, I do not consider a ban desirable.

Gezien de beperkte risico's voor de volksgezondheid en het feit dat een verbod er mogelijk toe zou kunnen leiden dat de verkoop zich via andere, illegale kanalen gaat afspelen, acht ik een verbod niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Bontes over afgebroken 100 procentcontrole op harddrugs op Schiphol

PVV MPs De Roon and Bontes asked whether a 100 percent drug control on a Paramaribo flight was stopped because passengers threatened to run amok, why it was not completed, what the usual seized weights are, and what guidelines apply to resistance. The minister refers to earlier answers on the same matter, gives 2012 seizure figures of 339 kilograms of net cocaine from couriers plus 128 kilograms in cargo, and states that the Customs service calls in the Royal Marechaussee in case of violence or threats.
In case of resistance with violence or threat of violence, Customs calls in the Royal Marechaussee.
In geval van verzet met geweld of dreiging met geweld schakelt de Douane de Koninklijke Marechaussee in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Wilders over 100 Nederlandse Jihadisten die vechten in het buitenland

MPs Bontes and Wilders asked whether Dutch jihadists fighting abroad should be detained on return in a special terrorist wing, how many hold dual nationality or residence permits, and whether dual nationals should be denaturalised and expelled. The minister answered that suspects would be placed in the existing Terrorist Wing, declined to give numbers or individual cases, said most have a second nationality (mainly Moroccan or Turkish), and described immigration measures and the possibility of revoking Dutch nationality after a terrorism conviction where statelessness does not result.
I cannot make concrete public statements about numbers or individual cases.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen concrete mededelingen doen over aantallen of individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Bontes en Wilders over de enorme toename van het aantal «Nederlandse» jihadisten

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Social Affairs about the sharp rise in Dutch jihadists, whether the government has oversight of them, their dual nationality, Islam's teaching on jihad, and deportation or denaturalisation of jihadists with dual nationality. The minister said the AIVD keeps as much oversight as possible, declined to give numbers or individual cases, noted most have a second nationality (mainly Moroccan or Turkish), and explained that citizenship can be revoked only for those with another nationality who are finally convicted of terrorism.
I cannot make concrete public statements about numbers or individual cases.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen concrete mededelingen doen over aantallen of individuele gevallen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Bontes over het bericht dat Europese superspionnen het recht krijgen om persoonlijke informatie zoals e-mails, websitebezoeken, medische data en politie bestanden in te zien

MPs Madlener and Bontes asked whether reports that EU 'super spies' would gain access to citizens' emails, website visits, medical data and police records are accurate, and whether the EU agency ENISA should be abolished. The minister replied that the report conflates a non-binding cybersecurity strategy with a Commission directive, that ENISA has no operational or investigative powers, and that the government will ensure the existing EU data protection framework is respected.
The report is not correct and, in my view, is not accurate.
Het bericht klopt niet en is mijns inziens niet accuraat.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bontes over een inbreker die een klacht indient tegen een schietende agent en de reactie daarop van de politieleiding

An MP asked whether the police leadership wrongly abandoned an officer who shot a fleeing burglar, and whether the official instruction on firearm use should be changed. The minister replied that the shooting was found unlawful due to inadequate training on the instruction, that the officer cannot be prosecuted due to a successful mistake-of-law defence, and that the instruction needs no amendment, though training attention will be increased.
The investigation showed that the agent's use of the firearm in this specific situation was not lawful.
Uit het onderzoek is gebleken dat het gebruik van het vuurwapen door de agent in deze specifieke situatie niet rechtmatig was.
Antwoord vragen Bontes en Van Klaveren over een politiesnoepreisje naar Marokko

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether Dutch police trips to Morocco, reported as a costly study trip, were necessary and whether police diversity policy was absurd. Minister Opstelten answered that the trip's necessity is tested by the Landelijke korpschef under a new Gedragscode Buitenlandse Dienstreizen, and that non-operational trips are reported in advance to his ministry.
The starting point of this code of conduct is that foreign business trips undertaken by the police must always be integrity-based, useful and necessary.
Het vertrekpunt van deze gedragscode is dat buitenlandse dienstreizen die door de politie worden ondernomen altijd integer, nuttig en noodzakelijk dienen te zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Bontes over het bericht “Misdaad loont weer, criminaliteit kan stijgen”

PVV MPs Helder and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether misdaad pays and whether the minister will raise sentences and the chance of arrest after a newspaper report that criminality could rise. Minister Opstelten said he agrees crime should not pay, disputed the report's claim of low arrest odds citing clearance rates, and pointed to regeerakkoord measures (more police, minimum sentences for recidivism, a tougher Voetbalwet) while deferring some points to later letters and referring elsewhere.

I will inform the House before the spring memorandum in more detail about how the coalition agreement measures to strengthen the police and improve the performance of the criminal justice chain will be implemented.

Ik zal uw Kamer voor de voorjaarsnota nader berichten over de uitwerking van de maatregelen uit het regeerakkoord die zijn gericht op versterking van de politie en verbetering van de prestaties van de strafrechtsketen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Bontes over het artikel ‘Drugrunners vechten met NS-personeel’

MPs De Graaf, Helder and Bontes asked whether a permanent public transport ban, a permanent police post at Rotterdam CS, tasers for NS staff, and broader group liability should follow a violent attack on NS staff by drug runners. The minister answered that a travel and stay ban bill is being prepared, that the police post will return after renovation, that tasers have no legal basis for NS staff, and that existing criminal law suffices.
A bill amending the Passenger Transport Act 2000 to allow a stay ban at stations, for example, is currently being prepared.
Momenteel wordt gewerkt aan een voorstel tot wetswijziging van de Wet personenvervoer 2000 ten behoeve van een verblijfsverbod op bijvoorbeeld een station.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de zoveelste brute mishandeling door Marokkaans tuig en de bizarre reactie door de politie

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Immigration about a brutal assault by a group they describe as Moroccan youths and about an alleged police failure to assist the victim. The government confirmed awareness of the report, said the investigation is ongoing, denied that police left the victim behind, and stated that it does not distinguish by ethnicity in tackling youth nuisance while leaving sentencing to the courts and noting that revoking Dutch nationality for common crimes is not possible.
The criminal investigation into the precise facts and circumstances of this case is still ongoing.
Het opsporingsonderzoek naar de precieze feiten en omstandigheden in deze zaak is nog gaande.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bontes en Wilders met betrekking tot het advies van de politie om rustig toe te kijken bij een woningoverval

PVV MPs Bontes and Wilders asked the Justice Minister whether police advice to watch calmly during a home robbery encourages criminals, and whether burglary victims may defend themselves and police should arrive quickly and robbers should face high minimum sentences. The minister answered that victims must prioritise their own safety and may defend themselves proportionately, that police aim to catch robbers in the act, and that prosecutors seek a three-year starting sentence raised for aggravating circumstances.
Victims of a home robbery or burglary must always put their own safety first.
Slachtoffers van een woningoverval of woninginbraak moeten altijd hun eigen veiligheid vooropstellen.
Antwoord vragen Wilders en Bontes over zakkenvullende eurocraten

Two PVV MPs asked the Prime Minister, Foreign Affairs and the Foreign Affairs state secretary whether they agree that EU officials' salaries, pensions and allowances (commissioners, MEPs, junior staff) are excessive, whether the Dutch EU contribution should be suspended until they are cut, and what the government will do. The government answered that it wants EU staff conditions modernised and reduced, that it pressed for more ambitious Commission proposals and voted against the 2011 indexation, and that it is pursuing lower Dutch contributions in the MFF negotiations, but did not commit to suspending payments.
The cabinet is of the view that in the upcoming revision of the EU staff regulations, the working conditions of EU staff should be modernised and reduced.
Het kabinet is van mening dat bij de komende herziening van het EU-ambtenarenstatuut de arbeidsvoorwaarden van EU-personeel gemoderniseerd en versoberd dienen te worden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bontes, Van Klaveren en Wilders met betrekking tot de inzet van politie tijdens de Ramadan

Three PVV MPs asked whether extra police deployment against Ramadan-related crime existed, its cost, whether police see a link between Ramadan and crime, and whether the costs could be recovered from convicted offenders. The state secretary answered that no extra police capacity is deployed during Ramadan, only capacity management of existing rosters, that no data exist on the suggested link, and that cost recovery is not warranted.
In both The Hague and Utrecht no extra police capacity is deployed during Ramadan.
In zowel Den Haag als Utrecht wordt geen extra politiecapaciteit ingezet gedurende de Ramadan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders en Bontes over het bericht "Brussel wil meer geld van EU-lidstaten"

PVV MPs asked the government, after a press report that Brussels wants more money from member states, whether it finds this absurd during the economic crisis and whether it will act like Thatcher to cut Dutch EU contributions. The state secretary replied that the Netherlands voted against the Council position, that it favours a nominal freeze of the EU budget and a substantial reduction of Dutch contributions, and that it keeps its rebate and collection fee.
The Netherlands voted against the Council position mentioned in the report.
Nederland heeft tegen de in het bericht genoemde Raadspositie gestemd
Antwoord vragen Fritsma, Bontes en Wilders over het bericht dat de EU de deur open zet voor vele vreemdelingen

PVV MPs asked why the Netherlands joins EU mobility partnerships that ease visa access for Moroccans, Egyptians and Cape Verdeans, whether visa-free travel should be used as leverage, and whether the Netherlands should leave the EU. The government answered that mobility partnerships are tailored, conditional agreements covering irregular migration, legal migration, asylum and return, that visa facilitation is not visa liberalisation, and that it will not seek EU withdrawal.
Visa facilitation is not the same as visa-free travel. The Netherlands is very reluctant when it comes to visa liberalisation.
Visumfacilitatie is niet hetzelfde als visumvrij reizen. Nederland is zeer terughoudend als het gaat om visumliberalisatie.
Antwoord vragen Tony van Dijck,  Bontes en Wilders over de berichten "De Jager moet miljard bijlenen voor steun aan Griekenland" en "Merkel pleit voor nieuwe politieke unie in Europa"

MPs Van Dijck, Bontes and Wilders asked whether the government would refuse further Greek support and reject Merkel's call for more EU powers. The government answered that the Greek loan programme is funded via the EFSF without Dutch market borrowing, and that it will respond to the Van Rompuy report on the economic pillar once published.
The cabinet will come with a response to this report as soon as it has been published.
zal het kabinet met een reactie op dit rapport komen zodra dit is verschenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes inzake de ontvoering van een negenjarig meisje

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the reported abduction of a nine-year-old girl, asking whether the Dutch Central Authority acted to return the child, whether criminal measures were taken against the mother, and whether conflicting Dutch and Austrian rulings should be clarified with Austrian authorities. The government replied that the answers are confidential and sent them by post only to the House, without giving the substance in the public text.
Due to the confidential content of the answers, this letter is sent to the House only by post.
In verband met de vertrouwelijke inhoud van de beantwoording, wordt de onderhavige brief alleen per post aan uw Kamer toegezonden.
Antwoord vragen Bontes over advocaten die blind blijven voor verdachte transacties

An MP asked the minister whether lawyers' failure to report unusual transactions under the anti-money-laundering law creates an appearance of involvement, whether measures should be taken against lax lawyers, and whether the Dutch Bar's supervision is adequate. The state secretary answered that reporting rates alone prove nothing, that supervision falls to the Bureau Financieel Toezicht and the Bar's disciplinary powers, and that the government considers current supervision insufficient and will tighten it via an Advocatenwet amendment and a forthcoming WWFT bill.
The cabinet considers the existing supervision of compliance with the WWFT by lawyers not adequate.
Het kabinet acht het bestaande toezicht op de naleving van de WWFT door advocaten niet toereikend.
Antwoord vragen Helder en Bontes over het bericht ‘Angst rondtrekkende bendes bij winkelier’

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that organised Eastern European mobile gangs are driving large-scale theft from shops, whether politicians concealed the scale of this crime before EU accession, and what will be done to recover the losses. The minister said the precise scale is unknown, denied deliberate concealment, noted a pilot for sharing camera images with retailers, and referred to a separate letter for the remaining questions.
To answer these questions I refer to the letter I sent to your House on 26 March 2012.
Voor de beantwoording van deze vragen verwijs ik naar de brief die ik uw Kamer op 26 maart 2012 gestuurd heb
Antwoord vragen De Roon en Bontes over de VN-mensenrechtenraad

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister why the UN Human Rights Council adopted a report praising Qaddafi's Libya despite global criticism, why EU members on the Council agreed, and whether those states would be challenged. The minister replied that the report only records the Council's discussion of Libya's 2010 review, that Netherlands asked critical questions, and that adopting the report does not mean endorsing every statement in it.
Agreeing to the report therefore certainly does not automatically mean agreeing with everything other UN member states have put forward.
Instemming met het verslag betekent dus zeker niet per definitie instemming met al hetgeen door andere VN-lidstaten naar voren is gebracht.
Antwoord vragen De Roon, Kortenoeven en Bontes over kandidaturen van Pakistan en Venezuela voor de VN Mensenrechtenraad

Three PVV MPs asked whether Pakistan and Venezuela are the only candidates for vacant UN Human Rights Council seats, whether their poor human rights records should bar them, and what the government will do to block them. The minister replied that other candidates exist under clean-slate arrangements, that human rights records weigh heavily but Netherlands does not state voting preferences, and that election of these two countries is unlikely to be prevented.
However, the Netherlands does not make statements about voting preferences in elections for UN bodies.
Nederland doet echter geen uitspraken over stemvoorkeuren bij verkiezingen voor VN-organen.
Antwoord vragen Bontes over tientallen vaders die jaarlijks vals beschuldigd worden door ex’en van misbruik of mishandeling

An MP asked the Justice Minister about dozens of fathers each year falsely accused of abuse by ex-partners, and why false reports by mothers are rarely prosecuted. The minister said false reports are prosecutable only when intent is provable, that the scale is unknown, and pointed to a public-prosecution policy of press statements and remedies in civil custody proceedings.
The Public Prosecution Service has no figures on this.
Bij het OM zijn hiervan geen aantallen bekend.
Antwoord vragen Bontes en Wilders over de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Pretoria

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether the Dutch ambassador in Pretoria, who had 'liked' a Facebook page opposing a government supported by the PVV, should be disqualified and what measures would be taken. The minister confirmed the ambassador should have refrained from publicly expressing such a political view, that he has been addressed on it, and that he has since unliked the page.
Mr Haspels has been addressed on this and has in the meantime unliked the relevant Facebook page.
De heer Haspels is hierop aangesproken en heeft de betreffende Facebook-pagina inmiddels «ge-unliked».
Antwoord vragen Bontes, Elissen en Van Bemmel van uw Kamer over het censureren van internet

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether court-ordered blocking of websites by internet providers (following the Brein case) is censorship, what steps will prevent it, whether compensation applies if the ruling is reversed, and why funds for internet freedom abroad are not used domestically. The state secretary declined to comment on the pending case, pointed to existing compensation law, noted that Dutch policy opposes censorship while funds are spent abroad, and said he is still considering a response to a related motion.
By letter I informed the House about the ruling of the Hague District Court of 11 January 2012 and indicated that I refrain from commenting on this case, because it is before the court.

Bij brief heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd over de uitspraak van de rechtbank Den Haag van 11 januari 2012 en heb ik aangegeven dat ik mij onthoud van commentaar op deze zaak, omdat deze onder de rechter is.
Antwoord vragen Wilders en Bontes over een brochure betaald door het Duitse ministerie van Justitie

PVV MPs Wilders and Bontes asked the foreign minister whether it is appropriate that a German justice ministry-funded brochure links Wilders' ideas to German neo-Nazi violence, and whether the government will distance itself and summon the German ambassador. The minister answered that the brochure does not make that claim, only factual references to Wilders' visit and a Facebook announcement, that the government distances itself from any reading implying he operates outside the rule of law, and that it will not summon the ambassador but has raised the matter directly with the German ministry.
No, there are direct contacts with the German Ministry of Justice on this subject in which the Dutch position described above has been stated.
Nee, er zijn directe contacten met het Duitse ministerie van Justitie over dit onderwerp waarin de boven beschreven Nederlandse positie is gemarkeerd.
Vragen van de leden Bontes en Driessen (beiden PVV) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over Julius Malema (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister and state secretary why Julius Malema, suspended from the ANC, was elected to the Limpopo provincial committee, and whether development aid to South Africa should end. The government answered that Malema's suspension is under appeal, the embassy will monitor it, aid will not be ended because Nederland works with the government rather than individual politicians, and the development relationship will be phased out as already announced.
The handling of the appeal against Malema's suspension will be closely monitored by the Dutch embassy.
De behandeling van het beroep tegen de schorsing van Malema zal door de Nederlandse ambassade nauwlettend worden gevolgd.
Vragen van de leden Bontes, Driessen en Van Klaveren (allen PVV) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over een nieuwe Nigeriaanse anti-homowet (ingezonden 1 december 2011).

Three PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister about a Nigerian Senate-passed anti-homosexuality law, a senator's call to kill homosexuals, the death penalty under sharia, and whether aid should be halted. The minister confirmed awareness, condemned the call to violence, explained that Nigeria receives no direct development relationship but Dutch and EU human-rights programmes continue, and argued that cutting aid would not help LGBT people.
The Netherlands does not maintain a development relationship with the Nigerian government.
Nederland onderhoudt geen ontwikkelingsrelatie met de Nigeriaanse overheid.
Vragen van de leden Driessen en Bontes (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over ontwikkelingshulp aan de Islamitische Republiek Afghanistan (ingezonden 9 december 2011).

PVV MPs asked the state secretary about EU and Dutch aid to Afghanistan given corruption reports, and whether all aid should be ended. The government acknowledged corruption as a serious problem, said it would keep anti-corruption on the agenda, and refused to end aid, pointing to conditional post-2014 engagement and rule-of-law programmes.
Dutch support is however not unconditional.
Nederlandse steun is echter niet onvoorwaardelijk.
Vragen van de leden De Roon en Bontes (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over systematische foltering onder de Libische Overgangsraad (ingezonden 17 oktober 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether, given the Amnesty report on torture by Libya's Transitional Council, Dutch aid would be cut under the 'more for more, less for less' principle. The minister answered that the new authorities have assured him abuses will not be tolerated, that he will keep monitoring, and that he will raise it with the transitional government and take measures if abuses continue.
If it appears that the abuses continue to take place on the part of the government, I will address the new transitional government on this and take appropriate measures where necessary.
Als blijkt dat de misstanden van overheidswege blijven plaatsvinden, zal ik de nieuwe overgangsregering daarop aanspreken en indien nodig gepaste maatregelen treffen.

Vragen van de leden De Mos, Graus en Bontes (allen PVV) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «VS laten zich de les niet lezen in de luchtvaart»

PVV MPs asked the state secretary whether the EU Emissions Trading System for aviation threatens Schiphol's hub role by pushing non-European airlines to route around Europe, and whether an independent study and joint EU action should follow. The state secretary answered that ETS is a market-based instrument rather than a tax, that a KiM study on Dutch aviation effects is underway, and that the Commission has been asked to assess EU-wide consequences.
The Knowledge Institute for Mobility Policy has currently commissioned a study into the effects of the EU ETS on Dutch aviation.
Bij het Kennisinstituut Mobiliteitsbeleid is op dit moment een onderzoek uitgezet naar de effecten van EU-ETS op de Nederlandse luchtvaart.
Vragen van de leden De Roon en Bontes (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een Jihad-oproep in Polen (ingezonden 5 oktober 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether a call to violent jihad displayed by Polish football fans is unacceptable and antisemitic, and what Poland should do to prevent it. The minister called the banner inappropriate, said it could be seen as antisemitic, and noted that Polish prosecutors and UEFA are acting, which he considers an adequate response.
The Polish Public Prosecution Service is investigating whether a criminal offence has occurred and will decide on further steps based on the results.
Het Poolse Openbaar Ministerie onderzoekt of er sprake is van een strafbaar feit en zal naar aanleiding van de resultaten een besluit nemen over verdere stappen
Vragen van de leden De Roon, Bontes en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over nog meer Europees geld voor de Palestijnse Autoriteit (ingezonden 25 augustus 2011).

PVV MPs asked the state secretary whether Europe should stop sending hundreds of millions of euros to the Palestinian Authority, which they called corrupt and tolerant of terrorist attacks, and what the government could do to oppose the subsidy. The minister answered that EU aid supports the Israeli-Palestinian peace process, that the PA cooperates with Israel against terrorism, and that the funding follows Dutch policy, without committing to any new action.
This funding is in line with the policy of the Netherlands.
Deze financiering ligt in het verlengde van het beleid van Nederland.
Vragen van de leden Wilders, Bontes en van Dijck (allen PVV) aan de minister-president over de onacceptabele voorstellen van de Voorzitter van de Europese Commissie (ingezonden 29 september 2011).

PVV MPs asked the Prime Minister whether he objects to Commission President Barroso's State of the Union proposals for eurobonds, a financial transaction tax and treaty changes removing member-state veto rights. The Prime Minister answered that the Netherlands opposes eurobonds and an EU-level transaction tax (preferring a global one), supports unanimity on certain files, and will raise these views with the Commission.
The Netherlands is not in favour of abolishing this.
Nederland is er niet voor om dit op te heffen.

Vragen van het lid Bontes (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de EU die 20 miljoen euro van haar mensenrechten budget uitgeeft om Amerikanen te doceren over linkse uitgangspunten (ingezonden 7 juni

An MP asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about reports that the EU spends 20 million euro of its human rights budget promoting left-wing views to Americans, calling it misuse and waste. The State Secretary answered that the instrument covers all non-EU countries including the US, that he agrees priorities should lie elsewhere, but sees no misuse and no grounds for specific action.
Regarding the deployment of the European Instrument for Democracy and Human Rights in the United States, I do not share your view that there is misuse of EU funds.
In het geval van de inzet van het Europees Instrument voor Democratie en Mensenrechten in de Verenigde Staten deel ik niet uw mening dat hier sprake is van misbruik van EU-middelen.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Bontes en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over gratis vechtsportlessen voor overlastgevend tuig in Gouda (ingezonden 5 augustus 2011).

PVV MPs asked the Minister of the Interior whether free martial arts lessons for nuisance youths in Gouda rewarded bad behaviour, what the project costs were, and why not harsher punishment or loss of nationality instead. The minister rejected the reward framing, said the preventive project targets beginning nuisance behaviour with costs of EUR 36,618, and stated that prosecution is for the OM and that nationality cannot be withdrawn for ordinary offences.
I do not share this view. There is no question of rewarding bad behaviour.
Ik deel deze visie niet. Er is geen sprake van beloning van slecht gedrag.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de belachelijke uitlatingen van een Surinaams parlementslid over het homohuweli

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers of Education and Foreign Affairs about remarks by a Surinamese parliamentarian calling same-sex marriage a European epidemic and urging eradication of homosexuality. The government answered that the remarks speak for themselves, that the MP spoke as a member of the Surinamese National Assembly, and that it deplores and condemns the statements.
The Dutch government deeply regrets and condemns the remarks of the parliamentarian.
De Nederlandse regering betreurt en veroordeelt de uitlatingen van het parlementslid ten zeerste.
Vragen van de leden De Roon, Bontes en Helder (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Veiligheid en Justitie over «Betalen om aangifte te mogen doen» (ingezonden 31 mei 2011).

Three PVV MPs asked whether victims in Greece must now pay 100 euros before filing a police report, and whether the Dutch embassy would advance the fee to stranded Dutch citizens. The government answered that the fee applies only to minor offences such as insult, slander, family theft and minor injury, that serious crimes are free, and that the consulate has received no complaints.
For offences such as robbery, mugging, theft or serious bodily injury no fee is payable.
Voor misdrijven zoals overval, beroving, diefstal of ernstig lichamelijk letsel is geen bijdrage verschuldigd.
Vragen van de leden Wilders en Bontes (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de dreiging van Turkije met een crisis over Cyprus (ingezonden 15 juli 2011).

PVV MPs Wilders and Bontes asked the Foreign Minister whether he condemns Turkey's threat to freeze EU relations if Cyprus holds the EU presidency, and whether he will press EU partners not to yield and will call for ending Turkey's accession talks. The minister replied that the presidency is an EU matter, that the government trusts the Cypriot presidency, that Turkey must meet the 2005 negotiating framework conditions on Cyprus and neighbours, and that accession talks are open-ended with no guaranteed outcome.
The cabinet has confidence in the Cypriot EU presidency, which begins on 1 July 2012.
Het kabinet heeft vertrouwen in het Cypriotische EU-voorzitterschap dat op 1 juli 2012 aanvangt.
Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven, Bontes en Hernandez (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Defensie over de bouw van Iraanse raketbases in Venezuela (ingezonden 20 mei 2011).

Three PVV MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about reports that Iran was building missile bases in Venezuela, and about the strategic ties between Tehran and Caracas. The government said it could not confirm the reports, noted that a closer Iran-Venezuela relationship could undermine UN sanctions and that compliance would be monitored, and described the bilateral cooperation agreements while saying it would follow developments closely.

Although the Dutch government cannot confirm that these reports are true and therefore cannot establish whether international prohibitions and treaties are being violated, a more intensive relationship between Venezuela and Iran may bring serious and undesirable developments.

Hoewel de Nederlandse regering niet kan bevestigen dat deze berichten op waarheid berusten en het daardoor niet mogelijk is vast te stellen of internationale verbodsbepalingen en verdragen worden geschonden, kan een intensievere relatie tussen Venezuela en Iran ernstige en onwenselijke ontwikkelingen met zich meebrengen.

Vragen van de leden De Mos, Gerbrands en Bontes (allen PVV) aan staatssecretarissen van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het artikel «Limburgs grondwater nog decennia vuil» (i

Three PVV MPs asked whether the Netherlands should tighten manure rules to meet the 2015 Water Framework Directive nitrate target, and whether further study or postponement to 2027 was wise. The state secretary replied that nitrate concentrations are falling, that policy changes will follow careful study, that no extra research is needed now, and that extending the deadline to 2021 or 2027 may be considered.

That does not necessarily mean that on the basis of this recent research the manure rules will be tightened in the short term merely to meet the 2015 target date of the European Water Framework Directive.

Dat betekent niet per definitie dat op basis van dat recente onderzoek op korte termijn de mestregels zullen worden aangescherpt, om maar de streefdatum van 2015 uit de Europese Kaderrichtlijn Water te halen.

Vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Bontes (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het artikel «Vissers strijden in Franse Haven» (ingezonden 21 april 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation whether he knew of reports that Dutch fishermen were struggling to sell their catch in Boulogne because French fishermen were blocking the port, and whether he would help recover their damages. The minister confirmed he knew of the report, agreed Dutch fishermen should be able to sell there, and said he had raised the extra costs with French authorities and would commission general legal advice on a claim, while stating that the fishermen themselves are responsible for claiming their damages.
I am willing to have general legal advice drawn up on the possibilities for a claim.
Ik ben bereid een algemeen juridisch advies te laten opstellen over de mogelijkheden van een claim.
Vragen van de leden Bontes en Elissen (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie naar aanleiding van het bericht «Privacywaakhond CBP schendt privacy» (ingezonden 26 april 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice whether it was scandalous that the data protection authority CBP published privacy-sensitive address data in a report on Google, and whether he would hold it to account or investigate its working methods. The State Secretary answered that the CBP had anonymised the report immediately, apologised to the affected persons, and that he considered this an adequate response, with the CBP able to draw its own lessons.
I consider that an adequate response, and I regard the CBP as sufficiently capable of drawing the right lessons from this incident itself to prevent a repetition.
Ik vind dat een adequate reactie en acht het CBP voldoende in staat uit dit incident zelf de juiste lessen te trekken om herhaling te voorkomen.
Vragen van het lid Bontes (PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Slachtoffer met letsel in de kou» (ingezonden 10 maart 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a report showing insurers delaying compensation for injured victims justifies binding rules, such as a statutory code, a complaints tribunal and a quality mark requirement. The minister acknowledged the delays, placed primary responsibility on the injury-claims sector and its voluntary Gedragscode, and declined new legislation, a special complaints committee or extra quality-mark conditions, pointing to existing complaint routes.
I therefore see no reason to set further requirements for the Quality Mark.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om nadere eisen te stellen aan het Keurmerk.

Vragen van de leden De Roon en Bontes (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de band van de Venezolaanse minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Justitie met Hezbollah (ingezonden 15 februari 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about reported ties between Venezuela's interior minister and Hezbollah, including whether Venezuelan passport holders should be screened and whether the minister's sister, newly appointed ambassador to the Netherlands, is acceptable. The minister denied knowledge of supporting facts, said Venezuelan passport holders already undergo standard checks, and explained that agrément is granted absent grounds such as human rights violations, terrorism or espionage, none of which applied.
Because none of this applies in the case of Ms Aissami, she received agrément in the usual way.
Omdat hiervan in het geval van mevrouw Aissami geen sprake is, heeft zij op de gebruikelijke wijze agrément ontvangen.
Vragen van de leden De Roon en Bontes (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over aanvallen van moslims op christenen in Ethiopië (ingezonden 8 maart 2011).

PVV MPs De Roon and Bontes asked the foreign minister about attacks by Muslims on Christians in Ethiopia and whether the Netherlands would raise this internationally and with the Ethiopian government. The minister confirmed the Jimma-zone attacks, described Dutch efforts on religious freedom at the EU and UN Human Rights Council, and said Ethiopian authorities had responded adequately so no further pressure was needed.
I therefore currently see no need to press the Ethiopian government for additional protection.
Ik zie derhalve op dit moment geen noodzaak om bij de Ethiopische regering aan te dringen op extra bescherming.
Vragen van het lid Bontes (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over Vinex-wijk getto van de toekomst (ingezonden 23 februari 2011).

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Interior whether Vinex neighbourhoods becoming problem areas (harassment, nuisance, crime) can be solved without subsidies to municipalities, whether zero tolerance is needed, and for a breakdown of nationalities of those causing nuisance. The minister answers that municipalities have many tools, cites the Gemeentefonds funds for urban renewal, says a combination of preventive and repressive measures is needed, and declines to provide nationality data because he has no insight into individual residents' nationalities.
I have no insight into the nationality of individual residents of neighbourhoods in Dutch cities and villages.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de nationaliteit van individuele bewoners van wijken in Nederlandse steden en dorpen.

Vragen van de leden De Roon en Bontes (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het uitroepen van dag van staatsgreep door Bouterse als Surinaamse nationale feestdag (ingezonden 10 februari 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether the Netherlands would condemn Surinamese president Bouterse's declaration of the 1980 coup anniversary as a national holiday, boycott the celebration, lower flags at the embassy, and urge other missions to do the same. The minister answered that the Netherlands rejects seizing power undemocratically, that Surinam decides its own holidays, that the Netherlands will not take part in the celebration, and that the embassy will open normally with no special flag protocol.
However, it is for the Surinamese government to determine which days are designated as national holidays.
Het is evenwel aan de Surinaamse overheid om te bepalen welke dagen als nationale feestdag worden aangemerkt.
Vragen van de leden De Roon, Kortenoeven, Bontes en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een rapport van «EU-diplomaten» over Jeruzalem (ingezonden 14 januari 2011).

Four PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether he would distance the Netherlands from an EU diplomats' report suggesting East Jerusalem be treated as a Palestinian capital, and whether Dutch diplomats contributed to it and whether the report should be discarded. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports a two-state solution with Jerusalem's final status left to negotiation, that the report was largely factual with options the Netherlands endorsed only where they maintained existing policy, and that Dutch contributions followed government policy and distanced the Netherlands from calls contrary to it.
Options that anticipate the outcomes of the final status negotiations have not been supported by the Netherlands.
Opties die vooruitlopen op de uitkomsten van de finalestatusonderhandelingen zijn niet door Nederland ondersteund.
Vragen van de leden Bontes en Driessen (beiden PVV) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de moord op de Ugandese homo-activist David Kato (ingezonden 28 januari 2011).

PVV MPs Bontes and Driessen asked the foreign minister whether the government shares outrage at the murder of Ugandan gay rights activist David Kato, whether it will put political pressure on Uganda to improve the position of homosexuals, and whether it will halt all development aid except emergency aid. The minister answered that the government is shocked, that the issue is raised in bilateral and EU dialogue and that donors pressed for protection of activists, but that stopping aid would not help the position of homosexuals.

The Netherlands will continue to hold the Ugandan authorities accountable for their responsibility to protect the rights of sexual minorities and press for a vigorous criminal investigation into the murder of David Kato.

Nederland zal de Ugandese autoriteiten blijven aanspreken op hun verantwoordelijkheid bij het beschermen van de rechten van seksuele minderheden en aandringen op voortvarend strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar de moord op David Kato.

Vragen van de leden Bontes, Kortenoeven en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het door moslims op Kerstavond aangerichte bloedbad tegen christenen in Nigeria (ingezonden 4 januari 2011).

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether the Christmas Eve killings of Christians in Nigeria were part of a global Islamic war, whether they could be called genocide, and what action was being taken. The minister rejected the global-war framing, said the attacks were claimed by Boko Haram and are under investigation, stated the genocide definition is not met, and listed EU and Dutch measures such as calls for prosecutions and support for a conflict-management centre.
Regarding the qualification 'genocide', I refer to the definition of genocide in the 1948 Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of the Crime of Genocide.
Ten aanzien van de kwalificatie «volkerenmoord» verwijs ik graag naar de definitie van genocide zoals opgenomen in het Verdrag inzake de Voorkoming en de Bestraffing van Genocide uit 1948.

Vragen van de leden Elissen, Fritsma, Kortenoeven en Bontes (allen PVV) aan de ministers voor Immigratie en Asiel en van Veiligheid en Justitie, Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de

PVV MPs asked whether members of terrorist organisations should be denied or stripped of refugee status, citing a 2010 EU Court ruling and asking for screening and a revised EU directive. The government answered that the AIVD and IND can refuse or revoke status for national-security risks or serious non-political crimes after individual assessment, that mere membership is not enough, and that the current Qualification Directive already allows denying residence to those actually involved in terrorism.
The EU Court of Justice holds that a person who belonged to an organisation using terrorist methods can only be excluded from refugee status after an individual examination.

Het Hof van Justitie van de EU overweegt dat een persoon die heeft behoord tot een organisatie die terroristische methoden toepast, slechts van de vluchtelingenstatus kan worden uitgesloten na een individueel onderzoek.

Vragen van de leden Bontes, Van Klaveren en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de bouw van twee moskeeën voor illegalen in Athene onder andere gefinancierd door Nederlandse belastingb

Three PVV MPs asked whether an EU emergency fund finances two mosques for illegal immigrants in Athens with Dutch taxpayers' money, and how such a decision was made. The State Secretary replied that the report is largely incorrect: only one mosque was approved by Greek law in 2006, funded from Greek national budget, not from the EU fund or Dutch taxes.
No Dutch taxpayers' money is being spent on the construction of the mosque.
Aan de bouw van de moskee wordt geen Nederlands belastinggeld besteed.
Vragen van het lid Bontes (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse zaken over «Turkse regering doet een Khadaffi» (ingezonden 30 november 2010).

An MP asked the foreign minister whether Turkey proposed accepting refugees in exchange for easier EU visa rules, whether this amounts to blackmail, and what action the government would take. The minister answered that the visa question and the readmission agreement negotiations are separate technical matters, that visa liberalisation is not on the table, and that Turkey must meet all conditions first.
There is no direct link between Turkey's call for easier visa issuance and the negotiations on a Readmission Agreement.
Er is geen direct verband tussen het Turkse pleidooi voor versoepelde visumverlening en de onderhandelingen over een Terug- en Overnameovereenkomst.

Vragen van de leden Bontes en Driessen (beiden PVV) aan de aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de uithaal van de premier van Kenia naar homomannen (ingezonden 6 december 2010).

PVV MPs asked whether the minister is aware of reports that Kenya's prime minister called for arrest of gay men, whether they share outrage, and whether all development aid except emergency aid should be halted. The government answers that the prime minister has clarified his remarks, that it sees no reason for bilateral steps, and that bilateral aid flows through civil society rather than the Kenyan government.
We are of the view that the Kenyan government has already convincingly corrected the picture painted in the media and see no reason for bilateral steps.
Wij zijn van mening dat de Keniaanse regering het in de media geschetste beeld al overtuigend heeft rechtgezet en zien geen reden voor bilaterale stappen.

Vragen van de leden Wilders, Kortenoeven en Bontes (allen PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de beschuldiging van de Turkse premier Recep Tayyip Erdoğan dat Europa verantwoordelijk is voor de bomaanslag die

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister how he assesses Turkish PM Erdogan's claim that Europe supports terrorist organisations and is responsible for the Istanbul bombing, and whether he will rebut it and whether Turkey should never join the EU. The minister replied that the government does not share the accusation, has no evidence Turkey supports terrorism, will keep cooperating with Turkey on counter-terrorism, and that the membership perspective stands conditional on reforms.
The government has no indications that the Turkish government supports terrorism.
De regering beschikt niet over aanwijzingen dat de Turkse regering terrorisme zou steunen.

Vragen van de leden Driessen en Bontes (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over ontwikkelingshulp van de Europese Unie (EU) aan de schurkenstaten Zimbabwe, Somalië, Libië, Syrië, Iran en Myanmar (

PVV MPs Driessen and Bontes asked the state secretary why the EU gives development aid to Zimbabwe, Somalia, Libya, Syria, Iran and Myanmar, and questioned the amounts and whether the EU should stop such aid. The state secretary rejected the premise that the EU supports bad regimes, detailed the aid and its purposes, gave Dutch-share estimates, and said the country list would be reviewed for the next EU financial framework without committing to stop aid to these states.

With a view to preparing the new Financial Perspectives 2014–2020, I do intend to review the list of countries to which the EU gives development aid together with the Commission and other European partners.

Met het oog op de voorbereiding van de nieuwe Financiële Perspectieven 2014–2020 ben ik overigens wel van plan om de lijst van landen waaraan de EU ontwikkelingshulp verleent samen met de Commissie en andere Europese partners tegen het licht te houden.
Vragen van de leden Bontes en Driessen (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «EU grants Egypt 609 million euros for development» (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about the EU granting Egypt 609 million euros for development, questioning whether the EU should give aid, how much the Dutch taxpayer contributes, and whether the aid and bilateral aid should be stopped given rights abuses and military spending. The state secretary defended EU development cooperation as serving shared interests, estimated the Dutch share at about 30.45 million euros (5%), and refused to reverse the grant, citing its legal basis.
No. Support to Egypt from the EU budget has a legal basis, namely Regulation (EC) No 1638/2006.
Neen. De steun aan Egypte uit de EU-begroting heeft een wettelijke basis, te weten de Verordening (EG) nr. 1638/2006

Vragen van de leden Elissen en Bontes (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Justitie, van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «Hulp dekmantel voor terreur» (ingezonden 13 sept

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Justice, Interior and Foreign Affairs about the EU terrorist listing of Al-Aqsa, the Dutch decision to withdraw its national sanctions regime, and measures against fundraising for Hamas-linked groups. The government explained the withdrawal for regulatory consistency, noted the court ruling against the EU listing, said the national procedure was adapted in April 2010, and described existing anti-terror-financing measures while declining to report on ongoing investigations.
No statements are made about investigations carried out in this area, in the interest of those investigations.
Over onderzoeken die op dit vlak worden gedaan, worden in het belang van deze onderzoeken geen mededelingen gedaan.
Vragen van de leden Driessen en Bontes (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat de EU haar hulp aan Afghanistan bevriest (ingezonden 15 juli 2010).

PVV MPs Driessen and Bontes asked the foreign minister whether he agreed that corruption in Afghanistan is rampant and whether he would suspend aid as the EU reportedly did.
