Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Otwin van Dijk over het bericht «Meer regeldruk dreigt door transitieplannen»

MPs Ypma and Otwin van Dijk asked the State Secretary for Health about Actal's warning that transition plans for youth and long-term care risk increasing red tape, and whether concrete agreements to reduce it are made. The State Secretary answered that the decentralisations are expected to cut regulatory burden by about EUR 20 million, that agreements to remove rules and standardise data requests are included, and that a monitoring commitment with municipalities will follow from 2015, while not adopting all of Actal's recommendations as such.
Question 4: Are you willing to follow the four recommendations of Actal, including concrete agreements that should be made to reduce regulatory burden and bureaucracy?
Vraag 4 Bent u bereid de vier aanbevelingen van Actal op te volgen, waaronder concrete afspraken die gemaakt dienen te worden om regeldruk en bureaucratie te verminderen?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over de positie van cluster 1 en 2 leerlingen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Education about worries that visually, hearing and communication-impaired pupils will lose support in regular schools from August 2014, including the independence and uniformity of assessment committees, parents' remedies, and funding. The State Secretary answered that cluster 1 and 2 institutions take on a statutory support duty with full budgets, that committees are legally composed, that the government will not impose uniform admission conditions but will monitor referrals, and that parents can object or use the national dispute committee.
In the coming years the number of referrals to cluster 1 and 2 institutions and the support arrangements in regular education will be monitored.
De komende jaren zal het aantal verwijzingen naar de instellingen cluster 1 en 2 en de ondersteuningsarrangementen in het regulier onderwijs worden gevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Recourt over meer vechtscheidingen door het verplichte ouderschapsplan

MPs Ypma and Recourt asked whether the mandatory parenting plan causes more high-conflict divorces and what support children in such divorces receive. The government says no study shows the parenting plan causes more conflict, describes existing child support and planned early-signalling pilots, and points to parents' and their networks' responsibility.
I am not aware of any research on the basis of which it can be concluded that the parenting plan causes more high-conflict divorces.
Mij is geen onderzoek bekend op basis waarvan de conclusie kan worden getrokken dat het ouderschapsplan voor meer vechtscheidingen zorgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Ypma over het bericht ‘Schoolrendement belangrijker dan leerling’

MPs Jadnanansing and Ypma asked the minister whether school selection hurdles that deny pupils from lower socio-economic backgrounds a fair chance are acceptable, and whether additional entrance tests at secondary schools are unlawful given a prior motion. The minister acknowledged that selection mechanisms must not be misused, promised a fuller policy response to the Onderwijsraad advice before summer, and deferred the question on additional tests to earlier answers.
A detailed description of our policy on easing transitions and access to the various types of education will be sent to you before the summer as a policy response to the Onderwijsraad advice.

Een uitvoerige beschrijving van ons beleid op de versoepeling van overgangen en toegankelijkheid van en naar de diverse onderwijssoorten, zullen wij u voor de zomer aanbieden als beleidsreactie op het advies van de Onderwijsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Ypma over de uitzending ‘Dit is de dag – onderzoek’ en de berichten in de Telegraaf over daders van kindermishandeling

MPs Bergkamp and Ypma asked why child abuse complaints rarely lead to prosecution, how effective the policy is, and whether pleaders receive follow-up support. Minister Opstelten answered with registration figures, outlined existing protocols, a planned OM directive on forensic expertise, and promised a progress report and midterm review.
I will inform you of the outcomes in the next progress report.
Ik bericht u over de uitkomsten in de eerstvolgende voortgangsrapportage.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over de wens vanuit het voortgezet onderwijs (vo) om een toelatingstoets in te voeren ter omzeiling van het schooladvies

An MP asked the state secretary whether secondary schools may use entrance tests to override the primary school recommendation, and how the Ypma motion banning such tests will be implemented and enforced. The state secretary answered that rules are being amended so the recommendation is leading and the eindtoets is the only permitted second opinion, with inspectorate monitoring from next year.
I will ask the Inspectorate of Education to include this in its supervision of compliance with laws and regulations from next year.
Ik zal de Inspectie van het Onderwijs vragen om dit vanaf volgend jaar mee te nemen in haar toezicht op de naleving van de wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Ypma over het niet baggeren van de gekanaliseerde Hollandsche IJssel door Rijkswaterstaat

MPs Jacobi and Ypma asked the minister why Rijkswaterstaat handed over the Gekanaliseerde Hollandsche IJssel to Hoogheemraadschap De Stichtse Rijnlanden without dredging, and whether combined sanitation and maintenance dredging could save costs. The minister confirmed the handover and the EUR 37.5 million lump sum, said sanitation dredging was decoupled and is under joint investigation, and called it worth considering that HDSR undertake the combined dredging.
To allow the GHIJ to be transferred quickly, it was decided at the end of 2012 to decouple the sanitation of the riverbed below the required depth from the December 2012 transfer.
Omwille van het snel kunnen overdragen van de GHIJ is eind 2012 besloten om het saneren van de waterbodem onder de leggerdiepte te ontkoppelen van de overdracht van december 2012.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over de afwijzing van coöperatie-scholen

MP Ypma asked the State Secretary for Education why a cooperative of small schools was rejected, and why the cooperative is not seen as a useful form of cooperation for keeping village schools open in shrinking areas. The State Secretary answered that parts of the plan are welcome and can proceed under current rules or through his own projects, but he cannot support placing schools in a cooperative to evade closure norms, reopening a closed school, or moving schools away from their boards, and he sent his letter to the initiators.
I hereby send you the letter that I sent to Mr S. H.
Ik stuur u hierbij de brief die ik aan de heer S. H. heb verzonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Ypma over het bericht “Scholen niet blij met vergelijkingssite”

MPs Jadnanansing and Ypma asked the State Secretary for Education about criticism that the new school comparison website scholenopdekaart.nl is a confusing mass of data, the cost of Vensters PO compared with MBO Transparant, and whether data is openly available and SchoolInfo falls outside Wob and SLOA. The State Secretary rejected the criticism, explained the costs and the public nature of the data, confirmed SchoolInfo is outside Wob and SLOA, and promised a separate letter on transparency in spring.
In a separate letter to the House, which I will send you this spring, I will set out my vision on transparency and thereby also on Vensters voor Verantwoording PO and VO.
In een aparte brief aan uw Kamer, die ik u dit voorjaar toezend, zal ik mijn visie op transparantie en daarmee ook op Vensters voor Verantwoording PO en VO uiteen zetten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ypma over het oneigenlijk gebruik van de fusiecompensatieregeling

An MP asked the state secretary whether schools abuse the merger compensation scheme by merging with a small village school and then closing it, and what measures would prevent this. The state secretary denied knowledge of such signals, said closure by merger is not itself abuse, did not know how many of the 95 merged schools closed a site, and promised to act and reclaim funds if misuse is found.
If it turns out that misuse or improper use of the merger compensation scheme occurs, I will take appropriate measures and reclaim unlawfully obtained funding.
Als blijkt dat zich misbruik of oneigenlijk gebruik van de fusiecompensatieregeling voordoet, zal ik treffende maatregelen nemen en onrechtmatig verkregen bekostiging terugvorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over het feit dat scholen en gemeenten niet gezamenlijk kunnen investeren in nieuwe schoolgebouwen

An MP asks whether schools and municipalities can jointly invest in new school buildings, given the transfer of 256 million euro from the municipal fund to school lump sums and the ban on school boards investing in construction. The State Secretary answers that municipalities are autonomous in spending, that school boards may not spend lump-sum funds on construction, and that he is willing to explore conditional exceptions if the PO-Raad and VNG reach agreement.
If the PO-Raad and the VNG can reach agreements on these matters, I am willing to explore the possibilities of giving school boards room to deploy funds.
Als de PO-Raad en de VNG over deze zaken tot afspraken kunnen komen, ben ik bereid de mogelijkheden te onderzoeken om schoolbesturen de ruimte te geven om middelen in te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Ypma over het bericht dat een school in Zwolle is gesloten vanwege de vondst van asbest

MPs Leenders and Ypma asked whether a Zwolle school closed over asbest exposed pupils and staff, and how many schools have completed asbestos inventories. The state secretary answered that no one was exposed, air and adhesive samples were clean, 64% of pre-1994 school buildings are inventoried for asbestos, and referred to an earlier letter for the action on other schools.
There has been no health risk for pupils or staff.
Er is geen gezondheidsrisico geweest voor leerlingen of het personeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over de besteding van achterstandsgelden in het onderwijs

An MP asked the state secretary about how education disadvantage funding is distributed, including the Education Council's call to base allocation on parental education and origin, and about transparency and effectiveness. The state secretary said funding continues, will be reviewed for a new allocation model by year end, schools will be encouraged to account more, and effectiveness research is ongoing.
I aim to use, in such a model, data collected outside the school.
Ik streef erna om in een dergelijk model gebruik te maken van gegevens die buiten de school om verzameld worden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ypma en Rebel over het bericht dat ziekenhuizen blind zijn voor geweld tegen kinderen

MPs Ypma and Rebel asked the state secretary for Health whether hospitals miss many child abuse cases, why hospitals report too little, and about implementing the mandatory child check in emergency departments. The state secretary answered that hospital reports to the AMK have risen sharply, pointed to the new mandatory reporting code and sector norm, and said the inspectorate will enforce compliance and that a baseline measurement and 2015 evaluation of the child check are planned.
In addition, the IGZ supervises the introduction of the child check as a statutory minimum requirement of the reporting code within its regular oversight.
Daarnaast ziet de IGZ toe op invoering van de kindcheck als wettelijke minimumeis van de meldcode bij haar reguliere toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Mohandis over opleidingen die studenten met autisme weigeren

MPs Ypma and Mohandis asked about vocational and higher education institutions refusing students with autism, and the government's support for students with disabilities. The minister said the inspectorate had received no reports from institutions, that Start Foundation had about 100 unverified reports, and that the Equal Treatment Commission had handled only four cases, all in vocational education.
For now it is not known whether higher education institutions have refused admission to autistic students.
Vooralsnog is niet bekend of ho-instellingen autistische studenten niet hebben toegelaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Ypma over problemen met de ouderbijdrage in het onderwijs

MPs Jasper van Dijk (SP) and Ypma (PvdA) asked the state secretary about a news report on schools charging high parental contributions that deter poorer families, and about segregation. The state secretary answered that the contribution must be voluntary and that the inspectorate enforces this, but declined to cap contributions or to set a fixed enrolment date, leaving segregation to local authorities.
Where the inspectorate finds that schools do not comply with this statutory requirement, the inspectorate acts to enforce it.
Daar waar de inspectie constateert dat scholen zich niet aan deze wettelijke vereiste houden, treedt de inspectie handhavend op.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Ypma over de administratie van instellingen in het onderwijs

Two MPs asked the state secretary for Education about irregularities in the school registry (BRIN) and whether schools can reclassify branches to avoid the regional planning procedure, plus the validity of diplomas issued under a different school name. The state secretary denied that the registry is generally unreliable, said schools must report changes and that main branches can be reclassified only through the regional plan or merger rules, and declined to invalidate diplomas, while promising to address a legal gap and to remind schools of diploma rules.
In my policy response to the evaluation of facilities planning I announce that I will repair this omission in the law, namely 'what happens when the main branch is closed and the branch is not'.

In mijn beleidsreactie op de evaluatie voorzieningenplanning kondig ik aan deze omissie in de wet, namelijk «wat gebeurt er als de hoofdvestiging gesloten wordt en de nevenvestiging niet», te repareren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Yücel en Ypma over het bericht dat allochtone leerlingen vaak niet welkom zijn op een 'witte school'

MPs Yücel and Ypma asked whether primary schools refuse ethnic minority pupils and what the government will do about it and about school segregation. The state secretary said the small study does not support the conclusion, that OCW has no data showing ethnic background plays a role in admissions, that further research and dialogue with school boards are not needed, and that segregation is tackled locally with quality measures.
No such conclusion can be drawn from the small-scale study.
Uit het kleinschalige onderzoek kan deze conclusie niet worden getrokken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ypma en Jadnanansing inzake het adviesrapport van de Kinderombudsman Van leerplicht naar leerrecht

MPs Ypma and Jadnanansing asked the state secretary for Education how to tackle thousands of truant children, including the Children's Ombudsman's view that the system is too rigid, that passend onderwijs does not solve the problem, and whether a jeugdregisseur with binding authority is needed. The state secretary agreed flexible solutions are needed, pointed to existing leerplicht exemptions and the coming zorgplicht under passend onderwijs, and rejected statutory binding authority for a regisseur in favour of local cooperation.
Statutorily regulated binding authority does not, in my view, fit a system that offers room for local tailoring.
Een wettelijk geregelde doorzettingsmacht vind ik niet passen in een systeem waarin ruimte voor lokaal maatwerk wordt geboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over het versterken van operationele vaardigheden op de werkvloer na de transitie jeugdzorg

Ypma (PvdA) asked how knowledge from specialist centres can be translated into practical tools and reach frontline professionals such as teachers and municipal staff after the youth care transition. The state secretary replied that existing knowledge institutes, ZonMw programmes and municipal networks already share and disseminate knowledge, and promised an inventory of gaps with ZonMw whose results would be shared with the House later.
I would gladly inform you of the outcomes of this ZonMw programme in due course.
Over de uitkomsten van dit programma van ZonMw wil ik u t.z.t. graag informeren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ypma en Jadnanansing over de uitspraak van het College voor de Rechten van de Mens over het gebruik van de formulekaart bij dyscalculie

MPs Ypma and Jadnanansing asked the state secretary of Education about the College voor de Rechten van de Mens ruling that a dyscalculia student should be allowed a formula card at the wiskunde exam, which the College voor Examens had refused. The secretary answers that a formula card is acceptable only if it does not replace required understanding or exam requirements, that the CvE will advise schools at the start of next year, and that a limited card was arranged for the student.
The CvE will advise schools at the start of the next course year on the use of a formula card and the rules that apply to it at the central exams.
Het CvE zal scholen aan het begin van het volgende cursusjaar adviseren over het gebruik van een formulekaart en de regels die daartoe gelden bij de centrale examens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over de positie van het openbaar onderwijs binnen samenwerkingsscholen

An MP asked the state secretary about the position of public (openbaar) education within cooperative schools, including how many have formed and whether public education is adequately protected. The state secretary answered that the law guarantees public education's equal position, reported that only a few cooperative schools exist and some public schools have merged or closed, and promised to address barriers to cooperation in a forthcoming letter on pupil decline.
The legislation guarantees the equal position between the public and the special-education parts within the cooperative school.
De wetgeving borgt de gelijkwaardige positie tussen het openbare deel en het bijzondere deel binnen de samenwerkingsschool.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt, Marcouch en Ypma over een illegale verstandelijk gehandicapte jongen die in een schoolbus is opgepakt en een week in vreemdelingenbewaring heeft verbleven

MPs Recourt, Marcouch and Ypma asked the minister and state secretary of Security and Justice about a mentally disabled undocumented youth stopped in a car and held in immigration detention for about a week, asking why he was detained, whether his vulnerability was considered, and whether a 48-hour judicial review should be introduced. The state secretary answered that the vulnerability was unknown to police and not reported, detention was justified by the risk of absconding, compensation was offered, and a future policy vision would follow, while declining to examine the case further beyond answering the questions.
Personal information about the person concerned and his immigration status has been limited as much as possible in these answers, given his privacy.
Persoonlijke informatie over betrokkene en zijn vreemdelingrechtelijke status is zo veel als mogelijk beperkt in deze antwoorden, gelet op zijn privacy.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Ypma over toezicht op de medische kinderopvang

MPs Yücel and Ypma asked about the supervision of medical childcare after reports that no checks are carried out, including screening of staff and the four-eyes principle. The state secretary answered that the Inspectorate for Youth Care and the Health Care Inspectorate apply risk-based supervision, that no serious concerns emerged from visits, and that a four-eyes principle is impractical in youth care, without committing to new steps.
Taking further steps is not necessary in view of the above.
Het nemen van verdere stappen is gezien bovenstaande niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hilkens, Oosenbrug en Ypma over de bescherming en de bewustwording van jongeren op internet

MPs Hilkens, Oosenbrug and Ypma asked the state secretary of Security and Justice about youth protection and awareness on the internet, including the Digibewust finding that two-thirds of 12-16 year olds had a bad online experience, parental awareness, consent for minors' online profiles, the handling of grooming and the Meldknop website. The government disputed the two-thirds figure citing SCP research, pointed to existing criminal law, Mediawijzer.net, CBP guidance and EU strategy, and largely answered on substance without committing to new concrete steps.
I cannot confirm this conclusion from the YoungWorks research commissioned by Digibewust on the basis of my own data.
Deze conclusie uit het onderzoek van YoungWorks in opdracht van Digibewust kan ik niet op basis van eigen gegevens bevestigen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Ypma over het geadopteerde Chinese meisje dat na drie weken bij een pleeggezin is ondergebracht

MPs Recourt and Ypma asked the state secretaries about a Chinese adopted girl placed with a foster family after three weeks, the Inspectorate's findings, whether the Central Authority was informed, adoption-matching failures and aftercare. The government answered that the adoptive parents did not inform the intermediary or Central Authority, that the Central Authority of China was informed afterwards, that the Inspectorate's recommendations will feed into an evaluation of the quality framework, and that VWS will report on aftercare in the first half of 2013.
The quality framework for intercountry adoption intermediaries is currently being evaluated.
Momenteel wordt het kwaliteitskader voor de vergunninghouders interlandelijke adoptie geëvalueerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ypma over de decentralisatie van de jeugd-ggz

MP Ypma asks the state secretary whether the sector wrongly believes youth mental health care (jeugd-ggz) will not be decentralised to municipalities, what will be done about the Chamber majority's wish to include it, and what measures will be taken against providers and insurers not anticipating decentralisation and how experiments before 2015 will be encouraged. The state secretary confirms decentralisation of jeugd-ggz is in the coalition agreement, promises a bill before summer 2013, and describes a digital library of good practices and a transition plan.
The coalition agreement states that youth care will be decentralised to municipalities in 2015 and that youth mental health care is part of this.
In het regeerakkoord staat dat in 2015 de jeugdzorg wordt gedecentraliseerd naar gemeenten en dat de jeugd-ggz hiervan een onderdeel is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ypma over het bericht dat steeds meer kinderen in de noodopvang wonen

MPs Tanamal and Ypma asked the state secretary about reports that more children live in emergency shelters, whether this is acceptable, how many children stay long-term, and what will be done. The state secretary agreed children should not be in shelter, said 2012 figures are not yet available, acknowledged some stays exceed a month, and committed to further monitoring and discussions with municipalities and the VNG.
There are not yet any figures known on the number of children who were received in the social shelter in 2012.
Er zijn nog geen cijfers bekend over het aantal kinderen dat in 2012 in de maatschappelijke opvang is opgevangen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ypma over kinderen die de dupe worden van (v)echtscheidingen

An MP asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport whether Youth Care Bureaus see a rising trend of children harmed by high-conflict divorces and what measures will protect them. The government answered that bureaus do not register this problem, that parents bear responsibility for their children's welfare, and pointed to decentralisation of youth care, prevention, and the mandatory parenting plan with the court and Child Protection Board as the safeguard.
The youth care bureaus do not register cases by specific problem type.
De bureaus jeugdzorg registreren niet aan de hand van specifieke problematiek.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ypma over ondertoezichtstellingen die vele jaren worden verlengd

An MP asked whether repeated extensions of child supervision orders (OTS) lasting many years should be capped by law, and whether financial incentives for youth-protection organisations discourage foster guardianship. The government declined a statutory maximum, pointing to case-by-case judicial review, the pending bill with a prospect-based test and Raad voor de Kinderbescherming advice, and said it knows of no such financial practice.
Ultimately, it is the children's judge who, after carefully weighing all interests, judges whether the measure should continue.
Uiteindelijk is het de kinderrechter die na zorgvuldige afweging van alle belangen een oordeel geeft over de noodzaak om de maatregel al dan niet te laten voortduren.
Antwoord vragen Kuzu over een tekort aan opvangplekken voor dakloze gezinnen

MPs Kuzu and Ypma asked about a shortage of shelter places for homeless families, families being turned away, mixing with psychiatric or addicted people, daytime access, and whether a plan of action is needed. Secretary of State Van Rijn said the situation is undesirable in places, that data is lacking and monitoring is commissioned, that preventive measures are preferred over a separate plan of action, and that he will inform parliament before summer.
Neither the VNG nor the Federatie Opvang, the umbrella organisation of shelter institutions, knows how many families have become homeless over the past five years or how many are on a waiting list.

Bij de VNG en bij de Federatie Opvang, de koepelorganisatie van de instellingen voor maatschappelijke opvang, is niet bekend hoeveel gezinnen de afgelopen vijf jaar dakloos zijn geraakt en hoeveel er op een wachtlijst staan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hilkens en Ypma over het bericht dat er in Nederland meer kinderen seksueel worden uitgebuit

PvdA MPs Hilkens and Ypma asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that more children are being sexually exploited in the Netherlands, the National Rapporteur's figures, underreporting by mandatory reporting bodies, and shelter capacity. The minister said he would send the National Rapporteur's report, referred to earlier answers on reporting and shelter capacity, and held that the existing anti-trafficking priority, including the loverboy programme, is sufficient without further intensification.
I will send the NRM report in question to your House shortly.
Ik zal het rapport in kwestie van de NRM binnenkort aan uw Kamer doen toekomen.

Vragen van de leden Hilkens en Ypma (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over drugsgebruik in het speciaal onderwijs (ingezonden 20 december 2012).

MPs Hilkens and Ypma asked about high drug and alcohol use among students in special and practical secondary education, and about the Rotterdam approach and youth prevention. The government confirms the problem is national, says the Rotterdam approach will be examined for wider use, and describes existing prevention programmes and a vocational-education plan.
The Ministry of OCW will, in consultation with the relevant sectors and other parties, examine whether and to what extent the Rotterdam approach can be spread more widely nationally.
Het ministerie van OCW zal in overleg met de betreffende sectoren en overige partijen bezien of en hoeverre de aanpak in Rotterdam breder landelijk verspreid kan worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ypma over het uitlekken en te koop aanbieden van de Cito-opgaven

An MP asks the state secretary for Education how original Cito test items came to be leaked and offered for sale online, whether past leaks occurred, and what will be done to guarantee fair testing and what happens to the leaked test. The government says it is unaware of how the leak happened, that Cito is investigating and has filed a complaint, that no past leaks have been observed, and that it favours a central public final test, but that the government is not a party in the current situation and Cito will proceed with the test.
In the current situation the government is not a party.
In de huidige situatie is de overheid geen partij.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ypma over het bericht minder kinderen in jeugdinstellingen in Zeeland

MPs Ypma and De Vries asked about a report that fewer children in Zeeland are placed in youth institutions thanks to the wraparound care model, and whether this model should guide the transition of youth care to municipalities. The state secretary answered that the Zeeland method is a good example for the transition, though it has not yet reduced placements, and pointed to existing models, shared learning platforms and funding for pilots.
I will further examine how we can make these good examples more visible.
Ik ga nader bezien hoe wij deze goede voorbeelden meer zichtbaar kunnen maken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ypma over een innovatieplatform ten behoeve van de transitie jeugdzorg

An MP asks the state secretaries whether differences in municipal readiness for the youth care transition, the value of innovative pilot projects, and the need for an innovation platform should be addressed. The government answers that municipalities bear primary responsibility, that existing support and knowledge-sharing are in place, and that it will consult the field on whether a platform is needed.
In consultation with the field I want to discuss and test whether there is a need for a platform and how the exchange of innovative projects can be improved.
In overleg met het veld wil ik bespreken en toetsen of er behoefte is aan een platform en hoe de uitwisseling van innovatieve projecten kan worden verbeterd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over de gemeentelijke bijdrage aan vervoer van “signatuurleerlingen”

An MP asked the state secretary of Education whether municipalities should stop paying school transport for pupils attending faith-based schools elsewhere, and whether the rules should change so parents bear those costs. The government answered that the travel burden is a parental choice, that the regulation is being reconsidered in the context of the Onderwijsraad advice on article 23 of the Constitution, and committed to look at possible amendments.
I am willing to look into the possibilities of amending the regulations.
Ik ben bereid te kijken naar de mogelijkheden om de regelgeving aan te passen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ypma over de betrokkenheid van ouders bij passend onderwijs

An MP asked the education minister how parents would be involved in individual support plans, the governance of special-needs collaboration bodies, the availability of education advisers, and teacher training on parental partnership. The minister answered that development plans will be agreed with parents, that parents can appeal to the national dispute committee, that the inspectorate will check parental consent in support plans, and that education advisers will be retained with extra funding.
If parents nevertheless disagree with the established development perspective, they can request a judgment from the national dispute committee for inclusive education.
Zijn ouders het desondanks niet eens met het vastgestelde ontwikkelingsperspectief, dan kunnen zij hierover een oordeel vragen aan de landelijke geschillencommissie passend onderwijs.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wolbert en Ypma over het falen van het huidige beleid ten aanzien van marketing van ongezonde voedingsmiddelen gericht op kinderen

MPs Wolbert and Ypma asked the health minister about an IASO report showing rising exposure of Dutch children to unhealthy food advertising, and how this fits with industry self-regulation. The minister replied that self-regulation covers under-7s and calls for restraint for 7-12s, that the report only covers EU Pledge signatories, that free riders can be addressed via the Advertising Code Commission, and that industry should continue monitoring and accountability.
I expect the industry to keep taking steps on this and to keep taking responsibility.
Ik verwacht dat de industrie hierop stappen en haar verantwoording blijft nemen.

m: Motie van het lid Hagen over een aanpak voor het terugdringen van wachtlijsten in het speciaal onderwijs
Asks the government to work with partners on an approach to reduce waiting lists in special education and link it to youth care waiting-time plans.
requests the government to consult school partnerships and specialised education on an approach to reduce waiting lists in special education
verzoekt de regering in overleg te treden met samenwerkingsverbanden en het gespecialiseerd onderwijs om te komen tot een aanpak voor het terugdringen van wachtlijsten in het speciaal onderwijs
Motie van het lid Hagen over kwalitatief onderzoek naar de beweegredenen bij het vrijstellen van de leerplicht wegens richtingbezwaren
Asks the government to commission qualitative research into parents' motives for exempting children from compulsory education on grounds of directional objections.
requests the government to conduct qualitative research into the motives for exempting from compulsory education on grounds of directional objections
verzoekt de regering kwalitatief onderzoek te doen naar de beweegredenen bij het vrijstellen van de leerplicht wegens richtingbezwaren
Motie van het lid Hagen c.s. over het binnen de kaders van het Klimaatfonds uitwerken van een regeling om circulaire koplopers te ondersteunen
Asks the government to design a scheme under the Climate Fund to support circular economy frontrunners.
requests the government to develop, within the Climate Fund framework, a scheme to support circular frontrunners
verzoekt de regering om bij de besluitvorming over en binnen de kaders van het Klimaatfonds een regeling uit te werken om circulaire koplopers te ondersteunen
Motie van het lid Hagen c.s. over een voorstel voor een circulaire-economiewet
Asks the government to come up with a proposal for a circular economy act to give legal steering to raw material policy.
requests the government to come with a proposal for a circular economy act
verzoekt de regering met een voorstel voor een circulaire-economiewet te komen
Motie van het lid Hagen c.s. over het kosteloos ter beschikking stellen van boeken en licenties voor Nederlands, Engels, rekenen en burgerschap aan mbo-studenten jonger dan 18 jaar
Motion asks the government to reserve 10 million euros a year from 2024 for free books and licences for under-18 MBO students.
requests the government to structurally reserve 10 million euros from 2024
verzoekt de regering om vanaf 2024 structureel 10 miljoen euro te reserveren
Amendement van het lid Hagen c.s. over middelen voor taal, rekenen en burgerschap voor mbo-studenten
Moves funds within the vocational education budget to provide free books and licences for under-18 MBO students in language, maths and citizenship.
Funding is found within the financing of vocational education.
Dekking wordt gevonden binnen de bekostiging van het mbo.
Motie van de leden Boucke en Hagen over eisen ten aanzien van circulariteit opnemen in alle nog uit te schrijven tenders voor wind op zee
Asks the government to include circularity requirements in all offshore wind tenders still to be issued.
requests the government to include circularity requirements in all still-to-be-issued tenders for offshore wind
verzoekt de regering om eisen ten aanzien van circulariteit op te nemen in alle nog uit te schrijven tenders voor wind op zee

Motie van de leden El Yassini en Hagen over mbo-studenten op de BES-eilanden ondersteunen bij het leren van de Nederlandse taal in geval van doorstroming naar het hoger onderwijs in Europees Nederland
Asks the government to support mbo students from the BES islands with learning Dutch when they move on to higher education in the Netherlands after a Papiamento-medium programme.
requests the government to support mbo students on the BES islands, at the student's request, in learning Dutch
verzoekt de regering mbo-studenten op de BES-eilanden, op aanvraag van de student, te ondersteunen bij het leren van de Nederlandse taal
Motie van de leden Hagen en Van Ginneken over een concrete aanpak om het thuiswerken te stimuleren
Asks the government, with employer and employee organisations, to present a concrete approach to stimulating home working before summer 2022.
requests the government, in consultation with employer and employee organisations, to come up with a concrete approach to stimulate home working
verzoekt de regering om in samenspraak met werkgevers- en werknemersorganisaties met een concrete aanpak te komen om het thuiswerken te stimuleren
Motie van het lid Hagen over het opzetten van een tweejaarlijkse massabalans van textiel
Asks the government to set up a biennial mass balance of textiles alongside the start of extended producer responsibility.
requests the government to set up a biennial mass balance of textiles at the same time as the introduction of extended producer responsibility
verzoekt de regering om tegelijkertijd met het ingaan van de invoering van de uitgebreide producentenverantwoordelijkheid een tweejaarlijkse massabalans van textiel op te zetten
Motie van de leden Geurts en Hagen over een helmplicht voor snorfietsers per 1 juli 2022
Asks the government not to postpone the helmet requirement for mopeds and to introduce it on 1 July 2022.
requests the government not to postpone the helmet requirement for mopeds and to let it take effect on 1 July 2022
verzoekt de regering de helmplicht voor snorfietsers niet uit te stellen en 1 juli 2022 in te laten gaan
Motie van het lid Hagen over het actief tegengaan van misleidende informatie op textiel en kledingproducten
Asks government to investigate how stricter national and EU product rules could curb misleading information on textiles and clothing.
requests the government to investigate how tightening national and European product regulation can actively counter misleading information
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken hoe via het aanscherpen van nationale en Europese productregelgeving
Motie van de leden Hagen en Sneller over het opzetten van een met privacywaarborgen omkleed gedeeld informatiesysteem inzake milieucriminaliteit
Asks the government to set up a shared information system with privacy safeguards for all administrative and criminal agencies enforcing environmental crime law.
requests the government to set up a shared information system surrounded by privacy safeguards
verzoekt de regering om een met privacywaarborgen omkleed gedeeld informatiesysteem op te zetten
Motie van het lid Peter de Groot c.s. over toekomstige grootschalige werkzaamheden overzichtelijk in beeld brengen voor automobilisten, reizigers, vervoerders en schippers
Asks the government to create regional maps showing future large-scale road works for road users, carriers and skippers, and propose how to communicate them.
requests the government to show future large-scale works clearly on regional maps
verzoekt de regering op korte termijn door middel van regionale kaarten toekomstige grootschalige werkzaamheden overzichtelijk in beeld te brengen
Motie van het lid Bouchallikh c.s. over in kaart brengen of er sinds de invoering van statiegeld op kleine flesjes sprake is van ontwijkingsgedrag bij drankproducenten
Asks the government to map whether drink producers are evading the deposit scheme on small bottles and, if so, act against them.
requests the government to map by year end whether there is indeed evasion behaviour
verzoekt de regering om voor het einde van het jaar in kaart te brengen of er inderdaad sprake is van ontwijkingsgedrag
Motie van de leden Hagen en Geurts over het wetsvoorstel Vrachtwagenheffing uiterlijk voor het einde van het zomerreces naar de Kamer sturen
Asks the government to send the truck road-charge bill to the House before the end of the summer recess.
requests the government to send the Vrachtwagenheffing bill to the House as soon as possible and at the latest before the end of the summer recess
verzoekt de regering, om het wetsvoorstel Vrachtwagenheffing zo spoedig mogelijk en uiterlijk voor het einde van het zomerreces de Tweede Kamer toe te doen komen
Motie van het lid Grinwis c.s. over een nieuwe afspraak over financiering van de verruiming van de Sluis Kornwerderzand

Asks the government to take the lead in agreeing a new financing arrangement this year for the 26.5 million euro market contribution to widening the Kornwerderzand lock, since the province cannot legally collect it.
requests the government, with respect for the concluded administrative agreement, to take the lead in reaching a new arrangement this year on how the 26.5 million euro can be financed

verzoekt de regering, om, met respect voor de gesloten bestuursovereenkomst, regie te nemen bij het komen tot een nieuwe afspraak dit jaar over de wijze waarop het bedrag van 26,5 miljoen euro gefinancierd kan worden
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Hagen c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 8 over uitsluiten inzet van biobrandstof uit soja
Legally bans blending biofuels made from non-certified soybean oil into fuel, aligning Dutch law with a high indirect land-use risk classification.
is not produced from soybean oil, except soybean oil with a certified low risk of indirect land-use change
wordt niet geproduceerd uit olie uit sojabonen, met uitzondering van olie uit sojabonen met een gecertificeerd laag risico op indirecte veranderingen in landgebruik
Amendement van het lid Hagen over uitsluiten inzet van biobrandstof uit soja
Amendment legally excluding biofuels produced from soybean oil from being counted as admixed biofuel because of indirect land-use risk.
Therefore this amendment legally establishes that blending biofuels obtained from soybean oil is not allowed
Derhalve wordt met dit amendement wettelijk vastgelegd dat de bijmenging van biobrandstoffen verkregen uit sojaolie niet toegestaan is.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Boucke over het bericht 'Provincie stond jarenlang toe dat Tata-fabriek kankerverwekkende stoffen lekte'

Two D66 MPs asked the state secretary whether the province knowingly allowed Tata Steel to emit carcinogenic PAHs for decades, including a 1988 agreement that required no action on leaking coke-oven doors, and asked for archival reconstruction, the documents and a full overview of agreements. The state secretary declined archival research, said the 1988 document has not yet been found and will be sent when located, gave no overview of historical agreements, and said licence revocation is for the competent authority, with an OD NZKG investigation expected in Q1 2024.
As soon as these documents have been found, I will still send them to your House.
Zodra deze documenten zijn aangetroffen, zal ik deze alsnog aan uw Kamer doen toekomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Westerveld, De Hoop, Hagen, Peters, Richardson, Drost, Beertema, Pouw-Verweij, Bisschop, Van Baarle, Sylvana Simons, Omtzigt en Wassenberg over de examenuitslag voor vso-scholieren

MPs asked the minister whether vso (special secondary education) pupils could receive their exam results on the same day as mainstream pupils, and whether an earlier-announcement arrangement from 2024 was progressing. The minister agreed this would be desirable, explained that a structural fix requires rescheduling the state exams and will not be ready until late 2024, and said an interim measure is unlikely to be feasible in 2025.

I will inform your House about these possibilities and the extent to which the group of candidates for whom it becomes possible increases compared with a possible interim solution in 2024, so that your House can weigh the desirability of the interim solution in 2025.

Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over deze mogelijkheden en in welke mate het de groep kandidaten voor wie het mogelijk wordt gemaakt ten opzichte van een eventuele tussenoplossing in 2024 wordt vergroot zodat uw Kamer de wenselijkheid van de tussenoplossing in 2025 kan wegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sahla en Hagen over de werking van de wet meer ruimte voor nieuwe scholen

D66 MPs asked how start-up funding for new schools works, whether its timing and amount hinder founding, and about slow DUO issuance of institution codes. The minister said start-up funding is paid from 1 June before opening, that the amount and timing are being discussed with new boards, and that DUO is exploring faster issuance of codes.
My ministry has received signals from new school boards about the issuing of an institution code by DUO.
Mijn ministerie heeft signalen ontvangen van nieuwe schoolbesturen over de verstrekking van een instellingscode

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over de berichtgeving‘Hoogoplopend conflict op Drachtster Lyceum: onderwijs- enarbeidsinspectie starten onderzoek. 'MR-mes in onze rug niet verdiend’’en ‘Dream School-directeur Eric v

An MP asks whether the school leader sidelining the works council at Drachtster Lyceum, a color-coding staff assessment system, and the inspectorates' role are acceptable and what will be done to protect the works council and staff. The minister answers that the Inspectorate is investigating, that the works council's cost coverage and dispute route exist under the WMS, that school leaders are being strengthened, and that the board, not the government, judges the school leader's conduct.
The Inspectorate of Education is currently investigating the situation at the school and at the board.
De Inspectie van het Onderwijs doet momenteel onderzoek naar de situatie op de school en bij het bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Boucke over het bericht dat hoge concentraties kankerverwekkende stoffen bij Tata Steel als sinds jaren 70 bekend zijn

MPs Hagen and Boucke (D66) asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that carcinogenic PAH concentrations near Tata Steel were known since the 1970s, asking whether government acted negligently, about enforcement, emissions, and the Tata India plans. The State Secretary answered that a 1977 provincial report existed and was shared with provincial states, that BaP levels fell 99% since 1975, that the state cannot fully reconstruct past decisions, and that enforcement against Tata is handled by the provincial authority and the Omgevingsdienst NZKG with ongoing penalty orders.
Without archival research it is difficult to say what the government specifically did in response to this report at the time.
Het is zonder archiefonderzoek moeilijk om te zeggen wat de overheid toentertijd precies heeft ondernomen in reactie op dit rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Sneller over statiegeld op lachgascilinders en het bericht “Maat is vol: afvalverzamelaars gaan ‘levensgevaarlijke’ lachgas cilinders terugsturen”

MPs Hagen and Sneller asked about dangerous nitrous oxide cylinders ending up in waste processing after the nitrous oxide ban, financial damage, responsibility, and collection measures. The government answered that the damage stems from illegal dumping by individuals, that it will explore possible financial support, and that it is working with the waste sector and ministries on collection points, storage capacity and enforcement.
The central government is willing to explore whether a financial contribution is possible, using existing schemes or not, for measures that help mitigate risks in the waste sector.

Het Rijk is wel bereid te verkennen of een financiële tegemoetkoming mogelijk is, al dan niet gebruikmakend van bestaande regelingen, voor het treffen van maatregelen die bijdragen aan het mitigeren van de risico's in de afvalbranche.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over het bericht "Liters kankerverwekkende stoffen laat Claessen Tankcleaning zo de Maas in stromen"

An MP (D66) asked the ministers about NRC reports that tank cleaner Claessen Tankcleaning discharged benzene-laden waste water into the Maas, and about enforcement history. The state secretary answered that waste water is treated on-site and discharged via the municipal sewer and the Waterschap plant, that enforcement began in 2020, and that a penalty order was issued in July 2023 with follow-up checks.

On 31 July 2023 the municipality of Venlo sent Claessen Tankcleaning an order subject to a penalty after it was established that benzene tank cleaning was carried out differently, in method and installations, than described in the permit.

Op 31 juli 2023 is er door gemeente Venlo een last onder dwangsom verstuurd aan Claessen Tankcleaning nadat is vastgesteld dat de reiniging van tankwagens met benzeen anders wordt uitgevoerd qua werkwijze en installaties dan in de vergunning is omschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen, Peters, Kwint, Beertema, Westerveld en Van der Plas over carnaval en de afname van de doorstroomtoets

Six MPs asked the minister why the doorstroomtoets (transition test) was not moved around the carnival period and whether an extra week could be granted to carnival regions. The minister answered that after a stakeholder meeting the test window was extended from two to three weeks, with the extension for 2024 applied to the digital test and to be codified in law after that, while the test timing will be evaluated later.
Based on that conversation, I have decided to extend the period in which schools can administer a transition test from two to three weeks.
Op grond van dat gesprek heb ik besloten de periode waarin scholen een doorstroomtoets kunnen afnemen van twee naar drie weken te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over het bericht 'Ruim veertig procent van de flesjes met statiegeld komt niet bij een inzamelpunt terecht'

An MP (D66) asked the state secretary about reports that over 40% of deposit bottles never reach a collection point, the enforcement response, deposit funds retained by the Afvalfonds Verpakkingen, and whether consumers should get deposit back at all points. The secretary answered that the ILT issued a warning and demanded data, that the producer-run fund is responsible for the system and retained deposit, and that the sector must present a plan to reach the 90% target.
The ILT has sent a warning to the Afvalfonds Verpakkingen because it failed to meet the collection target for plastic bottles.
De ILT heeft een waarschuwing gestuurd aan het Afvalfonds Verpakkingen vanwege het niet halen van het inzameldoel voor plastic flessen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen, Van Esch, Bouchallikh, Beckerman en Thijssen over PFAS

MPs Hagen, Van Esch, Bouchallikh, Beckerman and Thijssen asked about PFAS: licensed emitters, drinking water, health and economic effects, contaminated sites, enforcement against Chemours and 3M, and whether the government knew of harms. The minister answered that no central emissions register exists, outlined permitting and monitoring responsibilities, and said ongoing RIVM research and legal action continue, while declining to comment on several pending matters.
No, there is no centralised overview of this.
Nee, hiervan is geen gecentraliseerd overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Boucke over het bericht 'Tata hakt knoop door en gaat tóch staal maken met waterstof'

MPs Hagen and Boucke (D66) asked the ministers about reports that Tata Steel India and Tata Steel Netherlands would pursue revised green steel plans with a DRI and electric arc furnace, and what this means for climate, air quality, emissions, noise, jobs and the maatwerk agreements. The minister answered that the revised plans cannot yet be assessed, that the April 2022 expression of principles remains in place, and that the government will test the plans once the company provides details after the summer.
I cannot yet assess the plans at this moment.
Ik kan de plannen op dit moment nog niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sahla en Hagen over het bericht dat kinderen soms langer dan een jaar wachten op logopedie

MPs Sahla and Hagen asked about reports that children sometimes wait over a year for speech therapy, including waiting-list data, the Treek norm, therapist numbers, tariffs, insurer duties and measures to reduce waits. The minister reported that over half of first-line practices had waits exceeding one year in 2022, that insurers must ensure access and mediate, and that he will consult the NZa on more intensive supervision, while stating that tariff adequacy cannot yet be judged.
I will consult with the NZa on whether it is possible to exercise more intensive supervision of speech therapy.
Ik ga met de NZa overleggen, of het mogelijk is om intensiever toezicht op de logopedie te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Boucke over de vertraging om de groenstaalplannen van Tata Steel

MPs Hagen and Boucke (D66) asked about delays in Tata Steel's green steel plans, the regional environmental service's enforcement against unclean cokes-oven gas and its capacity, and the government's follow-up on related motions. The State Secretary answered that delays are undesirable, that the government is in talks with the company and the regional service, that enforcement is independent and risk-based, and that a verbal commitment to further steps and extra capacity funding has been made.
I agree with the OD NZKG that a worked-out and reliable planning is necessary for the success of the project.
Ik ben het eens met de OD NZKG dat een uitgewerkte en betrouwbare planning nodig is voor het slagen van het project.
Antwoord op van de leden Boucke en Hagen over het bericht 'Miljoenen nodig voor sloop kerncentrale Dodewaard bij aandeelhouders beland'

MPs Boucke and Hagen asked how the state came to bear decommissioning costs for the Dodewaard nuclear plant while shareholders received payouts, and about financing rules for decommissioning other energy infrastructure. The minister explains that GKN could not secure approved financial guarantees, that a term sheet transfers NEA's assets to the state, and that a broader reform of mining decommissioning rules is planned for after summer.
The downside is that the state thereby becomes (indirectly) responsible for dismantling GKN.
Keerzijde is dat de Staat hiermee (indirect) verantwoordelijk wordt GKN te ontmantelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Hagen en Van der Graaf over het mislukken van het textielconvenant

MPs asked whether the government should reconsider its role as a party to voluntary sector agreements on responsible supply chains after the textile agreement collapsed, and what the failure means for garment workers and for the need for IMVO legislation. The minister answered that sectoral cooperation remains important, that the government's role will be evaluated in September 2023 with stakeholder consultation, and that the government is pursuing EU and national due-diligence legislation while keeping its existing policy mix.
In doing so I will of course evaluate the role of the government, also in relation to the future entry into force of legislation.
Daarbij zal ik uiteraard de rol van de overheid evalueren, ook in relatie tot inwerking treden van wetgeving in de toekomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Sneller over statiegeld en lachgascilinders

MPs Hagen and Sneller asked the government about the delayed deck-deposit (statiegeld) scheme on cans, risks of drinks cartons and plastic bottles, batteries in household waste, and fire and explosion risks from nitrous oxide cylinders at waste processors. The state secretary answered that the government will report to parliament on the deposit scheme in 2024, that it is monitoring substitution toward cartons and considering a recycling target, that battery fires are being tackled via a taskforce, and that it is working with partners on a practical solution for nitrous oxide cylinders, while rejecting a deposit system for them.
As provided in art. 16 of the Packaging Management Decree, I will send the House of Representatives a report in 2024 on the effectiveness and effects of deposit on beverage packaging.
Zoals bepaald in art. 16 van het Besluit beheer verpakkingen zal ik in 2024 de Tweede Kamer een verslag toesturen over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van statiegeld op drankverpakkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over kankerverwekkende stoffen die vrijkomen bij het storten van granuliet in natuurplassen

An MP asked whether acrylamide may be released into water when dredged material (granuliet) is dumped in deep nature lakes, whether the unpublished RIVM/Deltares report should be shared, and whether the precautionary principle and a halt on dumping apply. The state secretary answered that the literature review found no new evidence, the report was shared with parliament, earlier studies found acrylamide not detected and unlikely to form, the precautionary principle was applied, and only a future exploration of greener alternatives is promised.
The report was shared with the House at the same time as answering these parliamentary questions.
Het rapport is tegelijk met het beantwoorden van deze Kamervragen met de Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Hagen over de aanpak van milieucriminaliteit

MPs Sneller and Hagen asked how the government will tackle environmental crime, including whether non-conviction transactions are sufficiently deterrent, the Court of Audit's findings on inspection, repeat offenders, and implementation of earlier motions. The Minister answers that a sentencing study will be commissioned, a compliance-based transaction modality is planned, and the motions will be followed up through the IBP VTH programme, while several answers defer to other bodies or to later letters.
The Ministry of Justice and Security will commission scientific research into the current way of sentencing and its effectiveness in environmental offences.
Het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid zal opdracht geven voor een wetenschappelijk onderzoek naar de huidige wijze van straffen en de effectiviteit daarvan bij milieufeiten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Tjeerd de Groot over het artikel van het platform voor onderzoeksjournalistiek Follow the Money met als titel ‘Steenwolfabriek in Roermond mag van de provincie twee keer zoveel st

MPs Hagen and Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked the government about a Follow the Money report that the Rockwool stone wool plant in Roermond may emit twice the ammonia and phenol limits of other plants under a 2020 provincial permit. The State Secretary answered that Rockwool is the second-largest ammonia emitter, that the province chose permit limits within the EU BREF range, that the Schone Lucht Akkoord lowest-end principle is a starting point rather than an automatic cap, and that the government will talk with Rockwool and push for BAT revisions and sustainable insulation alternatives without committing to tighter national limits.
The competent authority prioritised limiting the emissions of these two substances, even if phenol emissions are higher as a result.
Het bevoegd gezag heeft prioriteit gegeven aan het beperken van de uitstoot van deze twee stoffen, ook als daarbij de emissie van fenol hoger is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over de uitspraak van de Raad van State over statiegeld op metalen drankverpakkingen

An MP asked the state secretary how the government responds to a Council of State ruling that postponed enforcement of the mandatory deposit on metal beverage cans, and whether the framework for extended producer responsibility needs tightening. The secretary calls the ruling disappointing, says enforcement is suspended until 31 March 2023, rejects tightening the law now, and promises an evaluation in 2024 that will inform Parliament.
I will inform the House of Representatives about that.
Ik zal de Tweede Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Hagen over het bericht ‘Stap-subsidieregeling blijkt funest voor kleine opleiders’

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about small training providers being excluded from the STAP subsidy scheme because they lack quality marks, some of which impose turnover thresholds. The minister acknowledged the problem, said talks with the sector are underway, and committed to informing parliament on a plan to steer STAP funds toward shortage sectors in early 2023.
In consultation with the training sector and industry organisations, we are examining how to make access to the training register easier for small providers.
In overleg met het opleidingsveld en brancheorganisaties wordt bekeken hoe we de toegang tot het scholingsregister voor de kleine opleiders kunnen vergemakkelijken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke en Hagen over het bericht 'Nieuwe productiemethode maakt rotorbladen van windmolens goed recyclebaar'

Two MPs (Boucke and Hagen, D66) asked the government about recycling of wind turbine blades, the fate of decommissioned turbines, circularity in the energy transition, and related regulation and tenders. The minister answered at length, describing current recycling options, the TNO innovation, producer responsibility rules, and planned measures such as a national circular economy programme and circularity criteria in offshore wind tenders, but gave no firm numeric targets.
For stimulating R&D&I aimed at transitions, mission-driven innovation policy makes an important contribution.
Voor het stimuleren van R&D&I gericht op transities levert het missiegedreven innovatiebeleid een belangrijke bijdrage.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Van Ginneken over het aanbieden van petities door de gemeente Bergen en de Nederlandse Federatie Omgevingslawaai Motorvoertuigen (NEFOM)

MPs Hagen and Van Ginneken asked the State Secretary about petitions from NEFOM and the municipality of Bergen on motor vehicle noise nuisance, the RIVM advice on environmental noise, and steps taken per noise source. The State Secretary answered that concrete follow-up will be reported to parliament around the end of the year, noted that noise norms are generally met, and said an inventory of motor vehicle noise nuisance and a study are underway.
I expect to be able to inform your House about this around the end of this year.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer rond het eind van dit jaar hierover te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht dat chemiefabriek Chemours maandenlang veel meer GenX in water loosde dan toegestaan

MPs Hagen and Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked whether Chemours discharged far more GenX into water than permitted, and whether monitoring data pointed to illegal discharges. Minister Harbers answered that the national monitoring data are not suited to attributing discharges to a single firm, that Chemours' permits allow 2 kg and 5 kg per year, and that enforcement was not possible because the source could not be identified.
None of these measurements show that Chemours exceeded the set GenX standard at the end of 2021.
Uit geen van deze metingen blijkt dat Chemours eind 2021 de gestelde norm voor GenX heeft overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Hagen over aanspoelen stookolie langs de kust

Two MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about oil washing ashore along the Dutch coast, the timing of Rijkswaterstaat's response, cleanup, polluter liability, illegal bilge discharges, the revision of cleanup and bird-rescue arrangements after the MSC Zoe incident, volunteer involvement, and monitoring and Coast Guard capacity. The minister answered that cleanup and daily inspections were carried out, the polluter will be held liable once identified, the revised regulations are expected in the first half of 2023, and existing monitoring and equipment are sufficient.
Rijkswaterstaat acted immediately upon reports of washed-up oil pollution following the applied approach and launched an investigation into the extent of the pollution.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft direct na melding van aangespoelde olieverontreiniging ingegrepen volgens de gehanteerde aanpak
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Tjeerd de Groot over nieuwe risicogrenzen voor PFAS in oppervlaktewater

MPs Hagen and Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked about new RIVM risk limits for PFAS in surface water and their consequences for the Hedwige polder de-embankment and the Westerschelde. The minister confirmed the new limits, said a decision on adopting them as norms is still pending, and maintained that PFAS levels do not obstruct the nature goals of the de-embankment.
I will, partly on the basis of RIVM's advice, decide whether the PFAS standards for surface water need to be adjusted.
Ik zal mede op basis van het advies van het RIVM een besluit nemen of de normen voor PFAS in oppervlaktewater aangepast moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over de Zembla uitzending van 9 september 2022 over PFAS

An MP asked the ministers about a Zembla broadcast on PFAS contamination in the Westerschelde, Indaver's discharge permits, Dutch objections to Flemish permits, and contacts with Flanders. The minister answered that the VU study's breast milk conclusions were wrong, that Indaver now complies with tightened limits, that Rijkswaterstaat advised Flanders in writing, and that a national health study will be announced.
Rijkswaterstaat sent letters on my behalf to the Antwerp city council and the Flemish Department of the Environment.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft namens mij brieven verzonden aan het college van burgemeester en schepenen en het Vlaams departement Omgeving
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Hagen over het bericht Opleidingsinstituten profiteren massaal van royale subsidieregeling

MPs Van Beukering-Huijbregts and Hagen (D66) asked whether training providers inflating course prices to exhaust the STAP training budget is acceptable, how providers can circumvent rules, why public institutions offer little STAP-funded training, and how supervision can be strengthened. Minister Van Gennip answered that price inflation is unacceptable, that the Toetsingskamer STAP monitors and sanctions providers (removal from the register, reclaiming subsidy, possible criminal investigation), that four providers received intent-to-remove notices, and that the regulation will be reviewed.
Improper price increases are highly undesirable.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Podt over het bericht ‘Friese mbo's verliezen deel van inburgeraars’

MPs Hagen and Podt asked why Friese Poort and Friesland College declined to tender for the B1 and Z integration routes, citing non-cost-covering fees, and what consequences this has for newcomers and for the government's funding of the education route. The minister replied that court rulings found the regional bandwidths reasonable, that a contract for both routes has been secured in Friesland, and that additional funding and a structural solution are being prepared.
In view of these rulings, I see no reason to take further measures.
Met het oog op deze uitspraken zie ik geen aanleiding om nadere maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over de Kamerbrief Versterking VTH-stelsel.

An MP asked why the interbestuurlijk programma VTH (IBP VTH) was sent to the Chamber late, why environmental service boundaries are not aligned with safety regions, and how the Van Aartsen recommendations on environmental crime, enforcement capacity, uniform enforcement policy and independence of enforcement bodies are being followed up. The government answered that the programme was delayed by the pre-recess workload, that alignment with safety regions is a stated aim being examined under pillar 1, and that the recommendations are being worked out in pillars 1 to 5 with progress reports twice a year.
As indicated in the programme plan, this recommendation is also being taken up.
Zoals in het programmaplan aangegeven, wordt ook deze aanbeveling opgepakt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Boucke over de aangenomen motie-Hagen c.s., het artikel ‘Kankerverwekkende stof chroom-6 aangetroffen in grond Tata Steel’ en de intentieverklaring ‘Afspraken met Tata Steel Neder

MPs Hagen and Boucke (D66) asked the government about the timeline, binding nature, monitoring, financing and emissions targets of the Expression of Principles with Tata Steel Nederland, and about carcinogenic chromium-6 found in soil at the site. The minister answered that the EoP is non-binding but guides negotiations toward a binding agreement, that no public funds are yet attached, that further investigation into chromium-6 has been commissioned by the regional environmental service, and that some answers depend on ongoing procedures or are the responsibility of other bodies.
First an attempt will be made to reach more concrete and binding agreements between the parties.
Eerst zal geprobeerd worden om te komen tot concretere en bindende afspraken tussen partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over meer hart- en vaatziekten door Tata Steel in IJmond

An MP asked the state secretary about GGD and RIVM findings that residents near Tata Steel in IJmuiden have more heart and vascular disease and high blood pressure, and whether emissions should be cut faster, including reaching WHO air quality guidelines and closing coke plant 2. The state secretary acknowledged the health problems, pointed to the joint action plan with the province, said WHO guideline attainment by 2030 is uncertain and will be decided in 2023, and committed to exploring earlier closure of coke plant 2 with the other authorities.
Yes, at the committee debate on External Safety of 22 June I committed to talk with the co-governing authorities about the possibilities to close Coke Plant 2 sooner.
Ja, in het commissiedebat Externe Veiligheid van 22 juni jl. heb ik toegezegd dat ik met de mede-overheden in gesprek ga over de mogelijkheden om de Kooksfabriek 2 versneld te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over het artikel 'RIVM: 'eet zo min mogelijk vis en garnalen uit de Westerschelde'

An MP asked the government about RIVM advice to eat little fish and shellfish from the Westerschelde due to high PFAS levels, including whether it is acceptable that this contamination is far higher than in shop-bought products, the status of a motion on holding 3M liable, and whether a population health study should be started. The minister acknowledged the contamination and advice, said follow-up on the motion is underway with Belgium and a report to parliament will follow, and said a population study is for the GGD and expert group to advise on, with EU limits planned.
The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management will inform your House ahead of the Water Legislative Consultation about progress in implementing the motion.
De Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat zal uw Kamer voorafgaand aan het Wetgevingsoverleg Water informeren over de voortgang in de uitvoering van de motie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over de PFAS-uitstoot door Chemours/Dupont

An MP asked the state secretary about PFAS/GenX emissions from the Dupont/Chemours plant, including whether permits should allow such releases and what is done to protect residents. The government answered that permitted GenX emissions have been reduced by over 99% since 2016, that GenX is classed as a substance of very high concern requiring minimisation, and that Nederland is preparing an EU-wide PFAS restriction to be submitted in January 2023.
Furthermore, I remain committed to addressing the concerns about PFAS in Europe.
Daarnaast zet ik mij blijvend in om de zorgen over PFAS in Europa te adresseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over het bericht dat veel gevaarlijk asbestschroot in illegaliteit verdwijnt

An MP asked whether the claim that over 50% of asbestos demolition is illegal, as reported by Omgevingsdienst NL, is correct, and how the government will respond to that body's letter. The state secretary says the illegality mostly concerns missing demolition notifications and asbestos inventories, that the VTH system has not failed given the difficulty of enforcing against private parties, and promises further consultation and a letter to provinces.
No, given a compliance shortfall that largely arises among private individuals, it cannot be said that the VTH system has failed.
Nee, op grond van een nalevingstekort dat voor een belangrijk deel speelt bij particulieren kan niet worden gesteld dat het VTH-stelsel heeft gefaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over het bericht ‘DUO en mbo-studenten lopen elkaar mis: ‘Wáár kun je die aanvullende beurs aanvragen?’

An MP asked the Education Minister about reports that many vocational students entitled to the supplementary grant (aanvullende beurs) do not apply for it. The minister acknowledges the non-take-up, promises to make the grant checked by default in the application screen and improve information, but sees little room to simplify the parental-income procedure.
I am therefore taking measures to reduce the non-take-up.
Ik neem daarom maatregelen om het niet-gebruik af te laten nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over nieuw bewijs voor zware vervuiling van Nederlandse waterwegen met plastickorrels

An MP asked the state secretary about new evidence of heavy plastic pellet (nurdle) pollution in the Westerschelde, whether enforcement under the permitting and inspection system had failed, and what was being done with Belgium and the UK. The government acknowledged the problem and pointed to industry initiatives, inspections by Rijkswaterstaat and the regional service, international cooperation (OSPAR, Scheldt Commission) and EU plastics measures, without accepting failure of the enforcement system.
Companies are first and foremost responsible themselves for preventing polluting substances, such as plastic pellets, from entering the environment.
Antwoord 4 Bedrijven zijn allereerst zelf verantwoordelijk om te voorvoorkomen dat verontreinigende stoffen, zoals plastic korrels, in het milieu terechtkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Hagen over het stimuleren van het gebruik van wasbare luiers en incontinentiematerialen

MPs Van Esch and Hagen asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about municipal and national handling of disposable versus washable nappies and incontinence products, including recycling, collection bins, VAT, insurance coverage and chemical content. The State Secretary answered at length, acknowledging limited recycling capacity and fragmented responsibility, but largely deferred to municipalities, care institutions, insurers and EU rules, and committed only to examining instruments and to pleading for EU labelling changes.
I am currently examining which instruments can be deployed to make the nappy chain more closed.
Momenteel bezie ik welke instrumenten ingezet kunnen worden om de luierketen meer sluitend te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over ‘de afvalbergen die ontstaan door het verplaatsen van textielproducten vanuit Europa naar Ghana’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about textile waste mountains in Ghana caused by exports from Europe, including export volumes, steps against low-grade textile exports, financial support to Ghana, extended producer responsibility, and lobbying in Brussels. The government says exports are sorted to buyers' demand and EVOA rules apply, that there is no data on trade flows, that Ghana receives no Dutch funding, and that it will raise the issue in the EU textile strategy and report in spring 2023.
There are no figures on these trade flows known to the Dutch government.
Er zijn geen cijfers over deze handelsstromen bekend bij de Nederlandse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over de transitie naar een circulaire economie en de definiëring van afval binnen de afvalwet- en regelgeving

An MP asked the state secretary about the waste definition blocking circular businesses, the implementation of the Taskforce recommendations, and legal certainty for investments in recycling. The government answered that the definition of waste is a shared EU concept needing clarification rather than replacement, that companies bear the primary burden of proving material status, and that it is working on guidance, end-of-waste regulations for struvite and cellulose, and EU-level clarification, though many answers restate existing policy and defer to decentralised authorities.
It is not so much a new waste definition that is needed, but mainly a clarification of the current definition.
Het is niet zozeer een nieuwe afvaldefinitie die nodig is, maar met name een verduidelijking van de huidige definitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen, Sahla en Van der Laan over het bericht 'Minister zet ventilatie op scholen op 1'

Three D66 MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and of Education about ventilation in schools, childcare, vve, mbo, hbo and universities, CO2 measurement, and whether the school helpline extends to these sectors. The government answered that ventilation responsibility lies primarily with providers and institutions, that existing rules and risk-based inspection apply, and that the helpline is not extended, pointing instead to RIVM guidance and an app.
The cabinet has no insight into the measures regarding ventilation at institution level in secondary vocational education (mbo) and higher education (ho).
Het kabinet heeft geen inzicht in de maatregelen met betrekking tot ventilatie op instellingsniveau in het middelbaar beroepsonderwijs (mbo) en hoger onderwijs (ho).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over de producentenverantwoordelijkheid van matrassen.

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the voluntary extended producer responsibility scheme for mattresses, covering fee levels, cost coverage, monitoring, consultation and the absence of legal targets. The State Secretary replied that producers set the scheme's terms themselves, that government only declared the private agreement generally binding, and that further policy details would follow in a letter.
The producer responsibility for mattresses therefore has no statutory obligations or targets.
Daarmee kent de producentenverantwoordelijkheid voor matrassen geen wettelijke verplichtingen of doelstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht “Limburgse grensgemeente verrast door volstorten recreatieplas”

MPs Hagen and Tjeerd de Groot asked about reports that a Flemish Maas lake near the Dutch border was designated for dumping excavated soil from Antwerp, possibly polluted like the Westerschelde, and about risks to Dutch municipalities, boaters, agriculture and drinking water. The State Secretary answered that no soil is currently being applied, the Flemish authority is responsible, the permit excludes heavily polluted soil, no monitoring report or MER exists yet, and that the Netherlands will be closely involved in monitoring approval.
It is not possible to send you a report regarding ecological or environmental requirements.
Het is niet mogelijk om u een rapportage met betrekking tot ecologische of milieueisen toe te zenden.
