Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Boulakjar over de berichten '3000 lege vliegtuigen in België de lucht in om landingsrechten te behouden' en 'Knotsgekke drempels in Europese lidstaten bemoeilijken treinreis

Two D66 MPs asked about reports of empty flights run to preserve airport slot rights during the pandemic and about rail cross-border obstacles, and asked how many empty flights were operated, whether the slot waiver would be extended, and what was being done on international rail. The minister replied that no empty flights were needed at Dutch slot-coordinated airports, that the EU slot relief rules are expected to continue for summer 2022 with a request for clarity beyond, and outlined ongoing EU and national rail initiatives without committing to a new legal change.
The ministry has no access to load factors per airline or per flight movement.
Het ministerie heeft geen inzage in de bezettingsgraden per luchtvaartmaatschappij en of per vliegtuigbeweging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Bontenbal over het fragment ’80 miljoen zonnepanelen in 2024 zijn een tikkende milieutijdbom’

MPs Hagen and Bontenbal asked the state secretary about reports that financing for recycling solar panels is not secured, including the 13 cent per panel fee and how it compares with Belgium's system. The state secretary acknowledged the concern, said the current fee covers only present costs, and pointed to producer organisation OPEN as primarily responsible while it develops a financing roadmap and a possible removal fund.
The financing of high-quality processing of future discarded solar panels is not in order.
De financiering van een hoogwaardige verwerking van vrijkomende afgedankte zonnepanelen in de toekomst is niet op orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Tjeerd de Groot over bedrijven die nauwelijks gecontroleerd worden op milieudelicten

MPs Hagen and Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked whether companies are hardly inspected or fined for environmental offences, how often omgevingsdiensten should visit polluting firms, and about ammonia emissions by cacao factory Cargill Aurora in Zaandam that were not reported to the RIVM for 2010-2018. The State Secretary answered that inspection frequency is risk-based, that the Landelijke Handhavingsstrategie and the VTH reform are being used, that Cargill's unreported emissions were discovered in 2019 and are being addressed through a planned last onder dwangsom, and that the omission does not create new nitrogen effects.

I find this a worrying conclusion, and it was partly the reason for my predecessor to inform you, in the letter on strengthening the VTH system, about the actions planned to follow up the recommendations of the Van Aartsen committee.

Dit vind ik een zorgwekkende conclusie en het is voor mijn voorganger mede aanleiding geweest om u met de Kamerbrief versterking VTH-stelsel 5 te informeren over de acties die worden voorzien om de aanbevelingen van de commissie Van Aartsen op te volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Hagen over drugsgebruik in het verkeer

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers about drug driving enforcement, including THC thresholds, saliva tests, medicinal users, licence suspensions and possible discriminatory policing. Minister Grapperhaus defended the uniform per se limits, explained the saliva-then-blood procedure and licence rules, and said he would not comment on individual cases.
The NFI will re-evaluate the scientific insights on this in 2022.
Het NFI zal in 2022 de wetenschappelijke inzichten hieromtrent opnieuw evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Paternotte en Hagen over de snelle opmars van een nieuwe virusvariant in Zuid-Afrika

Two D66 MPs asked the health and transport ministers about a new COVID variant spreading fast in South Africa, including monitoring, travel testing, vaccine donations and border checks. The minister answered by referring the parliament to a separate letter on the omicron measures, without answering the questions directly.

The written questions from MPs Paternotte and Hagen to the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Health, Welfare and Sport about the rapid rise of a new virus variant in South Africa (2021Z21733) have been answered by way of a letter.

De schriftelijke vragen van leden Paternotte en Hagen aan de ministers van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de snelle opmars van een nieuwe virusvariant in Zuid-Afrika ( 2021Z21733 ) zijn beantwoordwoord middels brief

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Sneller over de berichten ‘Dwangsom asfaltfabriek Eindhoven als te hoge uitstoot kankerverwekkende stof benzeen niet stopt, ‘half miljard naar milieucontrole bedrijven, maar wat g

Two D66 MPs asked about benzene emissions from an Eindhoven asphalt plant exceeding limits, weak enforcement of environmental rules, the lack of data on sanctions and about 570 million euro spent by local environmental services, and continued ship degassing in Flevoland lakes. The state secretary answered that enforcement is the competence of local authorities and environmental services, denied any tolerance policy on degassing, and promised a status overview and a leading policy note by year end.
I do not have figures on how often companies are ultimately (partially) closed down.
Ik heb geen cijfers voorhanden hoe vaak bedrijven uiteindelijk (gedeeltelijk) worden gesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over mogelijke ontwijking van het statiegeldsysteem

An MP asked whether producers are evading the deposit (statiegeld) system by shifting drinks to cartons without deposit, and what the government will do. The state secretary says the government will monitor litter data and market sales in 2022, has raised the issue with industry, introduced a recycling target for cartons, and will consider a deposit or ban on cartons for water and soft drinks if the shift grows.
In doing so, I will at least explore the possibilities of making deposits mandatory on drinks cartons and banning the use of drinks cartons for packaging water and soft drinks.
Daarbij verken ik in ieder geval de mogelijkheden van het verplichten van statiegeld op drankenkartons en het verbieden van het gebruik van drankenkartons voor het verpakken van water en frisdrank.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over het bericht 'Vliegverkeer Schiphol blaast zorgelijk veel ultrafijnstof de lucht in'

An MP asked the minister about TNO measurements of ultrafine particles at Schiphol, which were taken when the airport ran at about 60% capacity, and about health risks for airport workers and residents. The minister answered that the RIVM will report in Q1 2022, that the sector is considering a health study for platform workers, and that further steps will be sent to Parliament by end 2021.
In the first quarter of 2022 the RIVM will publish its final report, after which the ministry will consider what the RIVM's conclusions mean for policy and possible measures.

In het eerste kwartaal van 2022 zal het RIVM zijn eindrapportage publiceren, waarna het ministerie zal bezien wat de conclusies van het RIVM betekenen voor het beleid en mogelijk te nemen maatregelen.

Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Hagen over de berichten ‘Meerderheid Nijmeegse politiek: vervuilende asfaltcentrale moet vertrekken ’ en ‘Protest tegen asfaltfabriek zwelt aan; ook andere wijken én politiek in verzet’

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that an asphalt plant in Nijmegen may emit far more PAHs than allowed, and about how the competent authority can enforce, monitor and sanction. The state secretary acknowledged the exceedance, said enforcement tools and the 'recognised measure' rule are under review with a decision expected by year-end, and explained the monitoring, certification and fine-setting arrangements, while stating that the burden of proof stays with the authority.
Signals that the regulations on monitoring PAHs at asphalt plants are experienced as an obstacle, I take seriously and am investigating.
Signalen dat de regelgeving ten aanzien van monitoring van PAK's bij asfaltcentrales daarbij als belemmerend wordt ervaren neem ik serieus en onderzoek ik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Hagen over investeringszekerheid en annex IX, A biobrandstoffen

MPs Bontenbal and Hagen asked the state secretary about soy-based biofuels under E10, the treatment of biomethanol from the gas grid, blending rules, and whether the opt-in for Annex IX-A biofuels in shipping would continue to give investment certainty. The state secretary answered that no soy oil was used, that grid-based methanol will qualify for HBEs under conditions from 2022, that blending of fossil and renewable fuels remains restricted, and that the opt-in for shipping will run until 2025 before moving to sector-specific policy.
I intend to continue this as manageably as possible until 1 January 2025 in the Energy Decree that is before your House.
Ik ben voornemens dit tot 1 januari 2025 zo beheersbaar mogelijk voort te zetten in het Besluit energie dat bij uw Kamer voorligt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over de berichten ‘Primark wil af van vervuilende wegwerpmode’ en ‘Een betere wereld? Primark maakt er geen haast mee’

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary about reports that Primark wants to move away from polluting fast fashion and that it plans to pay living wages in its supply chain only by 2030. The government welcomed Primark's steps, noted that concrete interim targets and transparent monitoring are still lacking, and described Dutch measures on living wages and the circular textile programme, including the planned extended producer responsibility for textiles.
I welcome that the company is taking steps to move closer to a circular textile chain.
Ik juich het toe dat het bedrijf stappen zet om dichter bij een circulaire textielketen te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wuite over het artikel 'Rapport over Caribische luchtvaart al twee jaar in onderste la ministerie I&W'

Two MPs from D66 asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Waterstaat about a report on Caribbean aviation connectivity that had reportedly sat unactioned at the ministry, and about the status of recommendations, Winair support, the ferry tender and alternatives. The minister confirmed dunne routes exist, said the Winair state-participation evaluation is complete but still being discussed with departments and will be sent to parliament later, and said he is exploring a public service obligation and easing airline establishment rules.
The evaluation, including the follow-up being given to it, is currently being discussed with the most involved departments. Once this is completed I will send you the evaluation and policy response.

De evaluatie, inclusief de opvolging die daaraan wordt gegeven wordt momenteel met de meest betrokken departementen besproken. Zodra dit is afgerond zal ik u de evaluatie en beleidsreactie doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over het bericht 'Provincie en gemeente Utrecht: 80 km/u alternatief voor verbreding A27

An MP (D66) asked the minister about the Utrecht provinces' proposal for an independent commission on alternatives to widening the A27, the effect of working from home on the need for road expansion, and whether the A27 plans should be reconsidered. The minister answered that the Tracébesluit is pending before the Raad van State, that a new alternatives study is not appropriate for a demissionary cabinet, and that infrastructure investment remains necessary despite more home working.
Because the appeal procedure is still ongoing and the cabinet is caretaker, a renewed alternatives study, or the establishment of a commission, is not on the table.
Omdat de beroepsprocedure nog loopt en het kabinet demissionair is, is een hernieuwd alternatievenonderzoek, of instelling van een commissie niet aan de orde.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Hagen naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Stikstofdeal met zes boeren die stoppen, A15 kan volgens ministerie daardoor alsnog doorgaan’ in de Gelderlander

MPs Tjeerd de Groot and Hagen (D66) asked whether deals with six livestock farmers allow the A15 extension to proceed despite the 25-km nitrogen limit, and why farms were bought out where external netting is not permitted. The minister confirmed agreements were signed (some before the 25-km rule was set), stated only businesses with a realised capacity were included, cited the Rijk's lifted netting limits and the province's permit withdrawal, and said no irreversible steps will be taken until the Raad van State rules.
Are you willing to take no irreversible steps on the A15 until this has been discussed in the House of Representatives during the MIRT committee consultation?
Bent u bereid geen onomkeerbare stappen te zetten op de A15 tot hierover is gesproken in de Tweede Kamer tijdens het notaoverleg MIRT?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Hagen over de quarantaineplicht voor gevaccineerde reizigers

Two D66 MPs asked why vaccinated travellers from very-high-risk areas without a variant of concern must quarantine while vaccinated household contacts of positive cases need not, and whether the government will reconsider. The minister answers that from 22 September vaccinated travellers from such areas are exempt from quarantine (a negative test is still required), that quarantine remains for unvaccinated travellers, and that the amendment Paternotte/Kuiken provides the legal basis.

Given the strongly increased vaccination rate in the Netherlands and the limited risk that vaccinated travellers pose to public health for transmission of the coronavirus, the cabinet has decided to exempt vaccinated travellers from the quarantine obligation from 22 September.

Gezien de sterk toegenomen vaccinatiegraad in Nederland en het beperkte risico dat gevaccineerde reizigers voor de volksgezondheid vormen voor de transmissie van het coronavirus, heeft het kabinet besloten gevaccineerde reizigers per 22 september uit te zonderen van de quarantaineplicht
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Hagen over het bericht ‘IJzeretende bacterie gevonden in Kanaal van Gent naar Terneuzen’

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports of an iron-eating bacterium in the Ghent-Terneuzen canal, its risks to ships and dams, whether it has reached the Dutch side, and whether the canal should be closed. The minister answered that no damage on the Dutch side is known yet, that Rijkswaterstaat will inspect locations with results expected in October, and that closure is not an option, while cooperation with Flanders on the cause is ongoing.
Rijkswaterstaat will participate in the investigation announced by Flanders and carry out targeted inspections itself.
Rijkswaterstaat zal participeren in het onderzoek dat Vlaanderen heeft aangekondigd en zelf gerichte inspecties uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en De Groot over het bericht ‘Chemelot mag 14.000 kilo microplastics per jaar in de Maas lozen’

MPs De Groot and Hagen (D66) asked whether the water permit allowing Chemelot to discharge about 14,040 kg of microplastics per year into the Maas is compatible with environmental and health protection, the precautionary principle, the Water Framework Directive and BBT, and how oversight works. The minister answers that the permit is the competence of the Limburg water board, that a research obligation with a report due January 2024 was included, and mostly refers back to earlier answers, committing to no new concrete action.
The competent authority is responsible for supervising the permits issued.
Het bevoegd gezag is verantwoordelijk voor het houden van toezicht op de afgegeven vergunningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht ‘Kan zonnebrand koraal aantasten?’

MPs Hagen and Tjeerd de Groot asked about reports that sunscreen chemicals harm coral, the Bonaire ban on oxybenzone-containing products, and whether Dutch waters are polluted by UV filters. The minister acknowledged the Bonaire motion and the need for regulation, said UV-filter levels in Dutch surface water were below reporting limits, noted monitoring around the BES islands is planned, and pointed to ongoing EU REACH assessments of octinoxate and oxybenzone without committing to new national measures.
A monitoring programme around the BES islands is currently being prepared and will likely start in 2022.
Op dit moment wordt een monitoringsprogramma rond de BES-eilanden voorbereid dat waarschijnlijk in 2022 van start kan gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke en Hagen over het bericht 'De wereld heeft veel meer grondstoffen nodig om de klimaatdoelen te halen'

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers how the Netherlands is raising raw material supply for the energy transition in a clean, recycling-focused way, and how it responds to an IEA report on critical minerals. The government answered that it works through EU critical materials and circular economy plans, a circular manufacturing transition agenda, and innovation programmes, without committing to new concrete measures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen, Bouchallikh, Grinwis, Van Raan en De Hoop over de minicargovluchten die worden uitgevoerd tussen Luik en Maastricht

MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about mini cargo flights between Liège and Maastricht, including how many occurred, whether the minister still opposes them for environmental reasons, and whether a ban like France's is legally possible. The minister confirmed seven repositioning flights since January (six by Astral Aviation), said the EU framework lacks room for national bans, and promised to monitor France's case and raise the issue in revising EU Regulation 1008/2008.

A concrete legal basis for temporarily banning such flights due to serious environmental problems is absent from Dutch legislation and, given their cross-border nature, could not be unilaterally established by the Netherlands.

Een concrete wettelijke grondslag voor het tijdelijk verbieden van dergelijke vluchten wegens ernstige milieuproblemen ontbreekt in de Nederlandse wetgeving en zou gelet op het grensoverschrijdend karakter niet eenzijdig door Nederland vastgesteld kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Paternotte, Hagen, Boucke, Grinwis en Ceder over niet-EU-familieleden van expats, die geen toegang hebben tot Nederland

MPs from D66 and ChristenUnie asked whether non-EU family members of expats and residents are barred from entering the Netherlands under the EU entry ban and Dutch flight bans, whether this breaches Article 8 ECHR, and whether exceptions can be made for Suriname and other regions. The government answered that family of Dutch residents with residence permits are exempt, that individual exceptions exist for urgent family reasons, that the flight bans were lifted on 1 June 2021, and that generic exceptions for first- and second-degree relatives were not desirable.
The cabinet notes that the right to private and family life in Article 8 ECHR does not constitute an absolute right of access to the Netherlands.
Daarbij merkt het kabinet op dat het in artikel 8 EVRM opgenomen recht op privé en familieleven geen absoluut recht tot toegang tot Nederland behelst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Hagen over het bericht dat Duitsland reisbeperkingen instelt voor het Verenigd Koninkrijk vanwege de opmars van de Indiase virusvariant B.1617

MPs Paternotte and Hagen asked about Germany's travel restrictions on the UK over the Indian B.1617 variant, the adequacy of contact tracing and genomic surveillance, and whether further measures are needed. Minister De Jonge replied that the RIVM advises no additional measures now, that surveillance meets ECDC norms with about 1500 sequences weekly, and that the RIVM will keep monitoring.

At my request, the RIVM will continue to closely monitor the situation and will advise me, both on request and unsolicited, if additional measures for travellers from the UK turn out to be needed at a later time.

Op mijn verzoek blijft het RIVM de situatie nauwgezet monitoren, waarbij zij mij gevraagd en ongevraagd zal adviseren indien aanvullende maatregelen voor reizigers uit het VK op een later moment alsnog nodig blijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht 'Tata Steel overtreedt opnieuw milieuregels: loost zonder vergunning kwik in het riool'

MPs Hagen and Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked about press reports that Tata Steel discharged mercury into the sewer without a permit, and about an Omgevingsdienst letter demanding incomplete emissions data. The minister replied that the data are still under assessment by the competent authority, that the discharge is not expected to cause additional harm, and that the company must supply missing data within set deadlines.
I will inform you as soon as a judgement has been made on this.
Ik zal u informeren zodra hierover geoordeeld is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over vliegverboden en de coronasituatie in India en Zuid-Amerika

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about travel bans and the COVID situation in India and South America, including whether the B.1.617 variant justified a flight ban on India. The minister answered that the RIVM advised no ban on India for now, that the list of banned countries is reviewed regularly, and that the government is preparing mandatory quarantine for travellers from very high-risk areas.
The RIVM has also recently indicated that it currently sees no reason to advise imposing a flight ban.
Het RIVM heeft ook recent aangegeven op dit moment geen aanleiding te zien om te adviseren een vliegverbod in te stellen.

m: Motie van het lid Van der Hoeff c.s. over onderzoeken welke ondersteuning nodig is om leerlingen met internaliserende problematiek en leerlingen met externaliserende problematiek in het speciaal onder
Asks the government to investigate and report to the House what support teachers and pupils need when mixing pupils with internalising and externalising problems in special education.
requests the government to investigate what support is needed for the teacher and the pupil
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken wat er qua ondersteuning voor de leraar en de leerling nodig is
Motie van het lid Van der Hoeff over de taalvaardigheid van eerstejaars mbo-studenten direct monitoren bij de intakeprocedure
Asks the government to monitor reading skills of first-year MBO students at intake and offer mandatory catch-up programmes.
requests the government to monitor first-year MBO students directly at intake for reading skills
verzoekt de regering eerstejaarsstudenten in het mbo direct bij de intakeprocedure te monitoren op leesvaardigheid
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boon en Van der Hoeff over herhaalde antisemitisme en oproepen tot geweld door Radboud-docent Harry Pettit

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how she judges a Radboud University lecturer's statements comparing Zionists to Nazis and calling for eradicating Zionism, whether this warrants criminal reporting, and why the university has not dismissed him. The Minister called the statements abject, said criminality is not for her to determine, left employment and conduct measures to the university as employer, described the inspectorate's and Raad van Toezicht's roles, and rejected the claim that the university lacks moral authority.
It is for Radboud University, as employer, to take measures towards its staff where necessary.
Het is aan de Radboud Universiteit om, als werkgever, zo nodig maatregelen te nemen richting haar medewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boon en Van der Hoeff over antisemitisme en oproep tot ingrijpen wegens wanbeheer

Two PVV MPs asked the education minister whether recent occupations at the University of Amsterdam and Radboud University endangered students and staff, whether students should be expelled, and whether the minister would order an inspection and a formal instruction for alleged mismanagement by the boards. The minister answered that institutions handle disciplinary measures themselves, that the Inspectorate acts independently and a formal instruction is not currently warranted, and that the sector is being engaged on antisemitism and safety.

If the Inspectorate of Education, after investigation, concludes there is mismanagement within the meaning of the WHW, i.e. a serious degree of neglect of social safety, I can as a last resort issue a formal instruction to the Supervisory Board.

Wanneer de Inspectie van het Onderwijs na onderzoek tot de conclusie komt dat er sprake is van wanbeheer in de zin van de WHW, dus van ernstige mate van verwaarlozen van de sociale veiligheid, kan ik als ultimum remedium overgaan tot het geven van een aanwijzing aan de RvT.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boon, Van der Hoef en Uppelschoten over het bericht 'Lezing pro-Israëlische activiste op Radboud Universiteit ruw verstoord, aangifte tegen gemaskerde docent: ’Hij leidde de bende’ en anti

MPs from the PVV asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a disrupted lecture at Radboud University, lecturers linked to Scholars for Palestine, alleged antisemitic slogans at demonstrations, and the awarding of a contract for antisemitism-prevention lessons in schools. The Minister said universities must report offences and take measures proportionate to the situation, that the TU Delft and UM handle their own assessments, and that the Fawaka contract was awarded on multiple criteria with the award documents withheld as confidential.
The associated award and assessment documents cannot be sent to the House, because they contain commercially sensitive and confidential information.
De bijbehorende gunnings- en beoordelingsdocumenten kunnen we niet aan de Kamer toesturen, omdat deze bedrijfsgevoelige en vertrouwelijke informatie bevatten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Hoeff over het artikel ‘VU laat pro-Palestina demonstratie toe tijdens belangrijk tentamen: ‘Neem koptelefoon mee’'

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Education whether the VU's decision to allow a pro-Palestinian demonstration during an important exam was proportionate, and whether recent talks with universities were improving outcomes. The Minister replied that the VU did not formally permit the disturbance, that it rescheduled activities and took crowd-control measures, and that he had spoken with the VU but saw no reason for further talks.
I have discussed this with the VU and obtained information about the incident in question.
Ik ben hierover met de VU in gesprek gegaan en heb informatie ingewonnen over het genoemde voorval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Hoeff over de evaluatie van de meiprotesten 2024 op de Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA)

An MP asks the minister how she views the Berenschot evaluation of the May 2024 protests at the University of Amsterdam, including whether university boards can keep order, whether boards should resign, and whether the UvA should be placed under enhanced supervision. The minister says the evaluation is welcome and the UvA will act on its lessons, rejects the claim that boards act above the law, declines to provide disciplinary figures (a matter for the UvA), and rules out enhanced supervision since no mismanagement has been established by the Inspectorate.
Placing the UvA under enhanced supervision is not an option.
Het plaatsen van de UvA onder verscherpt toezicht is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boon en Van der Hoeff over hakenkruizen en antisemitisme op het United World College (UWC) in Maastricht

MPs Boon and Van der Hoeff asked the Minister of Education about swastikas and antisemitism at UWC Maastricht, including a reported incident involving a six-year-old Israeli girl and whether the school handled antisemitism adequately. The State Secretary answered that the school handled six reported swastika incidents with internal investigations, sanctions in one case, and extra measures, that the inspectorate sees no reason for further steps, and that the school is urged to use the antisemitism guidance.
The inspectorate currently sees no reason for follow-up steps.
De inspectie ziet op dit moment geen reden voor vervolgstappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Hoeff over het artikel 'Ambtenaren op ministeries moeten opstaan tegen een Wilders, Trump en Musk'

A PVV MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about remarks by the ministry's secretary-general and other civil servants, reported as calling for resistance against politicians, at a Reuring!Café event. The minister defended the civil servants' duty of neutrality and constitutional loyalty, declined to comment on individual remarks, and said discrimination will be addressed as a matter of good employership.
From their professional civil-service role, they bring all relevant aspects into well-considered political decision-making.
Vanuit hun ambtelijke professionaliteit brengen zij alle relevante aspecten in ten behoeve van goed afgewogen politieke besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Hoeff over het bericht “Hoe schoolbestuurders zakendoen met bekenden en zichzelf”

An MP asks whether school board members and supervisors who also hold paid roles at private education advisory firms create conflicts of interest, and why OCW and the Inspectorate cannot intervene. The Secretary of State calls such conflicts unacceptable, points to existing civil-code and governance-code rules and inspectorate enforcement, and promises a bill on governance and internal supervision with consultation expected by end of December, plus a letter in autumn on regulating the advisory market.
Board members and internal supervisors must be beyond any doubt.
Bestuurders en intern toezichthouders moeten boven elke twijfel verheven zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Hoeff en Crijns over het bericht 'Zorgen bij kinderombudsman: Steeds meer kinderen gaan niet naar school'

MPs Van der Hoeff and Crijns asked the minister about a report that more children are staying out of school and the implications for the child ombudsman's concerns, including links to youth care waiting lists and the closure of secure youth care. The minister acknowledges the problem, cites causes such as waiting lists, teacher shortages and Long COVID, and lists measures like digital schooling and a truancy bill, without confirming a link to secure youth care closures.
Together with schools, collaborative partnerships, municipalities and care organisations, we are working to ensure that no child stays at home unnecessarily any longer.
Samen met scholen, samenwerkingsverbanden en gemeenten en zorgorganisaties zetten we ons in om ervoor te zorgen dat geen kind meer onnodig thuiszit.

m: Motie van het lid Thiadens over een onafhankelijk instituut dat alle data over medicijntekorten bij elkaar brengt
Asks the government to talk with insurers, pharmacists and manufacturers about creating an independent institute gathering all medicine shortage data.
requests the government to talk with insurers, pharmacists and pharmacies to establish an independent institute
verzoekt de regering om met verzekeraars, farmaceuten en apotheken in gesprek te gaan om te komen tot de oprichting van een onafhankelijk instituut
Motie van het lid Thiadens over zicht op medicatietekorten en naleving van verplichte buffervoorraden
Asks the government to present a plan giving insight into medicine shortages and compliance with mandatory buffer stocks, reporting to the House within five months.
the Minister has insufficient insight into the shortages and cannot properly check compliance
de Minister onvoldoende zicht heeft op de tekorten en de naleving niet goed kan controleren
Motie van het lid Thiadens over alles in het werk stellen om evergreening tegen te gaan
Asks the government to do everything possible to stop pharmaceutical 'evergreening', where existing medicines are modified to extend patent protection and block competition.
requests the government to do everything in its power to counter 'evergreening'
verzoekt de regering alles in het werk te stellen om «evergreening» tegen te gaan
Motie van het lid Thiadens over betere monitoring en evaluatie van zorgakkoorden
Asks the government to improve monitoring and evaluation of health care agreements to show their effectiveness and report to the House annually.
requests the government to achieve better monitoring and evaluation of the care agreements to make their effectiveness transparent, and to inform the House annually about this
verzoekt de regering betere monitoring en evaluatie van de zorgakkoorden te bewerkstelligen en daarmee de effectiviteit ervan inzichtelijk te maken, en de Kamer hier jaarlijks over te informeren
Motie van het lid Thiadens over intensief toezicht op mensen met een chronische ziekte of handicap verminderen
Asks the government to reduce intensive supervision of people with chronic illness or disability and focus more on fraud across healthcare.
requests the government to reduce the intensive supervision of people with a chronic illness or disability
verzoekt de regering het intensieve toezicht op mensen met een chronische ziekte of handicap te verminderen
Motie van het lid Thiadens over mensen met een chronische ziekte of handicap enkel vragen om bewijsstukken bij een significante wijziging
Asks the government to require chronically ill or disabled people with structural care costs to submit proof only when costs or indication change significantly.
requests the government to ask people with a chronic illness or disability with structural costs for proof only when there is a significant change in costs or indication
verzoekt de regering om mensen met een chronische ziekte of handicap met structurele kosten enkel te vragen om bewijsstukken aan te leveren bij een significante wijziging in de kosten of de indicatie
Motie van de leden Thiadens en Eerdmans over uitspreken dat intramuraal verblijf niet hetzelfde is als thuis
Asks the government to state that intramural (residential) care is not the same as living at home.
requests the government to state that residential care is not the same as living at home
verzoekt de regering uit te spreken dat intramuraal verblijf niet hetzelfde is als thuis
Motie van het lid Thiadens c.s. over langdurige indicatiestelling voor thuiswonenden met een levenslange en levensbrede beperking mogelijk maken
Asks the government to end mandatory periodic re-assessment of care eligibility for people at home with lifelong, broad disabilities and allow long-term indication.
requests the government to end the system of mandatory periodic re-indication for home-dwelling people with a lifelong, broad limitation
verzoekt de regering het systeem van verplichte periodieke herindicatie voor thuiswonenden met een levenslange, levensbrede beperking te beëindigen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thiadens over het artikel ‘Bewoners van wooncomplex in Enschede verdrietig: ‘Niet meer dat gezellige kopje koffie’

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Health about a care provider (Livio) converting a residential care complex in Enschede into social housing, with residents feeling isolated by neighbourhood visitors and facing higher costs. The State Secretary said the situation is regrettable, that community-building is generally positive, that no residents hold a Wlz care indication, and that Livio has offered a rent freeze and is working to improve atmosphere.
I am not aware of any cost increases resulting from this change.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van verhoging van kosten die het gevolg zijn van deze wijziging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thiadens over de ernstige misstanden bij woonlocatie De Akker

An MP asked the Minister of Health about abuse of vulnerable residents at care location De Akker, filmed and shared online by staff, and whether controls and enforcement had failed. The minister condemned the abuse, said the IGJ is awaiting the provider's investigation, and noted the staff were dismissed and criminal complaint filed, but could not guarantee residents' safety and gave only general commitments.
The Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGJ) has taken up the report.
De Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) heeft de melding in behandeling genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thiadens over het bericht: ‘Recordaantal gedwongen opnames gevraagd voor verpleeghuis: ‘Vooral alleenstaande demente ouderen vormen een groot gevaar’'

An MP asked the Health Minister about news reports of record numbers of compulsory admissions of elderly people with dementia and whether restoring old-age care homes would prevent these. The minister acknowledged the dangers, defended the Wzd safeguards and said care homes would not have prevented compulsory admissions, while a study on their return and housing targets are ongoing.
In the extreme case it is possible to admit an elderly person with dementia against their wishes if they are a danger to themselves or others.
In het uiterste geval is het mogelijk om een oudere met dementie tegen zijn wens in op te nemen als hij een gevaar voor zichzelf of anderen is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thiadens over het bericht 'Tegen wil en dank fit: Hengelose ouderen moeten sporten voor thuishulp, maar Adje (88) protesteert'

An MP (PVV) asks the state secretary whether Wmo support for elderly people should be unconditional and not tied to joining the 'powerfull ageing' exercise programme, which municipalities reportedly make a quasi-obligation with long waits for home help. The state secretary agrees in principle that Wmo support must not depend on participation, calls the programme's use in some municipalities critical, and commits to talks with the VNG soon.
If it is the case that municipalities impose a disguised obligation on vulnerable elderly people that leads them not to use Wmo support, then I share the view that this is unacceptable.

Als het zo is dat gemeenten een verkapte verplichting opleggen aan kwetsbare ouderen die ertoe leidt dat ouderen geen gebruik maken van ondersteuning op grond van de Wmo, dan deel ik de mening dat dit onacceptabel is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thiadens en Emiel van Dijk over het bericht inzake de aanhouding van de 27-jarige verdachte voor de moord op een 76-jarige vrouw in Den Dolder

MPs Thiadens and Emiel van Dijk (PVV) asked about the fatal stabbing of a 76-year-old woman in Den Dolder by a 27-year-old patient on leave from a clinic, questioning who authorised the leave, the risk assessment, and safety measures. The state secretaries largely declined to answer on the specific case pending an Inspectorate investigation, pointed to the provider Fivoor's responsibility, and described general measures and a planned relocation.
Pending this investigation, we cannot address questions about this specific incident.
In afwachting van dit onderzoek kunnen we niet ingaan op vragen over dit specifieke incident.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thiadens over het bericht ‘Dramatisch meer valdoden onder ouderen: ‘Bont en blauw, pezen afgescheurd, maar ik kwam er nog goed vanaf’

An MP asked the state secretary about rising fall deaths among older people, including whether anticoagulant and midazolam use is recorded and whether medication evaluations and municipal fall-prevention programmes are adequate. The state secretary answered that medication use is only recorded when directly linked to the injury, that a 2024 study is being followed up with a progress letter promised before end-2024, and that municipalities have SPUK funds and support for fall prevention.
No. As explained in the answer to question 2, medication use is not routinely recorded in the emergency department registration unless there is a direct link to the injury diagnosis.
Nee. Zoals toegelicht bij het antwoord op vraag 2, wordt het medicatiegebruik niet standaard vermeld in de SEH-registratie, tenzij er een direct verband is met de letseldiagnose.

qn: Vragen van het lid Koppejan (CDA) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over drinkwater en Europese vereisten (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

Koppejan (CDA) asks the minister whether the national norm for non-human-toxicologically relevant pesticide metabolites in the Drinking Water Decree goes beyond the EU Drinking Water Directive, and why it is set and not notified, with questions on impact, costs and the RIVM advice. The minister answers that the Directive requires relevant metabolites to be covered, that the national 1.0 microgram/l norm is a precautionary choice based on RIVM advice that is less strict than in other member states, that no separate notification is needed for one-to-one implementation, and that no extra impact is expected from existing monitoring.
The norm will however be reported to the Commission as part of the Drinking Water Decree in implementation of Article 17(2) of the Drinking Water Directive.
De norm zal wel (als onderdeel van het Drinkwaterbesluit) aan de Commissie worden gemeld ter uitvoering van art. 17, tweede lid, van de Drinkwaterrichtlijn.

Vragen van de leden De Mos en Gerbrands (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over verdubbeling in het aantal legionellagevallen

Two PVV MPs asked the housing/environment and health ministers about a doubling of legionella cases, asking whether weather influences the rise, whether water quality will be investigated and warnings issued, and what is done to prevent legionella in warm standing water. The minister's reply only announces that the answers will be late because consultation with the relevant bodies takes more time.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over invloed van CO2 in de atmosfeer op temperatuurstijging (ingezonden 20 september 2010).

An MP asks the minister whether a lecture by a former AKZO director, claiming a doubling of CO2 yields only 0.27 degrees warming, reopens the debate on human-caused warming, and whether climate policy should be halted until the IPCC conclusions are better substantiated. The minister answers that the lecturer's trends stem from changes in measurement systems rather than atmospheric change, and that there is no reason to doubt the IPCC's main conclusions, so no investigation or policy halt is planned.
The lecture by Mr Van Andel gives no reason to doubt the main conclusions of the IPCC.
De lezing van de heer Van Andel geeft geen aanleiding te twijfelen aan de hoofdconclusies van het IPCC.
Vragen van het lid Koopmans (CDA) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het overgangsrecht voor het separate projectbesluit (ingezonden 9 augustus 2010).

An MP asks the housing and spatial planning minister to explain a newsletter notice on transitional law for separate project decisions under the Wabo, whether this creates delay, and why legal procedures must be repeated. The minister confirms a gap in transitional law exists, says no significant procedural delay follows, and promises a legislative fix as soon as possible though not before 1 October.
My intention is to bring this forward as part of a broader bill as quickly as possible.
Mijn bedoeling is om dit als onderdeel van een meeromvattend wetsvoorstel zo snel mogelijk in procedure te brengen.

Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Financiën over het werkelijke brandstofverbruik van vermeend schone en zuinige auto’s (ingezonden 9 septem

MP Jansen (SP) asked ministers about the gap between official test fuel consumption and real-world consumption of supposedly clean cars, the actions taken, the timeline for a more realistic test, EU competence, CO2 targets and fiscal incentives. The minister answered that the test is EU-harmonised and cannot be changed unilaterally, that a new test is expected around 2015, that the government acknowledges the test needs revising, and that the discrepancy does not affect air quality targets.
The Netherlands cannot deviate from this unilaterally.
Nederland kan daar niet eenzijdig van afwijken.

Vragen van het lid Koopmans (CDA) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het meetellen van biokerosine voor de bijmengverplichting van biobrandstoffen binnen de EU (ingezonden 8 j

An MP asked whether biokerosine could count toward the EU biofuel blending obligation and why it was left out of Dutch implementing rules. The minister answered that it was excluded because of the link with the fuel quality directive and that the rules could be amended in 2011 once uncertainties are resolved.

I will make efforts in the coming months to remove the uncertainties, so that the regulations can be adjusted in the second half of 2011 and biokerosine can be included in meeting the renewable energy targets in transport.

Ik zal mij de komende maanden inspannen om de onzekerheden weg te nemen, zodat de regelgeving in de tweede helft van 2011 aangepast kan worden en biokerosine meegenomen kan worden bij het behalen van de doelstellingen hernieuwbare energie in het vervoer.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de Centrale As (ingezonden 1 juli 2010).

An MP asked the housing and spatial planning minister whether she supports the Centrale As motorway and why she dropped her objection to the provincial zoning plan, and asked about need for the road and the 2,300 residents opposing it. The minister replied that she withdrew further legal steps after consultations and additional studies found sufficient guarantees for landscape integration, and that she respects the province's decision on the road and a related business park is not part of the plan.

In June 2010 I informed the province of Fryslân in writing that, after the consultations and recently conducted additional studies, I see no reason to take further legal steps in the subsequent procedure.

In juni 2010 heb ik de provincie Fryslân schriftelijk laten weten dat, na de gevoerde overleggen en de recent uitgevoerde aanvullende onderzoeken, ik geen aanleiding meer zie om in het vervolgtraject verdere juridische stappen te ondernemen.

Vragen van de leden Jacobi en Samsom (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de aanleg van een geluidswal met vervuilde g

MPs Jacobi and Samsom asked ministers about a noise barrier built with contaminated soil in the Heerenveen EHS nature area, including whether a contractor built it free of charge, whether heavier contaminated soil is used, and whether ecological and health effects were studied. The government's reply is only a notice that answers will be delayed because consultation with the parties involved takes more time.
Consultation with the bodies involved requires more time.
Het overleg met de betrokken instanties vergt meer tijd.

Vragen van de leden Van Gent en Van Tongeren (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het terugvliegen naar Nederland per privéjet (ingezonden 26 augustus 2010)

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether the environment minister flew home from Italy by private jet at taxpayers' expense, whether ministers often do this, and whether such flights are defensible in times of ecological and economic crisis. The minister confirmed a government flight to Rotterdam, cited the entitlement rules for transport and accompaniment, said the return was by scheduled flight and that all business travel is now fully carbon-compensated.
On Tuesday 17 August I flew from Perugia to Rotterdam on a government flight.
Op dinsdag 17 augustus ben ik met een regeringsvlucht van Perugia naar Rotterdam gevlogen.

Vragen van het lid Neppérus (VVD) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het artikel «Huizinga laat zich met privéjet uit Italië

An MP asked whether the housing minister flew from Italy in a private jet at ministry expense costing €11,800, and questioned her holiday timing during budget debates. The government answered that the flight was a government flight that the minister has paid for herself, that the holiday schedule was not tied to school holidays, and that the trip complied with rules on ministerial travel.
The minister has since decided to bear these costs herself and has already paid them.
De minister heeft inmiddels besloten deze kosten voor eigen rekening te nemen en heeft deze reeds betaald.

Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Samsom (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het bericht dat minister Huizinga zich

PvdA MPs asked whether minister Huizinga used a private jet from Italy at ministry expense, and what rules govern ministerial travel and the meaning of 'necessary facilities'. The minister confirmed a government flight was used to attend a budget debate and a scheduled flight home, maintained the decision was within article 6 of the Voorzieningenbesluit, and declined to tighten the rules.
Do you consider it desirable to tighten the aforementioned Voorzieningenbesluit regarding business travel other than by car?
Vraag 9 Acht u aanscherping van het genoemde voorzieningenbesluit ten aanzien van dienstreizen anders dan per auto gewenst?

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken, van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de Europese export van afgekeurde voedi

An MP asked ministers whether the EU exports rejected food and banned chemicals such as DDT to Africa, and how export of non-compliant fish and expired food is controlled. The government answered that DDT export is banned under EU rules (transit possible, WHO-sanctioned malaria use), that prior-consent procedures apply to restricted chemicals, and that non-compliant Dutch fish must be destroyed and the VWA supervises, while offering no new commitments.
No. DDT is a substance listed under the Stockholm Convention on persistent organic pollutants, and European regulation prohibits exporting DDT from Europe.
Nee. DDT is een stof die op de lijst staat van het Verdrag van Stockholm inzake persistente organische verontreinigende stoffen en Europese regelgeving verbiedt het om DDT uit Europa te exporteren.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het bericht dat de ijskappen minder hard smelten (ingezonden 6 september 2010).

An MP asked the minister about a TU Delft study finding ice caps melt less than thought, whether the study's inclusion of crustal measurements was justified, and whether such measurements would be adopted in future research. The minister answered that the method is new, not yet very accurate, and that the authors themselves call for further research.
This new method is still in its infancy and is not yet very accurate.
Deze nieuwe methode staat nog in de kinderschoenen en is nog niet heel nauwkeurig.

Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de emissie-eisen voor tweewielers (ingezonden 16 juli 2010).

MP Jansen asks ministers about the rising popularity of scooters, their contribution to air pollution, and the much weaker emission standards for mopeds and motorcycles compared with cars, and whether stricter standards and tax differentiation should be pursued. The minister answers that moped contributions to national pollutants are small, that she ambitions to raise moped emission standards to car levels and supports faster EU tightening, but that tax differentiation is not feasible and no moped tax will be proposed.
It is my ambition to raise the emission requirements for two-wheeled motor vehicles to the current level of standards for passenger cars.
Het is mijn ambitie om de eisen aan de uitstoot van tweewielige motorvoertuigen op te trekken tot het huidige niveau van de normen voor personenauto's.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Leeuwen (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over mantelzorgwoningen (ingezonden 6 mei 2010).

The SP MPs asked the housing and health ministers about municipal rules for care annexes (mantelzorgwoningen) and the enforcement against families living in such annexes, such as a penalty imposed by Schiermonnikoog. The minister acknowledged application difficulties, promised reforms and a later letter, said the delay was regrettable, and declined to judge the local enforcement decision, pointing to the courts.
I cannot intervene in a local assessment of whether to permit a care situation on a particular plot.
Ik kan niet treden in een lokale afweging om op een bepaald perceel al dan niet een mantelzorgsituatie toe te staan.

Vragen van het lid Neppérus (VVD) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Verkeer en Waterstaat over plannen van Waternet voor een zwembad in de Amstel bij Amsterdam nabij het k

An MP asked ministers whether Waternet's plan for a swimming pool in the Amstel near its office fits the tasks of a drinking-water company and water board, and what action would be taken. The ministers answered that the project is a municipal matter for Amsterdam and Waternet, that they were not previously informed, that funding comes from an Amsterdam educational budget, and that they see no reason to act or give cost details.
Building a swimming pool in the Amstel is a matter for the municipality of Amsterdam and the board of the Waternet foundation.
Het aanleggen van een zwembad in de Amstel is een aangelegenheid van de gemeente Amsterdam en het bestuur van de stichting Waternet.

Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de bedreiging van Brabants drinkwater door ondergrondse opslag van kernafval in België (ingezonden 9 septembe

An SP MP asked the minister whether Brabant drinking water is threatened by Belgian plans for underground nuclear waste storage near the Dutch border, and what legal protection Dutch authorities, citizens and firms would have. The minister replied that Belgium has not chosen a site or decided on deep geological storage (not before 2020), that the Netherlands has not yet submitted a position but is in intensive official contact, that Belgian procedures give Dutch parties less notification than Dutch rules, and that the Netherlands will stay involved and act to protect drinking water.
Should a decision be taken on underground storage of radioactive waste, the Dutch government will be intensively involved in the entire process
Mocht het zover komen dat een besluit wordt genomen over ondergrondse opslag van radioactief afval, zal de Nederlandse regering intensief betrokken zijn bij het gehele proces

Vragen van de leden Linhard en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de financiële risico’s van het Wieringerrandmeer (ingezonden 11 juni 2010).

MPs Linhard and Vermeij asked the minister whether the province of Noord-Holland's financial risks on the Wieringerrandmeer project (about 100 million euro, including a 30 million euro aqueduct) could fall on the national budget and whether the central government had approved them. The minister answered that the project is a provincial matter, the state does not participate or contribute, no agreement on aqueduct costs exists, and the province's risks are limited to invested equity, with approval a provincial responsibility.
Approval of this project is, however, a provincial responsibility. Provincial States are ultimately responsible.
Goedkeuring van dit project is echter een provinciale verantwoordelijkheid. Provinciale Staten zijn uiteindelijk eindverantwoordelijk.
Vragen van het lid Neppérus (VVD) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over dubieuze afkoop van vervuiling (ingezonden 11 augustus 2010).

An MP asked the environment minister about reports that CDM carbon credits from HFC-23 projects were inflated and whether Dutch firms knew, and whether the EU emissions trading system should continue. The minister said the UN CDM Executive Board's further investigation must be awaited, that Dutch CDM credit use is capped at 10% of allocations, and that a Dutch inquiry would follow if warranted.
If the results of the follow-up investigation give cause for it, I will consider whether and how an inquiry into the Dutch situation can be carried out.
Als de resultaten van het vervolgonderzoek er aanleiding toe geven, zal ik bezien of en hoe een onderzoek naar de Nederlandse situatie vorm gegeven kan worden.
Vragen van het lid Koopmans (CDA) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over CDM-Projecten (ingezonden 16 juli 2010).

An MP asks the minister whether Dutch CDM carbon credit contracts should be frozen pending clarity on possible fraud in HFC-22 projects, and questions contracts with China and India, credit validity risk, pricing, and disclosure of contract details. The minister answers that contracts cannot be frozen once credits are issued, most contracts are already signed, no new HFC contracts will be made, prices followed market levels, and contract details will not be published for commercial and contractual reasons.
I do not consider it wise to make contract details public.
Ik acht het niet verstandig daarbij contractgegevens in de openbaarheid te brengen.

Vragen van het lid Vendrik (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over een overeenkomst met Shell omtrent CO2-opslag in Barendrecht (ingezonden 2

Green Left MP Vendrik asked whether a written agreement with Shell on CO2 storage at Barendrecht already exists, its status, possible compensation liability, and why published documents are incomplete or unsigned. The government answered that the agreement was drafted but left unsigned because it will be converted into a subsidy with an implementation agreement, to be signed by a next cabinet, and that no operating permit legally requires a contract.
This agreement is not signed because it was decided to convert the agreement into a subsidy with an implementing agreement.
Deze overeenkomst is niet ondertekend omdat gekozen is voor de omzetting van de overeenkomst naar een subsidie met uitvoeringsovereenkomst.
Vragen van het lid Polderman (SP) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over verlies van GGO-koolzaad en het ontbrekend COGEM-advies (ingezonden 20 mei 2010).

An SP MP asks the minister about GM rapeseed spillage during transport and the missing COGEM advice on the Amflora potato's antibiotic resistance gene. The minister replies that spillage risk appears small, that approved GM varieties were assessed for spillage, that no new measures are needed beyond monitoring and customs checks, and that the Amflora assessment was complete.
After completion of the entire COGEM project, I will examine whether and how the results can be used to improve the effectiveness of control measures where necessary.
Na afronding van het gehele COGEM project zal ik bezien of en hoe de resultaten kunnen worden gebruikt om de effectiviteit van controlemaatregelen zo nodig te verbeteren.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over activiteiten van Nederlandse drinkwaterbedrijven in China (ingezonden 30 juni 2010).

An SP MP asked the minister whether Dutch public drinking water companies' foreign commercial activities in China are permissible, whether the government holds data on their size, and how compliance with the 1% foreign-turnover guideline is monitored. The minister answered that the companies' annual reports already disclose foreign activities, that public shareholders are primarily responsible for oversight, and that the 1% limit actually concerns the share of turnover spent on WASH-related foreign activities rather than all commercial turnover.

The public shareholders are primarily responsible for the drinking water companies and can, with the mentioned and any additional information from the companies, keep track of the foreign activities and compliance with the policy letter.

De publieke aandeelhouders zijn de eerst verantwoordelijken voor de drinkwaterbedrijven en kunnen met de genoemde en eventuele aanvullende informatie vanuit de drinkwaterbedrijven zicht houden op de buitenlandse activiteiten en de naleving van de beleidsbrief.

Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de voormalig hoogleraar milieukunde en onderzoeker aan de Universiteit van Ottawa (ingezonden 30 juli 2010).

MP De Mos (PVV) asks the minister about a former Ottawa environmental scientist's claim that man-made global warming is a corrupt social phenomenon, whether IPCC scientists serve governments, and whether CO2 emissions trading is fraudulent. The minister answers that the 'corrupt' wording is not in the cited essay, that IPCC authors are selected on expertise and unpaid, and refers to earlier answers on emissions-trading fraud.
The authors of the IPCC reports are selected by the IPCC Bureau primarily on the basis of scientific expertise.
Antwoord 3 De auteurs van de IPCC rapporten worden geselecteerd door het Bureau van IPCC primair op basis van wetenschappelijke expertise.

Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het bericht dat adviesbureau CE in Delft in een gepubliceerd rapport stelt dat huishoudens jaarlijks 500 eur

An MP asks the minister about a CE Delft report proposing higher environmental taxes, including fuel levies, a VAT rise and a CO2 levy, and disputes the climate basis and the cost to households. The minister answers that the report concerns a greener tax system, not a general tax increase, that it is about broader sustainability, and that the government is not freezing climate policy.
The aim of the study is to provide building blocks for greening the tax system, not a general increase in the tax burden.
De insteek van de studie is bouwstenen aan te dragen voor een vergroening van het belastingstelsel, niet een algehele verhoging van de belastingdruk.

Vragen van het de leden Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink en Ortega-Martijn (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Financiën over MVO-criteria voor banken (i

MPs from the ChristenUnie asked whether the government will require a transparent CSR policy and a minimum CSR level in all tenders for financial services, and whether it will exclude banks linked to cluster munitions or harmful firms. The minister replied that CSR criteria will be considered case by case under proportionality rules, that a minimum CSR level is not suitable, and that financial services already fall under Duurzaam Inkopen and generic social criteria.
In future tenders for financial services, the central government will consider which criteria focusing on the socially responsible conduct of the contractor can be included.
Het Rijk zal bij toekomstige aanbestedingen van financiële diensten bezien welke criteria kunnen worden meegenomen die zich richten op het maatschappelijk verantwoord handelen van de opdrachtnemer.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over ophef over anti-glasnost brief Pachauri aan auteurs (ingezonden 16 juli 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether the IPCC chair's letter to report authors urging careful, coordinated media statements undermines open climate debate, and whether the minister would ask him to stop such letters. The minister answered that the letter was a call for care, that the chair clarified it in a follow-up stressing transparency and media contact, and that no request to the IPCC chair was made.
The letter primarily asks for care.
De brief vraagt primair om zorgvuldigheid.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het bericht «Zelfde catastrofedenkers bij nieuw IPCC» (ingezonden 30 juni 2010).

An MP from the PVV asked the environment minister whether activist climate scientists dominating the IPCC's author selection undermine trust, and whether a Greenpeace-linked coordinating lead author should be appointed to Working Group 2. The minister replied that author selection is based on scientific expertise via national nominations, that the appointed author's team is balanced, and that the PBL and an InterAcademy Council review will inform the IPCC process.
The IPCC secretariat selects authors based on nominations from countries and international organisations, and may also approach experts itself.
Het bureau van het IPCC doet de selectie van de auteurs op basis van de nominaties van landen en internationale organisaties en eventueel kan het bureau ook zelf experts benaderen.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over biobrandstof (ingezonden 1 juli 2010).

An MP asks the minister whether the EU should drop mandatory biofuel blending given CE Delft findings on deforestation and climate impact, and whether all biofuel targets competing with food land should be scrapped. The minister replies that sustainability criteria already apply, that Netherlands supports an indirect land-use change factor, and that food-competition risks are being monitored, without committing to abolish the blending target.

Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het rapport «Beleidsgericht onderzoeksprogramma fijn stof» (ingezonden 9 juli 2010).

An MP asked the minister about the PBL/RIVM/TNO fine-particulate research report, which finds a larger man-made share of PM10 and implications for air-quality policy, wood stoves, sea-salt deduction and EU targets. The minister answered all ten questions on substance, indicating follow-up research (BOP II), a review of the sea-salt deduction method, and support for tighter stove standards.
I have asked the RIVM to examine how the method for determining the sea-salt deduction could be adjusted based on the new insights
Ik heb het RIVM gevraagd om na te gaan (a) hoe op basis van de nieuwe inzichten de methodiek om de hoogte van de zeezoutaftrek vast te stellen, zou kunnen worden aangepast

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de (on)mogelijkheid om bedrijven die zich niet aan hun milieuvergunning houden, te kunnen sluiten (ingezo

MP Ouwehand asks the minister whether firms repeatedly breaching their environmental permits should be closable, whether periodic review should replace permits, why advice for lighter, temporary permits was not followed, and whether temporary permits would have prevented cases like Sterigenics in Zoetermeer and Nijhoff in Almelo. The minister says closure must remain possible for structural non-compliance, that existing review duties suffice, that temporary permits already exist and will be widened by the Wabo, and that Gedeputeerde Staten's revocation of Nijhoff's permit is open to appeal.
In the Wabo, which enters into force on 1 October 2010, the power to grant permits temporarily is extended.
In de Wet algemene bepalingen omgevingsrecht (Wabo), die op 1 oktober 2010 in werking treedt, wordt de bevoegdheid om vergunningen tijdelijk te verlenen uitgebreid.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Spies (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer, van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Financiën over E85 (ingezonden 27 mei 2010).

MPs Omtzigt and Spies asked the ministers about E85 and other high-blend biofuels, including tax correction, traceability, the Platform Duurzame Mobiliteit, and comparison with other European countries. The government answered that tax compensation for sustainable E85 applies since April 2010, that a temporary tax arrangement may be considered for new blends, and that traceability and infrastructure subsidies are being pursued, while leaving some matters to future reports.

If a company has concrete plans to introduce a new higher blend to the market and wants to test the product first, it will be examined whether a temporary excise compensation can be granted for a limited test period under strict conditions, analogous to the E85 arrangement.

Als een bedrijf concrete plannen heeft voor de marktintroductie van een nieuwe hogere blend en dit nieuwe product eerst wil testen, zal worden bezien of voor een gelimiteerde testperiode onder strikte voorwaarden een tijdelijke accijnscompensatie kan worden verleend analoog aan de regeling voor E85.

Vragen van het lid Koopmans (CDA) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het meetellen van biokerosine voor de bijmengverplichting van biobrandstoffen binnen de EU (ingezonden 8 j

MP Koopmans (CDA) asks whether the EU renewable energy directive allows biokerosene to count toward the biofuel blending obligation, whether Dutch implementing legislation considered this, and what steps the government would take to include aviation as the inland shipping sector was. The minister's reply is a holding notice only: the answers are delayed because consultation with several parties is needed.
Answering these questions will unfortunately take longer than the usual three-week period, because coordination with various involved parties is needed.
Het beantwoorden van deze vragen neemt helaas meer tijd in beslag nemen dan de gebruikelijke termijn van drie weken, doordat afstemming met diverse betrokken partijen gewenst is.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de isolatieafstanden bij experimentele gentechaardappels (in

Ouwehand (PvdD) asks why no isolation distances apply to Avebe's experimental genetically modified potato field trial, whether COGEM covers economic risks and cisgenic health risks, and how contamination of conventional and organic crops and hobby growers is prevented. Minister Huizinga-Heringa answers that COGEM assesses environmental risks only, isolation distances are required only where environmental risk demands them with co-existence rules set by the sector, and the government sees no reason to amend the 2008 permit.
I have adopted the COGEM advice on this category 2 field trial of AVEBE.
Ik heb het advies van de COGEM over deze categorie 2 veldproef van AVEBE overgenomen.
Vragen van het lid Koopmans (CDA) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over mogelijke wanpraktijken en of fraude bij CDM-projecten (ingezonden 8 juli 2010).

An MP asked the minister about a suspected fraud investigation into HFC-22 Clean Development Mechanism projects, including which projects and countries are involved, the Dutch money at stake, when misuse was detected, and what measures were taken. The minister confirmed the UN-level investigation, said it is too early to establish fraud, and referred to a letter for volumes and details while withholding the contract price as confidential.
The price agreed on behalf of VROM is confidential information that, under the contract terms, may not be made public.
De namens VROM overeengekomen prijs is vertrouwelijke informatie die op grond van contractvoorwaarden niet openbaar mag worden gemaakt.

Vragen van de leden Vermeij en Linhard (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de plannen voor de vestiging van een Landal-Greenpark bij Fort benoorden Spaarndam (ing

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister whether holiday homes (Landal-Greenpark) could be built near Fort benoorden Spaarndam within the World Heritage Stelling van Amsterdam and its buffer zone without harming heritage and nature values, and whether the national advisor and Parliament could review the plans. The minister answered that such building is only possible if World Heritage obligations are met, that the current plan would substantially alter the fort's open firing field, that the province as site holder bears responsibility for assessment, and that the national advisor could be involved on a provincial request.

It is up to the province, as site holder of the World Heritage site and as co-initiator, to demonstrate that the plan sufficiently safeguards, and at least does not harm, the Outstanding Universal Value of the area.

Het is aan de provincie, als siteholde r van het werelderfgoed en als mede-initiatiefnemer, om aan te tonen dat met het plan het behoud van de Outstanding Universal Value van het gebied voldoende wordt gewaarborgd, in elk geval niet wordt aangetast.

Vragen van het lid Van Bemmel (PVV) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het voornemen om elf gebieden in Nederland te gaan inrichten als grootschalige windmolenparken (ingezond

An MP from the PVV asked the minister whether plans to designate eleven areas as large wind farms, along with their landscape impact, cost and effect on natural areas, should be abandoned, and whether nuclear power would be a better alternative. The minister replied that the study is only a forward-looking report on onshore wind, not a concrete plan, that renewable energy targets are not cyclical and wind is the cheapest renewable, and that deciding on a new nuclear plant is up to the next cabinet.
The report referred to in the previous question concerns a study on the future development of onshore wind energy in the Netherlands.
Het rapport waarop in de vorige vraag werd gedoeld, betreft een studie over de toekomstige ontwikkeling van windenergie op land in Nederland

Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer, van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Justitie over mogelijke fraude en omkoping bij het uitdelen

An SP MP asked the ministers of VROM, Interior and Justice whether a royal honour awarded via the VROM ministry, allegedly obtained through fraud and bribery, warranted investigation, and how long and how many honours were linked to the retired chief of cabinet. The government replied that the honour followed standard advisory procedure, the Public Prosecution Service sees no basis for a criminal investigation, and the related alleged offences are time-barred, so no systematic review is planned.
Based on the information currently available, the Public Prosecution Service sees no reason to initiate a criminal investigation.
Het Openbaar Ministerie ziet op basis van de thans beschikbare informatie geen aanleiding tot het instellen van een strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het bericht «Maleisië dreigt met conflict over hout» (ingezonden 25 juni 2010).

An MP from the PVV asks the minister why the Dutch taxpayer must bear costs of objection procedures brought by environmental groups against the Malaysian timber certificate, which the TPAC found compliant, why no decision on admission has been taken while neighbouring countries approved it, and whether the government applies double standards on forest felling at home. The minister replies only that the questions cannot be answered within the statutory deadline and that answers will follow as soon as possible.
I hereby inform you that these questions cannot be answered within the time limit set for them.
Hierbij deel ik u mee dat deze vragen niet binnen de daarvoor gestelde termijn beantwoord kunnen worden.

Vragen van de leden Linhard en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de financiële risico’s van het Wieringerrandmeer (ingezonden 11 juni 2010).

Two PvdA MPs asked the housing and environment minister about financial risks of the Wieringerrandmeer project, including whether the provincial government's commercial risks, a 100-million-euro cost-benefit shortfall and a 30-million-euro aqueduct were approved or co-financed by the state. The minister replied only that answering, especially on financial supervision by the Interior Ministry, needs more time, and promised answers as soon as possible.
I will send you the answers as soon as possible.
Ik zal u de antwoorden zo spoedig mogelijk toesturen.

Vragen van het lid Koppejan (CDA) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over individuele watermeters in gebouwen met twee of meer stijgleidingen (ingezonden 2 juni 2010).

An MP asks the minister whether she can instruct the drinking water company Evides to use individual meters showing actual consumption in multi-riser buildings, and how this fits earlier calls for full metering. The minister replies that she lacks the power to give such an instruction, that meter installation is the water companies' responsibility, and points to Vewin model terms, the Consumentenautoriteit and the Geschillencommissie.
I do not have the authority to issue an instruction regarding the installation of water meters.
Ik heb niet de bevoegdheid om een aanwijzing te geven met betrekking tot het plaatsen van watermeters.

Vragen van de leden Vermeij en Linhard (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de plannen voor de vestiging van een Landal-Greenpark bij Fort benoorden Spaarndam (ing

Two PvdA MPs ask the housing and spatial planning minister whether a Landal Greenpark holiday-home development near Fort Benoorden Spaarndam, within the UNESCO-listed Stelling van Amsterdam and a national buffer zone, can proceed without harming cultural-historical and natural value, and whether the advisory landscape adviser and the Recreatieschap Spaarnwoude will be asked to assess it. The minister replies only that the questions cannot be answered within the deadline because of consultation with the Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed, and promises answers as soon as possible.
Unfortunately these questions cannot be answered within the set deadline, given the need for further consultation with the Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed.
Helaas kunnen deze vragen niet binnen de daarvoor gestelde termijn beantwoord worden, gezien de noodzaak tot nader overleg met de Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed.
Vragen van het lid Polderman (SP) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over verlies van GGO-koolzaad en het ontbrekend COGEM-advies (ingezonden 20 mei 2010).

An MP asks the minister about GM rapeseed spillage during transport, existing contamination, whether COGEM will test wild rapeseed, the safety assessment of approved GM varieties, and the missing COGEM advice on antibiotic resistance for the Amflora potato.
