The minister replies only that the answers cannot be given within the usual period and promises a response within three weeks.
The necessary information is not yet available. I will give you an answer to the questions posed within 3 weeks.
De noodzakelijke informatie is nog niet voorhanden. Ik zal u binnen 3 weken alsnog een antwoord geven op de gestelde vragen.
Vragen van het lid Algra (CDA) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de WABO (ingezonden 21 mei 2010).

An MP asked the housing minister about reports of possible further delays to the WABO's introduction, training gaps at municipalities, and measures to ensure a 1 July 2010 start. The minister replied that the introduction date is now 1 October 2010 under the entry-into-force decree, that training is provided and municipalities and provinces must embed it, and that IPO and VNG committed to a careful implementation.
The entry-into-force decree (Staatsblad 2010, 231) sets the introduction date at 1 October this year.
In het inwerkingstredings KB ( Staatsblad 2010, 231 ) is opgenomen dat de invoeringsdatum 1 oktober dit jaar is.

Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer, van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Justitie over mogelijke fraude en omkoping bij het uitdelen

An MP asks three ministers whether reported facts about alleged fraud and bribery in awarding a Royal honour via the VROM ministry are true, whether prosecution is possible, how long a retired chief of cabinet held his post, how many people he influenced, and whether the ministers will systematically check others, and asks about a related ABN-AMRO/Bouwfonds case. The reply to the question is a holding notice stating that interdepartmental coordination will take longer than the usual three-week period.
Answering the question, due to the required interdepartmental coordination, unfortunately takes more time than the usual three-week period.
Het beantwoorden van de vraag neemt, vanwege de vereiste interdepartementale afstemming, helaas meer tijd in beslag dan de gebruikelijke termijn van drie weken.

Vragen van het lid Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over toezeggingen aan de Drentse gedeputeerde Klip over het demonstratieproject

An SGP MP asks the ministers of Economic Affairs and Housing/Spatial Planning about commitments made to a Drenthe deputy regarding a northern CO2 storage demonstration project, and whether these are conditional on the Barendrecht pilot. The ministers answer that commitments cover communication, provincial participation and administrative consultation, that Barendrecht remains a necessary step and safety is guaranteed, and they decline to reconsider the agreements.
The cabinet committed during the recent consultation with the House not to take steps that would irreversibly lead to CO2 storage at Barendrecht, or strengthen Shell's legal position in this.

Het kabinet heeft tijdens het recente overleg met de Kamer toegezegd geen stappen te zullen zetten die onomkeerbaar leiden tot CO 2 -opslag bij Barendrecht, dan wel de juridische positie van Shell in deze versterken.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Spies (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer, van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Financiën over E85 (ingezonden 27 mei 2010).

MPs Omtzigt and Spies (CDA) asked eleven questions about E85 and high-blend biofuels: excise correction for different energy content, government priority for high blends, double counting of second-generation biofuels, traceability, the Platform Duurzame Mobiliteit, biohydrogen excise, the fuelling station subsidy programme, the EU energy taxation directive, cross-border coordination and lessons from other countries. The minister's reply is only an interim notice saying answers on excise reduction will take longer than the usual three weeks because related subsidy measures must be examined.
Answering the questions on excise reduction unfortunately takes more time than the usual three-week period, because the relationship with other subsidy measures in this area must be examined.

Het beantwoorden van de vragen met betrekking tot accijnskorting neemt helaas meer tijd in beslag dan de gebruikelijke termijn van drie weken, omdat de relatie met andere subsidiemaatregelen daaromtrent moet worden onderzocht.

Vragen van de leden Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink en Anker (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de uitsp

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked ministers about a Council of State ruling on noise nuisance from Leger des Heils church services in Zutphen, including whether the Activiteitenbesluit exemption for religious services distinguishes amplified from unamplified sound and whether the law should be amended. The minister answered that the ruling is a provisional measure, the legal procedure is not finished, so the cabinet cannot comment on the case, while confirming the exemption applies regardless of amplification.
The judgment of the chair of the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State concerns a provisional measures ruling.
Het oordeel van de voorzitter van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State betreft een voorlopige voorzieningsuitspraak.

Vragen van de leden Schinkelshoek en Ferrier (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over geluidsoverlast door het Kerkgen

MPs Schinkelshoek and Ferrier asked whether a noise dispute over Salvation Army gatherings in Zutphen, a site with religious use since 1856, should weigh in the assessment, and how the government would safeguard religious freedom and engage churches. The minister replied that the matter is for the courts given a pending interim ruling, that the Wet geluidhinder contains no church-specific requirements, and pointed to information on the Activiteitenbesluit, declining to go into the case further.
The cabinet therefore does not go further into the content of the interim ruling.
Het kabinet gaat derhalve niet nader in op de inhoud van de voorlopige uitspraak.
Vragen van het lid Poppe (SP) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over lpg-stations en opslag van andere gevaarlijke stoffen (ingezonden 22 april 2010)

Mr Poppe (SP) asked the minister whether the confidential Adviesraad Gevaarlijke Stoffen report on risks around LPG stations and hazardous-substance storage was known, whether current risk calculation methods remain valid, and how many such installations exist. The minister confirmed receipt of the report with a government response due within three months, said there is no acute need to change the methods for now, and stated there are about 1900 LPG stations and 850 hazardous-substance storage sites.
Yes, I have now received the report. In accordance with the Framework Act on advisory bodies, you can expect the cabinet response within three months.
Ja, ik heb het rapport inmiddels ontvangen. Overeenkomstig de Kaderwet adviescolleges kunt u de kabinetsreactie binnen drie maanden verwachten.

Vragen van het lid Bilder (CDA) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeer over berekeningen die worden gebruikt bij de risicobepaling van LPG-stations (ingezonden 22 april 2010).

An MP from the CDA asked the housing and environment minister whether she knew of an advisory council's claim that the risk calculations for LPG stations are wrong, whether the council had contacted the ministry, and what action would follow. The minister said omwonenden do not appear to face more danger than assumed, promised a position within three months after the council's response, and said no action is planned yet.
Once I have carefully studied the AGS report and received an assessment from the RIVM Centre for External Safety, I will draw my conclusions.
Zodra ik het rapport van de AGS zorgvuldig heb bestudeerd en een oordeel daarover van het Centrum Externe Veiligheid van het RIVM heb ontvangen, zal ik mijn conclusies trekken.

Vragen van de leden Boelhouwer en Heijnen (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het advies «Risicoberekening volgens voorschrift: een ritueel voor vergunningverleni

MPs Boelhouwer and Heijnen asked the minister whether the Advisory Council on Hazardous Substances' finding that the prescribed risk-calculation model gives a wrong picture of real risks, and whether training and advisory recommendations should be followed. The minister promised a considered position within three months, said the Dutch method is realistic and conservative, and declined to act ahead of that position, leaving the licensing decision with the competent authority.
Once I have carefully studied the Advisory Council's report and received a judgement on it from the RIVM Centre for External Safety, I will draw my conclusions.
Zodra ik het rapport van de Adviesraad zorgvuldig heb bestudeerd en een oordeel daarover van het Centrum Externe Veiligheid van het RIVM heb ontvangen, zal ik mijn conclusies trekken.

Vragen van de leden Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink en Ortega-Martijn (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Economische Zaken over het bericht dat Nederla

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked ministers about the European Commission's move to take the Netherlands to the European Court over Noord-Holland's requirement of organic or fairtrade coffee in a coffee-machine tender, and whether governments have enough clarity on sustainability criteria. The minister answered that the rules allow sustainability criteria meeting transparency, non-discrimination and proportionality principles, that the Commission's case is a question for the European Court, and that a factsheet and guidance on social criteria are being prepared.
It is desirable that this question be answered by the European Court of Justice.
Het is wenselijk dat deze vraag door het Europese Hof van Justitie wordt beantwoord.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de vergunningplicht voor zonnecollectoren en zonnepanelen (ingezonden 7 mei 2010).

MP Jansen (SP) asks the housing and environment minister whether municipalities must set welstand criteria for solar panels, whether building permits for solar installations should be simplified or dropped, and why permits are required for free-standing panels and tilted flat-roof collectors under current rules. The minister's reply is only an interim notice stating that the questions cannot be answered within the deadline and will be answered as soon as possible.

I hereby inform you that the parliamentary questions from MP Jansen (SP) to the Minister of Housing, Spatial Planning and the Environment on installing solar panels on homes cannot, unfortunately, be answered within the set deadline.

Hierbij deel ik u mede, dat de Kamervragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het aanbrengen van zonnepanelen op woningen, helaas niet binnen de gestelde termijn kunnen worden beantwoord.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Leeuwen (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over mantelzorgwoningen (ingezonden 6 mei 2010).

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of Housing and Health whether they are aware that municipalities, including Schiermonnikoog, struggle with rules on care-related annexes and temporary units, and asked for a clear letter on municipal rules, procedures and whether the municipality's dwangsom against family members is justified. The minister's reply is only a notice that the questions cannot be answered within the deadline because not all necessary information is available yet, and promises an answer as soon as possible.
Not all the necessary information needed to answer these parliamentary questions is yet available.
Voor de beantwoording van deze Kamervragen is nog niet alle noodzakelijke informatie voorhanden.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Spies (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Financiën over duurzame bio-ethanol (E85) (ingezonden 9 april 2010).

Two CDA MPs asked whether government fleet cars can run on E85 bio-ethanol, whether M85 biomethanol producers can get excise compensation for lower energy content, and which other sustainable fuels could qualify. The government answered that only 17 state fleet cars can use E85, that suppliers mainly blend biofuels, that an E85 excise refund was introduced from 1 April 2010 for demonstrably sustainable ethanol, and that M85 compensation is not currently relevant, while noting possible EU-level changes to excise tariffs.
Furthermore, M85 is more corrosive than E85, so the car industry withdraws the warranty when M85 is used.
Voorts is M85 meer corrosief dan E85, waardoor de auto-industrie bij gebruik van M85 de garantie laat vervallen.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het duurzaam inkopenbeleid en de keurmerken die daaronder vallen (ingezonden 22 april 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether products carrying the 'Ik kies bewust' health logo are bought under the sustainable procurement policy, which certification marks qualify, and whether the policy will be reassessed for its nature and environmental effects. The minister answered that the logo is not prescribed or promoted under the policy, that health of end users is left to national legislation, and that criteria will be updated in an ongoing consultation process.
Under the Sustainable Procurement policy, no 'Ik kies bewust' logos are prescribed or promoted.
Onder het Duurzaam Inkopen beleid worden geen «Ik kies bewust» logo’s voorgeschreven of gepropageerd.

Vragen van de leden Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink en Anker (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de uitsp

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the ministers of Housing and Environment and of Interior how the Council of State's ruling on noise from Leger des Heils church services in Zutphen should be read, specifically whether the Activiteitenbesluit exemption for church services distinguishes amplified from unamplified sound and whether the law will be adjusted for clarity. The government replied only that the questions need more time for interdepartmental coordination and will be answered later.
The answers to these questions cannot be given within the three-week period because more time is needed for interdepartmental coordination.
De beantwoording van deze vragen kan niet plaatsvinden binnen de gestelde termijn van drie weken omdat voor de interdepartementale afstemming van deze vragen meer tijd nodig is.

Vragen van de leden Schinkelshoek en Ferrier (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over geluidsoverlast door het Kerkgen

Two CDA MPs ask ministers whether the Salvation Army's Zutphen meeting place, used for worship since 1856, should weigh in the noise-nuisance dispute, and how to protect freedom of religion against neighbour complaints. The ministers' reply is only an interim notice: the questions cannot be answered within three weeks because interdepartmental coordination takes more time.
The answers to these questions cannot be given within the three-week deadline because interdepartmental coordination of these questions requires more time.
De beantwoording van deze vragen kan niet plaatsvinden binnen de gestelde termijn van drie weken omdat voor de interdepartementale afstemming van deze vragen meer tijd nodig is.
Vragen van het lid Neppérus (VVD) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over biomassa (ingezonden 19 maart 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether she knew of ongoing court cases against electricity companies over biomass storage and what she thought of temporary storage on agricultural land during plant outages, and where biomass should be stored during temporary or longer outages. The minister confirmed the court cases, said storage raises environmental and safety concerns requiring careful assessment under the Environmental Management Act, and that the competent authority, in consultation with the company, must find storage that meets legal requirements regardless of duration.
It is up to the competent authority, in good consultation with the company concerned, to find storage that meets the requirements of the Environmental Management Act.
Het is aan het bevoegd gezag om – in goede samenspraak met het bedrijf in kwestie – een opslag te vinden die voldoet aan de vereisten van de Wet milieubeheer.

Vragen van de leden Linhard en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de plannen voor de vestiging van een Landal-Greenpark bij Fort Benoorden Spaarndam (ing

MPs Linhard and Vermeij asked whether a proposed Landal Greenparks holiday park near Fort Benoorden Spaarndam, in a national buffer zone and the former fire field of the Stelling van Amsterdam World Heritage site, is permissible and how the recreation board's finances relate to it. The minister replied that the plan currently conflicts with national protection goals, that the province of Noord-Holland as site holder and a provincial structure vision must address it, and that the recreation board's finances depend partly on attracting market parties within national policy limits.
A first review shows that the plan is currently insufficiently compatible with the protection and development objectives the national government has set for this area.
Uit een eerste bestudering blijkt dat het plan nu onvoldoende verenigbaar is met de vastgestelde beschermings- en ontwikkelingsdoelen die het rijk voor dit gebied heeft.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Spies (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Financiën over duurzame bio-ethanol (E85) (ingezonden 9 april 2010).

Two CDA MPs asked whether government fleet cars can run on sustainable bio-ethanol E85 at a competitive price, why biomethanol producers have failed to get excise compensation for low energy content, and which other sustainable fuels could qualify. The government's reply is a procedural notice only: the answers are delayed by the need to count flexifuel vehicles in the state fleet and to coordinate across departments.
Answering the question takes longer than the usual three-week period, because of the need to check the number of flexifuel cars in the state fleet and to coordinate across departments.

Het beantwoorden van de vraag neemt, vanwege het nagaan van het aantal flexifuel auto’s in het wagenpark van het Rijk en de vereiste interdepartementale afstemming, helaas meer tijd in beslag dan de gebruikelijke termijn van drie weken.
Vragen van de leden Vietsch en Bilder (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de toenemende geluidsoverlast (ingezonden 10 december 2009).

Two CDA MPs asked the housing and environment minister about rising noise nuisance, its neglect in construction, effects on schools and offices, research needs, and best-practice initiatives with the construction sector. The minister rejected the claim that noise gets too little attention, cited RIVM and RANCH data on school noise, and offered only to support and possibly participate in a sector initiative.
No nationwide picture of the noise exposure of all government buildings is available.
Er is geen landsdekkend beeld van de geluidsbelasting van alle overheidsgebouwen beschikbaar.
Vragen van het lid Neppérus (VVD) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de uitgaven aan een klimaatspindoctor (ingezonden 26 maart 2010).

An MP asked the housing and environment minister about public spending on climate communications consultant Maurits Groen, including the nature and cost of his assignments, whether any are ongoing, whether a set of assignments breached European procurement rules, and whether the spending respected government communication principles given known IPCC errors. The minister listed the projects and costs, admitted that the Ketenstudies assignments exceeded the procurement threshold by EUR 5,218 and promised internal measures, and maintained that communication principles were followed.
I will ensure that internal measures are taken to prevent such cases as far as possible.
Ik zal erop toezien dat intern maatregelen worden getroffen om dergelijke gevallen zoveel mogelijk te voorkomen.

Vragen van het lid Koppejan (CDA) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over individuele watermeters in gebouwen met twee of meer stijgleidingen (ingezonden 3 februari 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether individual water meters installed by Evides in a Rotterdam flat, which measure only cold water, are fair and lawful, and about tenants' rights to refuse them. The minister confirmed the installation, stated individual metering is preferred but a case-by-case decision for water companies, and pointed tenants to the Consumentenautoriteit, Consuwijzer and the Geschillencommissie.
Individual metering enabling payment for (drinking) water based on individual consumption is certainly preferred.
Individuele bemetering waardoor betaling van (drink)water op basis van individueel verbruik mogelijk is, heeft zeker de voorkeur.

Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het aanbrengen van zonnepanelen op woningen (ingezonden 24 maart 2010).

An SP MP asked whether the Besluit omgevingsrecht limits solar panels to roofs, excluding facades, and whether it should be amended to leave facade placement to local welstand rules. The minister confirmed facade placement now requires a permit for architectural integration and local welstand review, and declined to amend the decree.
Collectors and panels are only exempt from permit requirements when installed on building roofs.
Collectoren en panelen zijn alleen vergunningvrij bij plaatsing op daken van gebouwen.
Vragen van het lid Poppe (SP) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de verkoop van DSM Agro (ingezonden 1 april 2010).

An SP MP asked the environment minister about the sale of DSM Agro to Orascom, the reason for the book loss, whether the state environmental compensation was reflected in the price, and whether the ammonia transport convenant binds the buyer. The minister answered that the sale is a share transaction, the book loss is 10-20 million, the compensation is a legal entitlement not state aid, and DSM Agro remains bound by the convenant and confirmed it will honour the two-phase schedule.
I cannot assess to what extent this damage compensation played a role in determining the sale price.
Ik kan niet beoordelen in hoeverre deze schadevergoeding een rol heeft gespeeld bij de vaststelling van de verkoopprijs.

Vragen van de leden Smits en Langkamp (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en voor Jeugd en Gezin over het bericht dat de Raad van Europa aangeeft dat de mosquito in strijd is met he

Two SP MPs asked whether the Council of Europe's view that the Mosquito anti-loitering device violates the ECHR and the UN Children's Rights Convention would be adopted, what it means for municipalities, and whether alternatives are offered. The minister answered that the Assembly's recommendation is not yet final, the government considers Mosquito use undesirable and does not intend to facilitate or regulate it, and it is consulting VNG on a model by-law and guidance for municipalities.
The cabinet therefore considers, as it also stated in response to the Human Rights Commissioner's report, that use of the Mosquito in the Netherlands is undesirable.
Het kabinet vindt daarom, zoals het ook heeft aangegeven in reactie op het rapport van de Mensenrechtencommissaris, dat het gebruik van de Mosquito in Nederland ongewenst is

Vragen van de leden Van Bochove, Blanksma-van den Heuvel, Jan Jacob van Dijk en Koopmans (allen CDA) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer, van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Economisc

Four CDA MPs asked ministers about recent road works on the A325 between Arnhem and Nijmegen, including whether the Waalsprong housing plans fit regional accessibility, the reserved corridor for an A73 extension, and consultation of businesses during works. The minister replied that the plans fit regional spatial plans, that the national government is funding a second Nijmegen bridge and road investments, that the A73 extension is left to the region, and that the municipality is responsible for consulting businesses through information evenings and platform meetings.
It is up to the municipality of Nijmegen to determine how it wants to do this.
Het is aan de gemeente Nijmegen om te bepalen hoe zij dit wil doen.

Vragen van de leden Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink en Ortega-Martijn (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Economische Zaken over bedrijventerreinen (ing

MPs from the ChristenUnie asked the ministers of VROM and Economic Affairs about overplanning and fragmented regional cooperation in industrial estates, citing Han Olden's thesis, and whether provinces and municipalities are adequately held to account. The government replied that the 2010–2020 covenant with IPO and VNG, the SER-ladder and provincial restructuring programmes will ensure careful planning, rejected claims of collective government failure, and promised evaluations in 2013 and 2015 without reopening the covenant.
We trust that the covenant agreements and the application of the SER-ladder will lead to careful planning of industrial estates.
Wij vertrouwen erop dat de afspraken in het convenant en het hanteren van de SER-ladder zal leiden tot een zorgvuldige planning van bedrijventerreinen.
Vragen van het lid Poppe (SP) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de met asbest vervuilde V&D-vestiging in Hoorn (ingezonden 28 januari 2010).

An SP MP asked the housing and environment minister how asbestos contamination at the V&D store in Hoorn was allowed to persist for years, whether inspectorates failed to act, and whether an asbestos inventory duty should be reinstated. The minister acknowledged the seriousness, confirmed V&D knew of asbestos since 1994, and said the municipality and Labour Inspectorate were only alerted in 2008; he declined to answer questions on worker compensation and the 2007 drilling order, and pointed to ongoing criminal proceedings and a company-wide asbestos inventory.

As far as could be established, there were no renovations in the preceding period requiring a building or demolition permit, so the municipality and Labour Inspectorate were not earlier aware of the situation.
Voor zover kon worden nagegaan zijn er in de periode daarvoor geen verbouwingen geweest waarvoor een bouw- of sloopvergunning vereist was.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de effectiviteit van de regelgeving voor de bescherming van

The MP asks the ministers about the effectiveness of the international and Dutch rules protecting Antarctica, including tourism growth, permit numbers, environmental assessments and monitoring. The minister replies that the regime works in practice though not watertight, reports 14 permits granted since 2007 and about 32,000 landing tourists in 2007-08, and says monitoring of tourism effects is still being organised, with results possibly reported in 2010.
If this report becomes available, I am willing to send it to the House.
Ik ben bereid, indien deze rapportage beschikbaar komt, deze aan de Kamer te zenden.

Vragen van het lid Poppe (SP) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over onderschepping van transporten met illegaal giftig afval uit Duitsland (ingezonden 5 maart 2010).

MP Poppe (SP) asked the minister whether the interception of illegal toxic waste shipments from Germany to Vietnam through Rotterdam was a chance find or part of targeted enforcement, and what rules, sanctions and enforcement gaps apply. The minister replied that the interception followed risk-based customs selection, that Germany issued no export permit, that the Basel Convention, EVOA and Wet Milieubeheer were breached, that sanctions were imposed and the waste returned, and that the EU Commission is studying enforcement minimum standards.
The risk indicators and the resulting enforcement priorities are jointly established and recorded by the VROM-Inspectie and Customs.
De risico-indicatoren en de daarop gebaseerde prioriteiten in het toezicht worden door de VROM-Inspectie en de Douane gezamenlijk vastgesteld en vastgelegd.
Vragen van het lid Vendrik (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over katoen dat onterecht als «biologisch» verkocht is. (Ingezonden 4 februari 2010)

An MP asked the government whether Dutch clothing firms, like German ones, wrongly sold cotton as organic and whether import controls and supply-chain transparency are adequate. The minister said the cabinet cannot confirm or deny this since it has no oversight role over private certification labels, pointed to CSR policy and SER cooperation, and noted a possible new dispute-settlement mechanism.
This can formally be neither confirmed nor denied, because the cabinet has no supervisory role regarding the validity of private certification labels.
Dit kan formeel worden bevestigd noch worden ontkracht, omdat het kabinet geen controlerende functie heeft inzake de validiteit van private keurmerken.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de gevolgen van vuurwerk (ingezonden 5 februari 2010).

MP Ouwehand asks ministers about injuries from fireworks, including eye injuries rising 10% and most victims being bystanders, and whether a ban on consumer fireworks should be introduced. The government answers that it does not consider a ban effective or supported by society and politics, and maintains its policy of legal consumer fireworks with strict enforcement and information campaigns.
The fact remains that opinion polls show only 10 to 15% of the Dutch support such a ban.
Feit blijft dat uit opiniepeiling blijkt dat slechts 10 à 15% van de Nederlanders voorstander is van zo’n verbod.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer, van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Financiën over de regeling groenprojecten (ingezonden 3 februa

An MP asked ministers why green financing has been slow, whether it can cover biological shops and restaurants and comfort-class barns, and whether banks should finance protein-transition projects. The ministers answered that criteria were tightened, banks decide credit themselves, the regulation was delayed by EU approval, and that protein-transition projects can qualify via existing categories.

Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het bericht «Climategate: professor geeft «beroerde mails» toe» (ingezonden 3 maart 2010).

An MP asks the minister whether the Climategate revelations, including Phil Jones admitting to 'bad emails' and refusing data to sceptics, should be taken seriously, and whether the omission of warming periods by East Anglia is a scandal warranting controversial designation of the climate dossier. The minister replies that the meaning of 'beroerd' is unclear, that KNMI says the MP misrepresents Jones and that all warming periods are visible in the reconstruction, and that it is for the Chamber to decide which dossiers are controversial.
It is for the House to decide which dossiers it wishes to treat as controversial.
Het is aan de Kamer om te bepalen welke dossiers het als controversieel wil behandelen.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over een nieuwe blunder van het IPCC (ingezonden 5 februari 2010).

An MP asks the minister about a reported error in the IPCC report, questioning whether the Netherlands Environmental Assessment Agency (PBL) is an appropriate party to investigate it and disputing its figure that 55% of the Netherlands lies below sea level. The minister replies that PBL will conduct the review with integrity, that the KNAW will appoint an independent scientific committee to supervise the evaluation, and that PBL used existing CBS data and was not part of the Beat the Heat Now coalition.

Moreover, I have, partly at the request of PBL, asked the Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences (KNAW) to establish a scientific committee that will act as an independent supervisor of PBL's evaluation.

Daarenboven heb ik, mede op verzoek van het PBL, de Koninklijke Nederlandse Akademie van Wetenschappen (KNAW) verzocht een wetenschappelijke commissie in te stellen, die zal fungeren als onafhankelijk toezichthouder bij de evaluatie door het PBL.
Vragen van het lid Poppe (SP) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over een EVOA-beschikking (ingezonden 19 februari 2010).

The MP asks why an EVOA waste-shipment decision contains two conflicting versions of annex 1B and whether fraud or oversight failures occurred. The minister replies that only one version was valid, that SenterNovem made stamped amendments with the notifier's agreement, that no fraud occurred, and that SenterNovem's role is administrative rather than supervisory.
The file NL201867 does not contain conflicting annexes IB.
Het dossier NL201867 kent geen tegenstrijdige bijlagen IB.
Vragen van het lid Poppe (SP) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het terughalen van afval uit Polen. (ingezonden 4 februari 2010)

An SP MP asked the minister to send the decisions and attachments on Essent's waste export to Poland, whether the Public Prosecution Service is investigating a criminal complaint by SenterNovem, and how much waste Essent has taken back. The minister said the documents are partly confidential and placed with the clerk's office, confirmed a criminal investigation without details, and reported that nearly all exported waste (about 4,000 tons) has been returned, with about 60 tons still awaiting collection.
In the interest of the investigation, I cannot provide further information on that.
In het belang van het onderzoek kan ik daar verder geen mededelingen over doen.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het bericht «Emissiehandel: Hackers jatten CO2-credits» (ingezonden 8 februari 2010).

An MP asks the minister about reports of hackers stealing CO2 emission credits, and disputes the link between human CO2 emissions and warming. The minister confirms awareness of the hacking reports, states that the IPCC attributes most recent warming to humans, notes the attempted intrusion was unsuccessful in the Netherlands with extra safeguards added, and explains CO2's role in the greenhouse effect.
In the Netherlands this did not succeed, because additional security measures were quickly taken.
In Nederland is dit niet gelukt, omdat er snel extra veiligheidsmaatregelen zijn genomen.

Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het bericht dat het IPCC toegeeft dat zij fouten heeft gemaakt (ingezonden 22 januari 2010).

An MP from the PVV asked the environment minister whether IPCC admitted errors undermine its climate conclusions, whether Dutch funding should stop, and whether climate policy should be dropped in favour of tangible environmental policy. The minister replied that KNMI and PBL say the errors do not affect the IPCC's main conclusions, rejected the qualifications, and defended precautionary climate policy.
According to the KNMI and PBL, the identified errors do not detract from the main conclusions of the IPCC.
Volgens het KNMI en PBL doen de geconstateerde fouten niets af aan de hoofdconclusies van het IPCC.

Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het bericht dat het Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) foutieve informatie heeft gepubliceerd

An MP from the PVV asks the minister whether she knows of reports that the IPCC published wrong glacier-melt figures, whether this disqualifies the IPCC as a partner on climate policy, whether its dependence on government funding compromises its science, and whether climate targets based on IPCC data should be revised. The minister acknowledges the errors as worrying, says a letter was sent to the IPCC chair requesting an explanation and an audit, defends the IPCC's funding and consensus process, and rejects revising climate targets.
My predecessor sent a letter to the chair of the IPCC expressing her concern about these errors.
Mijn ambtsvoorganger heeft een brief aan de voorzitter van het IPCC gestuurd waarin zij haar verontrusting heeft uitgesproken over deze fouten

Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het bericht dat Phil Jones toegeeft dat er geen opwarming plaats heeft gevonden sinds 1995 en dat warmere pe

An MP asks the minister whether press reports that IPCC-linked scientist Phil Jones conceded no warming since 1995 and past warm periods without human influence should halt Dutch climate policy. The minister answers that Jones's remarks were misinterpreted, that a temporary stagnation does not prove humans do not contribute to warming, and that policy rests on the best available science.
I base my policy on the best available science on climate change, regardless of whether it becomes colder or warmer.
Ik baseer mijn beleid op de best beschikbare wetenschap op het gebied van klimaatverandering, ongeacht of het nou kouder of warmer wordt.

Two PVV MPs asked whether Dutch climate policy should stop relying on IPCC reports after alleged fraud and data manipulation, and whether the government should urge the IPCC to return its Nobel Peace Prize. The minister replied that errors were made but the main IPCC conclusions stand, so climate policy will not change, and that the IPCC's work is indispensable so the prize should not be returned.
Errors were indeed made in the IPCC report. My predecessor already shared these concerns with the House and asked the chair of the IPCC to have the errors investigated.

In het IPCC rapport zijn inderdaad fouten gemaakt. Mijn ambtsvoorganger heeft de zorgen hierover reeds met uw Kamer gedeeld en de voorzitter van het IPCC gevraagd om de gemaakte fouten te laten onderzoeken.

Member De Mos (PVV) asked the minister of Housing, Spatial Planning and the Environment about reports that US temperature data had been manipulated, questioning the reliability of global temperature measurements and whether climate policy spending should wait for clarification. The minister answered that the KNMI found the trends confirmed by several institutes, that the reduction in weather stations did not cause a break in the global temperature trend, and that the IPCC conclusion on human-caused warming stands.
This KNMI commentary shows among other things that the trends are confirmed by the various institutes.
Uit dit KNMI commentaar blijkt onder meer dat de trends door de verschillende instituten worden bevestigd.

MP De Mos asks the Minister of Housing, Spatial Planning and the Environment whether the 'climategate' scandal and reports on withheld Chinese weather station data undermine IPCC-based climate policy, and whether climate policy should be put on hold. The minister says the scandal does not reduce confidence in the IPCC's work, points to independent inquiries by the University of East Anglia and the Russell review, and promises to send their results to the Chamber.
As soon as the results of each of these investigations are available, I will send them to the Chamber and, if desired, discuss them with the Chamber.
Zodra de uitkomsten van elk van deze onderzoeken beschikbaar zijn, zal ik die de Kamer toesturen en daar desgewenst met de Kamer over van gedachten te wisselen.

An MP asked the housing and environment minister whether the IPCC misled on rapid glacier melt, how the IPCC handled alarming third-party information, which studies used it, and whether the government would investigate. The minister acknowledged errors in the IPCC process, pointed to a PBL review overseen by the Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences, and said the prime minister's predecessor asked the IPCC chair for an independent inquiry.
My predecessor has promised your House that PBL, the Netherlands Environmental Assessment Agency, will examine this matter.
Mijn ambtsvoorganger heeft uw Kamer toegezegd dat PBL, het Planbureau voor de Leefomgeving, deze zaak zal onderzoeken.

An MP asks the housing and spatial planning minister whether a study questioning the need for the Noordmanshoek business park in Olst-Wijhe is accepted, whether the VROM-Inspectie can still review a new draft zoning plan without a new pre-draft, and whether an independent study should be done. The minister declines to judge the study, says the SER-ladder is applied through provincial rules and that the inspectorate can still object and appeal, and says it is not for her to decide on an independent study.
It is not for me to judge whether an independent study should take place.
Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen of er een onafhankelijk onderzoek moet plaatsvinden.

An SP MP asked whether the government still stands by its view that the 2009 simplification of water board levies caused no unfair shifts, given sharp 2010 rises in Delfland and Rijnland, and whether it will work for more moderate household tariffs. The state secretary answered that the 2009 shifts matched expectations, that tariff setting lies with the water boards, that Delfland's rises stem from new treatment plant investments and flood-protection projects, and that a benchmark and a Delfland-specific study were started.
The general board of the water boards sets the tariffs.
Het algemeen bestuur van de waterschappen stelt de tarieven vast.

MP Atsma (CDA) asked the state secretary of Transport and Water Management about the poor weather and the failure of the KNMI to issue a weather alarm on 17 December 2009, and about the promised regional weather alarm. The state secretary answered that the disruption was serious, that the weather was not extreme enough to be foreseen as severe, that new criteria and protocols were sent to parliament, and that a regionalised weather alarm would be introduced on 1 February 2010 developed in consultation with market parties.
As communicated there, I sent the Chamber the criteria and protocol for a new weather alarm before the end of the year.
Zoals daar meegedeeld heb ik voor het einde van het jaar de Kamer de criteria en protocollering voor een nieuw weeralarm doen toekomen.

MP Ouwehand asks the State Secretary and ministers about the use of steel and phosphorus slag in dike foreshore reinforcement in the Oosterschelde, raising ecological risks, leaching, the 14-year-old soil quality standards, alternatives such as natural rock, and whether environmental assessments addressed these effects. The text only contains the questions and a notice that the answers will be delayed because interdepartmental consultation takes longer than the three-week deadline.
The answering of these questions cannot take place within the set period of three weeks because more time is needed for interdepartmental coordination on these questions.
De beantwoording van deze vragen kan niet plaatsvinden binnen de gestelde termijn van drie weken omdat voor de interdepartementale afstemming over deze vragen meer tijd nodig is.

qa: Beantwoording vragen van het lid Oualhadj over de situatie omtrent de ingreep bij Nexperia

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Economic Affairs for a full account of the cabinet's decision-making, legal basis, proportionality, foreign and EU coordination, and lessons learned behind the Goods Availability Act order against Nexperia, including why it remained in force after the Enterprise Chamber intervened. The Minister answered that the order was a proportionate, exceptional last resort to protect chip production capacity, pointed to an earlier timeline shared with parliament, and committed to a later evaluation, while declining to publish the detailed assessment framework and criteria in full.
That is why the cabinet is keeping the order in reserve, so that the ultimate goal, preserving very strategic capacity in legacy chips, can also be achieved in the long term.

Daarom houdt het kabinet het bevel achter de hand, zodat het uiteindelijke doel, namelijk het behouden van zeer strategische capaciteit op legacy chips, ook op de lange termijn verwezenlijkt kan worden.
